harivaṃśapurāṇe atha divyadhvanerante jainasya tadanantaram | cakrustadanusaṃdhānaṃ devā dunduminiḥsvanāḥ ||18|| puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ pravarṣanto rasnavṛṣṭiṃ ca tuṣṭuvuḥ | devāstatra vanoddeśe muhuścaikaṃ mahāmunim ||18|| taṃ niśamya muniśreṣṭhaṃ pūjyamānaṃ sureśvaraiḥ | śreṇiko gautamaṃ natvā papraccha bahuvismayaḥ ||183|| bhagavan ! brūhi kināmā muniḥ suragaṇairayam | pūjyate pūjya ! kiṃvaṃśaḥ prāpto vā'dya kimadbhutam ||18|| gadatisma tatastasmai vismitāya gatasmayaḥ | āgamānumitijñāpyavijñeyaḥ śrutakevalī ||185|| śrīmano'sya mahārāja ! śṛṇu śreṇika sanmateḥ | mune ma ca vaṃśaṃ ca māhātmyaṃ ca vadāmi te ||186|| jitaśatraḥ kṣitau khyāto dharitrīpatiratra yaḥ | prāpta eva dharitrīśa! bhavataḥ śrotragocaram ||187|| harivaṃśanabhobhānurabhimatanṛpasthitiḥ| rājya śriyaṃ parityajya prāvājījinasaṃnidhau ||18|| tapo duṣkaramanyeṣāṃ bāhyamādhyātmikaṃ ca saḥ | kṛtvā prāpto'dya ghātyante kevalajñānamadabhutam ||189|| tenāyamamaraiḥ sarvairjanamārgopavṛṃhakaiḥ | sa punarbodhilāmārtha bhaktito'tyarcito yatiḥ ||19|| punaḥ pragamya bhaktyā'sau samutakutūhalaḥ | pṛcchati sma gaṇādhīśamiti śreṇikabhapatiḥ ||19|| ka eṣa bhagavān ! vaṃśo hariśabdopalakṣitaḥ | jātaḥ kadā kva vā kīrtyaḥ ko vāsya prabhavaḥ pumān ||192|| keyantaḥ samatikrāntāḥ prajārakṣaṇadakṣiṇāḥ | dharmārthakāmamokṣāḍhyā harivaṃśakṣitīśvarāḥ ||193|| iha bhāratajātānāṃ jinānāṃ cakravartinām | halināṃ vāsudevānāṃ tathā caiṣāṃ pratidviṣām ||19||
prakāra jinendra bhagavānako saddharmadeśanā jagattrayake jīvoṃkī samasta bhrāntiko śānta kara detī hai ||180|| athānantara jinendra bhagavānkī divyadhvanike bāda devoṃne usakā anusandhāna kiyā| tathā kucha deva, dandabhike samāna śabda karate, puṣpavṛṣṭi evaṃ ratnavaṣṭi karate hae vanake eka deśameṃ sthita eka mahāmunikī stuti karane lage ||181-182|| indroṃke dvārā pūjita una śreṣṭha munikā nāma sunakara atyadhika āścaryase yukta rājā śreṇikane gautama svāmīko namaskāra kara pūchā ||183|| ki he bhagavan ! he pūjya ! kṛpā kara kahie ki deva loga jinako pūjā kara rahe haiṃ aise ye muni kisa nāmake dhāraka haiṃ ? inakā kyā vaṃśa hai ? aura āja kisa atiśayako prāpta hue haiṃ ? ||184|| tadanantara jinakā ahaṃkāra naṣṭa ho gayā thā aura jinhoṃne āgama tathā anumānake dvārā jānane yogya padārthoṃ ko jāna liyā thā aise śrutakevalī śrīgautama svāmī, āścaryase bhare hue rājā śreṇikase kahane lage ki ||185|| he mahārāja śreṇika ! maiṃ sadbuddhike dhāraka ina śrīmān munirājakā nāma, vaṃśa aura māhātmya saba tumhāre lie kahatā hū~ so śravaṇa kara ||186|| he pṛthivīpate ! isa pṛthivīpara jo jitaśatru nāmakā prasiddha rājā thā vaha āpake karṇagocara huā hogā ||187|| jo harivaṃśarūpī ākāśakā sūrya thā, jisane anya rājāoṃkī sthitiko abhibhūta kara diyā thā, jisane rājyalakṣmīkā parityāga kara jinendradevake samīpa pravrajyā-dīkṣā dhāraṇa kī thī tathā jisane anya logoṃke lie kaṭhina bāhya aura ābhyantara tapa kiyā thā āja vahī rājā jitaśatru ghātiyā karmoko naṣṭa kara āścarya utpanna karanevāle kevalajñānako prāpta huā hai ||188-189|| isīlie jinamārgakī prabhāvanā karanevāle samasta devoṃne milakara ratnatrayakī prāptike lie bhaktipūrvaka ina munirājakī pūjā kī hai ||190||

cāra aura tīna yojana raha jātā hai ||38|| tadanantara pradeśoṃmeṃ vṛddhi honese brahma-brahmottara nāmaka pā~caveṃ svargake antameṃ kramaśaḥ sāta, pā~ca aura cāra yojana vistṛta ho jāte haiṃ ||39|| punaḥ pradeśoṃmeṃ hāni honese mokṣa sthānake samīpa kramase pā~ca, cāra aura tīna yojana vistṛta raha jāte haiṃ ||40|| tadanantara lokake ūpara pahuṃcakara ghanodadhi vātavalaya ādhā yojana arthāt do kosa, ghanavāta valaya usase ādhā arthāt eka kosa aura tanuvātavalaya usase kucha kama arthāt pandrahase pacahattara dhanuṣa pramāṇa vistṛta hai ||41|| tīnoṃ vātavalayoṃse ghirā huā yaha loka aisā jāna paḍa़tā hai māno mahāloka jītanekī icchāse kavacoṃse hī āveṣṭita huā ho ||42||
___ isa lokameṃ pahalī ratnaprabhā, dūsarī śakaṃrāprabhā, tīsarī bālukāprabhā, cauthī paṃkaprabhā, pāṃcavīṃ dhūmaprabhā, chaṭhavīṃ tamaḥprabhā aura sātavoṃ mahātamaḥprabhā ye sāta bhūmiyā~ haiṃ| ye sātoṃ bhūmiyā~ tīnoṃ vātavalayoṃpara adhiṣṭhita tathā kramase nove-nīce sthita haiṃ| antameṃ calakara ye sabhī adholokake nīce sthita ghanodadhivātavalaya para adhiṣṭhita haiṃ ||43-45|| ina pṛthiviyoṃke rūḍha़i nāma kramase gharmā, vaṃśā, meghā, aṃjanā, ariṣṭā, maghavī aura mādhavī bhī haiṃ ||46|| pahalī ratnaprabhā pṛthivī eka lākha assī hajāra yojana moṭī hai tathā khara bhāga, paṃka bhāga aura abbahula bhāga ina tīna bhāgoṃmeṃ vibhakta hai ||47|| pahalā khara bhāga solaha hajāra yojana moṭā hai, dūsarā paṃka bhāga caurāsī hajāra yojana moṭā hai aura tīsarā abbahula bhāga assī hajāra yojana moṭā hai ||48-49|| paṃka bhāgako rākṣasoṃ tathā asurakumāroṃke ratnamayī dedīpyamāna bhavana yathā kramase suśobhita kara rahe haiṃ ||50|| tathā khara bhāgako nau bhavanavāsiyoṃke mahākāntise yukta, svayaṃ jagamagāte hue nānā prakārake bhavana alaṃkṛta kara rahe haiṃ ||51|| khara bhāgake 1 citrā, 2 vajrā, 3 vaiḍūrya, 4 lohitāṃka, 5 masāragalba, 6 gomeda, 7 pravāla, 8 jyoti, 9 rasa, 10 aṃjana, 11 aṃjanamūla, 12 aṃga, 13 sphaṭika, 14 candrābha, 15 varcaska aura 16 bahuśilāmaya ye solaha paṭala haiṃ ||52-54|| inameṃ se pratyeka paṭalako moṭāī eka-eka hajāra yojana hai tathā dedīpyamāna khara bhāga ina solaha paṭala 1. gomedha-ka.|

caturthaḥ sargaḥ catuḥṣaṣṭirmahādikṣu ṣaṣṭireva vidikṣu ca | ārasyāpi śataṃ miśraṃ caturviṃśatisaṃmatam ||129|| ṣaṣṭireva mahādikṣa ṣaṭpañcāśadvidikṣa ca | tārasyāpi ca tanmiśraṃ ṣoḍaśāgraṃ śataṃ matam ||13|| ṣaṭpañcāśanmahādikṣu dvāpañcāśadvidikṣu ca | mārasyāpi ca tanminaṃ matamaṣṭottaraṃ śatam ||131|| bāpañcāśanmahādikṣu catvāriṃśat sahāṣṭamiḥ | varcaskasya vidikṣu syāttanmibhaṃ śatameva tu ||132|| catvāriṃśat sahāṣṭābhirmahādikṣa vidikṣa tu | tamakasya caturmiśca yutaṃ vā navatirdvayam ||133|| catvāriṃśacaturbhiśca mahādikṣu vidikṣu tu | catvāriṃśat khaḍasyeyamaśītiścaturuttarā ||33|| : catvāriṃśanmahādikṣa ṣaṭtriṃśacca vidikṣu ca | yutā khaḍakhaḍasyeva ṣaṭsaptatirudāhṛtā ||13|| indrakaiḥ saha sapta syuḥ śatānyetāni sapta ca | śreṇībaddhāni sarvāṇi narakāṇyatra saṃmavāt || 136|| lakṣā navasahasrāṇi navatirnavamiḥ saha | navatiśca tribhiryuktā dviśatī ca prakīrṇakāḥ ||13|| ṣaṭatriṃśaca mahādikṣa dvātriṃśattu vidikṣa tat | tamaḥśruteyaṃ miśramaṣṭāṣaṣṭirudāhṛtā ||13|| dvātriṃśaśca mahādikṣa, 'bhramasyāṣṭau ca viṃśatiḥ | vidikṣa miśritaṃ tacca ṣaṣṭiriṣṭā manīṣibhiḥ ||139|| bhaṣṭāviṃśatiruddiṣṭā mahādikṣu vidikṣa tu | śreṣasya caturūnā syāvāpañcāśadvayaṃ yutā ||140|| caturviśatirandhrasya mahādikṣa vidikṣu tu | viṃśatimiśriyaṃ tasya catvāriṃśañcaturyutā ||14|| viṃśatistu mahādikṣu vidikṣvapi ca ṣoḍaśa | tamisrasya vimiśraṃ tat ṣaṭ triṃśannarakāṇi tu ||142||

prakāra pā~cavīṃ pṛthivīmeṃ pā~ca indraka vila milākara samasta indraka aura śreṇibaddha viloṃko saṃkhyā do sau paiṃsaṭha hai| tathā do lākha ninyānabe hajāra sāta sau paiṃtīsa prakīrṇaka vila haiṃ aura saba milakara tīna lākha vila haiṃ ||143-144|| chaṭhavīṃ pṛthivī sambandhī prathama prastārake hima nāmaka indrakakī cāroṃ mahādiśāoṃmeṃ solaha, vidiśāoṃmeṃ bāraha aura donoṃke milākara adāīsa śreṇivaddha | haiṃ ||145|| dūsare prastārake vardala nāmaka indrakakī cāroṃ mahādiśāoṃmeṃ bāraha, vidiśāoṃmeṃ āṭha aura donoṃke milākara bīsa śreṇibaddha vila haiṃ ||146|| aura tīsare prastārake lallaka nāmaka indrakakī cāroṃ mahādiśāoṃmeṃ āṭha, vidiśāoṃmeṃ cāra aura donoṃke milākara bāraha śreṇibaddha vila haiṃ||147|| isa prakāra chaṭhavīṃ pṛthivīke tīna prastāroṃmeṃ tīna indrakoṃkī saṃkhyā milākara vesaṭha indraka
aura śreṇibaddha vila haiṃ tathā ninyānabe hajāra nau sau battīsa prakīrṇaka vila haiṃ aura saba milakara pā~ca kama eka lākha vila haiṃ | ye sabhī vila prāṇiyoṃke lie duḥkhase sahana karane ke yogya haiṃ ||148-149||
sātavīṃ pṛthivīmeṃ eka hī prastāra hai aura usake bīca meṃ apratiṣṭhāna nāmaka indraka hai usakī cāroṃ diśāoṃmeṃ cāra śreṇibaddha vila haiṃ| isakī vidiśāoṃmeṃ vila nahīṃ haiṃ tathā prakīrṇaka vila bhī isa pṛthivī meṃ nahīṃ haiṃ| eka indraka aura cāra śreṇibaddha donoṃ milakara pāṃca vila haiṃ ||150|||
voke prathama prastārameṃ jo sīmantaka nāmakā indraka vila hai usakī pūrva diśāmeṃ kāṃkṣa, paścima diśāmeṃ mahākāṃkṣa, dakṣiṇa diśāmeṃ pipāsa aura uttara diśāmeṃ atipipāsa nāmake cāra prasiddha mahānaraka haiṃ | ye mahānaraka indraka vilake nikaṭa meṃ sthita haiṃ tathā durvarṇa nārakiyoṃse vyāpta haiṃ ||151-152|| dūsarī pṛthivīke prathama prastārameṃ jo taraka nāmakā indra ke vila hai usakī pūrva diśāmeṃ aniccha, paścima diśāmeṃ mahāniccha, dakṣiṇa diśāmeṃ vindhya aura uttara diśāmeṃ mahāvindhya nāmake prasiddha mahānaraka sthita haiṃ ||153|| tīsarī pṛthivīke prathama prastāra meṃ jo tapta nāmakā indraka vila hai usako pūrva diśāmeṃ duḥkha, paścima diśā meṃ mahāduḥkha, dakṣiṇa diśāmeṃ vedanā aura paścima diśāmeṃ mahāvedanā nāmake cāra prasiddha mahānaraka haiṃ ||254|| cauthī pathivīke prathama prastārameṃ jo āra nāmakā indraka vila hai, usako pūrva diśāmeṃ niḥsaṣṭa, paścima diśāmeṃ atiniḥsṛṣṭa, dakṣiṇa diśāmeṃ nirodha aura uttara diśāmeṃ mahānirodha nāmake cāra prasiddha mahānaraka haiṃ ||155|| pāṃcavoṃ pṛthivīke prathama prastārameṃ jo tama nāmakā indraka hai usakī

nīlākhyaśca mahānīlo nirayo maghavākṣito | dikṣa paṅkamahāpaṅko himanāmnastathā sthitaḥ ||157|| sthitāḥ kālamahākālaroravā nirayāstathā | mahārauravanāmā ca svāpratiṣṭhānadikṣa te ||158|| navatiśca sahasrāṇi triśatī ca prakīrṇakāḥ | lakṣāścaiva vyaśītiḥ syuścatvāriṃśacca saptabhiḥ ||159|| sahasrāṇi nava śreṇī-gatānāṃ ṣaṭśatīndrakaiḥ | tribhiḥ pañcāśatā lakṣā aśītiścaturuttarā ||16|| teṣu saṃkhyeyavistārāḥ ṣaḍūlakṣāḥ prathamakṣitau | santyasaṃkhyeyavistārāścaturviṃśatireva tāḥ ||161|| santi saṃkhyeyavistārāḥ pañcalakṣāstu viṃśatiḥ | tato'saṃkhyeyavistārā narakaughā hyadhaḥkṣitau ||162|| lakṣāstisrastṛtīyāyāṃ khyātāḥ saṃkhyeyayojanāḥ | asaṃkhyeyāstu vistārā lakṣā dvādaśa tu kṣitau ||163|| lakṣadvayaṃ caturthā tu nārakāṇāṃ kṣitau tataḥ | saṃkhyeyayojanānāṃ syādanyeṣāmaṣṭa lakṣitāḥ ||164|| adhaḥpaṣṭisahasrāṇi saṃkhyayā dhvanitānyataḥ | catvāriṃśatsahasrāṇi dvilakṣāṇyaparāgyapi || 165|| ekonaviṃśatiḥ ṣaṣṭayāṃ sahasrāṇi navottarā | navatirnavaśatyāmā saṃkhyeyā dhvanitāni tu ||166|| saptatiśca sahasrāṇi navāsaṃkhyeyayojanāḥ | śatāni nārakāvālā navaṣaṇṇavatistviha ||167|| eka saṃkhyeyavistāraṃ saptamyāṃ narakaṃ matam | tato'saṃkhyeyavistāraṃ narakāṇāṃ catuṣṭayam ||168|| tatra saṃkhyeyavistārā indrakāḥ sarva eva te | śreṇībaddhāstvasaṃkhyeyavistārā narakālayāḥ ||169|| kecit saṃkhyeyavistārāḥ sarvabhūmiprakīrṇakāḥ | ke'pyasaṃkhyayavistārā itthaṃ te tūbhayātmakāḥ ||17||
pūrva diśāmeṃ niruddha, paścima diśāmeṃ atiniruddha, dakṣiṇameṃ vimardana aura uttarameṃ mahāvimardana nāmake cāra prasiddha mahānaraka sthita haiṃ ||156|| chaṭhavīṃ pṛthivīke prathama prastārameṃ jo hima nāmakā indraka vila hai usakī pūrva diśāmeṃ nīla, paścima diśāmeṃ mahānīla, dakṣiṇameṃ paṃka aura uttarameṃ mahāpaṃka nāmake cāra prasiddha mahānaraka sthita haiṃ ||157|| aura sātavoṃ pṛthivīmeṃ jo apratiṣṭhāna nāmakā indraka hai usakī pūrva diśāmeṃ kāla, paścima diśāmeṃ mahākāla, dakṣiṇa diśāmeṃ raurava aura uttara diśāmeṃ mahārorava nāmake cāra prasiddha mahānaraka haiṃ ||158|| isa prakāra sātoṃ pṛthiviyoṃmeṃ terāsī lākha, nabbe hajāra, tīna sau saiṃtālisa prakīrṇaka, nau hajāra chaha sau śreṇibaddha, unacāsa indraka aura saba milākara caurāsī lākha vila haiṃ ||159-160||
prathama pṛthivīke tīsa lākha viloṃmeṃ chaha lākha vila saṃkhyāta yojana vistāra vāle haiṃ aura caubīsa lākha vila asaṃkhyāta yojana vistāravāle haiṃ ||131|| usake nīce dūsarī pṛthivīmeṃ pāṃca lākha saṃkhyāta yojana vistāravāle aura bosa lākha asaṃkhyāta yojana vistāravāle vila haiṃ ||162|| tīsarī pṛthivīmeṃ tīna lākha saṃkhyāta yojana vistāravāle aura bāraha lākha asaṃkhyāta yojana vistāravāle vila haiṃ ||163|| cauthī pṛthivīmeṃ do lākha vila saṃkhyāta yojana vistāravāle haiṃ aura āṭha lākha asaṃkhyāta yojana vistāravāle haiṃ ||164|| pāṃcavīṃ pṛthvīmeṃ sāṭha hajāra vila saṃkhyāta yojana vistāravāle haiṃ aura do lākha cālīsa hajāra vila asaṃkhyāta yojana vistāravāle haiṃ ||165|| chaṭhavīṃ pathivīmeṃ unnīsa hajāra nau sau ninyānabe vila saṃkhyātayojana vistāravāle haiṃ aura unyāsī dvaja nau sau chiyānabe vila asaṃkhyāta yojana vistāravāle haiṃ ||166-167|| sātavīṃ pathivīmeṃ eka arthāt bīcakā indraka vila saṃkhyāta yojana vistāravālā hai aura cāroṃ diśāoṃke cāra vila asaṃkhyāta yojana vistāravāle haiṃ ||168|| sātoṃ pṛthiviyoṃmeṃ jo indraka vila haiṃ ve saba saṃkhyāta yojana vistāravāle haiṃ, tathā śreṇibaddha vila asaṃkhyāta yojana vistāravāle haiṃ aura prakīrṇaka viloṃmeṃ kitane hī saṃkhyāta yojana vistāravāle tathā kitane ho asaṃkhyāta yojana vistāravāle haiṃ isa taraha ubhaya vistāravāle haiṃ ||169-170||

caturthaḥ sargaḥ vanakasyāpi vistāraḥ triṃśallakṣāḥ śatatrayam | trayastriṃśatsahasrāṇi trayastriṃśastribhāgavān ||18|| ghāṭasya viśatirlakṣā nava paṭpaṣṭiśca paṭaśatam | catvāriṃśatsahasrāṇi saikāni vyaṃśako hi saḥ ||18|| aṣṭāviṃśatilakṣāstu vistāraḥ parikīrtitaḥ | sa pañcāśat sahasrāṇi saṃghāṭasya nirantaraḥ||189|| saptaviṃśatilakṣāḥ sa trayastriṃśaṃ śatatrayam | pañcāśacca sahasrāṇi sāṣṭau jihvastribhāgavān ||19|| lakṣāḥ paḍviṃśatiḥoktāḥ sapaṭapa pṭipahasikāḥ| paṭakṣaṣṭiḥ ṣaṭśatī dhyaṃśau vistāro jibikāśrayaḥ||19|| pañcaviṃśatilakṣāstu lolasya parikīrtitaḥ | sahasrāṇi ca vistāraḥ samastaḥ pañcapaptatiḥ ||19|| caturviśatilakṣāśca lolupasya vibhāgān | jyaśotiśca sahasrāṇi triśatī triṃśatā brayam ||193|| trayoviṃśatilakṣāstu vistāraḥ stanalolupe | sahasrāyekanavatityaṃśau ṣaṭṣaṣṭi ṣaṭśatam ||14|| trayoviṃśatilakṣāstu tapte dvāviṃśatiḥ pare | tribhāgo'ṣṭau sahasrāṇi trayastriṃśacchatatrayam ||195|| ekaviṃśatilakṣā vai sahasrāṇi ca poḍaśa | tapanasya tribhāgau ca ṣaṭṣaṣṭiḥ ṣaṭśatī ca saḥ ||196|| lakṣāḥ viṃśatiruddiṣṭā munimiḥ pañcaviṃśatiḥ | sahasrāṇi ca vistārastāpanasyāpi sarvataḥ ||197|| ekonaviṃśatirlakṣā nidāghasya śatatrayam | trayastriṃśatvahasrāṇi tribhāgastriṃśatā ayam ||198|| sa cāṣṭādaśa lakṣāstāḥ ghaṭpaṣṭiḥ ṣoḍaśātmakam | śataṃ prajvalitasyāsau catvāriṃśatsahasrakaiḥ ||199|| lakṣāḥ saptadaśa proktā vistārastatvadarśimiḥ | sahaivojjvalitasyāsau catvāriṃśasahasrakaiḥ ||20|| lakṣāḥ ṣoḍaśa vistāro hyaṣṭāpañcāśadapyataḥ | sahasrāṇi triṃśatyaṃśaśitsaṃjvalite trimiḥ ||20||

tīsarī pṛthivīke pahale tapta nāmaka indrakakā vistāra teīsa lākha yojana hai| dūsare tapita indrakakā vistāra bāīsa lākha āṭha hajāra tīna sau taiṃtīsa yojana aura eka yojanake tīna bhāgoṃmeṃ eka bhāga pramāṇa hai ||195| tīsare tapana indrakakā vistāra ekkīsa lākha solaha hajāra chaha sau chiyāsaṭha yojana aura eka yojanake tīna bhāgoṃmeṃ do bhāga pramāṇa hai ||196|| cauthe tāpana nāmaka indrakakā vistāra muniyoṃne saba ora bīsa lākha paccīsa hajāra yojana kahā hai ||197|| pāṃcaveṃ nidāgha nāmaka indrakakā vistāra unnīsa lākha taiṃtīsa hajāra tīna sau taiṃtīsa yojana aura eka yojanake tīna bhāgoṃmeṃ eka bhāga pramāṇa hai ||128|| chaṭhaveṃ prajvalita indrakakā vistāra aṭhāraha lākha ikatālīsa hajāra chaha sau chiyāsaṭha yojana hai ||199|| sātaveṃ ujjvalita indrakakā vistāra tattvadarśī ācāryoṃne satraha lākha cālīsa hajāra yojana batalāyā hai ||200|| āṭhaveṃ saṃjvalita indrakakā vistāra solaha lākha aṃṭhāvana hajāra tīna sau taiṃtīsa yojana aura eka yojanake tīna bhāgoṃmeṃ eka bhāga pramāṇa hai ||201|| aura nauveṃ saṃprajvalita indrakakā vistāra pandraha lākha

chiyāsaṭha hajāra chaha sau chiyāsaṭha yojana aura eka yojanake tīna bhāgoṃmeṃ eka bhāga pramāṇa hai ||202||
cauthī pṛthivīke āra nāmaka pahale indrakakā vistāra saba ora caudaha lākha pacahattara hajāra yojana kahā hai ||203|| dūsare tāra indrakakā vistāra teraha lākha terāsī hajāra tīna sau taiṃtīsa yojana aura eka yojanake tīna bhāgoṃmeṃ eka bhāga pramāṇa hai ||204|| tīsare māra nāmaka indrakakā vistāra bāraha lākha ekānabe hajāra chaha sau chiyāsaṭha yojana aura eka yojanake tīna bhāgoṃmeṃ do bhāga pramāṇa hai ||205|| cauthe varcaska indrakakā vistāra bāraha lākha yojana hai| pāṃcaveṃ tanaka indrakakā vistāra gyāraha lākha āṭha hajāra tīna sau taiṃtīsa yojana aura eka yojanake tīna bhāgoṃ meṃ eka bhāga pramāṇa hai ||206|| chaṭhaveṃ khaḍa indrakakā vistāra daśa lākha solaha hajāra chaha sau chiyāsaṭha yojana aura eka yojanake tīna bhāgoṃmeṃ do bhāga hai||207|| aura sātaveṃ khaḍakhaḍa nāmaka indrakakā vistāra jānakāra ācāryoṃne nau lākha paccīsa hajāra yojana kahā hai ||208||
pā~cavoṃ pṛthivīke pahale tama nāmaka indrakakā vistāra āṭha lākha taiṃtīsa hajāra tīna sau taiṃtīsa yojana aura eka yojanake tīna bhāgoṃmeṃ eka bhāga pramāṇa hai ||209|| dūsare bhrama indrakakā vistāra sāta lākha ikatālīsa hajāra chaha sau chiyāsaṭha yojana aura eka yojanake tīna bhāgoṃmeṃ do bhāga hai ||210|| tīsare jhaṣa indrakakā vistāra chaha lākha pacāsa hajāra yojana kahā gayā hai ||211|| cauthe andhra nāmaka indrakakā vistāra pāṃca lākha aṃṭhāvana hajāra tīna sau taiṃtīsa yojana aura eka yojanake tīna bhāgoṃmeṃ eka bhāga pramāṇa vaṇita hai ||212|| aura pāṃcaveṃ tamisra nāmaka indrakakā vistāra cāra lākha chiyāsaṭha hajāra chaha sau chiyāsaṭha yojana aura eka yojanake tīna bhāgoṃ meṃ do bhāga pramāṇa hai ||213||
chaṭhavīṃ pṛthivīke pahale hima nāmaka indrakakā vistāra nirmala kevalajñānake dhārī arahanta bhagavānne tīna lākha pacahattara hajāra yojana batalāyā hai ||214|| dūsare vardala indrakakā vistāra do lākha terāsī hajāra tīna sau taiṃtīsa yojana aura eka yojanake tīna bhāgoṃmeṃ eka bhāga pramāṇa hai ||215|| aura tosara lallaka indrakakā vistāra eka lākha ekānabe hajāra chaha so chiyāsaṭha yojana aura eka yojanake tīna bhāgoṃmeṃ do bhāga pramāṇa hai ||216||

caturthaḥ sargaḥ kevalaiva tu lakṣakā yojanānāṃ prakīrtitaḥ | apratiṣṭhānavistāro vastuvistaravedimiḥ ||217|| indrakeṣu ca bāhulyaṃ dharmāyāṃ krośa eva ca | śreṇiveṣu sa satyaśo dvau savyaṃśau prakīrṇake ||21|| krośaḥ sārdhastu vaṃśāyāmindrakeṣu tadīritam | śrejīgateṣu tu kośau trayaḥ sārdhāḥ prakīrṇake ||219|| meghāyābhindra kapūktaṃ bāhulyaṃ kośayoyam | sa dvivyaṃ tacchaṇyāṃ saṃyukta tatprakīṇake ||22|| sādhī dvāvindvavetī catayāṃ śakastrayaḥ| śreṇyāṃkana keṣvete ṣaḍbhāgaiḥ pañca pañcabhiḥ ||221|| indrakepu vayaḥ krośāśvatvāraḥ śreyupāśrayaḥ | sa prakīrṇakeṣvete pañcamyāmupavarṇitāḥ ||222|| sārdhāḥ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ trayaḥ krośā indrakai śreṇyupāśritāḥ| catvārasvayaṃśa kāṭaute padabhāgāḥ prakīrṇake ||223|| saptamyāmapratighāne catvāraste samucchudhāḥ | śreṇibaddheṣu pacava satribhāgāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ||224|| yojanānāṃ cataḥṣaṣṭiḥ śatāni prathama kṣitī: jatina valayakā koragośvayaṃ tathā ||225|| bogadvādaśabhāgāśca tathaikādaśāpare | indrakāṇāmidaṃ śeyakamā madaraṃ budhaiḥ ||226|| catāpaṣṭiśatānyeva navatiśca navottarā | śreṇīgatāntaraṃ krośī māpanāśakāḥ ||227|| navatirnava caitāni catuḥpaṣṭiśatāni tat | kośāḥ saptadaśārogā kośapatriṃśadaṃśakāḥ ||22|| indrakāṇāṃ dvitīyāyāṃ pṛthivyāṃ tu pṛthuśrutāḥ | tadyojanaśatānyāhurekānnatripadantaram ||229|| nava miśca navatyā ca yojanaiḥ sahitāni tu | catvāriṃśacchatairyukā tathā saptadhanuḥśatī ||230|| tāvantyeva ca jāyante yojanānyanyayā'nayā| śroṇicaddhasthitānāṃ ca yā padāgiddhanuḥśatī ||23||

nidāghe'pyavareṣaiva sthitiḥ samupavarṇitā | parā tu navabhāgābhyāṃ sāgarāḥ pañca saṃcitāḥ ||27|| ajaghanyā nidāghe yā saiva prajvalite'nyathā | ṣaḍnavāṃśakasaṃmiśrā parā pañca payodhayaḥ ||275|| parā prajvalite yeyaṃ seva cojjvalite'parā | tathā sanavamāgāste ṣaṭsamudrāḥ parā sthitiḥ ||276|| utkṛṣṭojjvalite yeyaṃ saiva saṃjvalite'varā | sapañcanavamāgāste paramā ṣaṭa payodhayaḥ ||27|| sā saṃprajvalite hīnā parā sāgarasaptakam | tṛtīyanarake te'mī prasiddhāḥ sapta sāgarāḥ ||27|| yā saṃprajvalite dīrghā hasvā''re sā prakīrtitā | dīrghā sapta samudrāste saptabhāgāstathā trayaḥ ||289|| āre yā paramā proktā tāre saṃvāparā sthitiḥ | parā sapta samudrāste ṣaḍbhiḥ saptamabhāgakaiḥ||28|| tāre yā paramā proktā maiva māre'varā sthitiḥ | saha saptamamāgābhyāṃ parā'pyaṣṭau payodhayaḥ ||281|| māre tu yā parā saiva varcaske varṇitā'varā | pañcasaptamamāgaistu parāṣṭa jalarāśayaḥ ||22|| varcaske paramā yā'sau tamake'pyavarā sthitiḥ | parā saptamabhāgena saṃyuktā nava sāgarāḥ ||283|| parā tu tamake yā'sau jaghanyā sā ṣaḍe mata|| caturbhiḥ saptamairmāgaiḥ parā'pi nava sāgarāḥ ||28|| ṣaḍe tu paramā yā'sau hīnā ṣaḍaṣaḍe'pyasau | catuthyā suprasiddhāste parā tu daśa sāgarāḥ ||285||

tīsarī pathivīke tapta nāmaka prathama prastārameṃ nārakiyoṃke śarīrako ū~cāī satraha dhanuṣa, eka hātha, daśa aṃgula aura eka aṃgulake tīna bhāgoṃmeṃ do bhāga pramāṇa kahī gayī hai ||317|| spaṣṭa jñāna rūpī iṣṭa dṛṣṭiko dhāraṇa karanevāle tapita nāmaka dūsare prastārameṃ nārakiyoṃkī ū~cāī unnīsa dhanuṣa nau aṃgula aura eka aṃgulake tīna bhāgoṃmeṃ eka bhāga pramāṇa batalāyo hai ||318|| śiṣṭajanoṃne tapana nāmaka tīsare prastārameṃ nārakiyoṃke śarīrakā utsedha bosa dhanuṣa tīna hātha aura āṭha aṃgula pramāṇa batalāyā hai ||319|| tāpana nāmaka cauthe prastārameṃ nārakiyoṃke śarīrakī ūṃcāī bāīsa dhanuṣa do hātha cha: aṃgala aura eka aṃgalake tīna bhāgoṃmeṃ do bhāga pramāṇa kahī gayī hai|| 20|| nidāgha nāmaka pāṃcaveṃ prastārameṃ caubīsa dhanuṣa, eka hātha, pāṃca aṃgala aura eka aṃgalake tīna bhāgoṃmeṃ eka bhāga pramāṇa ūṃcāī vidvānoṃne batalāyī hai ||321|| jinakī ātmā jñānake dvārā dedīpyamāna hai aise ācāryoṃne projjvalina nāmaka chaṭhaveṃ prastārameṃ nārakiyoṃkī ū~cāī chabbīsa dhanuṣa aura cāra aṃgula pramāṇa batalāyī hai ||322|| āgamajñānase suśobhita vidvajjanoṃne ujjvalita nāmaka sātaveṃ prastārameṃ nārakiyoṃkā śarīra sattāīsa dhanuṣa, tīna hātha, do aṃgula aura eka aṃgula ke tīna bhāgoṃmeṃ do bhāga pramāṇa ū~cā kahā hai ||323|| vidvānoṃko saṃjvalita nāmaka āṭhaveṃ prastārameṃ nārakiyoṃkī ū~cāī untīsa dhanuṣa, do hātha eka aṃgulake tīna bhāgoṃmeṃ eka bhāga pramāṇa jānanā cāhie ||324|| aura saṃprajvalita nāmaka nauveṃ prastārameṃ ū~cāīkā pramāṇa ekatīsa dhanuṣa tathā

pacatriṃśaddhanaṃdhyāre dvau hastāvaṅa gulānyapi | viṃśatiḥ saptabhāgāśca catvāraḥ saṃprakīrtitaḥ || 336 || ranriṃśatathā tāre daṇḍā saptadaśāṅgulī | ekaḥ saptamabhāgaḥ syādutsedho nārakāśrayaḥ || 327|| catvāriṃśacaturbhiśca daṇḍā hastau trayodaśa | aṅgulāni mato māre saptabhāgaiḥ sa pañcabhiḥ || 328 || dhanūṃṣye konapañcāśadutsedhaḥ sa daśāṅgulī | dvau ca saptamabhāgau tau varcaske varṇito budhaiḥ ||329|| dhanūṃṣi satripañcāśadstau cāpi ṣaḍaṅgulī | ṣaṭ ca saptamabhāgāste tamake parikīrtitaḥ || 320 || aṣṭāpacāśadutsedho dhanūṃṣi vyaṅgulāni ca | trayaḥ saptamabhāgāśca ṣaḍe'pi prakaṭasthitaḥ || 331 || dviṣaṣṭistu dhanūṃṣi dvau hastī ṣaḍapaḍe mataḥ | utsedhaḥ suprasiddho yaścaturthe narake satām || 332 || tamonāmani coraledhaḥ kodaṇḍāḥ pañcasaptatiḥ | saptāśītirasau daṇḍā dvau hastau bhavati bhrame || 333|| vapuṣo nārakoyasya - śaṣe śatadhanūṃṣi saḥ | andhe dvādaśamiśrāṇi tāni hastadvayaṃ matam ||334 || mitre'pi ca tānyeva pañcaviṃśatidaṇḍakaiḥ | utsedho varṇito yo'sau pañcame narake budhaiḥ || 335|| ṣaṭṣaṣṭayā śatakodaṇḍā dvau hastau ṣoḍaśāṅgulī | utsedho varṇitaḥ pūrṇo himanāmani cendrake || 336 || dviśatyaṣṭau ca kodaṇḍā hasto'ṣṭāvaṅgulānyapi | utsedhaḥ śāstra netrāḍyairvardale'pi vilokitaḥ || 334|| śatadvayaṃ ca pañcāśaddhanūṃṣyeva sa māsitaḥ | lallake narake ṣaṣṭhe niṣṭhitārthairyaṃ iṣyate ||338||
eka hātha pramāṇa kahā jātā hai| isa prakāra tīsarī pṛthivīmeṃ nārakiyoṃkī ū~cāīkā varṇana kiyā || 325 ||

cauthī pṛthivīke āra nāmaka prathama prastārameṃ paiṃtīsa dhanuṣa, do hātha, bīsa aṃgula aura eka aṃgula sāta bhāgoṃ meṃ cāra bhāga pramāṇa ū~cāī kaho gayī haiṃ || 326 || tāra nāmaka dūsare prastārameṃ cālīsa dhanuṣa, satraha aṃgula aura eka aṃgulake sāta bhāgoṃ meṃ eka bhāga pramāṇa nārakiyoṃkī ū~cāī hai || 327|| māra nāmaka tīsare prastāra meṃ cavālīsa dhanuṣa, do hātha, teraha aṃgula aura eka aṃgulake sāta bhāgoṃ meṃ pāṃca bhāga pramāṇa ūṃcāī mānī gayī hai || 328 || varcaska nāmaka cauthe prastārameṃ vidvānoṃne śarīra kī ū~cāī unacāsa dhanuṣa, daśa aṃgula aura eka aṃgulake sāta bhāgoṃ meṃ do bhāga pramāṇa batalāyī hai || 329|| tamaka nāmaka pā~caveṃ prastārameṃ trepana dhanuṣa, do hātha, cha: aṃgula aura eka aṃgulake sāta bhāgoṃ meṃ chaḥ bhāga pramāṇa ū~cāī kahī gayī hai || 330 || ṣaḍa nāmaka chaṭhaveṃ prastārameṃ aṭhāvana dhanuṣa, tīna aṃgula aura eka aṃgulake sāta bhāgoṃ meṃ tīna pramāṇa ū~cāī prakaṭa kī gayī hai ||331|| aura ṣaḍabaḍa nāmaka sātaveṃ prastārameṃ bāsaṭha dhanuṣa, do hātha ū~cāī prasiddha hai | isa prakāra cauthī pṛthivī meṃ vidyamāna nārakiyoṃkī ūṃcāīkā varṇana kiyā hai ||332 ||
pā~cavīṃ pṛthivīke tama nāmaka prathama prastāra meṃ nārakiyoṃke śarīrakī ū~cāī pacahattara dhanuṣa batalāyī hai | bhrama nāmaka dūsare prastāra meṃ sattāsī dhanuṣa aura do hātha hai ||333 || jhaṣa nāmaka tīsare prastāra meṃ nārakiyoṃke śarīra kī ū~cāī so dhanuṣa kahī gayī hai | andha nāmaka cauthe prastārameṃ eka sau bāraha dhanuṣa tathā do hātha hai ||334|| aura tamisra nāmaka pā~caveṃ prastāra meṃ eka sau paccīsa dhanuṣa hai | isa prakāra pāṃcavīṃ pṛthivo meṃ vidvānoṃne ūṃcāīkā varṇana kiyā hai ||335 ||
chatrapṛthivīke hima nāmaka prathama prastāra meṃ nārakiyoṃke śarīrakī ūṃcāī eka sau chayāsaṭha dhanuṣa, do hātha tathā solaha aṃgula batalāyī hai ||336 || vardala nāmaka dūsare prastāra meṃ śāstrarūpī netroṃke dhāraka vidvānoṃne nārakiyoṃkī ū~cāī do sau āṭha dhanuṣa, eka hātha aura cha: aṃgula pramāṇa dekhī hai ||337|| aura lallaka nāmaka tīsare prastāra meṃ nārakiyoṃko ū~cāī do sau pacāsa dhanuṣa batalāyī hai | isa prakāra kṛtakṛtya sarvajña devane chaṭhavīṃ pṛthivīmeṃ ū~cāīkā varṇana kiyā ||338 || sātavīṃ

utsedhaścāpratiṣṭhāne pañcacāpaśatāni saḥ | niścito niścitajñānaiḥ saptame narake ca yaḥ ||339|| saptasu pratiboddhavyaḥ prathitaḥ prathamādiṣu | avadherviṣayastāsu pṛthivīṣu yathākramam ||34|| yojanaṃ ta trayaḥ krośāḥ sārdhā krośatrayaṃ tathā | sādhauṃ tau tavayaṃ sādhaḥ krośaḥ krośaśca niścitaḥ||341|| krośārddha mṛttikāgandhaḥ prathame paṭale vrajet | tadadho'dhaḥ krośasyā varddhate paṭalaṃ prati ||342|| pṛthivyorādyayoryuktā jīvāḥ kāpotaleśyayā | tṛtīyāyāṃ tayaivordhvamadhastānīlaleśyayā ||34|| adhaścovaṃ ca saṃbaddhāścaturthyāṃ nīlaleśyayā | tayaivopari pañcamyāmadhaste kṛṣṇaleśyayā ||344|| ṣaṣṭyāṃ ca kṛṣṇayaivolamadhaḥ paramakṛṣṇayā | saptamyāmumayatrāmī kliṣṭāḥ paramakṛṣṇayā ||345|| sparśanoṣṇena bādhyante nārakā bhūcatuṣṭaye | pañcamyāmuṣṇaśītābhyāṃ śītenaivāntyayorbhuvoḥ ||346|| ākāraṇoṣṭrikākumnīkusthalīmudgaropamāḥ | mṛdaṅganāḍikākārā nigodā pṛthivotraye ||347|| gogajāśvādimastrāma droṇyabjapuṭasaṃnibhāḥ | te catuthyāṃ ca pañcamyāṃ nārakotpattibhūmayaḥ ||348|| kedārākṛtayaḥ kecitjhallarīmallakopamāḥ | kecinmayūrakākārā nigodāste'nsyayorbhuvoḥ ||349|| ekadvitrikagavyūtiyojanavyāsasaṃgatāḥ | śatayojanavistīrṇāsteṣūtkṛṣṭāstu varṇitāḥ ||350|| ucchrāyo vastutasteṣāṃ vistāraḥ pañcatāḍitaḥ | nigodānāṃ samastānāmiti vastuvido viduḥ ||351||

caturthaḥ sargaḥ
tṛtīyāyāḥ dvitīyāyā prathamāyāśca niḥsṛtaḥ | tīrthakṛttvaṃ labhetāpi dehī darśanaśuddhitaḥ ||381|| balakeśavacakritvaṃ parihatyaiva jantavaḥ | naratvaṃ pratipadyaran narakebhyo vinirgatāḥ ||382|| adholokavibhāgaste saṃkṣepeṇa mayoditaḥ | tiryaglokavimāgasya śṛṇu śreṇika ! saṃgraham ||383||
śārdūlavikrīḍitam sūryācandramasāmagocaramadholokāndhakāraṃ budhāḥ
pradhvaṃsyā''ptavacaḥpradīpavimavaiḥ sarvatragaiḥ sarvadā | paśyantaḥ prabhavanti tattvamiti kiṃ citraṃ trilokyākṛtā
vāloke jinabhānunā viracite dhvāntasya vā kva sthitiḥ ||384||
ityāriṣṭanemipurāṇasaṃgrahe harivaṃśe jinasenācāryakṛtī adholokasaṃsthānavarṇano nāma caturthaḥ sargaḥ ||4||
huā jīva samyagdarśanakī śuddhatāse tīrthaṃkara pada prāpta kara sakatā hai ||381|| narakoṃse nikale hue jīva balabhadra, nārāyaṇa aura cakravartī pada choḍa़kara hī manuṣya paryāya prāpta kara sakate haiṃ arthāt manuṣya to hote haiṃ para balabhadra, nārāyaṇa aura cakravartī nahīṃ ho sakate ||382|| gautama svāmī kahate haiṃ ki he śreṇika ! isa prakāra maiṃne saṃkṣepase tere lie adho lokake vibhāgakā varṇana kiyā| aba tū tiryagloka-madhyama lokake vibhāgakā varṇana suna ||383||
baddhimāna manuṣya saba samaya. sarvatra vyāpta rahanevāle. jinendra bhagavānake vacana rūpī uttama dopakoṃko sāmarthya se sūrya aura candramāke agocara adholokake andhakārako naṣṭakara vastuke yathārtha svarūpako dekhate hue prabhutvako prāpta hote haiṃ isameṃ kyā āścarya hai ? kyoṃki tīna lokameṃ jinendra rūpī sūryake dvārā prakāśake utpanna honepara andhakārakā sadbhāva kahā~ raha sakatā hai ? ||384|| isa prakāra jisameṃ ariṣṭanemike purāṇakā saṃgraha kiyā gayā hai aise jinasenācārya praṇīta
harivaṃśapurāṇameṃ adholokakā varṇana karanevālā cauthā sarga samāpta huā ||4||
1. budhaḥ ma. | 2. pradhvastāpta | 3. trilokākṛtā-ma., vilokyākṛtā-kha., gha, ṅa. |

pūrvāparāntayoradaraṣṭāśīti catuḥśatī | pramāṇaṃ bhujayorasya bhāgāḥ ṣoḍaśa cādhikāḥ ||39|| ṣaṭkalā maratajyonā saikā saptatiroritā | catuḥśatīvimiśrāṇi sahasrāṇi caturdaśa ||40|| caturdaśasahasrāṇi pañcaśatyā tu viṃśatiḥ | aṣṭāmiaurataṃ bhāgā dhanurekādaśādhikāḥ ||41|| śatāni pañcaviṃśatyā saha ṣaḍbhiśca ṣaṭ kalāḥ | prasiddhayamiṣurbhāṣyā dhanuṣastasya bhāratī ||42|| aṣṭādaśaśatī proktā cūlikā pañcasaptatiḥ | ardhasaptamabhāgāśca sādhikā bharatakṣiteḥ ||43|| sahasramekamaṣṭau ca śatāni navatirdvayam | sādhikārdhāṣṭamāṃśāśca pūrvāparabhujaprabhā ||44|| śatayojanamānaḥ syāducchāyo himavagireḥ | avagāhastu tasyaiva pañcaviṃśatiyojanaḥ ||45|| yojanānāṃ sahasraṃ tu dvāpañcāśatsamanvitam | dvādaśāpi kalāḥ proktā vistāro himavagireḥ||46|| caturviśatirasyādreḥ sahasrāṇi śatānyapi | nava dvātriṃśatā jyā syādīṣadūnakalottarā ||17|| pañcaviṃśatirasyaiva sahasrāṇi śatadvayam | yojanāni dhanustriṃśaccatasraḥ sādhikā kalāḥ ||48|| sahasraṃ pañcaśatyekamaṣṭāsaptatireva ca | kalā cāṣṭādaśaivāriṣureṣā'sya māṣitā ||49|| yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇa pañca tāni śatadvayam | triṃśaccūlikā'syādurbhāgāḥ sapta ca sādhikāḥ ||50|| pañcavāsya sahasrāṇi pañcāśacca śatatrayam | sādhikā na to bāhū bhāgāḥ pañcadaśādhikāḥ||51|| bhāntyekādaśa kūṭāni haimasya himavagireḥ | śikhare'sya niviṣṭāni patyā pūrvaparātmanā ||52|| siddhāyatanakūṭaṃ prāk himavatkūṭamapyataḥ | kūṭaṃ bharatasaṃjñaṃ syādilākūṭaṃ tataḥ param ||53|| gaṅgākūṭaṃ śriyaḥ kūṭaṃ rohitāsyādikaṃ ca tat | sindhukūṭaṃ surādevīkūṭa haimavataṃ ca yat ||54|| kūṭaṃ vaiśravaṇākhyaṃ tu pāścāttyaṃ parikīrtitam | pañcaviṃśatirucchāyaḥ sarveṣāṃ yojanāni tu ||55|| pañcaviṃśatireva syād vistāro mūlagocaraḥ | arddha trayodaśāgre'ntaḥ' pādonaikonaviṃśatiḥ ||56||
batalāyī hai ||38|| vijayādha parvatakī pūrva-paścima bhujāoṃkā vistāra cāra sau aṭhāsī yojana tathā kucha adhika solaha kalā pramāṇa hai ||39|| bharata kṣetrako pratyaṃcā caudaha hajāra cāra sau ikahattara yojana aura kucha kama chaha kalā hai ||40|| isakā dhanu:pṛṣṭha caudaha hajāra pā~ca sau aṭṭhāīsa yojana tathā gyāraha kalā pramāṇa hai ||41|| bharatakṣetra sambandhī dhanuḥpṛṣṭhake bāṇakā vistāra pāṃca sau chabbīsa yojana aura chaha kalā pramāṇa prasiddha hai ||42|| bharata kṣetrakī cūlikā aṭhāraha sau pacahattara yojana tathā kucha adhika sāḍha़e chaha bhāga batalāyī hai ||43|| isako pūrva-paścima bhujāoṃkā vistāra eka hajāra āṭha sau bānabe yojana tathā kucha adhika sāḍha़e sāta bhāga hai ||44|| himavān kulācalakī ūṃcāī sau yojana, gaharāī pacīsa yojana aura cauḍa़āī eka hajāra bāvana yojana tathā bāraha kalā pramāṇa kahī gayī hai ||45-46|| isa himavat kulācalako pratyaṃcākā pramāṇa caubīsa hajāra nau sau battīsa yojana tathā kucha kama eka kalā pramāṇa batalāyā hai ||47-48|| isakā bāṇa eka hajāra pāṃca sau aṭhahattara yojana tathā aṭhāraha kalā pramāṇa kahā hai ||49|| himavatkulācalakī cūlikākā vistāra pā~ca hajāra do sau tīsa yojana tathā kucha adhika sāta kalā hai ||50|| isako pūrva-paścima donoṃ bhujāoṃkā vistāra pā~ca hajāra tīna sau pacāsa yojana sāḍha़e pandraha bhāga hai ||51|| isa suvaṇamaya himavat kulācalake śikharapara pūvase paścima taka paṃkti rūpase sthita gyāraha kūṭa suśobhita ho rahe haiṃ ||52|| una kūṭoṃke nāma isa prakāra haiṃ-1. siddhāyatanakūṭa, 2. himavatkūṭa, 3. bharatakūṭa, 4. ilākūṭa, 5. gaṃgākūṭa, 6. śrīkūṭa, 7. rohitakūṭa, 8. sindhukūṭa, 9. surādevīkūṭa, 10. haimavatakūṭa aura 11. vaiśravaṇakūṭa | ina sabhī kūṭoṃkī ūṃcāī pacīsa yojana pramāṇa hai ||53-55|| ina sabakā mūlameṃ pacīsa yojana, madhyameṃ paune unnīsa yojana aura ūpara sāḍha़e bāraha yojana vistāra hai ||56||
1. daśāne tu ma.|

harivaṃśapurāṇe
sahasre śataṃ pañca yojanāni tu pañcabhiḥ | māge haimavatasyāpi viṣkambhaḥ puṣkalo mataḥ ||57|| saptatriṃśatsahastrāṇi catuḥsaptati ṣaṭśatī | jyāpi haimavatasyānte nyūnāḥ ṣoḍaśa tāḥ kalāḥ ||58 || sāṣṭatriṃśatsahasrāṇi saptaśatyapi noditā | catvāriṃśaddhanurjyāyā daśāsyāḥ sādhikāḥ kalāḥ || 59 ||
triṃśacca śatāni syādaśītiśvaturuttarā | yojanāni kalāśvāsya catasro dhanuṣastviṣuḥ ||60|| cūlikā caikasaptatyā triṣaṣṭiśatayojanā | sādhikaiḥ saptabhirbhāgaiḥ kṣetrasyāsyopavarṇitā ||31|| saptaṣaṣṭiśatānyasyāḥ pañcapañcāśatā bhuvaḥ | yojanāni bhajāmānaṃ sādhikāśca trayoṃ'śakāḥ || 62|| sahasrāṇi tu catvāri daśottaraśatadvayam | daśabhāgāśca vistāro mahāhimavato gireḥ || 63|| ūrdhvaṃ ca punarudyāto yojanānāṃ śatadvayam | pañcāśatamadhī yāto ghariṇyāṃ dhariṇīdharaḥ ||64|| tripañcāśatsahasrāṇi yojanāni śatāni ca | navaikatriṃśadetasya jyā ṣaṭ māgāśca sādhikāḥ || 65 || pañcāśacca sahasrāṇi saptāsya dviśatī dhanuḥ | trinavatyā saha jyāyāḥ sādhikāce daśāṃśakāḥ ||66 || dhanuṣo'sya sahasrāṇi sapta sāṣṭaśatāni tu | caturnavatiyuktāni bhāgāśceṣuścaturdaśa || 67 || ekāśītiśatāni syādaṣṭāviṃśatireva ca | catvāro'rddhādhikā māgāścūlikā'sya mahībhṛtaḥ || 68|| sahasrāṇi nava dve tu śate ṣaṭsaptatirnava | bhāgā bhujadvayaṃ tasya sādhikārddha kalādhikāḥ || 69 || aṣṭārjunamayasyāsya kuṭāni śikhare gireḥ | ratnarañjitasānūni nityāni santi bhānti ca || 70 || siddhāyatanakūṭaṃ syānmahāhimavadādikam | kūṭaṃ haimavataṃ kūṭaṃ rohitā kūṭamapyataḥ || 71 || hoṭaṃ harikāntādi harivarṣādikaṃ hi tat | vaiḍūryakūṭamapyeṣāṃ pañcāśadyojanocchitiḥ || 72 || pañcāśadyojano maulo' farkambho madhyagocaraḥ | saptatriṃśattathā ca mastake pañcaviṃśatiḥ ||73||
isake āge dūsarā haimavata kṣetra hai isakā vistāra do hajāra eka sau pā~ca yojana tathā pā~ca kalā pramāṇa mānā gayā hai ||57|| isakī pratyaṃcā saiṃtīsa hajāra chaha sau cauhattara yojana tathā kucha kama solaha kalā pramāṇa hai ||18|| isa pratyaṃcākā dhanuṣapṛṣṭha aḍa़tīsa hajāra sāta sau cālīsa yojana tathā kucha adhika daśa kalā pramāṇa hai || 595 || aura isakā bāṇa tīna hajāra chaha sau caurāsī yojana tathā cāra kalā hai ||60|| isakī cūlikā chaha hajāra tīna sau ikahattara yojana tathā kucha adhika sāta kalā hai || 61 || pūrva-paścima bhujāoṃ kā māna chaha hajāra sāta sau pacapana yojana aura kucha adhika tīna bhāga hai ||62||
isake āge mahāhimavān kulācala hai isakā, vistāra cāra hajāra do sau daśa yojana tathā daśa kalā hai ||63|| yaha parvata pṛthivīse do sau yojana ūpara uṭhā hai tathā pacāsa yojana pṛthivīke nīce gayā hai ||64 || isakī pratyaṃcākā vistāra tirapana hajāra nau sau ikatīsa yojana tathā kucha adhika chaha kalā hai || 65 || isa pratyaṃcā ke dhanuḥpṛṣṭhakā vistāra sattāvana hajāra do sau tirānabe yojana tathā kucha adhika daśa aṃśa hai || 66 || isake bāṇakī cauḍa़āī sāta hajāra āṭha sau caurānabe yojana tathā caudaha bhāga hai ||67 || isa mahāhimavān parvatakī cūlikā āṭha hajāra eka sau aṭṭhāīsa yojana tathā sāḍha़e cāra kalā hai ||68|| isakī donoṃ bhujāe~ nau hajāra do sau chihattara yojana tathā sāḍha़e nau kalā pramāṇa haiṃ ||69 || cā~dīke samāna śvetavarṇavāle isa parvata ke śikharapara ratnoṃse śikharoṃko anuraṃjita karanevāle uttama evaṃ sthāyo āṭha kūṭa suśobhita ho rahe haiṃ ||70 || una kūṭoṃke nāma isa prakāra haiṃ - 1. siddhāyatanakūṭa, 2. mahāhimavatkūṭa, 3. haimavata kūṭa, 4. rohitā kūṭa, 5. hrī kūṭa, 6. harikānta kūṭa, 7. harivarṣa kūṭa aura 8 vaiḍūyaṃ kūṭa | saba kūṭoṃkī ū~cāī pacāsa yojana pramāṇa hai ||71-72 || mūlameṃ ina kūṭoṃkā vistāra pacāsa yojana, madhyameṃ sāḍha़e saiṃtīsa yojana aura ūpara pacīsa yojana hai ||73 ||
1. sakalāḥ kalāḥ kha. | 2. daśāntakāḥ ma | 3. mūle bhavo mīla: |

syādaṣṭau hi sahasrāṇi catuḥśatyekaviṃśatiḥ | harivarṣasya vistāro bhāgaścaikonaviṃśataḥ ||7|| śatāni nava saikāni sahasrāṇi trisaptatiḥ | jyāpi cāsya viśeṣeṇa bhāgāḥ saptadaśādhikāḥ ||75|| asyāścaturaśītiśca sahasrāṇi punarbhavet | ṣoḍaśāpi dhanuāyāścatasraḥ sādhikāḥ kalāḥ ||76|| ṣoḍaśāsya sahasrāṇi yojanānāṃ śatatrayam | iṣaḥ pañcadaśa jñeyā saha pañcadaśāṃśakaiḥ ||77|| sahasrāṇi navānyāni śatāni nava calikā | pañcāśītiśca pañcāṃśāḥ sahādūrdhakalayā tu sā ||8|| trayodaśasahasrāṇi triśato ṣaṣṭirekakam | sādhikārdhādhikārdhāḥ ṣaḍa़ bhāgāstatra bhajapramā||79|| dvācatvāriṃśadaṣṭau ca śatānyanyāni ṣoḍaśa | sahasrāṇi ca bhāgau dvau viṣkambho niṣadhasya ca ||8|| ucchāyaḥ punarasya syād yojanānāṃ catuḥśatī | avagāhastvadho bhūmeḥ śatayojanamātrakaḥ ||81|| caturnavatisaṃkhyāni sahasrāṇi śataṃ tathā | ṣaṭpañcāśadavibhāgau ca sādhiko jyāsya bhūbhṛtaḥ ||82|| laukātra sahasrāṇi caturviśatiraṃśakāḥ | sādhikā nava cāpaṃ ṣaṭcatvāriṃśacchatatrayam ||83|| dhanuṣo'sya trayastriṃśatsahasrāṇi śataṃ tathā | saptapañcāśadeva syādiṣuḥ saptadaśāṃśakāḥ ||44|| tathā daśasahasrāṇi śataṃ syātsaptaviṃśatiḥ | sādhiko ca parau bhāgī cūlikā niṣadhasya sā ||85|| viṃśatiśca sahasrāṇi pañcaṣaṣṭiyutaṃ śatam | sādhikārdhādhiko bhāgau pramāṇaṃ mujayoriha ||86|| tapanīyamayasyāsya niṣadhasyāpi mūrdhani | māsante navakūṭāni sarvaratnamarīcibhiḥ|| 87|| siddhāyatanakūṭaṃ ca kūṭaṃ taniṣadhādikam | harivarṣādikaṃ pūrvavidehādikameva tat ||8|| hokūṭaṃ tikūṭaṃ ca śītodākūṭameva ca | videhakūṭamityekaṃ rucakaṃ navamaṃ matam ||89|| ucchāyo yojanaśataṃ viṣkambhaścāpi mūlajaḥ | pañcāśanmastake'moṣāṃ madhye'sau pañcasaptatiḥ ||10||
isake āge harivarṣa kṣetra hai isakā vistāra āṭha hajāra cāra sau ikkīsa yojana tathā eka yojanake unnīsa bhāgoṃmeṃ se eka bhāga pramāṇa hai ||74|| isakī pratyaṃcākā vistāra tihattara hajāra nau sau eka yojana aura satraha kalā hai ||75|| isa pratyaṃcākā dhanuḥpṛṣṭha āṭha hajāra cāra sau solaha yojana tathā kucha adhika cāra kalā hai ||76|| isake bāṇakā vistāra solaha . hajāra tīna sau pandraha yojana tathā pandraha kalā hai ||77| isakī cūlikā nau hajāra nau sau pacāsī yojana tathā sāḍha़e pāṃca kalā hai ||78|| aura isakī bhajāoṃkā pramāṇa teraha hajāra tīna sau ikasaṭha yojana sāḍha़e chaha kalā hai ||79||
isake āge niṣadha parvata hai isakā vistāra solaha hajāra āṭha sau bayālīsa yojana tathā eka yojanake unnīsa bhāgoṃ meṃ do bhāga pramāṇa hai ||80|| isakī ūṃcāī cāra so yojana hai aura pṛthivīke nīce gaharāī sau yojana pramāṇa hai ||81|| isa parvatakī pratyaṃcā caurānabe hajāra eka sau chappana yojana tathā adhika do kalā hai ||82|| isakā dhanaḥpaṣṭha eka lākha caubīsa hajāra tīna sau chiyālīsa yojana tathā kacha adhika nau kalā hai ||83|| isa dhanaḥpaṣṭhake bāṇakā vistāra taiṃtīsa hajāra eka sau santāvana yojana tathā satraha kalā hai ||84|| isa niṣadha kūlācalakī cūlikā daśa hajāra eka sau sattāīsa yojana tathā kucha adhika do kalā hai ||85|| isakī bhujāoṃkā pramāṇa bīsa hajāra eka sau paiṃsaṭha yojana tathā kucha adhika aḍha़āī kalā hai ||86|| isa svarṇamaya niṣadhācalake mastakapara nau kūṭa haiṃ jo ki saba prakārake ratnoṃkī kiraṇoṃse suśobhita ho rahe haiṃ ||87|| una kūṭoṃke nāma isa prakāra haiṃ-1 siddhāyatana kūṭa, 2 niṣadha kūṭa, 3 harivarṣa kūṭa, 4 pūrva videha kūṭa, 5 hrī kūṭa, 6 dhṛti kūṭa, 7 sītodā kūṭa, 8 videha kūṭa aura 9 rucaka kūṭa ||88-89|| ina sabakī ū~cāī aura mūlakī cauḍa़āī sau yojana hai | bocakī cauḍa़āī pacahattara yojana aura mastaka-ūrdhva bhāgako cauḍa़āī pacāsa yojana hai ||90|| 1. mātrakāḥ ma.|

harivaṃśapurāṇe yojanāni trinavati vigavyūtāni cocchuitam | gādhato yojanāī syāt saridvistāratoraṇam ||15|| sarvaprakārataḥ sindhuḥ samānā gaṅgayā tataḥ | āvidehācca saritāṃ dviguṇaṃ jibikādikam ||151|| toraṇānyavagāhena samastāni samāni tu | vasanti teṣu sarveṣu dikkumāryo yathāyatham ||152|| ṣaṭsaptati kalāṣaṭakaṃ yojanānāṃ śatadvayam | gatvā'drau rohitāsyāto nipatya śrīgṛhe'gamat ||15| śatāni ṣoḍaśādau tu rohyā pañcayutāni sā | kalāścāgamya pañcāgād gireḥ pañcāśadantaram ||154|| tāvadeva gatā śaile harikāntottarāṃ diśam | samudraṃ paścimaṃ yātā prāpya kuṇḍaṃ śatāntaram ||155|| catuḥsaptatisaṃkhyāni śatāni kalayā harit | ekaviṃśatimāgamya niṣadhe hyapatacchate ||156|| sītodāpi giriṃ gatvā tāvadeva catuḥśatī| ullaṅa ghyāpatadadreḥ sā yojanānāṃ śatadvaye ||15|| tāvadeva samāgatya sītāsau nīlaparvate | tāvatyeva samāpatya prāgvidehān bibheda ca ||15|| dakṣiṇāmiḥ samā nadyaḥ ṣaḍmistāśca ṣaḍuttarāḥ | yathāyogyaṃ prapātādyaḥ pratipādyāḥ pratidvikam ||159|| gaṅgā caiva nadī rohyā harit sītā ca pūrvagāḥ | nārī suvarṇakalā ca saraktāḥ paragāḥ parāḥ ||16|| śraddhāvān vijayāvāṃśca padmavāṃścāpi gandhavān | madhye haimavatādīnāṃ vijayāstui vartulāḥ ||161|| yojanānāṃ sahasraṃ syānmūle vistṛtirucchitiḥ | tadadhaṃ mastake madhye pañcāśat saptaśatyapi ||162|| yojanārddhana na prāptā nadyo nābhigirīnimān | gatā pradakṣiṇā sītāsītode mandaraṃ yathā ||163||
jisa toraṇa dvārase lavaṇa samudra meṃ praveśa karatī hai vaha terānabe yojana tīna kośa ū~cā hai tathā ādhā yojana gaharā hai ||150||
sindhu nadī saba prakārase gaṃgā nadīke samāna hai kevala viśeṣatā yaha hai ki yaha paścima lavaṇa samudrameṃ milī hai| gaṃgā-sindhuse lekara videha kṣetra takakī samasta nadiyoṃkī jihikā ādikā vistāra dūnā-dunā jānanā cāhie ||151|| samasta nadiyoṃke toraṇa gaharāīkī apekṣā samāna haiṃ tathā una samasta toraṇoṃmeṃ yathāyogya dikkumārī deviyā~ nivāsa karatī haiṃ ||152|| rohitāsyā nadī do sau chihattara yojana chaha kalā parvatapara bahatī hai| tadanantara parvatase girakara śrī devīke bhavanakī ora gayī hai ||153|| rohyā nadī eka hajāra chaha sau pāṃca yojana pā~ca kalā parvatapara bahakara usase pacāsa yojana dūra girī hai ||154|| isī prakāra harikāntā nadī bhī mahāhimavān parvatapara eka hajāra chaha sau pacāsa yojana pā~ca kalā uttara diśākī ora bahakara so yojana dūra kuṇḍameṃ girī hai aura vahā~se paścima samudrako ora gayī hai ||155|| harit nadī sāta hajāra cāra sau ikkīsa yojana eka kalā niṣadha parvatapara bahakara sau yojana dūrapara girī hai ||156|| sītodā nadī bhī itanī hī dūra pavaṃtapara bahatī hai| tadanantara cāra sau yojana ū~ce ākāśako ullaṃgha kara parvatase do sau yojana dūra giratī hai ||157|| sītā nadī bhī itanī hī dūra nīla parvatapara bahatī hai aura itanī hī dūra ākāśameṃ uchalakara pūrva videha kṣetrako bhedana karatī hai ||158|| uttara diśākī chaha nadiyāṃ dakṣiṇa diśāko chaha nadiyoṃke samāna haiṃ isalie unake prapāta ādikā varṇana do-do nadiyoṃke yugala rūpameṃ yathāyogya karanā cāhie ||159|| gaṃgā, rohyā, harit, sītā, nārī, suvarṇakalā aura raktā ye sāta nadiyā~ pūrva samudra kī ora jātī haiṃ aura śeṣa sāta nadiyā~ paścima samudra kī ora ||160|| haimavata ādi cāra kṣetroṃke madhyameṃ kramase śraddhāvān, vijayāvān, padmavān aura gandhavān nāmake cāra golākāra vijayā parvata haiṃ ||161|| ye parvata mūlameṃ eka hajāra yojana, madhyameṃ sāta sau pacāsa yojana aura mastakapara pāṃca sau yojana cauḍa़e haiṃ tathā eka hajāra yojana ū~ce haiṃ ||162|| ina parvatoṃkā dūsarā nāma nābhi giri hai jisa prakāra sītā, pañcamaḥ sargaḥ
prāsādeṣa śirasyeṣāṃ svātirapyaruṇaḥ paraḥ | padmaścāpi prabhāsaśca vyantarā nivasanti te ||164|| kṣetraparvatanadyādyā ye'tra dvīpe prakīrtitāḥ | dviguṇā dhātakokhaṇḍe puṣkarāddhe ca te sthitāḥ ||165|| 'dvīpānatītya saṃkhyātān jambūdvīpaḥ paraḥ sthitaḥ | santi tatra puro'mīṣāmatra ye gaditāḥ surāḥ ||166|| nīlamandaramadhyasthā uttarāḥ kuravo matāḥ| sthitāstu devakuravaḥ sumeruniṣadhāntare ||16|| dvācatvāriṃśadaṣṭau ca śatāni vyāsato matāḥ | ekādaśasahasrāṇi kuravaste kalādvayam ||168|| jyā ca teṣāṃ tripañcāśatsahasrāṇi dhanuḥ punaḥ | ṣaṣṭiścatuḥśatī cāṣṭau daśāṃśā dvādaśādhikāḥ ||169|| tricatvāriṃśataṃ saikasahasrāṇi ca saptatiḥ | caturaṃśā navāṃśāśca kuruvṛttaṃ prakīrtitam || 170|| sahasrāṇi trayastriṃśat ṣaṭśatī caturaṃśakāḥ | aśītiścaturagrā'sau videhakṣetravistṛtiḥ ||171|| meroḥ pūrvottarāśāyāṃ sītāyāḥ pūrvataḥ sthitam | samīpaṃ nīlaśailasya jambūsthalamudīritam ||172|| pañcacāpaśatavyāsā gavyūtidvayamuddhatā ! sthalasyopari paryeti sarvato ratnavedikā ||173|| tasya pañcaśatī vyāso madhye bāhulyamaṣṭa tu | gavyūtidvitayaṃ cānte sthalasya parikīrtitam ||174|| jambūnadamaye tatra pīṭhikāṣṭocchrayā sthitā | mūlamadhyānavistāraidaśāṣṭacaturmitā ||175|| adho'dho'nyā ṣaḍetasyāḥ parito maṇivedikāḥ | pratyekamupari dve dve tāsāṃtā padmavedikāḥ ||17|| mūle gavyūtivistīrṇaḥ skandhocchrāyadviyojanaḥ | avagāhadvigavyūtiḥ śākhāvyāptāṣṭayojanaḥ ||177||
dūra rahakara ina parvatoṃkī pradakṣiṇā detī huī gayo haiṃ ||163|| ina parvatoṃke śikharoṃpara nirmita bhavanoṃmeṃ kramase svāti, aruṇa, padma aura prabhāsa nāmake vyantara deva nivāsa karate haiṃ ||164||
jambū dvīpameṃ jina kṣetra, parvata tathā nadī ādikā varṇana kiyā hai, dhātakīkhaṇḍa tathā puṣkarārdhameṃ ve saba dūne-dūne haiṃ ||165|| saṃkhyāta dvīpa samudroṃko ullaṃghakara eka dusarā jambū dvīpa bhī hai| isa jambū dvīpameṃ jina devoṃkā kathana kiyā hai usa dūsare jambū dvīpameṃ bhī ina devoṃke nagara haiṃ ||166|| nīla kulācala aura sumeru parvatake madhya meṃ jo pradeśa sthita haiṃ ve uttarakuru māne jāte haiṃ
aura sumeru tathā niṣadha kulācalake bīcake pradeśa devakuru kahe jāte haiṃ ||167|| ye donoṃ kuru vistārakī apekṣā gyāraha hajāra āṭha sau yojana do kalā pramāṇa māne gaye haiṃ ||168|| inako pratyaṃcā vepana hajāra aura dhanuḥpṛṣṭha chaha hajāra cāra sau aṭhāraha yojana bāraha kalā hai ||169|| ina kuru pradeśoṃkā vṛttakṣetra ikahattara hajāra eka sau taiṃtālīsa yojana tathā eka yojanake nau aṃśoṃmeṃ cāra aṃśa pramāṇa hai ||170|| |
videha kṣetrakā samasta vistāra taiṃtīsa hajāra chaha sau caurāsī yojana cāra kalā hai ||171|| meru parvatakī pūrvottara ( aiśāna ) diśāmeṃ, sītā nadīke pūrva taṭapara nīla kulācalake samīpa jambū sthala kahā gayā hai ||172|| pā~ca sau dhanuṣa cauḍa़ī aura do kośa ū~cī ratnamayī vedikā isa sthalako cāroṃ orase ghere hue hai ||173|| isa sthalakī cauḍa़āī mūlameṃ pāṃca sau kośa, madhyameṃ āṭha kośa aura antameṃ do kośa kahī gayī hai ||174|| isa svarṇamaya sthala meṃ āṭha kośa ū~cī eka pīṭhikā sthita hai jo mūlameṃ bāraha kośa, madhyameṃ āṭha kośa aura antameṃ cāra kośa cauḍa़ī hai ||175|| isa pīṭhikāke nīce-nīce cāroṃ ora ratnanirmita chaha vedikāe~ aura haiṃ tathā una pratyeka vedikāoṃpara do-do ratnamayī vedikāeṃ haiṃ| una chahoṃ vedikāoṃpara jo laghu vedikāe~ haiṃ ve padmavedikā kahalātī haiṃ ||176||
isa pūrvokta pīṭhikāke ūpara jambū vṛkṣa suśobhita hai| vaha jambū vṛkṣa mūlameṃ eka kośa cauḍa़ā hai, usakā skandha do yojana ū~cā hai, usako gaharāī do kośa hai, usakī śākhāe~ āṭha yojana .

harivaṃśapurāṇe 'aśmagarbhamahāskandho vaijraśākhopaśomitaḥ | rājadrājatapanāḍhyo maṇipuṣpaphalāṅkaraḥ ||17|| raktapallavasaṃtānaraaitāntadigantaraḥ | pīṭhikāyāṃ puroktāyāṃ jambūvṛkṣaḥ prakāśate ||179|| pṛthivīpariṇāmasya nānāśākhopaśominaḥ | mahādikṣa catasro'sya mahāśākhā mahātaroḥ ||18|| tatra cottaraśākhāyāṃ siddhāyatanamadbhutam | ādarānādarāvāsāḥ prāsādāstisṛṣu sthitāḥ ||18|| jambūvṛkṣasya tasyādhastriṃśadyojanavistṛtāḥ | pañcāśayojanocchāyāḥ prāsādā devayostayoḥ ||182|| vedikāntaradeśeṣu cakravāleṣu saptasu | pradhānakagumopetāḥ parivāro'sya pādapāḥ ||183|| catvāro'nantaraṃ tasya tataścāṣṭottaraṃ śatam | catvāri ca sahasrāṇi sahasrāṇi ca ṣoḍaśa ||184|| dvātriṃśacca sahasrāṇi catvāriṃśattu tānyataḥ | catvāriṃśat sahāṣṭābhiḥ pradhānaiḥ saptabhiryutāḥ ||185|| miśrāḥ śatasahasraṃ tu catvāriṃśasahasrakaiḥ | saṃjāyante samastāste śatamekonaviṃśatiḥ ||186|| dakṣiṇāparato meroḥ sītodāyāstaṭe pare | niṣadhasya samīpasthaṃ rājataṃ śālmalīsthalam ||187|| jambūsthalesame tatra śālmalīvṛkṣa iṣyate | vaktavyā tasya niḥśeṣā jambūvṛkṣasva varṇanā ||188|| tatra dakṣiṇaśākhāyāṃ siddhāyatanamakṣayam | prāsādāstu triśākhāsu tatra devāvimau mato ||189|| veṇuśca veṇudārī tāvādarānādarau yathā | uttareṣu kuruviṣṭau tathā devakuruvimau ||190|| nīlārdakṣiṇāśāyāṃ yojanaikasahasrake | sītā pūrvataṭe citra vicitraṃ kuṭamapyataḥ ||19|| niṣadhasyottarāśāyāṃ sītodātaṭayostathā | yamakūṭaṃ mataṃ pūrva meghakaṭamataḥ param ||192||
taka phailī huī haiṃ, usakā mahāskandha nīlamaṇikā banā huā hai, vaha horāko śākhāoṃse śobhita hai, cā~dīke sundara pattoṃse yukta hai, usake phūla-phala tathā aṃkura maṇimaya haiṃ, aura usane apane lāla-lāla pallavoṃke samūhase samasta diśāoṃke antarālako lāla-lāla kara diyā hai ||177-179|| pṛthivīkāya rūpa tathā nānā śākhāoṃse suśobhita isa mahāvṛkṣakī cāroṃ diśāoṃmeṃ cāra mahāśākhāe~ haiṃ ||180| inameṃ uttara diśāko śākhāpara āścarya utpanna karanevālā jinamandira hai aura śeṣa tīna diśāoṃkī śākhāoṃpara bhavana bane hue haiṃ jinameṃ ādara-anādarakā nivāsa hai ||181|| usa jambū vṛnake nīce una donoṃ devoṃke tīsa yojana cauḍa़e aura pacāsa yojana ū~ce aneka bhavana bane hue haiṃ ||182|| vedikāoṃke sāta antarāloṃmeṃ eka-eka pradhāna vṛkṣase sahita jo aneka vṛkṣa haiṃ ve hī isa jambū vṛkṣake parivāra-vṛkṣa kahalāte haiṃ ||183|| prathama vṛkṣake parivāravṛkṣa cāra haiṃ, dūsareke eka sau āṭha, tīsareke cāra hajāra, cautheke solaha hajāra, pā~caveṃke battīsa hajāra, chaṭheke cālīsa hajāra aura sātaveṃke aḍa़tālīsa hajāra haiṃ| sāta pradhāna vṛkṣoṃko sātha milānepara ina samasta vṛkṣoṃkī saṃkhyā eka lākha cālīsa hajāra eka sau unnīsa hotī hai||184-186||
meru parvatakī dakṣiṇa-paścima ( naiṛtya ) diśāmeṃ sītodā nadīke dūsare taṭapara niṣadhācalake samīpa rajatamaya eka śālmalī sthala hai ||187|| jambū sthalakī samānatā rakhanevāle isa śālmalī sthala meṃ śālmalī vṛkṣa hai | usakā saba varṇana jambū vṛkṣake varṇanake samāna jānanā cāhie ||188|| śālmalī vṛkṣakī dakṣiṇa śākhāpara avināśī jina-mandira hai aura śeṣa tīna śākhāoṃpara jo bhavana bane hue haiṃ unameṃ veṇu aura veṇudārī deva nivāsa karate haiṃ| jisa prakāra uttarakurumeṃ ādara aura anādara deva iṣṭa māne gaye haiṃ usī prakāra devakurumeṃ veṇudārī deva iṣṭa māne gaye haiṃ ||189-190||
nīla parvatakī dakṣiṇa diśāmeṃ sītā nadīke pūrva taṭapara eka hajāra yojana vistāravāle citra aura vicitra nāmake do kūṭa haiṃ ||191|| isī prakāra niṣadha parvatako uttara diśāmeṃ sītodā nadīke 1.nīlamaṇimayamahāskandhaḥ | 2. hīrakaśākhopaśobhitaḥ | 3. śobhamānarajatamayapatrasahitaḥ| 4. parivāramā matāḥ kha. | 5. saṃjāyate ma.| 6. jambūsthalasamastatra ma.|

nāmiparvatamānāni tāni kūṭāni teṣu tu | devāḥ svakaṭanāmānaḥ krīḍanti nijayecchayā ||193|| adhyaḍhe hi sahasrārdai nīlato nīlavān hṛdaḥ | tathottarakururnāmnā candraścairāvaṇo'paraḥ ||19|| mālyavāṃśca nadīmadhye sarve pañcaśatāntarāḥ | te dakṣiṇottarāyāmāḥ padmahadasamā matāḥ ||195|| niṣadhāduttaro nayā niṣadho nāmato hṛdaḥ | nāmnā devakuruḥ sūryaḥ sulasaśca taḍiprabhaḥ ||19|| ratnacitrataṭāḥ sarve vajramūlā mahāhadāḥ | teṣu nāgakumārāḥ syuḥ padmaprāsādavāsinaḥ ||197|| jalād dvikośamudviddhaṃ yojanocchitivistṛtam | padma pratihadaṃ krośavistṛtocchritakarṇikam ||19|| padmāḥ śatasahasraṃ hi catvāriṃśassahasrakaiḥ | śataṃ saptadaśāgraṃ syāt pratipadma paricchadaḥ ||199|| ekaikasya hṛdasyātra parvatā daśa samukhāḥ | mānti kāñcanakūṭākhyāḥ sītāsītodayostaṭe ||20|| ucchāyamūlavistāraiḥ śatayojanakāḥ samāḥ | pañcasaptatikā madhye pañcāśadavistṛtārakāḥ ||201|| teṣāmupari pratyekamekaikākṛtrimāḥ śubhāḥ| pratimāśca nirālambāḥ mokṣamārgakadīpikāḥ||2.2|| dhanuḥpañcaśatītujhā maṇikāñcanarasnagāḥ | pañcameruṣu vikhyātaṃ sahasrottarakaṭakam ||203|| ākropanagṛheṣveṣāṃ śikhareṣu mahāsviṣaḥ | devāḥ kāścanakāmikhyāḥ saṃkrīḍante samantataḥ ||204|| sītottarataṭe kūṭaṃ panottaramanuttare | taṭe tu nīlavatkaṭaṃ pūrvato meruparvatāt ||205|| śītodāpūrvatīre tu kuṭaṃ svastikamasti tat | tadaanagiriprakhyaṃ paścātte mervanuttare ||20|| taṭe tu dakṣiṇe tasyāḥ kumudaṃ kuramuttare | palāśamaparāśāyāṃ te tu mandarato mate ||207||
donoṃ taṭoṃpara yama kūṭa aura megha kūṭa nāmake do kūṭa haiṃ ||192|| ye kūṭa nābhi parvatoṃke samāna vistāravāle haiṃ tathā ina kūṭoṃpara kūṭoṃke hī samāna nāmavāle deva apanī icchānusāra krīḍa़ā karate haiṃ ||193|| nīla pavaṃtase sāḍha़e pāṃca sau yojana dūrīpara nadīke madhyameṃ nīlavān, uttarakuru, candra, airāvaṇa aura mālyavān nāmake pāṃca hrada haiṃ| ye samasta hrada pāṃca-pāṃca sau yojanake antarase haiṃ tathā inako dakṣiṇottara lambāī padma hradake samāna mānī gayī hai ||194-195|| isī prakāra niṣadha parvatase uttarako ora nadīke bīca niṣadha. devakara, sayaṃ, salasa aura taḍitprabha nāmake pā~ca mahāhrada haiṃ| ina sabake taṭa ratnoṃse citra-vicitra haiṃ tathā sabake mūla bhāga vajramaya haiṃ| ina mahāhradoṃmeṃ kamaloṃpara jo bhavana bane haiṃ unameṃ nāgakumāra deva nivāsa karate haiṃ ||196-197|| pratyeka mahāhradameṃ eka-eka pradhāna kamala hai jo jalase do kośa ūṃcā hai, eka yojana vistṛta hai aura eka kośa vistṛta kaṇikāse yukta hai ||198|| pratyeka pradhāna kamalake sātha parivāra rūpameṃ eka lākha cālīsa hajāra eka sau satraha kamala aura bhī haiṃ ||199|| tathā eka-eka mahāhradake sammukha sītā, sītodā nadiyoṃke taṭapara kāṃcanakūṭa nāmake daśa-daśa parvata haiṃ ||200|| ina parvatoṃkī ūṃcāī sau yojana hai tathā vistāra mūlameṃ sau yojana, madhyameṃ pacahattara yojana aura agrabhāgameṃ pacāsa yojana hai ||201|| una kāṃcanakūṭoṃmeṃ pratyekake ūpara ucchrāyo'pi hi sarveṣāṃ kūṭānāṃ ca yathāyatham| ātmādhārāvagāhasya samānastu prabhāṣitaḥ||224 siddhāyatanakūṭeṣu teṣu sarveṣu ye gṛhāḥ | siddhabimbasanāthāste vibhrājante yathāyatham ||225|| śeṣobhayāntakūṭeṣu ramante vyantarāmarāḥ | madhye ca dikkumāryastu krīḍāgāreṣu cāruṣu ||226|| . mogarā bhogavatī subhogā mogamālinī | vatsamitrā sumitrā'nyā vāriṣeṇā calāvatī ||22|| videhe citrakūṭākhyaḥ padmakūṭaśca parvataḥ | nalinaścaikaśailaśca nīlasītāntarāyatāḥ ||228|| pūrvādhāstu ṭaśca śailo caiśravaṇo'ñjanaḥ | ātmājanaśca sarve'pi te sītāniṣadhaspṛśaḥ ||229|| śraddhāvān suprasiddho'drirvijayāvāṃstathaiva ca | āśīviṣastadanyastu sukhāvaha itīritaḥ ||230|| videheṣvapareṣvete caravāro deśabhedakāḥ | svāyāmena prasiddhena sītodāniṣadhaspṛśaḥ ||23|| candrasūryau ca mālāstau nāgamālastathācalaḥ | meghamālaśca te madhye nīlasītodayoḥ sthitāḥ ||23|| sarittaṭeṣu cocchāyasteṣāṃ vakṣārabhūbhṛtām | śatāni pañcaśeṣaṃ tu pūrvavakṣāravarṇitam ||233|| pratyekaṃ ṣoḍaśasveṣu mūrdhni kūṭacatuṣṭayam | kulācalāntakūṭeṣu dikkumāryo vasanti tāḥ ||23|| nadīsamīpakūṭeṣu jinendrāyatanāni tu | tathā madhyamakūṭeṣu vyantarākrīḍanālayāḥ ||235|| bhadraśālavana meroḥ pūrvāparadigāyatam | nānādumalatākīrṇa varṇanīyaṃ yathākramam ||236|| āyāmo māgayostasya dvāviṃśatisahasrakaḥ | pratyeka dviśatī sārdā dakṣiṇottaravistṛtiḥ ||237||

dvādaśa syuḥ sahasrāṇi rathyānāṃ tu yathāyatham | sahasraṃ tu catuṣkāṇāṃ nagarīṣvakṣayāramasu ||266|| hai ||251-252|| ina sabakā pūrvāpara vistāra yojanake āṭha bhāgoṃmeṃ se eka bhāga kama do hajāra bīcake bhavana meṃ camara aura sapheda chatroṃse yukta vijayadevakā uttama siṃhāsana hai| usapara vaha vijayadeva pūrvābhimukha hokara baiṭhatā hai ||413|| usako uttara diśāmeṃ chaha hajāra sāmānika deva baiṭhate haiṃ | tathā āge aura do diśāoṃmeṃ chaha paṭṭadeviyāṃ āsana grahaṇa karatī haiṃ ||412|| pūrva-dakṣiṇaāgneya diśāmeṃ āṭha hajāra uttama pāriṣada deva baiṭhate haiṃ| madhyama pariṣadke daśa hajāra deva dakṣiṇa diśāmeṃ sthita hote haiṃ| bāhya pariṣadke bāraha hajāra deva, paścima-dakṣiṇa-naiṛtya diśāmeṃ āsanārūḍha़ hote haiṃ aura sāta senāoṃke mahattara deva paścima diśāmeṃ āsana grahaṇa karate haiṃ ||413-414|| cāroṃ diśāoṃmeṃ aṭhāraha hajāra aṃga-rakṣaka rahate haiṃ aura cāroṃ diśāoṃmeṃ utane hī unake bhadrāsana haiṃ ||415|| vijayadevake aṭhāraha hajāra parivāra deva haiṃ| ina sabake dvārā sevita hotā huā vaha kucha adhika eka palya taka jīvita rahatā hai ||416|| vijayadevake bhavanase uttara diśāmeṃ eka sudharmā nāmakī sabhā hai jo chaha yojana lambī, tīna yojana cauḍa़ī, nau yojana ūṃcī
aura eka kośa gaharī hai ||417|| sudharmā sabhāse uttara diśāmeṃ eka jinālaya hai jisakī lambāīcauḍa़āī ādikā vistāra sudharmā sabhāke samāna hai| paścimottara diśāmeṃ upapāśvaṃ sabhā hai ||418|| usake āge abhiṣeka sabhā, usake āge alaṃkāra sabhā, aura usake āge vyavasāya sabhā hai | ye saba sabhāeṃ sudharmā sabhāke samāna haiṃ ||419|| vijayadevake nagarameṃ saba milākara pāṃca hajāra cāra sau saḍa़saṭha bhavana haiṃ ||420||
vijayadevake nagarase bāhara pacīsa yojana calakara pūrvādi diśāoṃmeṃ cāra vana 1. vidiśo'sya ma.| 2. āsanaiḥ saha vidyamānā sāsanāḥ ma.| vidiśi ṣaṭa mahādevīnāmāsanāni | 3. daśasahasrāṇi | 4. sevyamānastaiḥ ma.| 5. jīvanti ma.|

pañcamaḥ sargaḥ
aśokavanamādau ca saptaparṇavanaṃ tataḥ | syāñcampakavanaṃ nāmnā tathā cūtavanaṃ tataḥ ||422|| yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi dvādaśāyāma iṣyate | śatāni pañcavistārāsteṣāṃ madhye tu pādapāḥ||423|| aśokaḥ saptaparṇaśca campakaścūtapādapaḥ | jambūpīṭhārddhamānāśca pīṭhā jamvarddha mānakāḥ ||424|| catasraḥ pratimāsteṣu caturdikṣu yathāyatham | aśokādisurairā jinānāṃ ratnamūrtayaḥ ||425|| vanasyottarapūrvasyāmaśokapuramatra ca | mānena vijayasyeva prāsādo'śokanāmakaḥ ||426|| saptaparṇapuraṃ pūrvadakṣiṇasyāṃ vanasya tu | saptaparṇapurasyātra prāsādaḥ pūrvamānakaḥ ||427|| dakṣiṇāparadigbhāge campakasya puraṃ vanāt | aparottaradigbhāge puraṃ cetāmarasya ca ||428|| vaijayantādayo devā vijayasya samāstrayaḥ | dakṣiṇādipurādhīśāḥ svālayāyuḥparicchadaiḥ ||429|| yojanānāṃ tu lakṣa dve vistīrṇo lavaṇārṇavaḥ | parikṣipya sthito dvīpaṃ parikheva savedikaḥ ||430|| lakṣāḥ pañcadaśāśītyā sahasraṃ ca śataṃ tathā | triṃśannava ca deśonā paridhilavaṇāmbudheḥ ||431|| aṣṭādaśa sahasrāṇi koṭyā navaśatānyapi | trisaptatiśca niśceyā lakṣāḥ ṣaṭṣaṣṭireva ca ||432|| sahasrāṇi ca pañcāśannava tāni ca ṣaṭśatī| gaṇitasya padaṃ vedyaṃ prakīrṇa lavaṇārṇave ||433|| daśaivopari mūle ca sahasrāṇi daśa smṛtaḥ | sahasramavagāḍho'dho dhruvāṇyekādaśocchritaḥ ||434|| taṭāntātpañcanavatiṃ deśān gatvā'vagāhate | deśamekamadhaścaivamaṅgalādi sayojanam ||435|| sa gatvā pañcanavatiṃ deśān deśāṃśca ṣoḍaśa | ucchito'ṅgalahastādīna yojanāni ca sāgaraḥ ||436||
haiṃ ||421|| unameṃ pahalā aśokavana, dūsarā saptaparṇavana, tīsarā campakavana aura cauthā āmravana hai ||422|| ye vana bāraha yojana lambe aura pāṃca sau yojana cauḍa़e haiṃ| ina vanoṃke madhyameṃ kramase aśoka, saptaparṇa, campaka aura āmake pradhāna vṛkṣa haiṃ| ina vṛkṣoṃkī poṭhikā jambū vṛkṣako pīṭhikāse ādhī hai tathā inakā nijakā vistāra jambū vṛkṣase ādhā hai ||423-424|| una cāroṃ vanoṃkī cāroṃ diśāoṃmeṃ yathāyogya aśokādi devoṃke dvārā pūjita jinendra devakī ratnamayī cāra pratimāe~ haiṃ ||425|| aśoka vanakī uttara-pūrva diśāmeṃ aśokapura nāmakā nagara hai isameṃ aśoka nāmaka devakā bhavana hai jisakā vistāra vijayadevake bhavanake samāna hai ||426|| saptaparṇa vanakī pūrva-dakṣiṇa diśāmeṃ saptaparṇapura hai usameṃ pūrva pramāṇako dhāraṇa karanevālā saptaparṇa devakā bhavana hai ||427|| campaka vanakī dakṣiṇa-paścima diśāmeṃ campaka devakā campakapura aura āmravanakī paścimottara diśāmeṃ āmradevakā āmra nagara hai ||428|| vaijayanta ādi tīna deva dakṣiṇādi diśāoṃmeṃ bane hue nagaroṃke svāmī haiṃ tathā apane bhavana vāyu aura parivāra ādikī apekṣā vijayadevake samāna haiṃ ||429|| isa prakāra jambū dvīpakā varṇana kiyā| aba lavaṇasamudrakā varṇana karate haiṃ
__ vedikāse sahita lavaṇasamudra, do lākha yojana vistāravālā hai aura vaha parikhāke samāna jambū dvīpako gherakara sthita hai ||430|| isakī paridhi pandraha lākha ikyāsī hajāra eka sau unatālīsa yojanameṃ kucha kama hai ||431|| tathā isake gaṇitakā prakīrṇaka pada (kṣetraphala ) aṭhāraha hajāra nau sau tihattara karoḍa़, chayāsaṭha lākha, unasaṭha hajāra chaha sau yojana hai||432-433|| isakī ūpara-nīce cauḍāī daśa hajāra yojana, gaharāī eka hajāra yojana aura avasthita rūpase ūṃ gyāraha yojana pramāṇa hai ||434|| vaha lavaṇasamudra, taṭāntase paṃcānabe hātha jānepara eka hātha, paṃcānabe aṃgula jānepara eka aṃgula aura paṃcānabe yojana jānepara eka yojana gaharā hai ||435|| aura paṃcānabe aṃgula, paṃcānabe hātha yā paṃcānabe yojana jānepara yaha samudra solaha aṃgula, solaha hātha yā solaha yojana ūṃcā hai arthāt taṭāntase paṃcānabe aṃgula jānepara solaha aṃgula ūṃcā hai, paṃcānabe hātha jānepara solaha hātha ūṃcā hai aura paṃcānabe yojana jānepara solaha yojana ūṃcā

harivaṃśapurāṇe
śukla pañcasahasrāṇi yāvattāvat pravardhate | pakṣe prahīyate kṛṣṇe yāvadekādaśaiva saḥ||437|| triśatī ca trayastriṃśad yojanāni dine dine | tribhāgaṃ vardhate vādhiḥ śukle kṛṣṇe ca hīyate ||438|| makṣikāpakṣmasūkṣmānto vedikānte payonidhiḥ| sa covaṃ mānatoyastu yojanāī pravarddhate ||439|| ṣaṭṣaṣṭi dve śate daṇḍā dvau hastau ṣoḍaśāṅgalī | śukle kṛṣṇe ca te syātāṃ vṛddhihānī dine dine ||440|| adhaḥ saṃkṣepaṇī droṇī vistīrṇodhvaṃ kṣitau divi | anyathā naupuṭāmmodhiḥ samo vā yavarāśinā ||441|| jagatyāḥ pañcanavatiṃ sahasrāṇi praviśya tu | madhye syurdikṣu catvāri pātālavivarāṇyadhaḥ ||442|| prācyāṃ pātālamāśāyāṃ pratīcyāṃ baḍavāmukham | kadambukamapācyāṃ syādudīcyāṃ yūpakesaram ||443|| tanmūlamukhavistāraḥ sahasrāṇi daśa smṛtaḥ | gāhasvamadhyavistārāvekā lakṣeti lakṣitau ||444|| alañjalasamānāni pātālāni samantataḥ | bāhulyaṃ vajrakuḍyānāṃ teṣāṃ pañca śatāni tu ||445|| trayastriṃśatsahasrāṇi trayastriṃśacchatatrayam | ekaiko'tra vibhāgaḥ syād yojanānāṃ tu māgavān ||446|| ūrdhvabhāge jalaṃ teṣāṃ tṛtīye kevalaṃ sadā | mūle ca balavān vāyumaṃdhyamāge krameṇa tau ||447|| vāyorucchvāsaniśvāsau pātāleṣu svabhāvajau | tadvaśādudakasyordhvamadhaśca parivartanam ||448|| bhāgaḥ pañcadaśaḥ śukle vāyubhiḥ pūryate śanaiḥ | pātālānāṃ jalaiḥ kṛṣṇe sthitiḥ syātpakṣasaṃdhiṣu ||44||
hai||436|| śukla pakṣa meṃ samudrakā jala pā~ca hajāra yojana taka ū~cā baḍha़ jātā hai aura kṛṣṇa pakṣameṃ svābhāvika ūcāījo gyāraha hajāra yojana hai vahā~ taka ghaṭa jātā hai ||437|| śukla pakṣameṃ samudra pratidina tīna sau taiṃtīsa yojana aura eka yojanake tīna bhāga baḍha़tā hai tathā kṛṣṇa pakṣameṃ utanā hī ghaṭatā hai ||438|| vedikāke antameṃ samudra makṣikāke paṃkhake samāna atyanta sūkṣma hai parantu jaba usake jalameṃ vṛddhi hotī hai taba ādhā yojana taka baḍha़ jātā hai ||439|| śuklapakṣameṃ vedikāke antameṃ pratidina samudrakī vṛddhi do sau chayāsaṭha dhanuṣa, do hātha aura solaha aṃgula hotī hai aura kṛṣṇapakṣa meṃ pratidina utanī hī hāni hotī hai ||440|| saṃkucita hotā huā samudra nīce bhāgameṃ nāvake samāna raha jātā hai aura ūpara pṛthivīpara vistīrṇa ho jātā hai tathā ākāśameṃ isake viparīta juḍa़ī huī do naukāoṃke puṭake samāna athavā jauko rāśike samāna nīce cauḍa़ā aura ūpara saṃkīrṇa ho jātā hai ||4412||
vedīse paṃcānabe hajāra yojana bhītara praveśa karanepara cāroṃ diśāoṃmeṃ nīce cāra pātālavivara haiṃ ||442|| unameṃ pūrva diśāmeṃ pātāla, dakṣiṇameṃ baḍavāmukha, paścimameṃ kadambuka aura uttarameṃ yūpakesara nāmakā pātāla hai ||443|| ina cāroṃ pātāloṃke mūla aura agrabhāgakā vistāra daśa hajāra yojana hai tathā gaharāī aura apane madhya bhāgakā vistāra eka-eka lākha yojana pramāṇa mānā gayā hai ||444|| ye pātāla-vivara golīke samāna haiṃ arthāt inakā tala aura ūparakā vistāra alpa hai tathā madhyakā adhika hai| inakī vajramayo dovāloṃkī moṭāī saba orase pāṃca-pāṃca sau yojana hai ||445|| ina vivaroṃke tīna-tīna bhāga haiṃ unameṃ se eka bhāga taiṃtīsa hajāra tīna sau taiṃtīsa yojana aura eka kalā pramāṇa hai ||446|| inake tīsare ūrdhva bhāgameṃ kevala jala rahatā hai, nīceke bhāgameṃ balavān vāyu rahatī hai aura bīcake bhāgameṃ kramase jala tathā vāyu donoṃ rahate haiṃ ||447|| pātāloṃmeṃ jo vāyu hai usakā ucchvāsa-ū~cā uṭhanā aura niḥśvāsa-nīce ānā svābhāvika hai usīke kāraṇa unameṃ jalakā ū~cā-nīcā parivartana hotā rahatā hai arthāt jaba vāyu ūpara uṭhatī hai taba jala ūpara uṭha jātā hai aura jaba vāyu nīce baiṭhatī hai taba jala nīce baiṭha jātā hai ||448|| pātāloṃkā pandrahavāṃ bhāga śuklapakṣameṃ dhīre-dhīre vāyuse bharatā rahatā hai aura kṛṣṇapakṣameṃ jalase | amāvasyā aura pūrṇimāke dina unakī svābhāvika sthiti ho jātī hai ||449|| ina pātāla-vivaroṃkā pṛthak-pṛthaka antara 1. sthiti syātpañcasandhiṣu ma. |

lakṣadvayaṃ sahasrāṇi saptaviṃśatirantaram | śataṃ saptatireṣāṃ' syāt pādonaṃ yojanaṃ pṛthak ||450|| vidikṣu kṣa drapātāla catuṣkaṃ mukhamūlayoḥ | sahasraṃ vistṛtaṃ dairdhya madhyavistārato daśa ||451|| caturṇāmapi teṣāṃ syātpañcāśatkuḍyavistṛtiḥ | ekaikasya tribhāgeṣu prāgivāmbhaḥ prabhañjanau || 452 || triyojana sahasrāṇi trayastriṃśaṃ śatatrayam | satribhāgaṃ trimāgānāṃ pratyekaṃ yojanasthitiḥ || 453 || ekalakṣā sahasrāṇi trayodaśa nijāntaram | pañcāśīti trayo'ṣṭāṃśāḥ kuṇḍānāṃ digvi disthitam || 454 || muktāvalīvadeteṣāmantarāleṣu cāṣṭasu | samudre kṣudra pātāla sahasra mavatiṣṭhate || 455 || sahasramavagāhaśca madhyaviṣkambha eva ca | yojanānāṃ śataṃ teṣāṃ vistāro mukhamūlayoḥ || 456 || pañcaviṃśataṃ tāni pratyekaṃ cāntare'ntare | dvihīnāṣṭaśatī krośaḥ saviśeṣastadantaram ||457 || yathāyogaparāvṛtta salilāplavaviplavāḥ | pātālaughāḥ samastāste kṣudrāśca parikīrtitāḥ ||458 || taṭād gatvā sahasrāṇi dvācatvāriṃśataṃ samau | caturdikṣu sahasroccaiḥ dvau dvau syātāṃ tu parvatau || 459|| kaustubhaḥ kaustumāsaśca pātāḻasyomayāntayoḥ | rājatāvarddha kumbhāmau tatsurau vijayaśriyau || 460|| udakaśyodavāsaśca kadambukasamīpagau | śivaśca śivadevaśca tayordevau yathākramam || 46 ||

do lākha sattāīsa hajāra eka sau paune ikahattara yojana hai ||450||

rūpa, rasa, gandha aura sparśase rahita va halakā va bhārī aura vartanā lakṣaṇase yukta kāladravya hai| vaha mukhya aura gauṇake bhedase do prakārakā hai||1|| jisa prakāra jīva aura pudgalake gamana karane meṃ dharma dravya, ṭhaharanemeṃ adharma dravya aura samasta dravyoṃko avagāha denemeṃ ākāśa dravya nimitta hai usī prakāra samasta dravyoṃkī vartanā--ṣaḍguṇī hāni-vṛddhirūpa pariṇamanameṃ niścaya kāladravya nimitta hai ||2|| jisa prakāra dharma-adharma aura ākāśadravyakā āgamadṛṣṭise niścaya kiyā jātā hai usī prakāra vidvānoṃko kāla dravyakā bhī niścaya karanā cāhie ||3|| jīva aura pudgaloṃkā pariṇamana nānā prakārakā hotā hai aura gauṇa kālakī pravṛtti mukhya kālake kāraṇa hai ||4|| samasta padārthoṃ meṃ jo pariṇāma kriyā paratva aura aparatvarūpa pariṇamana hote haiṃ ve apane-apane antaraṃga tathā bahiraṃga nimittoṃse hī saba ora pravṛtta hote haiṃ ||5|| una antaraṃga, bahiraṃga nimittoṃmeṃ antaraṃga nimitta to vastukī apano yogyatā hai jo sadā usameṃ sthita rahatī hai aura bāhya nimitta niścaya kāladravya hai aisā tattvadarśī ācāryoṃne niścita kiyā hai ||6|| parasparake praveśase rahita kālāṇu pṛthak-pṛthak samasta lokako vyāpta kara rāśirūpameṃ sthita haiṃ ||7|| dravyārthika nayakī apekṣā kālāṇuoṃmeṃ vikāra nahīṃ hotā isalie utpāda-vyayase rahita honeke kāraṇa ve kathaṃcit nitya haiṃ aura apane svarūpameṃ sthita haiṃ ||8| aguru laghu guṇake kāraṇa una kālāṇuoṃmeṃ pratyeka samaya pariṇamana hotā rahatā hai tathā parapadārthake sambandhase ve vikārī ho jāte haiṃ isalie paryāyāthika nayakī apekṣā kathaṃcit anitya bhī hai|9|| bhūta, bhaviṣya aura vartamānarūpa tīna prakārake samayakā kāraṇa honese ve kālāṇu tīna prakārake māne gaye haiṃ aura ananta samayoṃke utpādaka honese ananta bhī kahe jāte haiṃ ||10|| una kāraṇabhūta kālāṇuoṃse samayakī utpatti hotī hai so ṭhīka hī hai kyoṃki kāraṇake binā kabhī kārya utpanna nahīṃ hotā ||11|| yadi asadbhūta kāryako utpatti kāraṇake binā svayaṃ hī hotī hai to phira gadheke sīṃgakī utpatti svayaṃ hī kyoṃ nahīṃ ho jātī ? śrīmatāmanurūpaṃ yaḥ pariṇāmamanuśritaḥ | mananāt manujārthasya manusaṃjñāmanuśritaḥ ||1|| prakṣīṇaḥ kalpavṛkṣāramā madhyedakṣiṇamāratam | nābherapi sa evābhūt prāsādaḥ pṛthivīmayaḥ ||2|| śātakumbhamayastambho vicitramaṇibhittikaḥ | puṣpavidruma muktādimālābhirupaśomitaḥ ||3|| sarvatobhadrasaṃjño'sau prāsādaḥ sarvato mataḥ | saikāśītipadaḥ śālavāpyudyālādyalaṃkṛtaḥ ||4|| svasthānamekako'nalpakalpavṛkṣairvṛtaḥ kṣitau | adhyatiṣṭadadhiṣṭhātuḥ sa nābheranubhāvataḥ ||5|| atha nābherabhūdevī marudevīti vallamā| devī śacīva śakrasya śusaṃtānasaṃbhavā ||6|| abhyunnatau padāṅgaṣṭau prollasannakhamaṇḍalau | yasyā rejaturucyaiva lalāṭasya didṛkṣayā ||7|| unnatāgrasamasnigdhatanutāmranakhāṃśubhiḥ | kuṭṭile kurutāṃ yasyāḥ kramau kuravakaśriyam ||8|| śliṣṭāṅgulidalau gūḍhagulpho kāntijalaplavam | samau kūrmonnatī yatyāḥ pādapadmī pracakratuḥ ||9|| yasyāśca caraṇī cārumatsyaśaṅkhādilakṣaṇau | krīḍāsveva priyasparśātsvedasaṃbandhasaṃginau ||10|| ānupūrvyasuvṛtte ca jo romaśirojjhite | lāvaṇyarasavarṇāṭye śaradhī puṣpadhanvanaḥ ||11|| jānanī mṛdunī yasthā gūḍhasaṃdhānavartinī | dadatuḥ priyagātrāṇāṃ madusparśakṛtaṃ sukham ||12|| asārāḥ kadalīstambhāḥ karkaśāḥ karigāṃ karāḥ | pariṇāhaguṇatve'pi yadūrvoḥ saśāna te ||13||
athānantara ūpara jina nābhirājakā kathana kiyā gayā hai ve śrīmān puruṣoṃ ke anurūpa pariṇāmako prāpta the tathā samasta puruṣārthoṃkā manana karanese mana kahalāte the ||1|| usa samaya dakṣiṇa bharata kṣetrameṃ kalpavṛkṣarūpa prāsāda anyatra naṣṭa ho gaye the parantu rājā nābhirājakā jo kalpavṛkṣarūpa prāsāda thā vahī pṛthivī nirmita prāsāda bana gayā thā ||2|| rājā nābhirājake usa prāsādakā nāma sarvatobhadra thā, usake khambhe svarṇamaya the, dīvāleṃ nānā prakārakī maṇiyoṃse nirmita thīṃ, vaha pukharāja, mūṃgā tathā motī ādikī mālāoṃse suśobhita thā, ikyāsī khaṇḍase yukta thā aura koṭa, vāpikā tathā bāga-bagīcoṃse alaṃkṛta thā ||3-4|| vaha adhiṣṭhātā nābhirājake prabhāvase akelā hī aneka kalpavṛkṣoṃse āvṛta thā tathā pūthivīke madhya apane sthānapara adhiṣṭhita thā ||5||
athānantara rājā nābhirājakī marudevī nāmakī paṭarānī thī| yaha śuddha kūlameṃ utpanna huī thī tathā jisa prakāra indrako indrāṇī priya hotī hai usī prakāra rājā nābhirājako priya thī ||6|| jinake nakha atyanta camakadāra the aise usake uṭhe hue donoṃ pairoṃke aṃgaṭhe aise jāna paḍa़te the māno lalāṭake dekhanekī icchāse hī ūparakī ora uṭha rahe hoṃ||7| usake donoṃ caraṇa, unnata agrabhāgase yukta, sama, snigdha, patale aura lāla-lāla nakhoṃkī kiraṇoṃse pharśapara kuravakakī śobhā utpanna kara rahe the ||8|| jinakī aṃguliyārūpī kalikāe~ parasparameṃ saṭī huī thīṃ, jinakī gāṃṭheṃ chipī huī thīṃ aura jo kachuoṃke samāna unnata the, aise usake donoṃ caraṇakamala kāntirūpī jalameṃ māno taira hī rahe the ||9|| sundara maccha tathā śaṃkha ādike lakṣaṇoṃse yukta jisake caraṇa, krīḍa़āoṃke samaya hī patikā sparśa pākara pasīnāke sambandhase yukta hote the anya samaya nahīṃ ||10|| anukramika golāīse yakta, tathā roma evaṃ nasoṃse rahita usakī donoṃ jaṃghāe~ saundayaṃ rasase bhare hue māno kāmadevake do tarakaśa hī haiṃ ||11|| gūḍha़ sandhise yukta jisake donoṃ komala ghuṭane patike avayavoṃko komala sparśajanya sukha pradāna karate the ||12|| keleke stambha 1. mahādevīti ma. | 2. jalaplavī ma.|

159 kṣīrāpūrṇāḥ suraiḥ kṣiptā rājatāḥ karataḥ karam | sauvarṇāśca babhuḥ kummāścandrārkā iva merugāḥ ||16|| kumbhanirantarārāvaibahudevasahasrakaiḥ | kṣīrāmmobhijinendrasya cakre janmābhiṣecanam ||165|| aindrāḥ kummamahāmbhodā dugdhāmmo'ntaravarṣiṇaḥ | śiśojinagirerāsanna tadā''yāsahetavaḥ ||166|| jinocchvāsamuhuḥ kṣiptakṣīravāriplaveritāḥ | plavante sma kṣaṇaṃ devāḥ kṣīraudhe makṣikaughavat ||16|| dṛṣṭaḥ suragaṇeyaḥ prāga mandaro ratnapiñjaraḥ | sa eva kṣīrapūraudhairdhavalīkṛtavigrahaḥ ||16|| tadā'tyastaparokṣo'pi pratyakṣaḥ kṣīravāridhiḥ | kṛtaḥ khecarasaṃghātaijinajanmābhiṣevane ||169|| snānāsanamabhūmmeruḥ snānavāripayombudheḥ | snānasaṃpādakā devāḥ snānamīdaga jinasya tat ||170|| indrasāmānikānekalokapālādayo'marāḥ | krameṇa cakrurammomirabhiṣekaṃ payombudheḥ ||171|| asyantasukumārasya jinasya surayoṣitaḥ | śacyādyāḥ pallavasparśasukumārakarāstataḥ ||172| divyāmodasamākṛṣṭaṣaṭpadaughānulepanaiḥ | udvartayantyastāḥ prāpuḥ śiśusparśasukhaṃ navam ||173|| tato gandhodakaiḥ kummerabhyaṣiñcan jagatprabhum | payodharamarānamrāstā varṣā iva bhūbhṛtam ||14|| samaṃ ca caturasraṃ ca saṃsthānaṃ dadhataḥ param | suvajraṣamanārācasaṃghātasudhanātmanaḥ ||175|| karṇāvakṣatakāyasya kathaṃcid vajrapāṇinā| viddhau vajraghanau tasya vajrasūcīmukhena tau ||176|| kṛtābhyo karṇayorośaḥ kuṇḍalābhyāmabhāttataḥ| jambūdvīpaḥ subhānubhyāṃ sevakābhyāmivānvitaḥ ||177||
hāthoṃmeṃ aṣṭa maṃgala dravya dhāraṇa kara rahī thī, taba mahāvegaśālī devoṃke samūha ghaṭa lekara viśāla meghoṃke samāna samasta diśāoṃmeṃ phaila gaye aura unhoṃne kṣīrasāgarako kṣobhita kara diyā ||161-163|| kṣīrase bhare cāṃdī aura soneke kalaśa devoṃ dvārā eka hāthase dūsare hāthameṃ diye jākara sumeru parvatapara pahuṃca rahe the aura ve candra tathā sūryake samāna suśobhita ho rahe the ||164|| nirantara śabda karanevāle
sāgarake jalase bhare hae kalaśoṃke dvārā hajāroṃ devoṃne jinendra bhagavānakā abhiṣeka kiyā ||165|| usa samaya indroṃke kalaśarūpī mahāmegha jinabālakarūpī parvatake ūpara kṣīrodakakī varṣā kara rahe the parantu ve unheṃ raṃcamātra bhī khedake kāraṇa nahīṃ hue the ||166|| bhagavānke śvāsocchvāsase bāra-bāra uchāle hue kṣīrodakake pravāhase prerita deva, usa kṣīrodakake samūhameṃ kṣaṇa-bharake lie makkhiyoṃke samūhake samāna tairane lagate the ||167|| devoṃke samūhane pahale jisa meruko ratnoṃse pīlā dekhā vahī usa samaya kṣīrodakake pūrase sapheda dikhane lagā thā ||168|| yadyapi kṣīrasāgara atyanta parokṣa hai tathāpi jinendra ke janmābhiṣekake samaya devoṃke samūhane use pratyakṣa kara dikhāyā thā ||169|| jisameṃ meru parvata snānakā āsana thā, kṣīra samadrakā kṣīra snāna jala thā, aura deva snāna karānevāle the aisā vaha bhagavānkā snāna thā ||170|| indra sāmānika tathā lokapāla ādi aneka devoṃne kṣīrasāgarake jalase bhagavānakā kramapūrvaka abhiṣeka kiyā thā ||171||
tadanantara jinake hātha pallavoṃke samāna atyanta sukumāra the, aisī indrāṇī ādi deviyoṃne atiśaya sukumāra jina-bālakako apanī divya sugandhise bhramara-samūhako ākṛṣṭa karanevāle anulepanase ubaṭana kiyā aura isa taraha unhoṃne jina-bālakake sparśase samutpanna nūtana sukha prāpta kiyā ||172-173|| tadanantara payodharabhāra-meghoṃke bhārase namrībhūta varṣā ṛtu jisa prakāra parvatakā abhiṣeka karatī hai usī prakāra payodharabhāra-stanoṃke bhārase namrībhūta deviyoṃne sugandhita jalase bhare kalaśoṃ dvārā bhagavānkā abhiṣeka kiyā ||174|| jo parama sundara samacaturasra saṃsthānako dhāraṇa kara rahe the tathā vajrarṣabha nārāca saṃhananase jinakā śarīra atyanta sudaḍha thā, aise akṣatakāya jina-bālakake vajrake samāna majabūta kānoṃko indra vajramayī sūcīkī noṃkase kisī taraha vedha sakā thā ||175-176|| tadanantara kānoṃmeṃ pahanāye hue do kuṇḍaloṃse bhagavān usa taraha suśobhita ho rahe the jisa taraha ki sadā sevā karanevāle do sūryose jambūdvīpa suśobhita hotā hai ||177||

harivaṃśapurāṇe athānyadā prajāḥ prāptā nābheyaṃ nābhinoditāḥ | stutipūrva praṇamyocurekībhūya mahātayaḥ ||25|| prabho kalpadrumāḥ pūrva prajānāṃ vṛttihetavaḥ | teṣāṃ parikṣaye'bhūvan svayaṃcyutarasekṣavaḥ ||26|| divyekṣarasatṛptānāṃ rakṣitānāṃ vaujasā | prajānāṃ nātha ! dūreṇa vismṛtāḥ kalpapādapāḥ ||27|| idānīṃ chinnabhinnāśca na kṣarantīkṣavo rasam | yānti kālānumāvena mṛdavo'pi kaṭhoratām ||28|| phalabhāravaśānnamrā dṛśyante tṛṇajātayaḥ| na vidmo vayametāmiḥ kathamannavidhirbhavet ||29|| saramīṇāṃ ghaṭonīnāṃ mahiṣīṇāṃ ca saṃtatam | stanebhyo prakṣarad makṣyamabhakṣyaṃ vā taducyatām ||30|| kaṇṭhāśleṣocitāḥ pūrva siṃhavyāghravṛkādayaḥ | asmānudvejayantīśe kuputrā iva sāṃpratam ||31|| ataḥ kṣudhāmahāgrastā jovanopāyadarśanāt | svāminnanugṛhāṇatā rakṣaṇācca bhayāt prajāḥ ||32|| tato vīkṣya kṣadhākṣīṇāḥ prajāḥ sarvāḥ prajāpatiḥ | kṛtvātiharaṇaṃ tāsāṃ divyāhāraiḥ kṛpānvitaḥ ||33|| sarvānupadideśāsau prajānāṃ vṛttisiddhaye | upāyān dharmakāmārthān sādhanānyapi pārthivaḥ ||34|| asiṣī kṛṣividyā vāṇijyaṃ śilpamityapi | ṣaṭkarma śamesiddhayartha sopāyamupadiṣṭavān ||35|| paśupālyaṃ tataḥ proktaṃ gomahiṣyādisaṃgraham | varjanaṃ karasattvānāṃ siṃhādīnāṃ yathāyatham ||36|| tataḥ putraśatenāpi prajayā ca kalāgamaḥ | gṛhītaḥ sugṛhītaṃ ca kṛtaṃ śilpiśataṃ janaiḥ ||37|| puragrāmaniveśāśca tataḥ śilpijanaiḥ kṛtāḥ| sakheṭakarvaṭākhyāśca sarvatra maratakṣitau ||38|| kṣatriyāḥ kṣatitastrāṇād vaiśyā vāṇijyayogataḥ | śūdrāḥ śilpādisaṃbandhājātā varṇāstrayo'pyataḥ ||39||
athānantara kisī samaya bahuta bhārī vyathāse yukta samasta prajā, rājā nābhirājase prerita ho eka sātha bhagavān vṛṣabhadevake pāsa pahuṃcī aura stutipūrvaka praṇāma kara kahane lagī ||25|| he prabho! pahale, kalpavṛkṣa prajāko ājīvikāke sādhana the, phira unake naṣṭa honepara svayaṃ hī jinase rasa cū rahā thā aise ikṣu vṛkṣa sādhana hue ||26|| he prajānātha ! una divya ikṣu vṛkṣoṃke rasase prajā itanī santuṣṭa huī aura āpake pratāpane usakī aiso rakṣā kī ki usane kalpavṛkṣoṃko dūrase hī bhulā diyā ||27|| parantu isa samaya ve ikṣavṛkṣa chinna-bhinna honepara bhī rasa nahīṃ dete haiṃ so ṭhoka hī haiṃ kyoki samayake prabhāvase komala bhī kaṭhoratāko prāpta ho jāte haiṃ ||28|| yadyapi phaloṃke bhārase jhuke hae nānā prakārake taṇa dikhāī dete haiṃ parantu hama loga nahīṃ jānate ki inase anna kaise prāpta kiyā jātā hai ? ||29|| ghaṭake samāna sthūla stanoṃko dhāraṇa karanevālī gāyoṃ aura bhaiṃsoṃke stanoṃse bhī kucha jhara rahā hai so vaha bhakṣya hai yā abhakṣya yaha kahie ||30|| jo siṃha, vyāghra tathā bheḍa़iyā ādi pahale kaṇṭhāliṃgana karaneke yogya the he nātha ! aba ve ho isa samaya kuputroṃke samāna hama logoṃko bhayabhīta kara rahe haiṃ ||31|| isalie he svāmin ! kṣudhākī tīvra bādhāse grasta isa prajāko jīvana nirvāhake upāya dikhākara tathā bhayase usakī rakṣā kara anugṛhīta kījie ||32|| tadanantara dayālu bhagavānne samasta prajāko bhūkhase vyākula dekha pahale to divya āhārake dvārā sabakī pīḍa़ā dūra kī phira ājīvikāke nirvāhake lie saba upāya tathā dharma, artha aura kāmarūpa sādhanoṃkā upadeśa diyā ||33-34|| unhoṃne sukhakī siddhike lie aneka upāyoṃke sātha asi, maṣī, kṛṣi, vidyā, vāṇijya aura śilpa ina chaha karmoṃkā bhī upadeśa diyā||35|| tadanantara unhoṃne yaha bhī batāyā ki gāya, bhaiṃsa ādi paśuoṃkā saṃgraha tathā unako rakṣā karanī cāhie aura siṃha ādika duṣṭa jīvoṃkā parityāga karanā cāhie ||36|| tadanantara bhagavānke sau putroṃ aura prajāne kalā śāstra sīkhā, evaṃ logoṃne saikaḍa़oṃ śilpī banākara unheṃ apanāyā ||37|| jisase śilpijanoṃne bharatakṣetrako bhūmipara saba jagaha gāṃva, nagara tathā kheṭa, karvaṭa ādiko racanā kī ||38|| usī samaya kṣatriya, vaiśya . aura śūdra ye tīna varṇa bhī utpanna hue| vināśase jīvoṃkī rakṣā karaneke kāraṇa kṣatriya, vāṇijya 1. kaṇṭhāśleṣoditāḥ ma.| 2. -tīśa: ma. | 3. saṃgrahaḥ ma.| 4. kṣatatastrāṇāt ma.|
