punaḥ kṛtvā suviśrabdhāste dagdhodarapūraṇam | svasthāḥ kāryaṃ vicāryocuḥ svasthe citte hi buddhayaḥ || 116 || ko'bhiprāyaḥ prabhorasya tyaktabhogasya lakṣyatām | navaihikaphalāyedaṃ ceṣṭitaṃ suṣṭhuduṣkaram ||117|| tathā nena bho dṛṣṭāpado vipado yathā | ratyaratyorvighātena viṣayāi viṣopamāḥ || 118 || sālaṃkāraṃ parityaktaṃ vasanaṃ vyasanaṃ yathā | mūlotkhātāḥ svahastena mūrdhajā vairiṇo yathā || 119 || śarīramapi saṃnyastaṃ saṃnyastāhāravastunā | tadasyābhimataṃ kiṃcidāmutrikaphalaṃ bhavet || 120 || naiṣṭikavratamāsthāya svāminyevaṃ vyavasthite | kiṃ naḥ kartavyamityekaṃ na vidmaḥ sāṃprataṃ vayam || 121 || niṣkrāntānāmanenāmā svadeśāt pratinivartanam | naiva puṣṇāti naśchāyāmapāyabahulaṃ ca tat || 122 || na śaktāścarituṃ caryāṃ yadi nāma vayaṃ vibhoḥ | vanavāsitvasāmyena kiṃ na kurmo'nuvartanam || 123 || iti niścitya te'nyonyaṃ pāṇḍupatraphalāśinaḥ | jaṭāvalkalino jātāstāpasā vanavāsinaḥ || 124 || || yo marīcikumārastu naptā taptatanurvimoḥ | dṛṣṭavān jalabhāvena tṛṣāmarumarīcikām || 125 || jalāvagāhanānyasya gajasyeva vidāhinaḥ | mṛdavaśca mṛdaścakruḥ śarīraparinirvṛtim || 126 || yattanmāna kaṣāyī sa kāṣāyaṃ veṣamagrahīt | ekadaṇḍī śucirmuṇḍī parivābrata poṣaṇam ||127|| namiśca vinamiśvobhau bhogayācanayāturau | tāvudvigno vibhognau pādayorduḥsthitau sthitau || 128 ||
vṛkṣoṃko chāla ādi dhāraṇa kara nagna veṣa choḍa़ diyā || 115 || isake bāda niścintatāse adhama udarakī pūrti kara jaba ve svastha hue taba kāryakā vicārakara paraspara kahane lage so ṭhīka hī hai kyoṃki cittake svastha honepara hī buddhi utpanna hotī hai-vicāraśakti ātī hai || 116 ||
ve kahane lage ki bhagavānne samasta bhogoṃko choḍa़ diyā hai so isameṃ inakā kyā abhiprāya hai| yaha jñāta kiyā jāye | aihika phalake lie to inakī yaha atiśaya kaṭhina ceṣṭā nahīṃ ho sakatī kyoṃki inhoṃne sampattiyoṃ ko vipattiyoṃke samāna dekhā hai, rati aura aratiko naṣṭa kara viṣayoṃko viṣake samāna samajhā hai, vastrābhūṣaṇako duḥkhake samāna choḍa़ diyā hai, śirake bāloṃko śatruoṃkī taraha apane hāthase jaḍa़ se ukhāḍa़ diyā hai aura āhāra-pānīkā parityāga kara diyā hai isalie śarīrako bhī choḍa़ā huā samajhanā cāhie| isase jāna paḍa़tā hai ki inheṃ koī pāralaukika phala hī abhipreta hogā ||117- 120 || jabaki bhagavān naiṣṭhika vrata lekara isa prakāra virājamāna haiṃ - kucha bolatecālate nahīṃ haiṃ, taba isa sthiti meṃ hameṃ kyā karanā cāhie, isa eka bātako hama loga isa samaya bilakula nahīṃ jānate || 121 || hama loga inake sātha apane deśase nikala āye haiṃ isalie aba loṭakara jānā to hamārī śobhāko nahīṃ baḍha़ātā| sātha hī lauṭakara jānā aneka bādhāoṃ kaṣṭoṃse bharā hai || 122 || | yadi hama bhagavān‌kī caryākā ācaraṇa karaneke lie samarthaṃ nahīṃ haiṃ to kyā vanavāsīpanekī sadṛśatāse hama inakā anusaraṇa nahīṃ kara sakate ? bhāvārthaṃ - yadi hamase inake samāna kucha tapaścaryā nahīṃ banatī hai to inake samāna vanameṃ to raha sakate haiṃ || 123 || āpasameṃ aisā niścaya kara ve bhraṣṭa rājā, pake patra aura phaloṃko khāte hue jaṭā aura vṛkṣoṃkī chāla dhāraṇa kara vanavāsī tāpasa bana gaye ||124|| unameṃ marīci kumāra nāmakā jo bhagavānkā potā thā, pyāsa se usakā śarīra santapta ho rahā thā, usane bhrāntivaśa marusthalakī marīcikāko hī jala samajha liyā tathā usameṃ loṭane lagā so jisa prakāra jalameṃ praveśa karanā santapta hāthī ke śarīrako śānti pahu~cātā hai usī prakāra komala miṭṭīne usake śarīrako kucha śānti pahu~cāyo ||125-126 || marīci baḍa़ā mānakaṣāyī thā isalie usane parivrājakoṃ ke vratako poṣaṇa karanevālā geruā veṣa svīkāra kara liyā | vaha eka daṇḍa apane sātha rakhatā thā, snānādise apaneko pavitra mānatā thā tathā śira muḍa़āye rakhatā thā || 127|| idhara jo bhogoṃkī yācanāse atiśaya duḥkhī the, bhogoṃke abhāva ke kāraṇa udvigna the, 1. tyaktaṃ | 2. svadeśān ma. | 3. -'nuvartataṃ ma.

dhūtāsano'vadhijñānāt tadbuddhā dharaṇaḥ phaṇī | ājagāma munerbhaktyā maunaṃ sarvārthasādhanam ||129|| viśvāsya divyarūpo'sau bhrātarau bhrātarau yathā | mahāvidyāṃ dadau tābhyāṃ vidyālābho gurorvaśāt ||30|| yo'go vidyādharādhāro vijayāī itīritaḥ | so'pi tābhyāṃ tato labdhaḥ kiṃ na syāda gurusevayā ||13|| sa namirdakṣiṇaśreṇyāṃ pañcāśanagareśvaraḥ | vinamiścottaraśreṇyāmabhūt ṣaṣṭipureśvaraḥ ||132|| adhyaśiṣṭanna miḥ śreṣṭaṃ nagaraṃ rathanūpuram | nabhastilakamanvathaṃ vinamiḥ saha bāndhavaiḥ ||133|| vidyādharajano dhīroṃ prāpya tau parameśvarī | uparisthitamātmānaṃ bhuvanasyāpyamanyata ||13|| athāsau pratimāstho'pi praviśya bhagavān sthitaḥ | parīpahāgnividhyāpisaddhyānajaladhau sthiraḥ ||135|| matvetaramanuṣyāṇāṃ bhavatāṃ ca bhaviṣyatām | mokṣāya vijigīṣaṇāṃ bhuktyabhāve'lpaśaktitām ||136|| dharmārthakāmamokṣeṣu dharmaḥ kṣāntyādilakṣaṇaḥ | puruṣārthaḥ sthito mukhyo mokṣakāmārthasādhanaḥ ||137|| prāṇādhiṣṭānatanniṣṭaṃ śarīraṃ dharmasādhanam | prāṇaradhiṣṭitaḥ prāṇī prāṇāścānnairadhiṣṭitāḥ ||138|| garamparyaṇa dharmasya tato'nnamapi sādhanam | prāṇināmalpavīryāṇāṃ pradhānasthitikāraṇam ||13|| atastasyānavadyasya grahaṇe vidhimarthinām | śāsanasthitaye'nnasya darśayāmīha bhārate ||14||

athānantara- yadyapi dhīra-vīra bhagavān paroṣaharūpī agniko bujhānevāle praśasta dhyānarūpī sāgarameṃ praveśa kara pratimāyogase virājamāna the-chaha māhase pratimāyoga dhāraṇa karanepara bhī āhārake binā unheṃ kucha bhī ākulatā nahīṃ thī to bhī 'mokṣa prāpta karaneke lie karmarūpī śatruoṃko jītaneko icchā karanevāle jo anya manuṣya vartamānameṃ haiṃ tathā āge hoṃge āhārake abhāvameṃ unakī śakti kṣīṇa ho jāyegī' aisā mānakara ve vicāra karane lage ki kṣamā ādi lakṣaṇoṃse yukta dharma-puruṣārtha, dharma, artha, kāma aura mokṣa ina cāroṃ puruṣārthoṃ meṃ mukhya hai, vahī mokṣa, kāma aura arthakā sādhana hai | dharmakā sādhana śarīra hai aura śarīra prāṇoṃkā ādhāra honese prāṇoṃpara nirbhara hai| prāṇī prāṇoṃse adhiṣṭhita hai arthāt prāṇoṃke dvārā jīvita hai aura prāṇa annase adhiṣṭhita haiṃ arthāt annase hī prāṇa surakṣita rahate haiṃ| isalie paramparāse anna bhī dharmakā sādhana hai| alpaśaktike dhāraka manuṣyoṃkī sthiti pradhāna puruṣārtha-dharma meṃ banī rahe isameṃ anna bhī kāraṇa hai| ataḥ isa bharata kṣetrameṃ śāsanako sthiratāke lie maiṃ āhārake icchuka manuṣyoṃko nirdoṣa āhāra grahaṇa karanekī vidhi dikhātā hū~ ||135-140|| aisā vicārakara, yadyapi bhagavān kṣudhādike 1. cāturī ma. | 2. dharaṇendrāt | 3. -matyartha ma. | 4. dhīraḥ ma.| 5. sthiraḥ ma.| 6. vidhyāpī | 7. puruṣārthasthito mokṣo mukhyo ma.| 8. prāṇastvanna -ma. | 9. parārthamati ma.|

daśamaḥ sargaḥ
dharma pravadatā tena tadā trailokyasaṃnidhau | taṃ varṣasahastrāntaṃ maunamudyoditaṃ dṛḍham ||1|| saṃsārataraṇaṃ tīrtha nāthe darśayati svayam | dadarśa jagadatyartha gambhīrārthamapi sphuṭam ||2|| vāgādyatiśayodyoṃte dyotayatyarthasaṃpadam | jinendradyumaṇau ko vā mithyāndhatamasaṃ bhajet ||3|| jinendro'tha jagau dharmaḥ kāryaḥ sarvasukhākaraḥ | prāṇibhiḥ sarvayatnena sthitaḥ prāṇidayādiṣu ||4|| sukhaṃ devanikāyepu mānuṣeṣu ca yatsukham | indriyārthasamudbhūtaṃ tatsarva dharmasaṃbhavam ||5|| karmakṣayasamudbhatamapavargasukhaṃ ca yat | ātmādhīnamanantaṃ tad dharmādevopajāyate ||6|| dayā satyamathāsteyaṃ brahmacaryamamūrcchatā | sūkṣmato yatidharmaḥ syātsthūlato gṛhamedhinām ||7|| dāna pūjātapaśīla lakṣaṇaśca caturvidhaḥ | tyāgajaścaiva śārīro dharmo gṛhaniṣeviṇām ||8|| samyagdarśanamūlo'yaṃ mahaddhikasuraśriyam | dadāti yatidharmastu puṣṭo mokṣasukhapradaḥ ||9|| svargāpavargamūlasya saddharmasyeha lakṣaṇam | śrṛtajñānādviniśceyamarvāgdarśimirarthibhiḥ ||10|| dvādaśāṅgaṃ śrutajñānaṃ dravyabhāvabhidāṃ śritam | āptāmivyaṅgayamātaśca nirdoṣāvaraṇo mataḥ ||11||
usa samaya trilokavartī jīvoṃke sannidhānameṃ dharmakā upadeśa dete hue bhagavānne eka hajāra varṣa taka dṛḍha़tāpūrvaka dhāraṇa kiyā huā mauna kholā ||1|| śrī ādi jinendra svayaṃ hī saṃsārasāgarameṃ pāra karanevālā tīrtha dikhalā rahe the, isalie saṃsārake samasta jīva atiśaya gūḍha़ arthako bhī saralatāse dekha rahe the| bhāvārtha-yadyapi divyadhvanimeṃ pratipādita padārtha atyanta gambhīra thā phira bhī vaktāke prabhāvase loga use saralatāse samajha rahe the ||2|| usa samaya jaba ki vacana ādike atiśayoṃse prakāśamāna jinendrarūpī sūrya svayaṃ padārthoṃ ko prakāśita kara rahe the taba kauna manuṣya mithyātvarūpī andhakārako prāpta ho sakatā thā ? arthāt koī nahīṃ ||3||
athānantara jinendra bhagavānne kahā ki samasta prāṇiyoṃko jīva-dayā ādi kāryoṃ meṃ sthita dharma pūrṇa prayatnase karanā cāhie kyoṃki dharma hī samasta sukhoṃkī khāna hai ||4|| cāra nikāyake devoṃ aura manuṣyoṃmeṃ indriya viṣayajanya jo sukha dikhāī detā hai vaha saba dharmase hī utpanna huā hai ||5|| aura karmoṃke rūpase utpanna, svādhīna tathā antase rahita jo mokṣasambandhī sukha hai vaha bhī dharmase hī utpanna hotā hai ||6|| ahiṃsā, satya, acaurya, brahmacarya aura aparigraha-ye sūkṣma rītise dhāraṇa kiye jāveṃ to munikā dharma hai aura sthūla rītise dhāraṇa kiye jāveṃ to gṛhasthakā dharma hai ||7|| dāna, pūjā, tapa aura śīla yaha gṛhasthakā cāra prakārakā śārīrika dharma hai- śarīrase karane yogya hai| gṛhasthakā yaha caturvidha dharma tyāgase hī utpanna hotā hai ||8|| samyagdarśana jisakī jaḍa़ hai aisā yaha gṛhasthakā dharma mahaddhika devoṃkī lakṣmī pradāna karatā hai aura pūrṇatāse pālana kiyā huā munidharma mokṣa sukhako denevālā hai ||9|| jo mātra arvācīna bātako hī dekha sakate haiṃ aise hitābhilāṣī manuṣyoṃko ( chadmastha jīvoṃko) svarga aura mokṣake mūlabhūta samīcīna dharmakā lakṣaṇa śrutajñānake dvārā jānanā cāhie| bhāvārtha-alpajñānī manuṣya dvādaśāṃgake sahāre hī dharmakā lakṣaṇa samajha sakate haiṃ, isalie yahā~ dvādaśāṃgakā varṇana karanā ucita hai ||10|| dravyaśruta aura bhāvaśrutake bhedako prāpta huā dvādaśāṃga śrutajñāna āptake dvārā prakaṭa hotā hai aura āpta vahī mānā gayā hai

cakravartī camūṃ mūle saṃsthāpya himavagireḥ | kṛtāṣṭamopavāso'sau darmaśayyāmadhiṣṭitaḥ ||41|| kṛtatīrthodakasnānaḥ kṛtakautukamaṇḍanaḥ | ārūḍhāśvaratho dhanvī cakrāyudhapuraḥsaraḥ ||42|| kṣullakaṃ himavatkṛṭaṃ yatra tatra gataḥ śarī| vaiśākhasthānamāsthāya babhāṇa raṇadakṣiṇaḥ ||43|| bho bho nāgasuparṇādyāḥ śāsanaṃ śṛṇutāśu me | deśasthā ityataścāpamākṛṣya śaramākṣipat ||45|| papātāśaninirghoṣo yojane dvādaśe śaraḥ | himavatkūṭavāsī taṃ suro dṛṣṭā samāgamat ||4|| divyāmoṣadhimālāṃ sa divyaṃ ca haricandanam | dattvā saṃpūjya taṃ yātaḥ śāsanaiṣī visarjitaḥ ||46|| āgatya cakravartī ca tato vṛṣabhaparvatam | tatrālikhanijaṃ nāma kākaṇyā sa parisphuṭam ||17|| vṛṣabhasya suto mo'haṃ cakrī bharata ityasau| pravācya vijayārddhasya vedikāmagamat prabhuḥ||48|| buddhvopavāsinaṃ tatra śreṇidvayanivāsinau | namiśca vinamiścobhau gandhārādyaiḥ samāgatau ||49|| strīratnaṃ pratigṛhyābhyāṃ subhadrākhyaṃ khagairnataḥ | gaṅgānuvedikaṃ gatvā bhaktamaṣṭamamāsthitaḥ ||50|| gaṅgādevī viditvā taṃ gaṅgākūṭa nivāsinī | hemakumbhasahasreṇa kṛtvā tadabhiṣecanam ||51|| rasiṃhāsane tasmai pādapīṭhayute dadau | vijayāīkumāro'pi tasthau cakreśaśāsane ||52|| aṣṭādaśasahasrāṇi mlecchakṣitibhṛtāṃ tataḥ| vaśīkṛtyāttasadanaḥ khaṇḍakāpātamāpa saḥ ||53||
bharatakā abhiṣeka kara unheṃ pādapīṭhase suśobhita do uttama āsana bheṃṭa kiye ||40|| cakravartī senāko himavān parvatakī tarāīmeṃ ṭhaharākara tathā svayaṃ tīna dinake upavāsakā niyama lekara darbhaśayyāpara ārūḍha़ hue ||41|| tadanantara jinhoṃne tīrthajalase snāna kiyā thā, uttama veṣabhūṣā dhāraṇa kī thī, jo ghoḍoṃke rathapara savāra the, jinake āge-āge cakraratna cala rahā thā aura jo raṇameṃ atyanta kuśala the aise bharata, jahā~ himavān parvatakā himavat nāmaka choṭā kūṭa thā vahā~ āye aura bāṇa hāthameṃ le tathā vaiśākha āsanase khaḍa़e hokara bole ki 'he isa deśa meṃ rahanevāle nāgakumāra, suparṇakumāra ādi devo! tuma loga śīghra hī merī ājñā suno|' yaha kaha unhoṃne dhanuṣa khīṃcakara bāṇa choḍa़ā ||42-44|| vajrake samāna śabda karatā huā vaha bāṇa bāraha yojana dūra jākara girā tathā himavat kūṭapara rahanevālā deva use dekhakara bharatake pāsa āyā ||45|| usane divya oṣadhioṃkī mālā tathā divya haricandana dekara bharatakī pūjā kī| tadanantara ājñākī icchā karatā huā vaha bharatase vidā le apane sthānapara calā gayā ||46|| cakravartī vahāṃse calakara vṛṣabhācala parvatapara āye aura vahā~ unhoṃne kākaṇī ratnase sāpha-sāpha apanā yaha nāma likhā ki 'maiṃ bhagavān vṛṣabhadevakā putra bharata cakravartī hū~'| nāma likhakara tathā bā~cakara ve vijayādha parvatako vedikāke samīpa āye ||47-48|| dahā~ jākara unhoṃne upavāsa dhāraṇa kiyā| donoṃ śreṇiyoṃ ke nivāsī nami aura vinamiko jaba yaha jñāta huā ki bharata yahā~ vidyamāna haiṃ taba ve gandhāra ādi vidyādharoṃke sātha vahā~ āye ||49|| samasta vidyādharāna unheṃ namaskāra kiyā aura bharatane nami, vinamise subhadrā nāmaka strī-ratna grahaṇa kiyā| tatpaścāt ve gaṃgā nadīkī vedikāke kināre-kināre calakara gaṃgākūṭake samīpa āye aura tīna dinake upavāsakā niyama lekara vahā~ ṭhahara gaye | vahā~ gaṃgākūṭapara rahanevālī gaṃgā devīne unake ānekā samācāra jānakara suvarṇamaya eka hajāra kalaśoṃse unakā abhiṣeka kiyā ||50-51|| abhiṣekake bāda usane pādapoṭhase yukta do ratnoṃke siṃhāsana bheṃṭa kiye| yahāṃ vijayārdha parvatakā svāmī vijayādha kumāradeva cakravartīkī ājñāmeṃ khaḍā rahā ||52||

samati nāmaka mantrīne ekāntameṃ ādaraparvaka rājāse pūchā ki he svāmina ! āja āpa viṣādayukta kyoṃ haiṃ ? kṛpākara kahie ||53|| he prabho! āpakā yaha ekachatra rājya hai, prajā āpameṃ anurakta hai tathā anya rājā anurāga aura pratāpase vaśībhūta ho āpake dāsa ho rahe haiṃ ||54|| abhilaṣita vastuoṃko dekara āpane samasta yācakoṃko santuṣṭa kara rakhā hai tathā premakī adhikatāse prasanna hokara āpane samasta strigeko sammānita kiyā hai ||55|| dharma, artha tathā kāmaviṣayaka koī bhī vastu āpako durlabha nahīṃ hai, isa prakāra he nātha! saba prakārako kuśalatā honepara bhī āpakā mana dukhī kyoṃ ho rahā hai ? ||56|| sabhī loga prāṇatulya mitra ke lie manakā duḥkha bāṃṭakara sukhī ho jāte haiṃ yaha jagatkī rīti hai ||57| isalie he prabho ! batalāie maiṃ āja hī āpakī abhilāṣāko pūrṇa karūṃgā kyoṃki svāmīke sukhī rahanepara hī samasta prajā sukhī rahatī hai ||58||
___ mantrīke isa prakāra kahanepara rājāne śīghra ho kahā ki āja udyānako jāte samaya maiṃne eka para-strīko dekhā thā usīne vidyākī bhāṃti mujhe śīghra hī vaśa kara liyā hai ||59|| vaha aisī thī, aisī usakī veṣa-bhūṣā thī aura apanī spaṣṭa ceṣṭāoṃse apanā abhiprāya prakaṭa kara rahī thī prāyaḥ āpane bhī vaha dekhī hogī ||60|| yaha sunakara mantrīne kahā ki he svāmin ! dekhī hai, avaśya dekhī hai, vaha vīraka vaiśyakī vanamālā nāmakī strī hai ||61|| rājāne kahā ki yadi āja usake sātha merā samāgama nahīṃ hotā hai to maiṃ mānatā hū~ ki na merā jīvana bacegā aura na usa kuṭila bhauṃhoṃvālī vanamālākā ||2|| jāna paḍa़tā hai ki vaha mere binā eka dina bhī nahīṃ ṭhahara sakatī
aura na isake binā maiṃ bhī eka dina ṭhahara sakatā hū~ isalie śīghra hī isakā upāya karo ||63|| yadyapi isa kāryase isa janma meṃ apayaśa prāpta hotā hai aura parajanmameṃ anarthakī prāpti hotī hai tathāpi janmāndhake samāna mūrkha manuṣya kāryako nahīṃ dekhatā ||64|| isalie akāryameṃ pravṛtta honepara bhī maiṃ tumhāre dvārā rokane yogya nahīṃ hū~| yadi jīvana rahā to pāpako śānta karane ke bahuta-se upāya ho jāveṃge ||65|| yadyapi rājākā vaha vacana anyāyarūpa thā tathā mantrīne use

drutavilambitavṛttam atha vibuddhasarojavanaspṛśā suramiṇā spṛśatā marutā tadā | hṛtavapuḥśramakaṃ mithunaṃ mithastadakarodupagūḍhamatiślatham ||1|| mṛdutaraṅgaghane śayanasthale maditapuṣpacaye śayitotthitaḥ | saha bamau priyayā sumukho yathā samadahaṃsayuvā sikatāsthale ||2|| viṣahate sma viyogaviṣa kṣaṇaṃ virahiṇoriva rātriṣu pakṣiṇoḥ | priyavadhūvarayorvarayostayorna hṛdayaṃ hṛdayaṅgamaceṣṭayoḥ ||3|| na visasarja tataḥ svapatergṛha svagṛha eva rurodha vadhū prabhuḥ | rahasi durlabhamāpya manīṣitaṃ na hi vimuñcati labdharaso janaḥ ||4|| sumukhamukhyavadhūjanemukhyatāṃ samadhigamya ni varavadhūratigauravamāpa sā na sulabhaṃ sumukhe kimu bhartari ||5|| avatatāra kadācidacintito nidhirivorutaponidhirañcitaḥ | nṛpagṛhaṃ varadharmamunihānatithireti hi bhariśubhodaye ||6|| paramadarśanaśuddhi viśuddhadhīradhikabodhavibuddhapadārthakaḥ |
vratasuguptisamityatiśuddhatāmayacaritrapavitritavigrahaḥ ||7|| athānantara khile hue kamala vanakā sparśa karanevālī sugandhita vāyune sparśa kara jisakā samasta śrama dūra kara diyā thā aise usa mithunane usa samaya parasparakā āliṃgana atyanta ḍhīlā kara diyā ||1|| jisapara taraṃgoṃke samāna komala sikuḍa़neṃ uṭha rahī thīṃ tathā jisapara phūloṃkā samūha masalā gayā thā aisī śayyāpara sokara uṭhā sumukha, priyā vanamālāke sātha usa taraha suśobhita ho rahā thā jisa taraha ki bālūke sthalapara haṃsīke sātha madonmatta yuvā haṃsa saśobhita hotā hai ||2|| jisa prakāra rātrike samaya bichuḍa़nevāle cakavā-cakavīkā hṛdaya kṣaṇa-bharake lie bhī viyogarūpī viṣako sahana nahīṃ karatā hai usī prakāra manohara ceṣṭāke dhāraka una priya vadhū-varakā hṛdaya kṣaṇabharake lie bhī viyogarūpī viṣako sahana nahīṃ karanā cāhatā thā ||3|| isalie rājā sumukhane vadhū-vanamālāko usake patike ghara nahīṃ bhejā apane hī ghara roka liyā so ṭhīka hī hai kyoṃki durlabha vastuko pākara usakā rasa prāpta karanevāle use choḍa़te nahīṃ haiṃ |4|| sundarī vanamālā, apane . uttama guṇoṃse rājā sumukhakī samasta mukhya striyoṃmeṃ mukhyatāko pākara parama gauravako prāpta huī thī so ṭhīka hī hai kyoṃki bhartāke anukūla rahanepara kauna-sī vastu sulabha nahīṃ ? ||5||
tadanantara kisī samaya acintita nidhike samāna utkṛṣṭa tapake bhāṇḍāra varadharma nāmake pūjya muni rājā sumukhake ghara āye so ṭhīka hī hai kyoṃki atyadhika puṇyakā udaya honepara hī atithi ghara āte haiṃ ||6|| una muniko buddhi utkṛṣṭa darśanaviśuddhise viśuddha thī, adhika jñānase ve aneka padārthoṃko jānate the, vrata gupti aura samitikī atiśaya śuddhirūpī cāritrase unakā śarīra pavitra thā, ve anaśana tathā svādhyāya ādi tapakī nirmala lakṣmīse yukta the aura dhavala

atha tayā sa khagendrayuvānyadā kamalayeva ca khecarakanyayā | paramabhūtivivāhavidhānataḥ samamayoji' nijairjanatānataḥ ||3|| anubabhūva sukhaṃ cirametayā madanabhāvavilāsasametayā | suratanāṭakabhūmivinītayā madananartakasūrivinītayā ||34|| suravadhūvarasundarakandare paramavallabhayā saha mandare | surabhidevatarūmatacandane ciramaraṃsta tayā saha nandane ||35|| sa kulaśailasaraḥsaritāṃ tayā saha taṭeṣu sarāgamatāntayā| ratimavāpa kadācana kāntayā taruṣu bhogabhuvāmapi kāntayā ||36|| sthitimitaṃ vijayāīgirī pure raṇitadivyavadhūpadanūpure | bhuvi yadanyasudurlamamarthitaṃ bhajati tattadayatnasamarpitam ||37|| atha sa vīraka īśvaravañcitaḥ priyatamāvirahāśivaṃ citaḥ | kvacidiyāya śucā mṛdupallave śiśiratalpatale'stavipallave ||38|| na samaśīśamadasya śaśī karaiḥ hṛdayadāhamamā himaśīkaraiḥ| niśi sadā vihagasya viyoginaḥ sasaraso'pi yathā bhuvi yoginaḥ ||39|| sa vinigṛhya cirādvirahavyathāṃ ratirahasyagṛhāśramamāśramam |
jinanideśitamāsṛtavān vaśī sa hi paraṃ śaraṇaṃ śaraṇārthinām ||10|| tadanantara janasamūhake dvārā namaskṛta usa vidyādhara yuvāko, usake kuṭumbījanoṃne vaibhava pūrṇa vivāhakī vidhise lakṣmīko tulanā karanevālī vidyādhara-kanyā manoramāke sātha yukta kiyā ||33|| vivāhake bāda kumāra ārya, kāmajanita hāva-bhāvoṃse sahita kāmadevarūpī nataṃkācāryake dvārā śikṣita evaṃ suratarūpo nāṭakakī raṃgabhūmimeṃ lāyī huī isa manoramāke sātha sukhakā upabhoga karane lagā ||34|| kabhī vaha deva dampatiyoṃse sundara kandarāoṃse yukta mandara giripara isa parama vallabhāke sātha krīḍa़ā karatā thā to kabhī sugandhita devadāru aura candanake ū~ce-ūṃce vṛkṣoṃse suśobhita nandana vanameṃ isake sātha cirakāla taka krīḍa़ā karatā rahatā thā ||35|| kabhī vaha kulācaloṃke padma ādi sarovaroṃ aura gaṃgā ādi mahānadiyoṃke taṭoṃpara tathā kabhī bhogabhūmike vṛkṣoṃke nīce khedarahita sundaro vallabhāke sātha rāga-sahita rati-krīḍa़āko prāpta hotā thā ||36|| isa prakāra vijayādha parvatapara rahanevālā vaha yugala, divya striyoṃke padanūpuroṃko jhanakārase yukta apane nagarameṃ usa sukhakā upabhoga karatā thā jo pṛthivīpara dūsare manuṣyoṃke lie icchā karanepara bhī durlabha thā aura use binā hī prayatnake prāpta thā ||37||
athānantara-rājā sumukhake dvārā ṭhagā huā vīraka seṭha, priyatamā-vanamālāke virahameṃ śokake kāraṇa kahīṃ bhī hṛdayako śāntiko prāpta nahīṃ hotā thā| yahā~ taka ki jisapara vipattikā eka aṃśa bhī nahīṃ thā aise komala-pallavoṃse racī huī śītala śayyāpara bhī use sukha prāpta nahīṃ hotā thā ||38|| vaha viraha-jvālā śānta karaneke lie rātrike samaya khulī cā~danīmeṃ sarovarake taṭapara jā baiṭhatā thā para vahā~para bhī candramā barphake kaṇoṃke sātha-sātha apanī kiraṇoṃse usake hṛdayakī dāhako śānta nahīṃ kara pātā thā| vaha virahī cakravāka pakṣīke samāna sadā virahakī dāhameṃ jhulasatā hī rahatā thā ||39|| tadanantara usa vīrakane cirakāla bāda virahakī vyathāko 1. napatinā samayoji vidhānataḥ ṅa | 2. sarāgam atāntayā iti cchedaḥ| atāntayā - aśrāntayā iti ghapustake ṭippaṇam | 3. tattadayatnasamarpitam ṅa. | 4. nnasivaṃcitaḥ ma., cito hṛdayasya śivaṃ sukhaṃ na iyāya | 5. niyoginaḥ ma.| 6. susaraso'pi ma. | sarovarasahitasyāpi | 7.-māśritavāna ma.|

harivaṃśapurāṇe ativitapya tapastanuśoṣaṇaṃ viṣayalubdhamanobhavapeṣaṇam | agamadeśasukhāmbudhipoṣaṇaṃ prathamakalpamathāmaratoṣaṇam ||41|| suravadhūnivahādiparigrahaḥ sakalabhūṣaṇabhūṣitavigrahaḥ | surasukhāmṛtasāgarasaṃgataḥ samamatiṣṭata bhāvarasaṃ gataḥ ||42|| divi kadācidasau varakāminīnivahamadhyagato'vadhigocaram | samanayadvanitāṃ vanamālikā paricitaḥ praṇayaḥ khalu dastyajaḥ ||43|| sumukharājakṛtaṃ ca parābhavaṃ sa paricintya surastadanantaram | viṣamitonmiṣitāvadhicakṣuṣā mithunamaikṣata khecarayostayoḥ ||44|| prabhutayā pravidhāya parāmavaṃ parabhave hṛtavāṃśca mama priyām | iha bhave'pi tayaiva sahekṣyate ratimitaḥ sa para samukhaḥ khalaḥ ||45|| kṛtavato'pakṛti viṣamāṃ dviṣo dviguṇitā yadi sā na vidhīyate | prabhutayā kimanarthikayā pramoḥ pramavato'pi nirudyamacetasaḥ ||46|| iti vicintya ruṣā kaluṣīkṛtaḥ pratividhānakṛtau kṛtaniścayaḥ | bhuvamavātaradāśu sa vairadhīstridivato divasādhipamāsvaraḥ ||47|| sa khalu khecararājasutaṃ suraḥ sumukharājacaraṃ khacarīsakham |

kadācit vaha deva svargameṃ uttamottama striyoṃke bīca baiṭhā thā ki usane acānaka hī apanī pūrvabhavakī strī vanamālāko avadhijñānakā viṣaya banāyā arthāt avadhijñānake dvārā usakā vicāra kiyā so ṭhīka hī hai kyoṃki paricita-anubhūta sneha baḍa़ī kaṭhināīse chūṭatā hai ||43|| vicāra karate hī use sumukha rājāke dvārā kiyā huā parābhava smṛta ho gayā| tadanantara eka bāra nimīlita kara usane avadhijñānarūpī netrako punaḥ kholā to vidyādhara aura vidyādharīkā vaha yugala sāmane dikhane lagā ||44|| vaha vicāra karane lagā ki dekho jisa duṣṭa sumukhane pūrvabhavameṃ prabhutāvaśa tiraskāra kara hamārī strīkā haraṇa kiyā thā vaha isa bhavameṃ bhī usī strīke sātha parama ratiko prāpta huā dikhāī de rahā hai ||45|| yadi viṣama apakāra karanevāle śatrukā dūnā apakāra nahīṃ kiyā to samartha honepara bhī nirudyama cittake dhāraka prabhukī nirarthaka prabhutāse kyā lābha hai ? ||46|| aisā vicārakara krodhase jisakā citta kaluṣita ho rahā thā, tathā badalā lenekā jisane dṛḍha़ niścaya kara liyā thā aisā vaha sūryake samāna dedīpyamāna deva pūrva vairako buddhimeṃ rakha śīghra hī svargase pṛthivīpara utarā ||47|| usa samaya rājā sumukhakā jīva ārya nāmakā vidyādhara, apanī vidyādharīke sātha harivarṣa kṣetrameṃ icchānusāra krīḍa़ā karatā huā indrake samāna suśobhita 1. cakṣuṣaḥ ma.| 2. hatavāṃśca ma.|

vasantatilakāvṛttam śrīśītalādiha pareṣu jineṣu paścāt tīrtha pravartya bharate jagatāṃ hitārtham | kālakrameṇa navasu śritavatsu mokṣaṃ svargādihaiṣyati jinādhipatau ca viṃśe ||1|| śakrājñayā pratidinaṃ vasudhārayoccairāpūrayatyavanipasya gṛhaṃ kuberaḥ | padmāvatī madutale śayane śayānā svapnān dadarśa daśa ṣaṭ ca niśāvasāne ||2|| nāgokṣasiṃhakamalākusumasragindubālārkamatsya kalaśābjasaro'mburāśīn | siṃhāsanāmaravimānaphaṇīndragehasadratnarāśiśikhino jinasūrapaśyat ||3|| sopāsitā pavanavatyupamāvyatītadivyaprabhāvadigabhikhya kumārikābhiḥ | śayyātale sakusame śaśabhe vibuddhā lekhā yathā namasi tārakitā himāṃśoḥ ||4|| ubhidrapadmanayanānanapāṇipādā sā rāgiṇī dinamukhe'dhipatiṃ sumitram | bhadrāsanodayagataṃ sthalapadminīva padmāvatī samudiyāya sapuṇḍarīkā ||5|| 'citrāmbarāmburamanāgaraṇitātimajumañjīrasiñjitavihaṅganinādaramyā | mīnekṣaṇā trivalibhaṅgataraṅgiṇī sā strīvāhinī samagamad varaṃvāhinīśam ||6|| pīnastanastavakabhāranatāṅgayaṣṭirātāmrapallavakarā mṛdubāhuśākhā |
saṃcāriṇī maṇivibhūṣaṇamanmahīśakalpadrumaṃ yuvatikalpalatā nanāma ||7|| athānantara śrīśītalanātha bhagavānke paścāt jaba kālakramase nau tīrthaṃkara bharata kṣetra meṃ jagatke jīvoṃke hitārtha dharma tīrthakī pravṛtti kara mokṣa cale gaye aura bīsaveṃ tīrthaṃkara svargase avatāra leneke sanmukha hue taba indrako ājñāse kubera pratidina rājā sumitrake gharako ratnoṃkī utkṛṣṭa dhārāse bharane lagā| kadācit komala śayyāpara śayana karanevālī rānī padmāvatīne rātrike antima samaya 1 gaja, 2 vṛṣabha, 3 siṃha, 4 lakṣmī, 5 puṣpamālā, 6 candramā, 7 bālasūrya, 8 matsya, 9 kalaśa, 10 kamalasarovara, 11 samudra, 12 siṃhāsana, 13 devavimāna, 14 nāgendrabhavana, 15 ratnarāśi aura 16 agni ye solaha svapna dekhe ||1-3|| upamārahita evaṃ divya prabhāvako dhāraṇa karanevālī ninyānabe dikkamārī deviyoṃke dvārā sevita jinamātā padmāvatī jaba jāgakara phaloṃkī śayyāpara baiṭhī taba aisī suśobhita ho rahī thī māno ākāśameṃ tārāoṃse ghirī huī candramākī lekhā hī ho ||4|| tadanantara jisake netra, mukha, hātha aura paira phūle hue kamalake samāna the, jo anurāgase yukta thī, harṣase sahita thī aura hāthameṃ sapheda kamala dhāraṇa kara rahī thī aisī rānī padmāvatī prātaḥkālake samaya ūṃce siṃhāsanapara virājamāna rājā sumitrake pāsa gayī so aisī jāna paḍa़tī thī māno aneka kamaloṃse suśobhita, lālimāyukta sthala-kamalinī hī udayācalapara sthita sumitra-sūryake pāsa jā rahī ho ||5|| jo nānā prakārake vastrarūpī jalase. yukta thī, atyadhika runa-jhuna karanevāle atiśaya sundara nūpuroṃkī jhanakārarūpī pakṣiyoṃkī kala-kala dhvanise
hara thī. machaliyoṃ ke samāna netroṃse sahita thī aura trivalirūpī taraṃgoṃse saśobhita thī aisī vaha strīrūpī nadī rājā sumitrarūpī samudra ke pāsa gayī yaha ucita hī thā ||| usa samaya maṇimaya 1. tīrthaṅkarajananī | 2. sumitrākhyaṃ nṛpaṃ, sūryaṃ ca | 3. citrāṇyambarāṇyevāmbu yasyāṃ sā | 4. uttamasenādhyakṣa pakṣe uttamanadīpatim |

harivaṃśapurāṇe alpapramāṇaparamāṇusamūharāśirāsaṃcitaḥ 'svapariṇāmavaśādasāraḥ| kālapramānajavāvanipātamātrādāyudhanaḥ pralayamatra laghu prayāti ||33|| vajrāsmasaṃhananasaṃhatasaṃdhibandhaḥ satsanniveśanavaramyaśarīrameghaḥ | "modhībhavatyasubhṛtāmasamartha eṣa vāyuprakopabharamagnasamastagātraḥ ||34|| saubhāgyarūpanavayauvanabhūṣaṇasya bhūlokacittanayanāmṛtavarṣaṇasya | dehāmbudasya dinakṛtpratighātinī syācchāyāvayaḥpariṇatidrutavātyayā'sya ||35|| śauryapramāvasuvaśīkṛtasāgarāntabhūrājasiṃhacirarakṣitabhūmimāgāḥ | saurājyabhogagirayo'pi viśīrṇaśṛṅgāścūrṇīmavanti samayāntaravajraghātaiḥ ||36|| netraṃ manaśca bhavadatra kalatramiṣṭaṃ prāṇaiḥ samaṃ samasukhāsukha mitraputram | vyetīha patramiva śuṣkamadṛṣṭavātādevo'pyupaiti hi bhave priyaviprayogam ||37|| paśyannapi kṣaṇavi mājāmaṅgādikaṃ svayamamṛtyubhayo'yamagī| mohāndhakārapihitāgamadṛṣṭiriṣṭaṃ mārga vihāya viṣayāmiṣagartameti ||38|| pratyaṅgamaṅgajamataṅgajasaṃgatāṅgaḥ svāṅgaḥ spṛśan priyavadhajanagātrayaṣṭīḥ| dhika sparśasaukhyavinimīlitanetrabhāgo mātaṅgavada viṣamabandhamiyarti martyaḥ ||39|| āhāramiṣṭamiha pasabhedabhinnamāhārayan bahuvidhaṃ spṛhayāpadṛṣṭiḥ|
jihvāvaśo dalitaśaṅkavilagnāṃsapeśīpriyaścapalamīna ivaiti bandham yaha śīghra vilīna ho gayā hai ||32|| apane-apane pariṇāmoṃke anusāra saṃcita, alpa pramāṇa paramāṇuoṃkā rāśisvarūpa yaha āyurūpa megha niḥsāra hai isīlie to mṛtyurūpī pracaṇḍa vāyuke vegakā āghāta lagate hī śīghra hī naṣṭa ho jātā hai ||33|| vajrarūpī sandhiyoṃke bandhanase yukta yaha prāṇiyoṃkā uttama racanāse suśobhita nūtana evaṃ sundara śarīrarūpī megha, mṛtyurūpī pavanake prabala āghātase kṣata-vikṣata ho asamartha hotā huā viphala ho jātā hai ||34|| saubhāgya, rūpa aura navayauvana hī jisakā ābhūṣaṇa hai tathā jo pṛthivīke samasta manuṣyoṃke citta aura netroṃke lie amṛtakī varṣā karatā hai aise isa śarīrarūpī meghako chāyā, vṛddhāvasthārūpī tīvra āṃdhīse sūryako ācchādita karanevālī ho jātī hai-naṣṭa-bhraṣṭa ho jātī hai ||35|| śauyaṃ aura prabhāvake dvārā sāgarānta pṛthivīko acchī taraha vaśa karanevāle baḍa़e-baḍa़e rājāoṃke dvārā jinameṃ bhūmi-bhāgoṃkī cira rakṣā kī gayī hai aise uttama rājyake bhogarūpī parvatoṃke śikhara bhī kālarūpī pracaṇḍa vajrake āghātase cūra-cūra ho jāte haiṃ ||36|| netra aura manarūpa hotī huī netra aura manake samāna pyārī strī tathā prāṇoṃ ke samāna sakha-daḥkhake sāthī mitra aura patra isa saṃsārameṃ adaṣṭarūpī vāyase prerita ho sūkhe patteke samāna naṣṭa hote rahate haiṃ| manuṣyakī to bāta hī kyā hai deva bhī isa saṃsārameṃ priyajanoṃke viyogako prāpta hotā hai ||37|| aho ! yaha prāṇī, anya prāṇiyoṃke śarīra ādiko kṣaṇabhaṃgura dekhatā huā bhī svayaṃ mṛtyu ke bhayase rahita hai tathā isakī śāstrarūpī dṛṣṭi moharūpī andhakārase ācchādita ho gayī hai isalie yaha iṣṭa mārgako choḍa़kara viṣayarūpī āmiṣake garta meṃ , paḍa़ rahā hai ||38|| jisakā pratyeka aṃga kāmarūpo matta hāthīse saṃgata hai aisā yaha manuṣya apane avayavoṃse priya striyoṃke śarīrakā sparśa karatā huā unake sparśajanya sukhase nimīlita netra ho matta-mātaṃgake samāna viṣaya bandhako prāpta hotā hai isalie isa sparśajanya sukhake lie dhikkāra hai ||39|| jisakī viveka dṛṣṭi naṣṭa ho gayī hai aisā yaha manuṣya jihvā indriyake vaśībhūta ho 1. sapariṇāma- ma., ka. kha.| 2. āyureva dhanaḥ| 3. śoghram | 4. bandha -ma.| 5 vanaramya ma., kha.| 6. meghībhava-ma.|

śoḍaśaḥ sargaḥ
ghrāṇendriyapriyasugandhisugandhamandho' jaṅghābalādiva vilaṅghitatṛptimārgaḥ | duṣpākamastadhiṣaṇo viṣapuṣpagandhamāghrāya śīghramaghameti yathā ṣaḍaṅghriḥ ||41|| cittadravīkaraṇadakṣa kaṭākṣapātasasmeravaktravanitāṅganiviṣṭadṛṣṭiḥ | rūpapriyo'pi lamate paritāpamugraṃ prāptaḥ pataṅga iva dīpaśikhāprapātam || 42 || sveṣṭāṅganā mukharanūpuramekhalā dinānāvibhūṣaṇaravaiḥ priyabhāṣaṇaiśca | saṃgītakaiśca madhurairhṛtadhīradhīraḥ śrotrendriyaimṛga iva mriyate manuṣyaḥ ||43|| saṃkliśyate viṣayabhogakalaṅkapaṅke yatpuṅgavāṃ tatirihālpabalā nimagnā | citraṃ na tad yadatimajjati vajrakāya punnāgasaṃtatiritīdamatīva citram || 44 || yaḥ svargasaukhyajaladhīnatidīrghakālaṃ pītvā'pi tṛptimagamad bahuśo na jīvaḥ | sauhityamalpadivasaiḥ kathamasya kuryāt bhūlokasaukhyale valola tṛṇodabinduḥ ||45|| agnerivendhana mahānicayairna tṛptirambhonidheriva sadāpi nadīsahasaiḥ | jīvasya tṛptiriha nāsti tathāniṣevyaiḥ sāṃsārikairupacitairapi kāma mogaiḥ ||46|| bhogābhilāṣaviṣamāgniśikhākalāpasaṃvṛddhaye hi viṣayendhanarāśiruccaiḥ | tasyaiva tu praśamaheturihaiva tasmād vyāvṛttirindriyajiti sthiravāridhārā 47 || hitvā tato viṣaya saukhyamasārabhūtaṃ śīghraṃ yate'hamiha mokṣapathe sanāthe | svārtha sādhya paramaṃ prathamaṃ parārtha tīrthapravarttanamatha prathayāmi tathyam || 48 ||
243
icchāpūrvaka chaha prakārake rasoṃse yukta nānā prakārake iṣṭa āhārako grahaṇa karatā huā vaṃśīke kā~ṭepara lage māṃsa ke lobho mīnake samāna bandhako prāpta hotā hai ||40|| jisa prakāra nirbuddhi bhramara viṣapuṣpako gandhako sa~ghakara duṣpākase yukta maraṇako prāpta hotā hai usī prakāra jaṃghābalake kāraṇa hī māno tṛpti mārgako ullaṃghana karanevālā yaha manuṣya ghrāṇendriyako acche laganevāle sugandhita padārthoṃkī sugandhako sa~ghakara andhā hotā huā duṣpariṇāmase yukta pāpa bandhako prāpta hotā hai || 41 || jisa prakāra dīpa - śikhāpara paḍa़ā pataṃga ugra santāpako prāpta hotā hai usī prakāra rūpakā lobhī yaha prāṇī, cittako dravībhūta karane meṃ dakṣa kaṭākṣa aura manda manda musakurāhaṭase yukta mukhase suśobhita striyoṃ ke śarīrapara dṛṣṭi ḍālatā huā bhayaṃkara santāpako prāpta hotā hai ||42 || apanī iṣṭa striyoṃke śabdāyamāna nūpura tathā mekhalā ādi nānā prakārake ābhūṣaṇoṃke śabdoṃ, priyabhāṣaṇoṃ aura madhura saṃgītoṃ se jisakī buddhi harī gayī hai aisā yaha manuṣya adhīra hotā huā śrotrendriyake dvārā mṛgake samāna mṛtyuko prāpta hotā hai ||43|| alpa śaktike dhāraka kṣudra manuṣyoṃkā samūha viṣaya-bhogajanya pāparūpī kīcaḍa़ meṃ pha~sakara jo kleśa uṭhātā hai vaha āścarya nahīṃ hai kintu vajramaya śarīra ke dhāraka śreṣṭha manuṣyoṃ kā samudāya bhī jo usa pāpapaṃka meṃ atiśaya nimagna ho rahā hai yaha atyadhika āścaryakī bāta hai ||44|| jo jīva anekoṃ bāra atyanta dīrgha kāla taka svargake sukharūpī sāgarako pīkara bhī tṛptiko prāpta nahīṃ huā use bhūloka sambandhī alpa sukharūpī tṛṇakī caṃcala jalabindu kucha dinoṃ meṃ kaise santuṣṭa kara sakatī hai ? || 45 ||

jisa prakāra īndhanakī bahuta baḍa़ī rāśise agniko tṛpti nahīṃ hotī aura sadā giranevālī hajāroṃ nadiyoṃ se samudrako santoṣa nahīṃ hotā usī prakāra sevana kiye hue saṃsāra ke saṃcita kāma bhogoṃ se jīvako tṛpti nahīṃ hotī ||46 || niścayase viṣayarūpī īndhanakī bahuta baḍa़ī rāśi, bhogābhilāṣārūpī viṣama agniko jvālāoṃkī vṛddhikā kāraṇa hai aura indriyavijayī manuṣyakī jo
viṣayoṃse vyāvṛtti hai vaha sthira jaladhārāke samāna usa viṣamāgniko śāntikā kāraṇa hai || 4 || isalie maiṃ sārahīna viṣayasukhako choḍa़kara śīghra hī hitarūpa mokṣa-mārga meṃ pravṛtti karatā 1. sandho ma | 2. - maṇulola-kha | 3 tathābhiṣekaiḥ ma. |

harivaṃśapurāṇe itthaṃ matiśrutayutāvadhibodhanetre 'jāte svayaṃbhuvi tadā svayameva buddhe | ākampitāsanamabhūdamarendra vṛndaṃ sarvārthasiddhisuraparyavasānamāśu ||49|| laukāntikā lalitakuṇḍalahāraśobhāḥ sārasvataprabhṛtayo nibhṛtāḥ sitābhāḥ | āgatya maulimilitāñjalayaḥ kirantaḥ puṣpāñjalīniti jinaṃ nunuvunamantaḥ ||50|| vardhasva nanda jaya jīva jinendracandra ! vijñānaraśmihatamohatamovitāna | 'nirbandhubandhutama ! bhavyakumudatīnāṃ tīrthasya viṃśatitamasya hitasya kartā ||5|| tvaṃ varttaya tribhuvaneśvara ! dharmatīrtha yatrāyamugrabhavaduḥkhaiśikhiprataptaḥ | snāsvā janastyajati mohamalaṃ samastamahāya yāti ca śivaṃ śivalokamagrayam ||52|| cāritramohaparamopaśamātprabuddhaṃ laukāntikā iti jinaṃ pratibodhayantaḥ | nānyaja gurnijaniyoganivedaneṣu yuktā hi yānti na punaḥ punaruktadoṣam ||53|| saudharmapūrvavibudhāśca caturṇikāyā nānāvimānanivahasthagitāntarikṣāḥ | saṃprāpya nāthamamiṣicya sugandhitoyaistaṃ maṣitaṃ vidadhuradbhutamaṣaṇādyaiḥ ||54|| putraṃ ca sunatamasau munisuvrateśaḥ prābhāvateyamabhirājyapade'bhyaṣiñcat | śvetātapatrasitacāmaraviṣṭarāṇi so'lañcakāra harivaṃśanamaḥśaśāṅkaḥ ||55|| bhūpoddhatā nabhasi devagaṇairudūḍhāmārūḍhavān surucirāṃ śivikā vicitrām |
yāto vanaṃ viditakārtikaśuklapakṣe ṣaṣṭhopavāsakṛdupāśritasaptamīkaḥ ||56|| hū~ aura sabase pahale apanā utkṛṣṭa prayojana siddha kara paścāt parahitake lie yathārtha tīrthakī pravṛtti karūṃgā ||48|| isa prakāra mati, śruta aura avadhijñānarūpī netroṃse yukta svayambhū bhagavān jaba svayaṃ pratibuddha ho gaye taba sarvārthasiddhi takake samasta indroṃke āsana śīghra hī kampāyamāna ho gaye ||49|| usī samaya sundara kuṇḍala aura hāroṃse suśobhita, niścala manovṛtti aura śveta dīptike dhāraka sārasvata ādi laukāntika deva ā gaye aura hātha joḍa़ mastakase lagā puṣpāṃjaliyāṃ bikherate hue namaskāra kara jinendra bhagavānko isa prakāra stuti karane lage ||50||
he jinendra candra ! he samyagjñānarūpī kiraṇoṃse moharūpī andhakārake samūhako naṣṭa karanevāle ! āpa vṛddhiko prāpta hoṃ, samṛddhimān hoṃ, jayavanta raheṃ, cirakāla taka jīvita raheṃ, āpa bandha rahita haiṃ, bhavya jīvarūpī kumudiniyoṃke uttama bandhu haiṃ aura hitakārī bīsaveṃ dharmatīrthake pravartaka hai ||51|| he trilokīnātha! āpa usa dharmatīrthako pravṛtti kareṃ jisameṃ saṃsārake tīvra duḥkharūpī agnise santapta prāṇī snāna kara samasta moharūpo malako choḍa़ deṃ aura śīghra ho ānandadāyo uttama śivālayako prāpta ho jāveṃ ||52|| bhagavān , cāritra mohakarmake paramopaśama (utkṛṣṭa kṣayopaśama) se svayaṃ ho pratibodhako prāpta ho gaye the isalie unheṃ ukta prakārase sambodhate hue laukāntika devoṃne anya kucha nahīṃ kahā so ṭhoka hī hai kyoṃki yogya manuṣya apane niyogakī pūrti meṃ kabhī punarukta doṣako prāpta nahīṃ hote ||53|| usī samaya nānā vimānoṃke samūhase ākāśako ācchādita karate hue saudharmedra ādi cāroṃ nikāyake deva ā pahu~ce| ākara unhoṃne sugandhita jalase bhagavānkā abhiṣeka kiyā aura āścarya utpanna karanevāle, uttamottama ābhaṣaṇa ādise unheṃ alaṃkṛta kiyā ||54|| bhagavān munisuvratanāthane apanī prabhāvatī stroke putra suvratakā rājyapadapara abhiṣeka kiyā aura harivaṃśarūpī ākāśameṃ candramāke samāna suśobhita suvratane bhī sapheda chatra, sapheda cāmara tathā siṃhāsanako alaṃkṛta kiyā ||55|| tadanantara pahale jise bhūmipara rājāoṃne uṭhāyā thā aura usake bāda jise devaloga ākāśameṃ uṭhā le gaye the aisī atiśaya sundara vicitra 1. jñāne | 2. nirbandha-ka. | 3. duḥkhāgni | 4. yogyāḥ | 5. prabhāvatyāḥ apatyaṃ pumān prābhāvateyaḥ tam |

bhūbhṛtsahasraparivārabhṛdeṣa babhre dīkṣāṃ samakṣamakhilasya jagattrayasya | tanmūrdhajānadhinidhāya nijottamāṅge śakraścakāra vidhinā supayaḥpayodhau ||57|| kṛtvāmarāśca jinaniṣkramaṇaṃ tṛtīyakalyāṇapūjanamamī jagurīśvaro'pi | jñāneścatubhiranugaiśca sahasrasaṃkhyestaiḥ pārthivaidinamaṇiḥ kiraṇairivābhāt ||54|| ṣaṣṭhopavāsini paredyarine'vatīrṇa bhikṣāvidhiprakaṭanāya kuśāgrapuryām || bhikṣāṃ dadau vṛṣabhadatta iti prasiddhaḥ 'satyāyasaṃ savidhinā munisuvratāya ||51|| svādhīnamapratihataṃ sthitibhuktiyuktaṃ satpāṇipātramadhipena vidhānapūrvam | prāvarti vartanasuvartanasādhuyogyaṃ tīrthe nije sthitividā jilabhāskareṇa ||60|| citraṃ tadā hi paramānnamṛṣīndrapāṇī śuddhayānvitena dadatā pariniṣṭaśeṣam | śeṣairaśeṣayatibhiśca sahasrasaṃkhyairvobhujyamānamaparaiśca yayau na niṣṭā ||61|| nedustatastridaśadundubhayo ninādāḥ sādhusvanaḥ sakalamambaramātatāna | vāyurvavau surabhiradbhutapuṣpavṛṣṭiryomnaḥ papāta mahatī vasunaśca dhārā ||2|| āścaryapañcakamidaṃ ciramambarasthā devā vikṛtya paramaṃ paradurlabhaṃ te | saṃpūjya dānapatimarjitapuṇyapuñja jagmurjino'pi vijahāra vihārayogyam ||63|| chadmasthakālamativāhya samāsavarṣa saṃmārgaśīrṣasutithiṃ sitapañcamī tu |
dhyānāgnidagdhaghanaghātisamitsamṛddhiḥ kaivalyalāmavibhavena cakāra pūtām ||6|| pālakīpara ārūḍha़ hokara bhagavān vanameṃ gaye tathā vahā~ kārtika śukla saptamīke dina velākā niyama lekara dīkṣā lene ke lie udyata hae||56|| usa samaya eka hajāra rājāoṃke sātha bhagavānne samasta jagat trayake samakṣa dīkṣā dhāraṇa kī| unhoṃne apane śirake keśa ukhāḍa़kara pheṃka diye aura indra ne una keśoṃko piṭāremeṃ rakhakara vidhipūrvaka kṣīrasamudra meṃ kṣepa diyā ||57|| isa prakāra deva, bhagavānkā niṣkramaṇakalyāṇaka tathā usakī pūjā kara yathāsthāna cale gaye aura bhagavān bhī cāra jñānoṃ tathā eka hajāra anugāmī rājāoṃse usa taraha suśobhita hone lage jisa taraha ki eka hajāra kiraṇoṃse sūrya suśobhita hotā hai ||58|| velākā upavāsa dhāraṇa karanevāle bhagavān jaba āgāmī dina, āhārakī vidhi prakaṭa karaneke lie kuśāgrapuromeṃ avatīrṇa hue taba vṛṣabhadatta nāmase prasiddha puruṣane unheṃ vidhipūrvaka khorakā āhāra diyā ||59|| usa samaya maryādāke jānanevāle bhagavān munisuvratarūpī sūryane apane tīrthameṃ nirdoṣa cāritrake dhāraka muniyoṃke yogya āhārakī vaha vidhi pravṛtta kī jo svādhīna thī, bādhāse rahita thī, khaḍa़e hokara jisameṃ bhojana karanā paḍa़tā thā, jisameṃ pāṇipātrameṃ bhojana hotā thā aura dānapati jisameṃ vidhipūrvaka bhojana pradāna karatā thā ||60|| āścaryakī bāta thī ki usa samaya śuddhise sahita vṛṣabhadattane munirājake hāthameṃ jo khīra dī thī usase bākī bacī khorako hajāroṃko saṃkhyāmeṃ anya muniyoṃne khāyā tathā gharake anya logoṃne bhī bāra-bāra grahaṇa kiyā phira bhī vaha samāptiko prāpta nahīṃ huī ||61|| tadanantara viśāla śabda karate hue deva dundubhi bajane lage. dhanya-dhanyake śabdane samasta ākāśako vyāpta kara diyā. sagandhita vāya,
lagī, āścaryakārī phūloṃ kī varṣā hone lago aura ākāśase baḍa़ī moṭī ratnoṃkī dhārā paḍa़ne lagī ||62|| dūsaroṃke lie atiśaya durlabha isa paṃcāścaryako ākāśameṃ khaḍa़e devoṃne cirakāla taka kiyā| tadanantara puṇyarāśikā saṃcaya karanevāle dānapatikī pūjā kara ve deva loga yathāsthāna cale gaye aura bhagavān bhī vihārake yogya sthānameṃ vihāra kara gaye ||63|| tatpaścāt teraha mahīnekā chadmastha 1. satpātrasaṃ ma.| 2. śuddhānvitena | 3. -raśeṣapatibhiśca | 4. samāptim | 5. trayodaśamāsātmakam | 6. pūtam ma.|

harivaṃśapurāṇe sākṣāccakāra yugapatsakalaṃ sa meyamekena kevalaviśaddha vilocanena | nāthastadā na hi nirāvaraṇo vivasvānabhyudgataḥ kramasahāyaparaḥ prakāśye ||65|| nemuḥ sasaptapadametya nijāsanebhyaḥ sarve'hamindra nivahāḥ kṛtamaulihastāḥ | taṃ prāpurabhyuditatoṣaviśeṣacittāḥ śeṣā mahendrasarasantatayaḥ samantāt ||66|| bhaktyā'rcayan tribhuvaneśvaramānavendrāstaṃ devamabhyuditacampakacaityavṛkṣam | satprātihāryavibhavātiviśeṣarūpamārhantyamadbhutamacintyamanantametam ||67|| sa dvādaśasvatha gaṇepu niṣaṇṇavatsu sa dvādaśāṅgamanuyogapathaṃ jinendraḥ | dharma viśākhagaṇinā vinayena pṛṣṭaḥ saṃmāṣya tīrthamavanau prakaṭaṃ pracakre ||68|| kalyāṇapūjana minasya turīyamindrāḥ kṛtvā yathāyathamaguḥ praṇipātapūrvam | deśān jino'pi vijahāra bahūn bahūnāṃ dharmāmṛtaṃ tanubhṛtāṃ dhanavatpravarṣan ||19|| aṣṭau ca viṃśatirinasya jinendracaryāḥ kroḍīkṛtākhilacaturdaśapūrvaśāstrāḥ | triṃśatsahasragaṇanā pariṣad yatīnāṃ nānāguṇairajani saptavidhaḥ sa saṃghaḥ ||7|| syustatra pañcaśatapūrvadharā yatīśā ekādiviṃśatisahasramidāśca śikṣāḥ| aṣṭādaśaiva gaditāni śatāni tepu pratyekamasya munayo'vadhikevalāptāḥ ||71|| dvāviṃśatiryatiśatāni tu vaikriyākhyāstānyeva pañcadaśa te vipulāstu matyā|
syādaśaiva hi śatāni vivāntavairāḥ sadvādino munipateḥ prathitāḥ samāyām ||72|| kāla bitākara bhagavānne dhyānarūpī agnike dvārā ghātiyā kamarūpī īndhanakī vipula rāśiko dagdha kara kevalajñānakī prāptise magasira māsakī śukla paṃcamī tithiko pavitra kiyā ||64|| aba kevalajñānarūpī eka hī viśuddha locanase bhagavān samasta padārthoṃ ko eka sātha pratyakṣa dekhane lage so ṭhīka hī hai kyoṃki jaba nirāvaraṇa sūryakā udaya hotā hai taba vaha prakāśita karane yogya padārthoke viṣaya meṃ na to kramakī apekṣā karatā hai aura na dūsarekī sahāyatākī hī apekṣā karatā hai ||65|| usa samaya samasta ahamindroṃne apane-apane āsanoṃse sāta-sāta ḍaga āge calakara tathā hātha joḍa़ mastakase lagā jinendra bhagavānko parokṣa namaskāra kiyā aura jinake cittameṃ viśeṣa harṣa prakaṭa ho rahā thā aise śeṣa samasta indra tathā deva saba orase vahā~ āye ||66|| jinake campaka nāmaka caitya vṛkṣa prakaṭa huā thā, jo aṣṭa prātihāryarūpī vaibhavase atiśaya sundara the, aura jo āścaryakārī acintya evaṃ antātīta āhaṃntya padako prāpta the aise devādhideva munisuvratanāthako, tīnoṃ lokoṃke svāmī tathā rājāoṃne bhaktipūrvaka pūjā ko ||67||
tadanantara jaba bāraha gaṇa bāraha sabhāoṃ meṃ yathāsthāna baiṭha gaye taba viśākha nāmaka gaṇadharane vinayapūrvaka anuyoga dvārase dvādaśāṃgakā svarūpa pūchā usake uttarameṃ bhagavānne dharmakā nirūpaṇa kara pṛthivīpara tīrtha prakaṭa kiyā ||68|| indrādi deva bhagavānke caturthaṃ kalyāṇakakī pūjā kara namaskāra karate hue yathāsthāna cale gaye aura bhagavān bhī aneka prāṇiyoṃke lie dharmāmṛtakī varṣā karate hue aneka deśoṃ meṃ vihāra karane lage ||69|| bhagavān munisuvratanāthake sampūrṇa caudaha pūrvoko jānanevāle aṭṭhāīsa gaṇadhara the, aura tīsa hajāra muni the| bhagavānkā yaha saṃgha nānā guṇoṃse sāta prakārakā thā ||70|| usa saṃghameṃ pāṃca sau munirāja pūrvadhāro the, ikkīsa hajāra śikṣārthī the, aṭhāraha so avadhijñānī the, itane hī kevalajñānī the, bāīsa sau vikriyāṛddhike dhāraka the, pandraha sau vipulamati manaḥparyaya jñānake dhāraka the, baira ko dūra karanevāle bāraha sau prasiddha vādī the, pacāsa hajāra āryikāe~ thīṃ, eka lākha aṇuvrata, guṇavrata aura śikṣāvratoṃko dhāraṇa karanevāle śrāvaka the, aura 1. mekaṃ ma.|

pañcāśadātmakasahasramidāstadāryā: śikṣāguṇavatadharā gṛhiṇo'pi lakṣāḥ | samyaktvapūtamanaso vanitāstrilakṣāḥ sabhyoḍubhiḥ parivṛtaśca babhau jinenduḥ ||73|| triṃśadguṇaprathitavarṣasahasrajīvī prāk pañcasaptatiśatābdakumārakālaḥ | rājye'pi pañcadaśavarṣasahasramogī satsaṃyamena vijahāra sa śeṣakālam ||74|| ante sa sammadavidhāyivanāntakāntaṃ sammedaśailamadhiruhya nirastabandhaḥ | bandhāntakṛnmunisahasrayuto jagāma mokṣaṃ mahāmunipatirmunisuvrateśaḥ ||75|| mādhatrayodaśatithau sitapakṣabhāji māsopasaṃhṛtavihāravisṛṣṭadehe || sthitvā'parāhnasamaye varapuṣyayoge siddhe jine nanu mahaṃ vidadhuḥ surendrāḥ ||76|| ṣaḍvarṣalakṣaparimāṇaminasya tasya prāvarttata pravitataṃ muvi dharmatīrtham | vidyāvabodhabudhitārthamuniprabhāva devāgamāvirativaddhitalokaharṣam ||77|| viṃśasya tasya caritasya jinasya loke kalyāṇapañcakavibhūti vibhāvayan yaḥ | bhaktyā śṛṇoti paṭhati smaratīdamasmin manyo jano bhajati siddhi sukhaṃ sa śīghram ||78|| evaṃ vasantatilakapracuraprasūnamālāmimāṃ samadhiropya vinūtavṛttaḥ | vighnān vidhūya vidadhātu samādhibodhī dhīro jino jitamavo munisuvrato naḥ ||79|| ityariṣṭanemipurāṇasaṃgrahe harivaṃśe jinasenācāryakṛtī munisuvratanāthapañcakalyāṇavarṇano

saptadaśaḥ sargaḥ
babhūva harivaṃśānāṃ prabhurvaiyavasuṃdharaḥ | ariṣaḍvargajinmārgastridharmasya sa suvrataḥ ||1|| sa dakṣaṃ dakṣanāmānaṃ putraṃ kṛtvā nije pade | dīkṣitaḥ svapitustīrtha prāpa mokṣaṃ tapobalāt ||2|| aileyākhyamilāyāṃ sa dakṣaḥ putramajījanat | manoharī ca tanayāmarṇavo'pi yathā śriyam ||3|| vavṛdhe'nukumāraṃ ca kumārī netrahāriṇī| sānucandraṃ yathā kāntiḥ kalāguṇaviśeṣiṇī ||4|| yauvanena kṛtāśleṣā kṛśamadhyāvabhāsate | stanamāreṇa guruṇā jaghanena ca bhāriṇā ||5|| 'svādhīne sati rūpāstre tasyā dhīramanomidi| manobhavo'tyajatsveṣu kusumāstrapu gauravam ||6|| tadrūpāstravimokṣeṇa manobhūrekarod bhṛśam | dakṣasthāpi manobhedamanyeṣāṃ nu kimucyatām ||7|| kanyayā hṛtacittaśca tato dakṣaḥ prajāpatiḥ | āhūya cchadmanā sadma papraccha praṇatāḥ prajāḥ ||8|| pṛṣṭā vadata yūyaṃ me sajjanā jagati sthitim | aviruddhaṃ vicāryaha viśve viditavṛnayaḥ ||9|| yadvastu bhuvane'nadhya hastyaśvavanitādikam | prajānucitametasya rājā vibhuraho na vā ||10|| kecidūcurjanāstatra vicārya ciramātmani | yatprajānucitaṃ deva ! tatprajāpataye hitam ||11|| yathā nadīsahasrāṇāṃ sadratnānāṃ ca sāgaraḥ | ākaro'nagharatnānāṃ tathaivātra prajāpatiḥ ||12||
athānantara bhagavān munisuvratanāthake putra suvrata harivaṃśake svāmī hue| unhoṃne samasta pathivīko vaśa kara liyā thā. kāma, krodha, lobha, moha, mada evaṃ mātsayaṃ ina chaha antaraṃga śatruoṃko jīta liyā thā, tathā ve dharma artha kāma rūpa trivargake mārga-pravartaka the ||1|| unake dakṣa nāmakā atiśaya dakṣa-catura putra thā| ve use apane padapara niyukta kara apane hī pitāke samīpa dīkṣita ho gaye aura tapobalase mokṣa cale gaye ||2|| rājā dakṣane ilā nāmaka rānīmeṃ aileya nāmakā putra utpanna kiyā aura usake bāda jisa prakāra samudra ne lakṣmīko utpanna kiyā thā usī prakāra manoharī nāmakī putrīko utpanna kiyā ||3|| jisa prakāra candramāke sātha-sātha kalārūpī guṇase yukta usakī kānti baḍha़tī jātī hai usī prakāra kumāra ailayake sātha-sātha kalārūpo guṇase yukta netroko haraṇa karanevālī kumārī manoharī dinoṃ-dina baḍha़ne lagī ||4| jaba vaha yauvanavatī huī taba usakī kamara patalī ho gayī aura vaha sthūla stanoṃke bhāra tathā vistṛta nitamba sthalase atiśaya suśobhita hone lagī ||5|| dhīra-vīra manuṣyoṃke manako bhedana karanevāle usake saundaryarūpī astrake svādhīna rahate hue kāmadevane apane puṣpamayī bāṇoṃkā garva choḍa़ diyā thā ||6|| usake saundaryarūpī śastrako choḍa़kara kāmadevane rājā dakṣake bhī manako bheda diyā phira anya puruṣoṃkī to bāta hī kyā kahī jāye? ||7||
tadanantara kanyāke dvārā jisakā citta harā gayā thā aise dakṣa prajāpatine eka dina kisī chalase namrībhūta prajāko apane ghara balākara usase pūchā ki he sajjano! āpa saba vyavahārake jñātā haiṃ| maiṃ āpa logoṃse eka bāta pūchatā hū~ so āpa saba jagatkī sthitikā pūrvāparavirodha rahita vicārakara uttara dījie ||8-9|| bāta yaha hai ki yadi hāthī, ghoḍa़ā, strī ādi koī vastu saṃsārameṃ amūlya ho aura prajāke yogya na ho to rājā usakā svāmī ho sakatā hai yā nahīṃ ? ||10|| prajājanoṃmeṃ kitane hī logoṃne cirakāla taka ātmāmeṃ vicārakara kahā ki he deva ! jo vastu prajāke lie ayogya hai vaha rājāke lie hitakārī hai ||11|| jisa prakāra samudra hajāroṃ 1. sādhīne ma., ga., gha., ḍa. | 2. kāmaḥ | 3. hṛtacittaṃ sa. ma. |

tadanantara usane putrī manoharīkā kara grahaṇa svayaṃ hī kara liyā so ṭhīka hī hai kyoṃki kāmarūpī piśācase gṛhīta manuṣyakī maryādā kyā hai ? aura krama kyā hai ? bhāvārtha - kāmī manuṣya saba maryādāoṃ aura kramoṃko choḍa़ detā hai || 15 || rājā dakṣakī rānī ilā devī, patike isa kukṛtya se bahuta hī ruṣṭa huī isalie usane putrako pitāse phoḍa़ liyā - alaga kara liyā so ṭhīka hī hai kyoṃki strī ādi tabhī taka hai jaba taka svāmī maryādā meṃ rahatā hai-maryādākā pālana karatā hai || 16|| baḍa़e-baḍa़e sāmantoṃse ghirī ilā devī apane aileya putrako lekara durgama sthānameṃ calī gayī aura vahīṃ usane nivāsa karanekā niścaya kiyā ||17|| usane svargapurī ke samāna eka nagara basāyā jo baḍha़tī huī pṛthivīpara sthita honeke kāraṇa ilāvardhana nāmase prasiddha thā || 18 || aileyako usane usakā rājā banāyā so prajāse sahita, vīrya, dhairya aura nītikā ādhāra tathā harivaṃśa kā tilakasvarūpa rājā aileya vahāṃ atyadhika suśobhita hone lagā ||19|| rājā honepara aṃga deśameṃ nivāsa karanevāle aileyane tāmalipti nāmase prasiddha eka sundara nagara basāyā ||20|| jaba aileya nānā deśako jītane kī icchā karatā huā narmadā nadīke taṭapara āyā to usane pṛthivīpara prasiddha māhiṣmatī nāmakī nagarī basāyī || 21 || usa nagarī meṃ rahakara rājā aileyane cirakāla taka namrībhūta rājāoṃse yukta rājya kiyā | tadanantara vaha kuṇima nāmaka putrake lie rājya sauṃpakara tapake lie calā gayā ||22|| vijayake abhilāṣī evaṃ śatruoṃko santāpa denevāle kuṇimane vidarbha deśameṃ varadā nadī ke kināre kuṇḍina nāmakā sundara nagara basāyā ||23|| kucha samaya bāda kuṇimako jīvana kṣaṇabhaṃgura jāna paḍa़ā isalie vaha apanā vaibhava puloma nāmaka putrake lie sauṃpakara svayaṃ tapovanako calā gayā ||24|| rājā pulomane bhī pulomapura nāmakā nagara basāyā | antameṃ vaha pauloma aura

ekopādhyāyaśiṣyāṇāṃ nityamavyabhicāriṇām | guruśuśrūṣatā'tyāge' saṃpradāyabhidā kutaḥ ||6|| na smaratyajaśabdasya yathehārtho gurūditaḥ | trivarṣā vrīhayo'bījā ajā iti sanātanaḥ ||69|| ityukto'pi sa durmocagrāhagrahagṛhītadhīḥ | so'nādṛtya va vastasya pratijñāmakarotpunaḥ ||7|| kimatra bahunoktena śṛṇu nārada ! vastuni | parājito'smi yadyatra jihvācchedaṃ karomyaham ||71|| nāradena tato'vāci kiṃ duḥkhāgniśikhātī | pataṅga iva duḥpakṣaḥ parvata ! patasi svayam ||72|| parvato'pi tato'vocad yāta' kiṃ bahujalpitaḥ | śvo'stu nau vasurājasya sabhāyāṃ jalpanistaraḥ ||73|| naṣṭastvaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ ityuktvā svāvāsaṃ nārado'gamat | parvato'pi ca tāṃ vātāṃ māturātamatirjagau ||7|| sā niśamya hatāsmīti vadantī tāntamānasā | nininda nandanaṃ mithyā tvaduktamiti vādinī ||75|| nāradasya vacaḥ satyaṃ paramārthanivedanāt | vacastavānyathā putra ! viparītaparigrahāt ||76|| samastaśāstrasaṃdarbhagarbhanirbhedaśuddhadhīḥ | pitā te putra ! yatprāha tadevākhyāti nāradaḥ ||77|| evamuktvā niśānte sā niśāntamagamadvasoḥ | ādaraṇekṣitā tena pṛṣṭā cāgamakāraṇam ||78|| nigadya vasave sarva yayāce gurudakṣiṇām | hastanyāsakṛtāṃ pūrva smarayitvā gurogṛha ||79|| jānatā'pi svayā putra ! tattvātattvamaśeṣataḥ | parvatasya vacaḥ sthāpyaṃ dṛṣyaṃ nāradabhāṣitam ||8|| satyena śrāvitenāsthā vacanaṃ vasunā tataḥ | pratipannamataḥ sāpi kṛtārtheva yayau gṛham ||8||
prāpta huā hai ? ||67|| jo nirantara sātha-hī-sātha rahe haiṃ tathā jinhoṃne kabhī guruko śuśrūṣākā tyāga nahīṃ kiyā aise eka hī upādhyāyake śiṣyoṃ meṃ sampradāya bheda kaise ho sakatā hai ? ||68|| yahā~ aja śabdakā jaisā artha gurujone batāyā thā vaha kyā tumheṃ smaraṇa nahīṃ hai ? yadi isa viṣayameṃ parājita ho jāū~ to apanī jībha kaṭā leṃ ||70-71|| paścāt nāradane kahā ki he parvata ! khoṭā pakṣa lekara, khoṭe paṃkhoṃse yukta pakṣīke samāna duḥkharūpī agnikī jvālāoṃ meṃ svayaṃ kyoṃ paḍa़ rahe ho? isake uttara meṃ parvatane bhī kahā ki jāo bahuta kahanese kyā ? kala hama donoṃkā rājā vasuko sabhāmeṃ śāstrārtha ho jāve ||72-73|| vitaṇḍāvāda baḍha़te dekha nārada yaha kahakara apane ghara calā gayā ki parvata ! maiṃ tumheṃ dekhane āyā thā so dekha liyā. tama bhraṣṭa ho gaye| nāradake cale jānepara parvatane bhī duḥkhī hokara yaha vṛttānta apanī mātāse kahā ||74|| parvatakī bāta sunakara usakī mātākā hṛdaya bahuta duḥkhī huā| 'hāya maiṃ marī' yaha kahatī huī usane parvatako nindā ko, usake mukhase bāra-bāra yahī nikala rahā thā ki terā kahanā jhaṭha hai||75|| he patra! paramārthakā prarūpaka honese nāradakā kahanā satya hai aura viparīta arthakā āśraya lenese terā kahanā mithyā hai ||76|| samasta śāstroṃke pūrvāpara sandarbhake jñānase jinakī buddhi atyanta nirmala thī aise tere pitāne jo kahā thā he putra ! vahī nārada kaha rahā hai ||77|| isa prakāra parvatase kahakara vaha prātaḥkāla hote hī rājā vasuke ghara gayo | rājā vasune use baḍa़e ādarase dekhā aura usase āne kā kāraṇa pūchā ||78|| svastimatone vasuke lie saba vṛttānta sunākara pahale paḍha़te samaya gurugṛhameṃ usake hāthameṃ dharohararūpī rakho huī gurudakṣiṇākā smaraṇa dilāte hue yācanā kī ki he putra ! yadyapi tū saba tattva aura atattvako jānatā hai tathāpi tujhe parvatake hī vacanakā samarthana karanā cāhie aura nāradake vacanako dūṣita ṭhaharānā cāhie ||79-80||

vaidikārthavicāro'yaṃ tvadanyeṣāmagocaraḥ | vicchinnamasaṃpradāyānāmidānīmiha bhūtale ||95|| tadatra bhavato'dhyakṣamamīṣāṃ viduṣāṃ puraḥ | labhetāṃ niścayādetau nyāyyau jayaparājayaḥ ||16|| nyāyenāvasite hyatra vāde vedānusāriṇām | syātpravṛttirasaṃdigdhā sarvaloka pakāriṇī ||97|| ityurvīndraḥ sa vijñaptaḥ pūrvapakṣamadāpayat | parvatāya sadasyaistaiḥ sagarvaḥ pakṣamagrahīt ||28|| ajairyajñavidhiḥ kāryaḥ svargārthibhiriti śratiḥ | ajāścātra catuṣpādāḥ praṇītāḥ prāṇinaḥ sphuṭam ||59|| na kevalamayaṃ vede loke'pi paśuvācakaḥ | āvṛddhādaṅganābālādajaśabdaḥ pratīyate ||10|| naro'japotagandho'yamajāyāḥ kṣāramityapi | nāpanetumiyaṃ śakyā prasidvistridaśairapi ||10|| siddhaśabdārthasaṃbandhe niyatte tasya bādhane | vyavahāravilopa: syādandhadhūkamidaṃ jagat || 102|| abādhitaḥ punāye śabde śabdaḥ pravartate | śāstrīyo laukikaścātra vyavahāraḥ sugocare ||603|| yathāgnihotraṃ juhuyāt svargakāma iti śrutau | agniprabhṛtiśabdānāṃ prasiddhārthaparigrahaḥ ||104|| tathaivātrājaśabdasya paśurarthaḥ sphuṭaḥ sthitaḥ | kutra yāgādiśabdārthaḥ paśupātaśca niścitaḥ || 105|| ato'nuṣṭhānamāstheyama japotanipātanam | yajaiyaṣṭavyamityatra vākyaniṣṭhitasaṃśayaḥ ||106| āśaṅkā ca na kartavyā paśoriha nipātane | duḥkhaṃ syāditi mantreṇa sukhamatyorna duḥkhitā ||10|| mantrāṇāṃ vāhane sākṣād dīkṣānte'tisukhāsikā | maṇimantrauṣadhīnāṃ hi prabhāvo'cinyatāṃ gataḥ ||108||
āye haiṃ kyoṃki āpa nyāyamārgake vettā haiṃ ||94|| yaha vaidika arthakā vicāra isa samaya pṛthivītalapara āpake sivāya anya logoṃkā viṣaya nahīṃ hai kyoṃki una sabakā sampradāya chinna-bhinna ho cukā hai ||95|| isalie āpakī adhyakṣatāmeṃ ina saba vidvānoṃke āge ye donoṃ niścaya kara nyāyapūrṇa jaya aura parājayako prāpta kareṃ ||96|| nyāya dvārā isa vādake samāpta honepara vedānusārī manuṣyoṃ kī pravṛtti sandeharahita evaṃ saba logoṃ kā upakāra karanevālī ho jāyegī ||97|| isa prakāra vṛddhajanoṃke kahanepara rājā vasune parvatake lie pūrva pakṣa dilavāyā arthāt pūrvapakṣa rakhanekā use avasara diyā aura apane sāthī sadasyoṃke kāraṇa garvase bhare parvatane pūrva pakṣa grahaṇa kiyā ||28|| pūrva pakṣa rakhate hue usane kahā ki 'svargake icchuka manuṣyoṃ ko ajoṃ dvārā yajñakī vidhi karano cāhie' yaha eka śruti hai isameṃ jo aja śabda hai usakā artha cāra pāvavāle jantu viśeṣa-bakarā hai ||99|| aja śabda na kevala vedameṃ hī paśuvācaka hai kintu lokameṃ bhī striyoṃ aura bālakoṃse lekara vṛddhoṃ taka paśuvācaka hī prasiddha hai ||100| yaha manuṣya ajake bālakake samāna gandha vālā hai, aura 'yaha ajā -bakarīkā dūdha hai' ityādi sthaloṃ meṃ aja śabdakī jisa arthameṃ prasiddhi hai vaha devoṃke dvārā bhī dūra nahīṃ kī jā sakatī ||101|| siddha śabda aura usake arthakā jo sambandha pahalese niścita calā ā rahā hai yadi usameṃ bādhā ḍālī jāvegī to vyavahārakā ho lopa ho jāvegā kyoṃki yaha jagat andha ulūkoṃse sahita hai—nirvicāra manuṣyoṃse bharā huā hai ||102||
bda yogya arthameṃ avāṃchita rūpase pravṛtta hotā hai aura aisā honepara hī śāstrīya athavā laukika vyavahāra calatā hai ||103|| jisa prakāra 'agnihotraṃ juhuyāt svargakāmaḥ' svargakā icchuka manuṣya agnihotra yajña kare, isa śrutimeṃ agni ādi śabdoṃkā prasiddha hī artha liyā jātā hai usī prakāra 'ajairyaṣṭavyaṃ svargakāmaiḥ' svargake icchuka manuṣyoṃko ajoṃse homa karanā cāhie isa śrutime bhī ajakā paśu artha ho spaṣṭa hai aura yāgādi śabdoṃkā artha to paśudhāta niścita hī hai ||104-105|| isalie 'ajairyaṣṭavyam' ityādi vākyoṃ dvārā niḥsandeha, jisameṃ ajake bālakakā ghāta hotā hai aisā anuṣṭhāna karanā cāhie ||106|| yahā~ yaha āśaṃkā nahīṃ karanī cāhie ki ghāta karate samaya paśuko duḥkha hotā hogā kyoṃki mantrake prabhāvase usakī sukhase mṛtyu hotī hai use duḥkha to nāma mātrakā bhī nahīṃ hotā ||107|| dīkṣāke anta meṃ mantroṃkā uccāraṇa hote hī paśuko sukhamaya sthāna sākṣāt

harivaṃśapurāṇe nipātanaṃ ca kasyātra yatrātmā sūkṣmatāṃ śritaḥ |' abadhyo'gniviṣāstrādyaiḥ kiṃ punamantravāhanaiḥ ||109|| sūrya cakṣurdiśaṃ śrotraṃ vāyuṃ prāṇānasṛpayaḥ | gamayanti vapuḥ pṛthvīṃ śamitāro'sya yājñikāḥ ||10|| svamantreṇeṣṭamātreṇa svalokaṃ gamitaḥ sukham | yājakādivadākalpamanalpaṃ paśuraśnute ||11|| abhisaṃdhikṛto bandhaḥ svargāptya so'sya netyapi | na balādyājyamānasya śiśodvighṛtādibhiḥ ||112|| svarakṣamityupanyasya virarāma sa parvataḥ | nāradastamapāka mityuvāca vicakṣaṇaḥ ||1||3|| śṛṇvantu madvacaḥ santaḥ sāvadhānadhiyo'dhunā | parvatasya vacaḥ sarva śatakhaṇḍaṃ karomyaham ||114|| ajairityādike vākye yanmṛṣā parvato'bravīt | ajāḥ paśava ityevamasyaiṣā svamanīṣikā ||15|| svābhiprāyavaśād vede na śabdārthagatiya॑taḥ | vedādhyayanavatsāptādupadeśamupekṣate ||11|| gurupūrvakramādarthā da dṛśyaḥ śabdārthaniścitaḥ | sānyathā yadi jāyeta jāyetādhyayanaṃ tathā ||117|| athādhyayanamanyata syādanyatsyādarthavedanam | sthite sādhāraṇe nyāye kāmacāragatiḥ kutaḥ ||18|| śabdasyātha svato vetti prajñāsātiśayo'pi hi | na śabdamiti śāpo'yaṃ kutaḥ kasyātra dustaraḥ ||119||

na cāyaṃ saṃpradāyo'smāyekasmai guruṇoditaḥ | trayaḥ śiṣyāḥ vayaṃ yogyā vasunāradaparvatāḥ ||12|| samānaśrutikāḥ śabdāḥ santi loke'tra bhūriśaḥ | gavādayaḥ prayogo'pi teṣāṃ viṣayabhedataḥ ||121|| paśuraśmimṛgākṣāśāvajravājiṣu vāgbhuvoḥ | gośabdavyaktayo vyakāḥ prayujyante pṛthak-pṛthak ||122|| na hi citragurityatraṃ raśmivastuni śemuṣī | na cauśītagurityatra sāsnādimati vartate ||123|| rūḍyā kriyāvaśāvācye vācāṃ vṛttiravasthitā | tāmasthiropadeśāstu vismaranti gurūditam ||124|| tadā codanāvākye rūḍhiśabdārthadūragaḥ | kriyāśabdasya cāmnāto na jāyanta iti hyajāḥ ||125|| aiścaya rūḍhiśabdasya vidbhirlokaśāstrayoḥ | ajagandho'yamityādau prayogo na niṣidhyate || 126|| tena pūrvoktadoṣo'pi naivāsmākaṃ prasajyate | vyavahāropayogitvād vācāṃ svocitagocare ||127|| satyāṃ kṣityādisāmagyāmaprarohādiparyayāḥ | bīhayo'jāḥ padārtho'yaṃ vākyārtho yajanaṃ tu taiḥ ||128|| devapūjā yajerarthastairajairyajanaṃ dvijaiḥ| nevedyādividhānena yāgaḥ svargaphalapradaḥ ||129||
śabdakā artha to svayaṃ jāna letā hai para śabdako nahīṃ jāna pātā to yaha dustara śāpa yahā~ kisake lie kisase prāpta huā thā so batāo| bhāvārtha-yadi buddhimān manuṣya apanī icchāse śabdake arthakī kalpanā kara letā hai to use śabda bhī banā lenā cāhie isameṃ dvividhākī kyā bāta hai ? ||119|| gurune yaha sampradāya eka parvatake lie hī banāyā ho yaha bhī sambhava nahīṃ hai kyoṃki hama vasu, nārada aura parvata ye tīna yogya śiṣya the| bhāvārtha -tīna śiṣyoṃmeṃ-se eka śiṣyako guru dūsarā artha batalāveṃ aura śeṣako dūsarā artha yaha sambhava nahīṃ dikhatā ||120|| lokameṃ goko ādi lekara aise bahata śabda haiṃ jinakā samāna śravaṇa hotā hai-samāna uccāraṇa hotā hai parantu viṣaya-bhedase unakā prayoga pṛthak-pṛthak hotā hai| jaise go śabda-paśu, kiraṇa, mṛga, indriya, diśā, vaca, ghoḍa़ā, vacana aura pṛthivī arthameṃ prasiddha hai parantu saba arthoṃ meṃ usakā pṛthak-pṛthak hī prayoga hotā hai | 'citragu' isa śabdameṃ gokā kiraṇa artha koī nahīṃ karatā aura 'aśītagu' isa śabdameṃ go śabdakā artha sāsnādimān paśu koī nahīṃ mānatā kintu prakaraṇake anusāra 'citragu' śabdameṃ gokā artha gāya aura 'aśotagu' śabdameṃ kiraṇa hī mānā jātā hai ||121-123|| śabdoṃke artha meṃ jo pravṛtti hai vaha yā to rūḍha़ise hotī hai yā kriyāke ādhīna hotī hai parantu jinake hṛdaya meṃ gurukā upadeśa cirakāla taka sthira nahīṃ rahatā ve guru-pratipādita arthako bhūla jāte haiṃ ||124|| isalie 'ajairyaṣṭavyam' isa veda-vākyameṃ aja śabdakā athaṃ rūḍha़igata arthase dūra 'na jāyante iti ajāḥ' ( jo utpanna na ho sakeṃ ve aja haiṃ) isa vyutpattise kriyā sammata 'tīna varṣakā dhānya' liyā gayā hai ||125|| vidvān loga, loka aura śāstra donoṃmeṃ rūḍha़i śabdake aiśvayaṃko jānate haiṃ ataḥ 'ajagandho'yaṃ puruṣaḥ' ityādi sthaloṃmeṃ aja śabdakā bakarā arthameṃ prayoga niṣiddha nahīṃ hai ||126|| parvatane jo pahale yaha doṣa diyā thā ki yadi śabdoṃkā svabhāvasiddha artha na kiyā jāyegā to vyavahārakā hī lopa ho jāyegā usakā hamāre ūpara prasaṃga hī nahīṃ ātā kyoṃki śabdoṃkā apane-apane yogya sthaloṃpara vyavahārakī siddhike lie hī upayoga kiyā jātā hai || (27|| isalie pṛthivī ādi sāmagrīke rahate hue bhī jisameṃ aṃkurādi rūpa paryāya prakaṭa na ho sake aisā tīna varṣakā purānā dhāna aja kahalatā hai| yaha to aja śabdakā artha hai aura aise dhānyase yajña karanā cāhie yaha 'ajairyaṣṭavyam' isa vākyakā artha hai ||128|| yaja dhātukā artha deva-pūjā hai isalie dvijoṃko pūrvokta dhānase hī pūjā karanī cāhie kyoṃki naivedya ādise ko huī pūjā hī svarga rūpa phalako denevālī

harivaṃśapurāṇe ṣaṭakarmaṇāṃ vidhātāraṃ purāṇapuruṣaṃ param | trātāramindramindrejyaṃ vede gītaṃ svayaṃbhuvam ||130|| deśakaṃ muktimārgasya śoṣakaṃ bhavavāridheḥ | ananta jñānasaukhyādimadīśākhyaṃ maheśvaram ||13|| brahmāṇaṃ viṣṇumīśānaṃ siddhaṃ buddha manāmayam | ādityavarṇa vṛṣabhaṃ pūjayanti hitaiṣiṇaḥ ||132|| tataḥ svargasukhaṃ puṃsāṃ tato mokṣasukhaṃ dhvam | tataḥ kīrtistataḥ kāntistato dīptistato tiḥ ||13|| piaināpi na yaṣṭavyaṃ paśutvena vikalpitāt | saṃkalpādaśumātpāpaṃ puṇyaṃ tu śubhato yataḥ ||13|| yo nāmasthāpanādravyairbhāvena ca vibhedanāt | caturdhā hi paśuḥ proktastasya cintyaṃ na hiṃsanam ||135|| yaduktaṃmantrato mṛtyorna duḥkhamiti tanmaṣā | na ceda duḥkhaṃ na matyuḥ syāt svasthāvasthasya pūrvavat ||136|| pādanāsādhirodhena vinā cenipatatvaśaḥ| mantreṇa maraṇaṃ tathyamasaṃbhāvyamidaṃ punaḥ ||137|| sukhāsikāpi naikāntānmartamantraprabhāvataḥ | duḥkhitāpyāraṭajantohātasya nirīkṣyate ||138|| susūkṣmatvādavadhyo'yamātmeti yadudīritam | tanna sthūlaśarīrasthaḥ sthūlo'pi saṃbhavedyataḥ ||139|| pradīpavadayaṃ dehī dehādhāravaśād yataḥ | sūkṣmasthūlatayā thāti svasaṃhāravisarpaṇam ||14|| anīdaśastu saṃsārī śarīrānantavedakaḥ | sūkṣma eṣa kathaṃkāraṃ sukhaduḥkhamavāpnuyāt ||141||
ataḥ śarīrabādhāyāṃ mantratantrāstrayogataḥ | bādhanaṃ niyamādasya dehamātrasya dehinaḥ ||142|| hotī hai ||129|| hitābhilāṣī manuṣya jinhoṃne yugake ādimeṃ asi, maṣi, kṛṣi, sevā, śilpa aura vāṇijya ina chaha karmokī pravṛtti calāyī thī, jo purāṇa puruṣa haiṃ, utkṛṣṭa haiṃ, rakṣaka haiṃ, indrarūpa haiṃ, indrake dvārā pūjya haiṃ, vedameṃ svayambhū nāmase prasiddha haiṃ, mokṣa mārgake upadeśaka mantrake prabhāvase maranevāle paśuko sukhāsikā prāpta hotī hai yaha bhī ekānta nahīṃ hai kyoṃki jo paśu mārā jātā hai vaha grahase pīḍa़itakī taraha jorajorase cillātā hai isalie usakā duḥkha spaṣṭa saptadaśaḥ sargaḥ
259 mriyamāṇo'tiduḥkhena cakṣurādimirindriyaiḥ | viyujyate svayaṃ tena ko'nyasteṣāṃ viyojakaḥ ||13|| 'prāṇighātakṛtaḥ svargaḥ kutaḥ syādyājakādayaḥ | yājyasya svargagāmitve dṛṣṭāntatvaṃ gatā yataḥ ||144|| dharmyameva hi śarmāptya karma yājyasya jāyate | navapathyaṃ śiśorda mātrā'pi syātsukhāptaye ||145|| pariṣatprāvṛṣi sphūrjadvacovajramukhairiti | bhittvā parvataduḥpakṣaṃ sthite nāradanīrade || 146|| sādhukāro muhurdattastasmai dharmaparīkṣakaiḥ | salaukikaiḥ śiraḥkampaisvāṅgulisphoṭanisvanaiḥ || 647|| rājoparicaraḥ pṛṣṭhastataḥ śiṣṭebahuśrutaiḥ | rājan yathāśrutaṃ brūhi tvaṃ satyaṃ gurubhāṣitam || 148|| mūḍhasatyavimūḍhena vasunā dṛḍhabuddhinā| smaratāpi gurorvākyamiti vākyamudīritam || 149 || yuktiyuktamupanyastaṃ nāradena sabhājanāḥ | parvatena yatroktaṃ tadupādhyāyabhāṣitam ||150||
mantra-tantra tathā astra ādise śarīrakā ghāta honepara ise niyamase duḥkha hotā hai ||142|| jaba yaha jīva tīvra duḥkhase marane lagatā hai taba cakṣu ādi indriyoṃse svayaṃ hī viyukta ho jātā hai isalie unakā viyoga karānevālā aura dūsarā kauna hai ?| bhāvārtha-jaba jova svayaṃ hī cakṣu ādi indriyoṃse viyukta hotā hai taba yaha kahanā ki 'yājaka loga unake cakṣu ādiko sūrya ādike pāsa bheja dete haiṃ' mithyā hai ||143|| prāṇiyoṃkā ghāta karanevāleko svarga kaise ho sakatā hai ? jisase ki yājaka ādiko yājya ( paśu ādike ) svarga jānemeṃ dṛṣṭānta mānā jā sake| bhāvārtha-parvatane kahā thā ki mantra dvārā homa karate hī paśu svarga bheja diyā jātā hai aura vahā~ vaha yājakādike samāna kalpa kāla taka atyadhika sukha bhogatā rahatā hai so prāṇiyoṃkā ghāta karanevāle yājaka ādiko svarga kaise mila sakatā hai ? unheṃ to isa pāpake kāraṇa naraka milanā cāhie ataḥ jaba yājaka ādi svarga nahīṃ jāte taba unheṃ paśuke svarga jānemeṃ dṛṣṭānta kaise banāyā jā sakatā hai ? ||144||
____dharma sahita kārya hī paśuko sukha prāptimeṃ sahāyaka ho sakatā hai adharma sahita kārya nahīṃ kyoṃki bacceke lie mātāke dvārā diyā huā apathya padārtha sukha prāptikā kāraṇa nahīṃ hotā| bhāvārtha-pavaṃtane kahā thā ki jisa prakāra na cāhanepara bhī bacce ke lie ghī ādi diyā jātā hai to vaha usakī vaddhikā kāraṇa hotā hai, usī prakāra paśake na cāhanepara bhī use yajñameṃ homā jātā hai to vaha usake lie svargaprāptikā kāraṇa hotā hai | parvatakā yaha kahanā ṭhīka nahīṃ kyoṃki dharmayukta kārya hī paśuke lie sukhaprāptimeṃ sahāyaka ho sakatā hai adharmayukta nahīṃ| jisa prakāra mātāke dvārā diye hue ghṛta, dugdha ādi hitakārī padārtha hī bacceke lie sukhaprāptimeṃ sahāyaka hote haiṃ viṣādika apathya padārtha nahīṃ usī prakāra paśuko jabardastī homa dene mātrase use svargakī prāpti nahīṃ ho sakatī kintu usake dharmayukta kāryase hī ho sakatī hai ||145||
__isa prakāra sabhārūpī varṣākāla meṃ apane tīkṣṇa vacana rūpī vajrake agrabhāgase parvatake mithyā pakṣarūpī pavaṃta-pahāḍa़ke bhadde kināreko toḍa़kara jaba nāradarūpī megha cupa ho rahā taba sabhā meṃ baiṭhe hae dharmake parīkṣaka logoṃne evaṃ sādhāraṇa manaṣyoṃne śira hilā-hilākara tathā apanī-apanī aṃguliyāṃ caṭakākara nāradake lie bāra-bāra dhanyavāda diyā ||146-147||
tadanantara aneka śāstroṃke jñātā śiṣṭajanoṃne antarikṣacārī rājā vasuse pūchā ki he rājan ! āpane guruke dvārā kahā haā jo satya artha sanā ho vaha kahie ||148|| yadyapi rājā vasa daḍhabuddhi thā aura guruke vacanoṃkā use acchī taraha smaraṇa thā tathāpi mohavaśa satyake viṣaya meṃ avivekī ho vaha nimna prakāra vacana kahane lagā ||149|| ki he sabhājano! yadyapi nāradane yukti
1. prāṇighātaṃ karotīti prāṇighātakṛt tasya | 2. dharmameva ma. | 3. śiraḥkaṃpaṃ ma.|

harivaṃśapurāṇe vāṅmātreṇa tato bhūmau nimagnaḥ sphaṭikāsanaḥ | vasuḥ papāta pātāle pātakāt patanaṃ dhruvam ||15|| pātālasthitakāyo'sau saptamī pṛthivīṃ gataḥ | narake nārako jāto mahārauravanāmani ||152|| hiṃsānandamaṣānandaraudra dhyānāvilo vasuḥ | jagāma narakaṃ raudraṃ raudradhyānaṃ hi duḥkhadam ||153|| 'pratyakṣaṃ sarvalokasya pātāle patite vasau | tadākulaḥ samuttasthau hā hā dhigdhigiti dhvaniḥ ||15|| labdhāsatyaphalaṃ sadyo ninindunṛpatiṃ janāḥ | parvataṃ ca nirācakruḥ khalīkṛtya khalaṃ purāt ||155|| tattvavādinamakṣudraṃ nāradaṃ jitavādinam | kṛtvā brahmarathārūḍhaṃ pūjayitvā janā yayuḥ ||156|| parvato'pi khalīkāraṃ prāpya deśān paribhraman | duṣṭaṃ dviṣṭaṃ niraikṣiṣṭa mahākāla mahāsuram ||15|| tatastasmai parābhūtiṃ parābhūtijuṣe purā | nivedya tena saṃyuktaḥ kṛtvā hiṃsāgamaṃ kudhīḥ ||15|| loke pratārako bhūtvā hiṃsāyajñaṃ pradarśayan | araayajanaṃ mūḍhaṃ prāṇihiṃsanatatparam ||159|| matvā pāpopadeśena pāpaśāpavaśānmataḥ | sevāmiva vasoḥ kurvan parvato narake'patat ||16|| sthāpitā vasurājye'ṣṭī jyeṣṭhānukramaśaḥ kramāt | svalpaireva dinamatyuṃ sūnavo'pi vasoryayuḥ ||16|| tato mṛtyubhayātrastaḥ suvasuḥ prapalāyitaḥ | gatvā nāgapure'tiṣṭhanmathurā bṛhaddhvajaḥ ||162||
śārdūlavikrīḍitam kaṣṭaṃ khyātimavāpya satyajanitāṃ pāpādadho'gādvasuḥ
pāpaṃ parvatako'bhimānavaśagastasyaiva paścād yayau |
yukta kahā hai tathāpi parvatane jo kahā hai vaha upādhyāyake dvārā kahā huā kahā hai ||150|| itanā kahate hī vasukā sphaṭikamaṇimaya āsana pṛthivīmeṃ dhaṃsa gayā aura vaha pātālameṃ jā girā so ṭhīka hī hai kyoṃki pāpase patana hotā hī hai ||151|| jisakā śarīra pātālameṃ sthita thā aisā vasu marakara sātavīṃ pṛthivī gayā aura vahā~ mahāraurava nāmaka narakameṃ nārakī huā ||152|| hiṃsānanda aura mṛṣānanda raudra dhyānase kaluṣita ho vasu bhayaṃkara narakameṃ gayā so ṭhīka hī hai kyoṃki raudradhyāna duḥkhadāyaka hotā hī hai ||153|| saba logoṃke samakṣa jaba vasu pātālameṃ calā gayā taba saba ora ākulatāse bharā hā-hā dhika-dhika śabda gajane lagā ||154|| jise tatkāla hī asatya bolanekā phala mila gayā thā aise rājā vasukī saba logoṃne nindā kī aura duṣṭa parvatakā tiraskāra kara use nagarase bāhara nikāla diyā ||155|| tattvavādī, gambhīra evaṃ vādiyoṃko parāsta karanevāle nāradako logoṃne brahma rathapara savāra kiyā tathā usakā sammāna kara saba yathāsthāna cale gaye ||156|| idhara tiraskāra pākara parvata bhī aneka deśoṃmeṃ paribhramaṇa karatā rahā anta meṃ usane dveṣa-pūrṇa duṣṭa mahākāla nāmaka asurako dekhā ||157|| pūrva bhavameṃ jisakā tiraskāra huā thā aise mahākāla asurake lie apane parabhavakā samācāra sunākara parvata usake sātha mila gayā aura durbuddhike kāraṇa hiṃsāpūrṇa śāstrakī racanā kara, lokameṃ ṭhagiyā bana hiṃsāpūrṇa yajñakā pradarśana karatā huā prāṇihiṃsāmeṃ tatpara makhaṃjanoṃko prasanna karane lagā ||158-159|| antameṃ pāpopadeśake kā rūpī śāpake vaśībhūta honese parvata marā aura marakara vasukī sevā karaneke lie hī māno naraka gayā ||160| mantriyoṃne vasuke āṭha putroṃko kramase eka dūsareke bāda usakī gaddīpara baiṭhāyā parantu ve bhī thoḍa़e hī dinoṃmeṃ mṛtyuko prāpta ho gaye ||161|| tadanantara jo do putra śeṣa bace unameṃ mṛtyuke bhayase bhayabhīta ho suvasu to bhāgakara nāgapurameṃ rahane lagā aura bṛhaddhvaja mathurāmeṃ jā basā ||162||

aṣṭādaśaḥ sargaḥ
atha yo'sau vasoḥ sūnurmathurāyāṃ bṛhaddhvajaḥ| subāhurabhavattasmāttanayo vinayodyataḥ ||1|| lakṣmī sa tatra nikṣipya tapolakṣmīmupāśritaḥ | subāhudīrghabāhau ca vajrabāhau nṛpaśca saḥ ||2|| so'pi labdhāmimāne'pau bhānau so'pi yavau' sute | subhānī nayane so'pi bhīmanāmani sa prabhuḥ ||3|| evamādyāstathā'nye'pi śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ | munisuvratanāthasya tīrthe'tīyuḥ kṣitośvarāḥ ||4|| āyurvarṣasahasrāṇi yasya pañcadaśāgamat | namevahati tasyeha pañcalakṣābdake pathi ||5|| udiyāya yadustatra harivaṃśodayācale | yādavaprabhavo vyāpī bhūmau bhūpavibhākaraḥ ||6|| suto narapatistasmādudabhūd bhūvadhūpatiḥ | yadustasmin bhuvaṃ nyasya tapasā tridivaṃ gataḥ ||7|| śūraścāpi suvīraśca śūrau vīrau nareśvarī | sa tau narapatī rājya sthāpayitvā tapo'bhajat ||6|| śūraḥ suvīramāsthāpya mathurāyāṃ svayaṃ kṛtī| sa cakāra kuśagraṃpu paraṃ śauryapuraṃ puram ||9|| śūrāścāndhakavṛṣṇyādyāḥ śūrādudabhavan sutāḥ | vīrā bhojakavṛṣṇyādyāḥ suvīrānmathureśvarāt ||10|| jyeṣṭha putre vinikṣiptakṣitimāro yathāyatham | siddhau śūrasuvīro to supratipṭena dīkṣitau ||11|| āpīdandhakavṛṣṇeśca subhadrā vanitottamā | putrāstasyā daśotpannāstridaśābhā divaścyutāḥ ||16|| samudra vijayo'kṣobhyastathā stimitasāgaraḥ | himavān vijayaścānyo'calo dhāraṇapūraṇau ||13||
athānantara-rājā vasukā jo bṛhaddhvaja nāmakā putra mathurāmeṃ rahane lagā thā usake subāhu nāmakā vinayavān putra huā| rājā bṛhaddhvaja subāhu ke lie rājyalakṣmī sauṃpa āpa taparūpī lakṣmīko prāpta ho gayā | yathākramase subāhuke dīrghabāhu, dorghabāhuke vajrabāhu, vajrabāhuke labdhābhimāna, labdhābhimānake bhānu, bhānuke yavu, yavuke subhānu aura subhānuke bhīma putra huā| isa prakāra inheṃ ādi lekara bhagavān munisuvratanāthake tīrtha meṃ saikaḍa़oṃ-hajāroṃ rājā utpanna hae aura saba apane-apane putroṃpara rājya-bhāra sauṃpakara tapa dhāraṇa kiyā ||1-4|| bhagavān munisuvratake bāda naminātha hue| inakī āyu pandraha hajāra varṣakī thī tathā inakā tīthaṃ pā~ca lākha varṣa taka pracalita rahā | inhīṃke tīrthameṃ harivaṃśarūpī udayācalapara sūryake samāna yadu nāmakā rājā huā| yahī yadu rājā, yādavoṃkī utpattikā kāraṇa thā tathā apane pratāpase samasta pṛthvīpara phailā huā thā ||5-6|| rājā yaduke narapati nāmakā putra huā| usapara pṛthivīkā bhāra sauṃpa rājā yadu tapakara svarga gayā ||7|| rājā narapatike śūra aura suvīra nāmaka do putra hue so narapati unheṃ rājya-siṃhāsanapara beṭhākara tapa karane lagā ||8|| atyanta kuśala śarane choṭe bhāī suvīrako mathurāke rājyapara adhiṣṭhita kiyā aura svayaṃ kuśadya deśameṃ eka uttama śauryapura nāmakā nagara basāyā ||9|| śūrase andhakavṛṣṇiko ādi lekara aneka śūravīra utpanna hue, aura mathurāke svāmī suvīrase bhojakavṛṣṇiko ādi lekara aneka vīra putra utpanna hue ||10|| yathāyogya apane-apane baḍa़e putroṃpara pṛthivīkā bhāra sauṃpakara kṛtakṛtyatāko prāpta hue śūra aura suvora donoṃ hī supratiṣṭha munirājake pāsa dīkṣita ho gaye ||11|| andhakavṛṣṇikī subhadrā nāmaka uttama stro tho usase unake daśa putra hue jo devoṃke samāna kāntivāle the tathā svargase cyuta hokara āye the ||12|| unake nāma isa prakāra the-1 samudravijaya, 2 akṣobhya, 3 stimitasāgara, 4 himavān , 5 vijaya, 6 acala, 7 dhāraṇa, 8 pūraṇa,
1. yavunāmniputre | 2. bhūpatibhāskaraḥ ( ka. ṭi.) | 3. bhojanakavṛṣṇyādyāḥ ma. |

263 abhicandra ihākhyāto vasudevaśca te daśa | 'daśārhāḥ sumahābhāgāḥ sarve'pyanvarthanāmakāḥ ||14|| kuntī madrī ca kanye dve mānye strīguṇabhūṣaṇe | lakṣmīsarasvatītulye bhaginyau vṛṣṇijanmanām ||15|| rājño bhojakavṛṣṇeryā patnī padmāvatī sutān | ugrasenamahāsenadevasenānasūta sā ||16|| suvasossvabhavatsūnuḥ kuñjarāvarttavartinaḥ | bṛhadratha iti khyāto māgadheśapure'vasat ||1|| tasmādapyaṅgajo jātastato dṛḍheratho'ṅgajaḥ | tasmānnaravaro jajñe tato dṛḍha rathastataḥ ||18|| jātaḥ sukharathastasmāddīpanaḥ kuladīpanaḥ | sūnuḥ sāgaraseno'smānsumitro vaprathustataḥ ||19|| vindusāraḥ sutastasmādevagarbhastadarbhakaḥ | tataḥ śatadhanurvīro dhanurdharapuraḥsaraḥ ||20|| kramāt śatasahasreṣu vyatikrānteṣu rājasu | jāto nihataśatruḥ sa sutaḥ śatapatinṛpaḥ ||21|| jāto bṛhadratho rājā tato rājagṛhādhipaḥ | tasya sūnurjarāsandho vaśībhūtavasuṃdharaḥ ||22|| sa rāvaṇasamo bhūtyā trikhaṇḍamaratādhipaḥ | navamaḥ pratiśatrūṇāṃ suraśrīsadṛśojasām ||23|| madhye kālindasenākhyā mahiṣī mahiṣīgaṇā | tanayāḥ sanayāstasya te kālayavanādayaḥ ||24|| aparājita ityādyā bhrātaraścakravartinaḥ | harivaṃśamahāvṛkṣaśākhāyāḥ phalitātmanaḥ ||5|| ekasyā ekavīro'yaṃ dhārako dharaṇīpatiḥ | bahuvidyādharendrāgāṃ dakṣiṇaśregyupāśritām ||26|| saṃhati nṛpasiṃho'sau śāsti rājagṛhe sthitaḥ | uttarāpathabhūpālāḥ dakṣiṇāpathabhūbhṛtaḥ ||27||
pūrvāparasamudrāntā madhyadeśāśca tadvaśāḥ | bhūcaraiḥ khecaraiḥ sarvaiḥ śekharīkṛtaśāsanaḥ ||28|| 9 abhicandra aura 10 vasudeva | ye sabhī putra yogya daśāke dhāraka, mahābhāgyaśālī aura sārthaka nāmoṃse yukta the ||13-14|| ukta putroṃke sivāya kuntī aura madrī nāmako do kanyāe~ bhī thīṃ jo atiśaya mānya thīṃ, striyoṃke guṇarūpī ābhūṣaṇoṃse sahita thī, lakṣmī aura sarasvatīke samāna jāna paḍa़tī thīṃ aura samudravijayādi daśa bhāiyoṃko bahaneṃ thīṃ ||15||
rājā bhojakavṛṣṇikī jo padmāvato nāmakī patnī thī usane ugrasena, mahāsena tathā devasena nāmaka tīna putra utpanna kiye the ||16|| rājā vasukā jo suvasu nāmakā putra, kuṃjarāvatapura ( nāgapura ) meṃ rahane lagā thā usake bṛhadratha nāmakā putra huā aura vaha māgadheśapurameṃ rahane lagā||17| bṛhadrathake dṛḍha ratha nāmakā putra huā| dṛḍha rathake naravara, naravarake dṛḍharatha, dṛḍha rathake sukharatha, sukharathake kulako dīpta karanevālā dīpana, dīpanake sāgarasena, sāgarasenake sumitra, sumitrake vaprathu, vaprathuke vindusāra, vindusārake devagarbha aura devagarbhake śatadhanu nāmakā vīra putra huā| yaha śatadhanu dhanurdhāriyoṃ meṃ sabase śreṣṭha thā ||18-20|| tadanantara kramase lākhoṃ rājāoṃke vyatīta ho jānepara uso vaṃśameṃ nihataśatru nāmakā rājā huā| usake śatapati aura śatapatike bṛhadratha nāmakā putra huā| yaha rājagṛha nagarakā svāmī thā| bṛhadrathake pṛthivīko vaśa karanevālā jarāsandha nāmakā putra huā ||21-22|| vaha vibhūtimeṃ rāvaṇake samāna thā, tīna khaṇḍa bharatakā svāmī thā aura devoṃke samāna pratāpī pratinārāyaṇoṃmeṃ nauṃvā~ nārāyaṇa thā ||23|| aneka striyoṃke bīca usakī kālindasenā nāmakī paṭṭarānī thī jo paṭṭarāniyoṃke samasta guṇoṃse sahita thī| rājā jarāsandhake kālayavana ādi aneka nītijña putra the||24|| cakravartī jarāsandhake aparājita ādi aneka bhāī the jo harivaṃśarūpī mahāvṛkṣakī śākhāpara lage hue phaloṃke samāna jāna paḍa़te the ||25|| rājā jarāsandha apanī advitīya mātākā advitīya vīra putra thā | vaha rājasiṃha, rājagṛha nagarameṃ sthira rahakara hī dakṣiṇa śreṇī meṃ rahanevāle samasta vidyādhara rājāoṃke samūhapara śāsana karatā thā| uttarāpatha aura dakṣiṇāpathake samasta rājā, pūrva-paścima samudroṃke taṭa tathā madhyake samasta deśa usake vaśameṃ the| samasta bhūmigocarī aura samasta vidyādhara usakī ājñāko śekharake samāna śirapara dhāraṇa karate 1. daśayā arhāḥ yogyāḥ pūjyāśca | 2. dṛḍharathograjaḥ ma. | 3. nayena sahitāḥ sanayāḥ | 4. bhūbhṛtām ma. |

harivaṃśapurāṇe cāvartiśriyo martā bibhattīndrasya vibhramam | jātu śaurya purodyāne gandhamādananāmani ||29|| rātrau pratimayā tasthau supratiṣṭhaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ | pūrvavairādyatestasya cakre yakṣaḥ sudarśanaḥ ||30|| agnipātaṃ mahāvāta medhavṛṣṭyādiduḥsaham | upasarga sa jitvāpa kevalaṃ 'ghātighāta kṛt ||31|| tadvandanārthamindraughāḥ saudharmādyāścaturvidhaiḥ | devaiḥ saha samāgatya te'rcayitvā vavandire ||32|| vṛṣṇirapyāgato maktyā putradārabalānvitaḥ | saṃpūjyānamya saumyaṃ taṃ nijabhūmāvupāviśat ||33|| sāvadhāne sthite dharmadattakaṇe kṛtāñjalau | jagajane jagādetthaṃ supratiṣṭamunīśvaraḥ ||34|| dharmāstrivarganiṣpattistriṣu lokeṣu māṣitā | tatastāmicchatā kāryaḥ satataṃ dharmasaṃgrahaḥ ||35|| dharmo dhāmani saṃdhatte śarmādhāre śarīriṇam | nirmito vāṅmanaḥkāyakarmamiḥ śumavṛttimiḥ ||36|| dharmo maṅgalamutkṛṣṭamahiṃsāsaṃyamastapaḥ | tasya lakṣaṇamuddiṣṭaṃ saddṛṣṭijñānalakṣitam ||37|| dharmo jagati sarvebhyaḥ padārthebhya ihottamaḥ | kāmadhenuḥ sa dhenūnāmapyanūnasukhākaraḥ ||38|| dharma eva paraṃ loke śaraṇaṃ śaraṇārthinām | mṛtyujanmajarārogaśokaduḥkhārkatāpinām ||39|| viśvābhyudayasaukhyānāṃ manujāmaravartinām | dharma eva mato heturniśreyasasukhasya ca ||40|| nāminā māpito dharmaḥ samanvantaravartinām | ekaviṃśena nāthena kā tīrthasya sāṃpratam ||11|| pañcakalyāṇapūjānā svargāvataraṇādipu | bhājanaṃ yo babhūvāna tena dharmo'yamīritaḥ ||42|| mahāvatāni sādhanāmahiṃsā satyabhāṣa gam | asteyaṃ brahmacarya ca nirmūrchā'ceti pañcadhā ||4||
the ||26-28|| vaha cakravartīkī lakṣmīkā svāmī thā tathā indrako śobhāko dhāraṇa karatā thā| kadācit śauryapurake udyāna meṃ gandhamādana nāmaka parvatapara rātrike samaya supratiṣṭha nāmaka munirāja pratimā yoga lekara virājamāna the| pūrva vairake kāraṇa sudarśana nāmaka yakṣane una munirājapara agnivarṣā, pracaṇḍa vāya tathā meghavṛṣṭi ādi aneka kaṭhina upasarga kiye parantu una sabako jītakara ghātiyā karmoṃ kā kṣaya karanavāla ukta munirājane kevalajñāna prāpta kara liyā ||29-31|| unako vandanāke lie saudharma ādi indroṃ ke samūha, cāroṃ nikāyake devoṃke sātha vahā~ āye aura sabane bhaktipūrvaka pūjā kara kevalī bhagavānko namaskāra kiyā ||32|| śauryapurakā rājā andhakavṛṣṇi bhī apane putroṃstriyoṃ tathā senāoṃke sātha āyā aura bhaktipūrvaka supratiṣṭha kevalīkī pūjā-vandanā kara apane sthānapara baiṭha gayā ||33|| jaba jagat ke jīva dharmopadeśa sunane ke lie kāna dekara tathā hātha joḍa़kara sāvadhānoke sātha baiṭha gaye taba supratiṣṭha munirājane isa prakāra upadeśa denā prārambha kiyā ||34||
unhoṃne kahā ki tīnoṃ lokoṃmeṃ trivargako prāpti dharmase hī kahī gayī hai isalie usakī icchā rakhanevāle puruṣako sada| dharmakā saṃgraha karanā cāhie ||35|| śubha dṛttise yukta mana, vacana, kāyake dvārā kiyā huā dharma, prāṇīko sukhake ādhārabhūta sthāna-svarga athavā mokṣameṃ pahuṃcā detā hai ||36|| dharma utkṛṣṭa maṃgalasvarūpa hai tathā samyagdarśana aura samyagjñānase sahita ahiṃsā, saṃyama
aura tapa usa dharmake lakṣaṇa batalāye gaye haiṃ ||37|| isa saṃsārameṃ dharma saba padārthoṃse uttama hai, yaha dhenuoṃmeṃ kāmadhenu hai tathā utkṛṣṭa sukhako khāna hai ||38|| janma, jarā, maraṇa, roga, śoka ādise utpanna duḥkharūpī sūryase santapta śaraṇārthī janoṃke lie lokameṃ dharma hī uttama śaraṇa hai ||39|| manuṣyoṃ aura devoṃmeṃ pāye jānevāle samasta abhyudaya sambandhī sukha aura mokṣa sambandhī sukhakā kāraṇa dharma ho mānā gayā hai ||40|| jo svargāvataraṇādike samaya paṃcakalyāṇaka pūjāoṃke pātra the aise ikkīsaveṃ tīrthaṃkara bhagavān namināthane isa yugameṃ apane samayavartī jīvoṃke lie jo dharma kahā thā vaha isa prakāra hai ||41-42|| unhoṃne muniyoṃke lie 1 ahiṃsā, 2 satya bhāṣaṇa, 1. ghātināṃ ghātaṃ karotīti ghātighātakṛt | 2. putradārābalānvita: ma.| 3. śarīriṇām ma. | 4. -vatinā ma. | 5. aparigrahaḥ ||
