guptiśca vividhā prokkā pañcadhā samitistvidam | sarvasāvadyayogasya pratyākhyānaṃ mataṃ sataḥ ||14|| pañcadhāṇuvataṃ proktaṃ trividhaṃ ca guṇavatam | śikṣāvataṃ caturmedaṃ dharmo'yaṃ gṛhiṇāṃ smṛtaḥ ||45|| hiṃsāderdeśato muktiraṇuvratamudīritam | digdeśānarthadaṇḍebhyo viratiśca guṇavatam ||46|| sāmāyikaṃ trisaṃdhyaṃ tu proṣadhātithipūjanam | āyurante ca sallekhaḥ śikṣāvratamitīritam ||17|| māṃsamadyamadhuyūtakṣī rivṛkṣaphalojjhanam | veśyāvadhūratityāga ityādiniyamo mataḥ ||48|| idameveti taravārthaśraddhānaṃ jñānadarśanam | śaṅkākāṅkṣājugupsānyamataśaṃsāstavojjhanam ||49|| tathopagṛhana mārgabhraṃśināṃ sthitiyojanam | hetavo dṛṣṭisaṃśuddha vātsalyaṃ ca prabhāvanā ||50|| sābhādabhyudayopāyaḥ pāramparyeṇa muktaye | gṛhidharmo'tra maunastu sākṣānmokṣāya kalpate ||51|| sa dharmo mānuṣe dehe prāpyate nānyajanmani | mānuṣastu bhavo duḥkhāllabhyate bhavasaṅkaṭe ||52|| sthāvaratrasakāyeṣu caturgatiṣu dehinaḥ | karmodayavaśātkleśānaśnantaḥ paryaṭantyamī ||53|| pṛthivyaplejasā kāye marutāṃ ca vanaspateḥ | sparśanaikendriyo jīvo dīrghakālamaṭāṭyate ||54|| santi cānantabhedāste jīvāḥ karmakalaṅkitāḥ | ye trasasvamanāpannāḥ kunigodanivāsinaḥ ||55|| kuyonyaśītilakṣāsu caturabhyadhikāsvamī| anekakulakoṭoṣu bambhramyante tanūbhṛtaḥ ||56||
3 acaurya, 4 brahmacarya aura 5 aparigraha ye pāṃca mahāvrata, 1 manogupti, 2 vacanagupti aura 3 kāya- . gupti ye tīna guptiyā~, 1 īryā, 2 bhāṣā, 3 eṣaṇā, 4 ādāna nikṣepaṇa aura 5 pratiṣṭhāpana- ye pāṃca samitiyāṃ aura vidyamāna samasta sāvadya yogakā tyāga-yaha dharma batalāyā hai ||43-44|| tathā gṛhasthoṃke lie pāṃca aṇuvrata, tīna guṇavrata aura cāra śikṣākta yaha bāraha prakārakā dharma kahā hai ||45|| hiṃsādi pāpoṃkā eka deśa choḍa़nā aṇuvrata kahā gayā hai, diśā deśa aura anarthadaṇḍoṃse virata honeko guṇavrata kahate haiṃ aura tīnoṃ sandhyāoṃmeṃ sāmāyika karanā, proṣadhopavāsa ka atithipūjana karanā aura āyake antameṃ sallekhanādhāraṇa karanā ise śikṣāvrata kahate haiṃ ||46-47|| madya-tyāga, māṃsa-tyāga, madhu-tyāga, dyūta-tyāga, kṣīriphala-tyāga, veśyā-tyāga tathā anyavadhū-tyāga ādi niyama kahalāte haiṃ ||48|| 'tattva yahī hai' isa prakāra jñāna aura śraddhāna honā so samyagjñāna aura samyagdarśana hai| śaṃkā, ākāṃkṣā, jugupsā tathā anya matako praśaṃsā aura stutikā choḍa़nā, upagṛhana, mārgase bhraṣṭa honevāloṃkā sthitīkaraṇa karanā, vātsalya aura prabhāvanā ye saba samyagdarśanako śuddha karaneke hetu haiṃ ||49-50||
gṛhastha dharma sākṣāt to svargādika abhyudayakā kāraṇa hai aura paramparāse mokṣakā kāraṇa hai parantu muni dharma mokṣakā sākṣāt kāraṇa hai ||51|| vaha munidharma manuṣya śarīrameṃ hī prāpta hotā hai anya janmameṃ nahīṃ aura manuṣya-janma saṃkaṭapūrṇa saṃsāra meṃ baḍa़e duḥkhase prāpta hotā hai ||52|| ye prāṇī karmodayake vaśībhūta ho sthāvara tathā trasakāyoṃmeṃ athavā narakādi caturgatiyoṃmeṃ kleśa bhogate hue bhramaṇa karate rahate haiṃ ||53|| mātra sparśana indriyako dhāraṇa karanevālā ekendriya jīva pṛthivī, jala, agni, vāyu aura vanaspatike śarīrameṃ dīrghakāla taka bhramaṇa karatā rahā hai ||54|| karmakalaṃkase kalaṃkita aise ananta jīva haiṃ jinhoṃne āja taka saparyāya nahīṃ prāpta kī aura āge bhī usī nigoda paryāyameṃ nivāsa karate raheṃge ||55|| ye prāṇī caurāsī lākha kuyoniyoṃ tathā aneka kulakoṭiyoṃmeṃ nirantara bhramaṇa karate rahate haiṃ ||56||

niḥśrīgautamanāmāsau kṛtamātṛpitṛkṣayaḥ | sādhuṃ bhuñjānamadrākṣīd bhikṣārthī paryaṭan vaduḥ || 304 || samudradattanāmānamanugamya tamāśrame | jagādātmasamaṃ yūyaṃ kurudhvaṃ māṃ bubhukṣitam ||105|| bhavya masau buddhvā dīkṣāṃ tasmai dadau guruḥ | pāpaṃ varṣasahasreṇa vighnakṛt so'pyaśīśamat || 106|| sa śrīgautamasaṃjñākaḥ prāpto'kṣīṇamahānasam | padānusāriṇīṃ labdhi bījabuddhirasaddhimān || 107 || ārādhyārādhanāṃ samyak suviśālamagād guruḥ | śiṣyo varṣasahasrāṇi pañcāśat sa tapo'tapat || 108 || udiyāya sa tatra suviśāle viśāladhīḥ | sthiti saṃmānayanmānyāmaṣṭāviṃśatisāgaraiḥ ||109|| ahamindrasukhaṃ bhuktvā so'vatīrya tato nṛpaḥ | saṃjāto'ndhakavṛṣṇistvamahaṃ tu bhavato guruḥ || 110 || aprākṣīt pūrvajanmāni duḥkhitaḥ kṣitipaḥ punaḥ | svaputrāṇāṃ daśānāṃ ca kevalī ca jagāviti || 111 || sadbhadilapure rājā nāmno megharatho'bhavat | māryā tasya subhadrākhyā tayordṛḍharathaḥ sutaḥ || 112 ||
I
yo rājasamastasya bhāryā nandayaśāḥ sute | sudarśanā ca sujyeṣṭhā dhanadattasya sūnavaḥ || 113 || dhanaśca jinadevau ca pālāntāste trayo matāḥ | ahaṃdāsaḥ prasiddhaśca jinadāsastathā paraḥ || 114 || arhanta iti khyāto jinadattaḥ paraḥ smṛtaḥ | priyamitraḥ pratīto'nyastathā dharmarucidhvaniḥ || 115 || sumandaraguroḥ pārśva pravatrāja nareśvaraḥ | dhanadatto'pi putraistairnavabhiḥ saha dīkṣitaḥ || 116 || sudarśanārthikāpārśve subhadrā ca sudarśanā | sujyeṣṭhā ca tapo jyeṣṭaṃ sahaiva pratipedire || 117 || dhanadatto guruścaiva vārāṇasyāṃ nṛpastathā | kevalajñānamutpādya vihṛtya vasudhāṃ kramāt || 118 ||

the tathā bhīkha māṃgatā huā vaha idhara-udhara ghūmatā-phiratā thā| eka bāra usane samudradatta nāmaka munirājako āhāra karate dekhā | āhārake bāda vaha unake pīche laga gayā tathā āśrama meṃ pahu~cane para unase bolā ki maiṃ bhūkhā maratā hū~ āpa mujhe apane samāna banā lījie || 103 - 105 || munirājane use bhavya prāṇī jānakara dīkṣā de dī aura usane bhī dīkṣā lekara eka hajāra varṣakī kaṭhina tapasyā se vighnakāraka pāpoṃkā upaśama kara diyā || 106 || tapasyāke prabhāvase ukta gautama muni, bījabuddhi tathā rasaṛddhise yukta ho gaye aura akṣīṇamahānasa evaṃ padānusāriṇī ṛddhi bhī unhoṃne prāpta kara lī ||107 || guru samudradatta muni, acchī taraha ārādhanāoṃkī ārādhanā kara chaṭhe graiveyaka ke suviśāla nāmaka vimānameṃ ahamindra hue aura śiṣya gautama munine pacāsa hajāra varṣa tapa kiyā ||108|| antameṃ viśāla buddhike dhāraka gautama muni bhī aṭṭhāīsa sāgarakī sambhāvanīya āyu prāptakara usī suviśāla vimāna meṃ utpanna hue || 109 || ahamindrake sukha bhoganeke bāda vahā~se calakara gautamakā jīva to andhakavṛṣṇi huā hai aura terā guru muni samudradattakā jīva maiṃ supratiṣṭha huā hū~ ||110||
tadanantara duḥkhī hote hue rājā andhakavṛṣṇine apane daśoṃ putroṃke pūrva bhava pūche so kevalī bhagavān isa prakāra kahane lage || 111 || unhoṃne kahā ki kisī samaya sadbhadrilapura nagara meṃ rājā megharatha rahatā thā, usakī strīkā nāma subhadrā thā aura una donoṃke dṛḍha़ratha nāmakā putra thā || 112 || usī nagara meṃ rājākī tulanā karanevālā dhanadatta nāmakā seṭha rahatā thā usakī strīkā nāma nandayaśā thā | nandayaśāse usake sudarśanā aura sujyeṣṭhā nāmakī do kanyāe~ tathā dhanapāla, jinapāla, devapāla, addāsa, jinadāsa, addatta, jinadatta, priyamitra aura dharmaruci ye nau putra utpanna hue ||113 - 115 || kadācit rājā megharathane sumandara guruke pāsa dīkṣā le lī | yaha dekha seṭha dhanadatta bhī apane nau hī putroṃke sātha dīkṣita ho gayā || 116 || | aura sudarśanā nāmaka ārthika ke pāsa subhadrā seṭhānī tathā usakī sudarśanā aura sujyeṣṭhā nāmaka donoṃ putriyoṃne sātha hī sātha dīkṣā dhāraṇa kara lī ||117|| kadācit dhanadatta seṭha, sumandara guru aura megharatha rājā - tīnoṃ hī muni 1. suraddhimān ma. | 2. ṣaṣṭhagraiveyake viśālanāmni vimāne | 3. śreṣṭhī | 4. susyeṣṭā ma | 5. vihṛtā ma. |

banārasa āye aura vahā~ kevalajñāna utpanna kara pṛthivīpara vihāra karane lage || 118 || pūjanīya dhanadatta, sumandara guru aura megharatha muni kramase sāta varṣa, pā~ca varṣa aura bāraha varṣa taka pṛthivīpara vihāra kara antameṃ rājagṛha nagarase siddhaśilāpara ārūḍha़ hue - mokṣa padhāre || 119 || usa samaya seṭha dhanadattakī strī nandayaśā garbhavato thī isalie dīkṣā nahīṃ le sakī thī parantu jaba usake dhanamitra nāmakā putra ho gayā aura vaha yogya bana gayā taba vaha bhī use choḍa़ tapa karane lago ||120||
eka dina seṭha dhanadattake putra dhanapāla ādi nauke- nau munirāja prāyopagamana saṃnyāsa lekara siddhaśilāvara virājamāna the| muniyoṃkī mātā āryikā nandayaśāne unheṃ dekha vandanā kī aura snehase mohita ho nidāna kiyā ki maiṃ agrima bhavameṃ bhī inakī mātā banūṃ || 121 || muniyoṃkī bahana sudarśanā aura sujyeṣṭhā nāmaka āryikāoṃne bhī sneharūpī garta meṃ mohita ho nidāna kiyā ki ye agrima bhava meṃ bhī hamāre bhāī hoṃ | so ṭhoka hī hai kyoṃki snehake lie kyā kaṭhina hai ? ||122|| antameṃ 'samādhi dhāraṇa kara mātā, putra aura putriyā~ - sabake saba acyuta svarga meṃ deva hue| tadanantara bāīsa sāgara taka utkṛṣṭa sukha bhogakara vahā~se cale aura pṛthivīpara ākara he rājan ! tumhārī strī, triyā~ tathā putra hue haiṃ so ṭhīka hī hai kyoṃki pariṇāmoṃke anusāra nānā prakārakī gati hotī hī hai | bhāvārtha - nandayaśākā jīva to tumhārī rānī subhadrā huā hai, sudarśanā aura sujyeṣṭhāke jīva kramase kuntī ora mādrī hue haiṃ tathā dhanapāla ādike jīva vasudevake sivāya no putra hue haiṃ ||123-124||
tadanantara bhagavān supratiṣṭha kevalī, dhyānameṃ tatpara evaṃ kāna khaḍa़e kara baiṭhe hue manuṣya aura devoṃkī usa sabhā meṃ vasudevake bhavāntara kahane lage - ||125 || jisa prakāra samudrako laharoṃmeṃ tairatī huī kīla eke chidrako baḍa़ī kaṭhināīse prāpta kara sakatī hai usī prakāra saṃsāra-sāgarako duḥkharūpī laharoṃmeṃ ḍūbatā aura ubaratā huā yaha prāṇī manuṣya bhavako baḍa़ī kaṭhināīse prāpta kara pātā hai || 126 || | isī paddhatise vasudevakā jīva māgadha deśake śāligrāma nāmaka nagara meṃ rahanevāle atyanta brāhmaṇa aura brāhmaṇīke yahā~ aisā putra huā jise thoḍa़ā bhī sukha prāpta nahīṃ thā || 127|| jaba vaha garbha meṃ thā taba pitā mara gayā | aura utpanna hote hī mātā mara gayī isalie mausīne isakā pālana-poṣaṇa kiyā parantu vaha lagabhaga āṭha varṣakā hī ho pāyā thā ki usakī mausī bhī śokake

prāsukadravyayogena vaiyāvṛtyodyatasya hi | saṃyatasyāpi no bandho nirjaraiva tu jāyate ||142|| 'dharmasādhanamādyaṃ hi śarīramiha dehinām | tasya dhāraṇamādheyaṃ yathāśakti ca śāsane ||143|| samyagdṛṣṭiraśeṣo'pi mandaglānādirādarāt | paryupāsanayā nityamupacaryaḥ sudṛṣṭinā ||14|| pratīkārasamartho'pi yatsudṛṣṭimupekṣate| vyādhikliṣṭamasau naṣṭaḥ samyaktvasyāpabṛṃhakaḥ ||145|| yannopayujyate yasya dhanaṃ vā vapureva vā | svaśāsanajane tena tasya kiṃ bandhahetunā ||146|| tadeva hi dhanaṃ tasya vapurvā sarvathā matam | yadyasya śāsanasthānāṃ yathāsvamupayujyate ||14|| śaktasyopekṣamāṇasya sadadaṣṭijanamāpadi | kā vā kaṭhinacittasya jinaśāsanabhaktatā ||148|| samyaktvaśudviśuddha tu jaine bhaktivilopane | puṃso mithyāvinītasya kā vā darśanaśuddhitā ||149|| bodhilābhanimittāyā dṛṣṭiśuddhevibādhane | punarbodhipariprāptidurlabhā mavasaṃkaṭe || 150|| bodhilābhapariprāptāvasatyāṃ muktisādhanam | kuto vṛttamabhāve'sya kuto muktistadarthinaḥ ||15|| muktyamāve kutaḥ saukhyamanantamanapāyi ca | saukhyābhāve kutaḥ svāsthyaṃ svāsthyāmāve kutaḥ kṛtī||152|| ataḥ sarvātmanā bhāvyaṃ yathāsvaṃ svahitaiṣiṇā | vaiyāvṛtyodyatenā'tra yatinā gṛhiṇā tathā ||153|| śarīraṃ darśanaṃ jñānaṃ cāritraṃ paramaṃ tapaḥ | vaiyāvṛtyakṛtā sarva sthāpitaṃ hi parātmanoḥ ||15|| śāsanasthitivid vidvānupakurvan paraṃ svayam | nirapekṣopakāro vaḥ parātmalaghumokṣamāga ||155||

vaha to kevala karmabandhakā hī kāraṇa hai ||146|| jisakā jo dhana athavā jo śarīra sahadharmī janoṃke upayogameṃ ātā hai yathārthameṃ vahī dhana athavā vahī śarīra usakā hai ||147|| jo samartha hokara bhī āpattike samaya samyagdṛṣṭiko upekṣā karatā hai usa kaṭhora hṛdaya vāleke jinaśāsanakī kyā bhakti hai ? kucha bhī nahīṃ hai ||148|| jo samyagdarśanako śuddhatāse śuddha sahadharmīkī bhakti nahīṃ karatā hai vaha jhūṭha-mūṭhakā vinayī banā phiratā hai usake samyagdarśanako śuddhi kyā hai! ||149|| yadi bodhiko prāptimeṃ nimittabhūta darśanaviśuddhimeṃ bādhā pahu~cāyī jātī hai to phira isa saṃsārake saṃkaṭameṃ punaḥ bodhikī prāpti durlabha hī samajhanī cāhie ||150|| yadi bodhikī prāpti nahīṃ hotī hai to muktikā sādhanabhūta cāritra kaise ho sakatā hai ? aura jaba cāritra nahīṃ hai taba muktike abhilāṣī manuṣyako mukti kaise mila sakatī hai ? ||151|| muktike abhāvameṃ ananta evaṃ avināśī sukha kaise prāpta ho sakatā hai ? sukhake abhāvameṃ svāsthya kaise mila sakatā hai ? harivaṃśapurāṇe vaiyāvṛtyapravṛtto yaḥ śāsanātimāvitaḥ | na sa śakyaḥ surai rorbu kiṃ punaḥ kṣudrajantumiḥ ||56|| nandipeṇamuniścaiṣa tathāvidha iti stute | saudharmendreṇa devāstaṃ praśaśaṃsuḥ praṇāminaḥ ||15|| munidhairyaparīkṣārthaṃ tatraiko vibudhastadā | munirūpadharaḥ prāha nandiṣeṇamiti śritaḥ ||158|| vaiyāvṛtyamahānanda nandiṣeṇa mune śṛṇu | vyādhivyathitadehasya dehi me kiṃcidauṣadham ||159|| ityuktassa tamāhaivamavikalpānukampayā | dadāmi vata te sādho ruciḥ kasminnihāśane ||16|| pūrvadeśajaśālīnāmodanaḥ surabhiḥ śubhaḥ | pañcāladeśamudgānāṃ sūpaḥ svādurasānvitaḥ ||16|| haiyaṅgavīnamuttaptamaparāntabhuvāṃ gavām | payaḥ kaliṅgadhenūnāṃ susṛṣṭaṃ vyañjanāntaram ||162|| labhyeta yadi sādhu syāt śraddhā hyatra mamādhikā | ityuktaścānayāmīti jagāma śraddhayānvitaḥ ||163|| viruddha deśavastūnāṃ prārthane'pyaviṣaṇṇadhīḥ | gatvā gocaravelāyāmānīya sahasā dadau ||164|| upabhuktānapāno'sau śarīrāntarmalāvilaḥ | dhautastena svahastābhyāṃ niśi nirvicikitsayā ||165|| abhagnotsāhamālokya nandiṣeṇamaninditam | vayāvṛtyakṛtaṃ proce divyarūpadharaḥ suraḥ ||16|| yathā devasabhe'stoṣīda bhavantaṃ maghavānṛṣe | vaiyāvṛtyodyato loke tathaiva bhagavān bhavān ||16|| aho labdhiraho dhairyamaho nirvicikitsatā | aho śāsanavātsalyamaśalyaṃ tava sanmuneḥ ||168||
anyeṣāmapi yadyeṣā manīṣā syānmanīṣiṇām | kālatraye tapasyatra teṣāṃ śāsanabhaktatā ||169|| karatā hai ||155|| jo jinaśāsanake arthako utkaṭa bhāvanā karatā huā vaiyāvṛtya karane meṃ pravṛtta rahatā hai use deva bhī rokaneke lie samartha nahīṃ haiṃ phira kṣudra jīvoṃkī to bāta hī kyā hai ||156|| yaha nandiṣeṇa muni aise hī uttama muni haiṃ isa prakāra saudharmendra dvārā stuti kiye jānepara saba devoṃne unakī praśaṃsā kī aura parokṣa namaskāra kiyā ||157| unhīṃ devoṃmeṃ eka deva, munike dhairyakī parīkṣāke lie munikā rūpa rakha nandiṣeṇa munirājake pāsa pahuṃcā aura isa prakāra kahane lagā ||158|| he vaiyāvṛtyameṃ mahān ānanda dhāraṇa karanevāle nandiṣeṇa muni ! merā śarīra vyādhise pīḍa़ita ho rahā hai isalie mujhe kucha oṣadhi dījie||159|| usake isa prakāra kahanepara nandiṣeṇa munine apanī akhaṇḍa anukampāse kahā ki he sādho ! maiṃ oṣadhi detā hū~ parantu yaha batāo ki tumhārī kisa bhojanameṃ ruci hai ? ||160|| muni rūpadhārī devane kahā-pūrvadeśake dhānakā śubha evaṃ sugandhita bhāta, paṃcāla deśako mūṃgakī svādiṣṭa dāla, paścima deśakī gāyoṃkā tapāyā huā ghī, kaliṃga deśakī gāyoṃkā madhura dūdha aura nānā prakārake vyaṃjana yadi mila jāveṃ to acchā ho kyoṃki merī śraddhā inhīṃ cījoṃmeṃ adhika hai | isa prakāra kahanepara 'maiṃ abhī lātā hū~' yaha kahakara nandiṣeṇa muni baḍa़ī śraddhāke sātha ukta āhāra leneke lie cala diye ||161-163|| viruddha deśakī vastuoṃkī cāha honepara bhī unake manameṃ kucha bhī kheda utpanna nahīṃ huā aura gocarī velāmeṃ jā kara tathā ukta saba āhāra lākara unhoṃne śīghra hī usa kṛtrima muniko de diyā ||164|| kṛtrima munine usa āhāra pānīko grahaṇa kiyā parantu rātri meṃ śarīrake antargata malase usakā samasta śarīra malina ho gayā aura nandiṣeṇa munine binā kisī glānike use apane hāthoṃse dhoyā ||165|| tadanantara jinakā utsāha bhagna nahīṃ huā thā, tathā jo barābara vaiyāvṛtya kara rahe the aise praśaṃsanīya nandiṣeṇa muniko dekhakara divya rūpako dhāraṇa karanevāle devane kahā ki he ṛṣe! devoṃkī sabhāmeṃ indrane āpakī jisa prakāra stuti kī thī maiṃ dekha rahā hū~ ki āpa usī taraha vaiyāvṛtya karane meṃ udyata haiṃ ||166-167|| aho ! āpakī ṛddhi, āpakā dhairya, āpakī glāni jītaneko kṣamatā aura saṃśayarahita āpakā śāsana vātsalya sabhī āścaryakārī haiṃ, āpa uttama munirāja haiṃ ||168|| yadi tapa karate samaya anya buddhimān manuṣyoṃkī bhī isī prakāra trikālameṃ vaiyāvṛtya karanekī buddhi ho jāve to use unakī 1. stuteḥ ma. | 2. śrautastena ma. | 3. sanmane ma. |

275 iti stutvā muni nasvā samyaktvaṃ pratipadya saḥ | svargī svargamagānmārga jainendramativartayan ||17|| pañcatriṃśarasahasrāṇi varṣāṇyatigamayya saḥ| prāyopagamanaṃ bheje ṣaṇmāsāvadhi dhīradhīḥ ||171|| saṃnyastavapurāhāraḥ svaparāstapratikriyaḥ | śrīsaubhāgyanidānena svaṃ babandha sumohataḥ ||17|| ninditaṃ nākariṣyaccennidānaṃ sa munistadā | abadhyata tadā śaktyā tīrthakṛnāma taddhavam ||173|| sa cārādhya mahāśukra śakratulyastato'bhavat | tatra tasthau sukhaṃ kālaṃ sārddha ṣoḍaśasāgaram ||17|| sa bhuktasurasaukhyaste tataḥ pracyutya pārthiva | pārthivo vasudevo'yaṃ subhadrāyāmabhūtsutaḥ ||175|| iti śrutvā bhavān pūrvān vṛṣṇimāsutāḥ svakān | dharmasaṃvegasaṃpannāḥ saṃjātā nṛsurāstathā ||176|| supratiṣṭhaṃ praṇamyeyustridaśā nṛpatiḥ punaḥ | samudravijayaṃ rājye sābhiṣekamatiṣṭhapan ||177|| samaya॒ vasudevaṃ ca samudravijayāya saḥ | supratiṣṭhasya pādānte niṣkrāntastadbhavāntakṛt ||178|| rājye bhojakavṛṣṇiśca mathurāyāṃ nidhāya saḥ | ugrasenaṃ samagre'yaṃ nirgranthavatamagrahīt ||17||
pṛthivīchandaḥ samudravijayaḥ śivāṃ vihitapaṭṭabandhī priyāṃ
badhūnivahamukhyatāmadhigamayya rājyasthitim | sthirāṃ sa paripālayan sahajabandhubhavyāmbujaḥ
pratāpamamivardhayannudayanairjinākoṃ yathā ||18|| ityariṣṭanemipurāṇasaṃgrahe harivaṃśe jinasenācāryakṛtī samudravijayarājyalābhavarṇano nāmāṣṭādaśaḥ sargaḥ ||18|| śāsana bhakti samajhanā cāhie ||169|| isa prakāra vaha deva, munirājako stuti kara tathā samyagdarśana prāpta kara jina-śāsanakī prabhāvanā karatā huā svargako calā gayā ||170|| atyanta dhīra buddhiko dhāraṇa karanevāle nandiṣeṇa munine tapaścaraṇa dvārā paiṃtīsa hajāra varṣa bitākara antima samaya chaha māhakā prāyopagamana saṃnyāsa le liyā ||171|| unhoṃne śarīra aura āhārakā tyāga kara diyā, ve apane śarīrakī vaiyāvṛtti na svayaṃ karate the na dūsarese karāte the kintu itanā honepara bhī mohakī tīvratāse unhoṃne 'maiṃ agrima bhavameṃ lakṣmīmān tathā saubhāgyavān hoū~' isa nidānase apanī ātmāko baddha kara liyā ||172|| yadi ve muni usa samaya yaha nindita nidāna nahīṃ karate to apanī sāmarthyase avaśya hī tīrthaṃkara prakṛtikā bandha karate ||173|| tadanantara vaha ārādhanāoṃkī ārādhanā kara mahāśukra svargameṃ indra tulya deva huā aura vahāṃ sāḍha़e solaha sāgara taka sukhase vidyamāna rahā ||174|| he rājan ! vahī putra devoṃke sukha bhogakara antameṃ vahā~se cyuta ho terī subhadrā rānose yaha pṛthivīkā adhipati vasudeva nāmakā putra huā hai ||175|| isa prakāra andhakavṛṣṇi, usakī subhadrārānī tathā samudravijaya ādi putra supratiṣṭha kevalīse apane-apane pūrvabhava sunakara dharma aura saṃvegako prāpta hue| inake sivāya jo vahā~ manuṣya tathā deva the ve bhī dharma aura saṃvegako prāpta hue| inake sivāya jo vahā~ manuṣya tathā deva the ve bhī dharma aura saṃvegako prāpta hae ||176|| supratiṣṭha svāmīko namaskāra kara devaloga apane-apane sthānapara cale gaye| tadanantara saṃsārakā anta karanevāle rājā andhakavṛṣṇine samudravijayakā abhiṣeka kara use rājya-siṃhāsanapara baiṭhāyā aura vasudevako samudravijayake lie sauṃpakara supratiṣṭha kevalīke pādamūlameṃ dīkṣā dhāraṇa kara lī ||177-178|| udhara bhojakavaṣṇine bhī matharāke samagra rājyapara ugrasenako baiṭhākara nigrantha vrata dhāraṇa kara liyāmuni dīkṣā le lī ||179|| rājā samudravijayane apanī priyarānī śivādevīko paṭṭa bā~dhakara samasta striyoṃmeṃ mukhyatā prāpta karā dī| tadanantara jisa prakāra jinendrarūpī sūrya, aṣṭa prātihārya rūpa abhyudayase prabhāvako baḍha़āte hue bhavya jovarūpī kamaloṃko prasanna karate haiṃ usī prakāra rājya maryādākī rakṣā karanevāle rājā samudravijaya bhī apanī anupama vibhūtise pratāpako baḍha़āte hue apane bandhurūpī kamaloṃko prasanna karane lage ||180|| isa prakāra ariṣṭanemi, purāṇake saṃgrahase yukta, jinasenācārya racita harivaṃśapurāṇameṃ samudravijayake

ekonaviṃśaḥ sargaḥ athāha gaṇanāthādyaḥ śṛṇu śreṇika varṇyate | ceṣṭitaṃ vasudevasya vasudhāvijayā jam ||1|| samudravijayo bhūbhṛdaṣṭānāṃ navayauvane | bhrātaṇāṃ rājaputrībhiḥ satkalyāṇamakārayat ||2|| uvāha timakṣobhyastata; stimitasāgaraḥ | svayaṃpramā pramānūnāṃ sunītāṃ himavānapi ||3|| sitākhyāṃ vijayaḥ khyātāṃ priyālāpāṃ tathācalaḥ | upayeme yuvā dhīro dhāraṇaśca prabhāvatīm ||4|| kāliṅgī pūraṇaścārvīmabhicandraśca supramām | aṣṭau svāpu mahādevyastvaṣṭānāmapi tāḥ smṛtāḥ ||5|| kalāguṇavidagdhānāṃ teṣāmāsīt sayoṣitām | anyonyapremabaddha nāmananyasadṛśī ratiḥ ||6|| tadā devakumārābho vasudevaḥ śriyā śritaḥ | śauryapuyāṃ ca cikrīḍa kumārakrīḍayā yutaḥ ||7|| rūpalāvaṇyasaubhāgyabhāgyavaidagdhyavāridhiḥ | jahāra janacetāṃsi kumāro māravibhramaḥ ||8|| catuṇāṃ lokapālānāṃ veṣamādāya hāriṇam | indrādidikṣu niḥkṣudraḥ kramātpuyāṃ viniryayo ||9|| *niryāti sūryadīptāṅge candrasaumyamukhāmbuje | tatra śaurya pure strīṇāṃ mavatyākulatā parā ||10|| saṃghaṭṭaḥ puranārīṇāṃ vasudevadivāyā| jāyate'rṇavavelāyāṃ pūrṇacandodaye yathā ||11|| bhūmau rathyā yathā strīmistyaktaprastutakarmabhiḥ | prāsādeṣu gavākṣāśca sañchādyante didṛkṣamiḥ || 12|| saubhāgyahṛtacetaskaṃ bahirantaritastataḥ | babhūva puramubhrāntaṃ vasudevakathāmayam ||13||

striyoṃmeṃ pradhāna mānī gayī thīṃ ||3-5|| jo kalā tathā aneka guṇoṃmeṃ catura the, apanī-apanī striyoṃse sahita the aura pārasparika premase āpasameṃ ba~dhe hue the aise una saba bhāiyoṃmeṃ paraspara saubhāgya, bhāgya aura caturāīse sāgara tathā kāmadevake samāna sundara vasudeva janatāke cittako haraṇa karate the ||8|| atiśaya udāra vasudeva krama-kramase cāra lokapāloṃkā manohara veṣa rakhakara ekonaviṃśaḥ sargaḥ
277 anyadā puravṛddhāste samudra vijayaṃ nṛpam | natvā vyajijñapagnisthamupāṃśu 'piśunāntarāḥ ||14|| abhayaṃ naḥ pradāya tvaṃ śṛṇu vijñāpanaṃ vimo | yuktaṃ vā yadi vāyukaṃ bālasyeva vacaḥ pitā ||15|| nṛpastvaṃ rakṣaṇākṣaṇāṃ bhūpo rakṣaṇato bhuvaḥ | tvameva jagato rājā rājan ! prakṛtirañjanāt ||16|| svayi rājani rājante janitapramadāḥ prajāḥ | akṣudropadvāḥ pūrva pitarīva tavādhunā ||17|| urvarā sarvasasyaupaḥ śāligrīhyādibhirvaraiḥ | avagrahojjhitairdhatte prativarṣamavandhyatām ||1|| yathā kṛṣistathāsyartha vaṇijyā phalati prabho | kraya vikrayabāhulyād vaṇijāṃ rājyamūrjitam ||10|| ghaṭo'nyo ghaṭapūraṃ hi gomahiṣyudghadhenavaḥ | duhanti satataṃ dugdhaṃ prabhūtāḥ suhitāstṛṇaiḥ ||20|| gṛhārthamannamasyalpa prasādhitamayatnataḥ | nāntameti dinānte'pi dānadharmātmabhuktibhiḥ ||21|| svasvabhāvavibhaktānyabhāve ṣaṣṭeyabdavastuni' | tvatpramāvācirasthairyaḥ kālo dundubhireva naḥ ||22|| evaṃ sati sukha duḥkhaṃ svalpaṃ tadapi bhūpate | na prakāśayituṃ śakyaṃ yathātmodarapāṭanam ||23||
aisā samasta nagara usa samaya bhītara-bāhara udbhrānta ho gayā thā tathā jahāṃ-tahā~ eka vasudevako hī kathā sunāī detī thī ||13|| tadanantara kisī samaya jinake hṛdaya mātsaryase paripūrṇa the aise vṛddhajana rājā samudravijayake pāsa jākara tathā namaskāra kara ekāntameṃ isa prakāra nivedana karane lage ||14||
unhoṃne kahā ki he prabho ! jisa prakāra bālakake vacana cāhe yukta hoṃ cāhe ayukta, unheṃ pitā sunatā hī hai usī prakāra āpa hama logoṃko abhaya dekara hamāre vacana sunie| hamāre ve vacana bhale hī yukta hoṃ athavā ayukta hoṃ ||15|| he nātha ! āpa manuṣyoṃkī rakṣā karate haiṃ isalie nṛpa haiṃ, pṛthivīkī rakṣā karate haiṃ isalie bhūpa haiṃ aura prajāko anuraṃjita karate haiṃ isalie āpa hī rājā haiṃ ||16|| jisa prakāra pahale āpake pitāke rājya-kālameṃ prajā sānanda tathā kṣudra upadravoṃse rahita thī usī prakāra isa samaya āpake rājya-kālameṃ bhī prajā sānanda tathā kṣudra upadravoṃse rahita hai ||17|| yahā~ko upajāū bhūmi varṣāke pratibandhase rahita śāli, brīhi ādi saba prakārake uttamottama dhānyoṃke samūhase prativarṣa saphalatāko dhāraṇa karatī hai |||18|| he prabho! jisa prakāra kheto saphala rahatī hai usī prakāra vāṇijya bhī saphala rahatā hai| āpakā rājya vyāpāriyoṃ ke kraya-vikrayakī adhikatāse atyadhika sampanna ho rahā hai ||19|| ghaṭake samāna baḍa़e-baḍa़e stanoṃko dhāraṇa karanevālī evaṃ hare-bhare tṛṇoṃse santuṣṭa bahuta-sī gāyeṃ, bhaṃse aura uttama jātiko dhenue~ nirantara ghaḍa़e bharabharakara dūdha detī haiṃ ||20|| gharake upayogake lie sādhāraṇa rītise taiyāra kiyā huā thoḍa़ā-sā anna bhī, dānake samaya dharmātmāoṃke bhojanameṃ ānese sāyaṃkālataka bhī samāpta nahīṃ hotā ||21|| he nātha ! sāṭha saṃvatsarī rūpa jo vastu hai usameṃ svabhāvavaśa hī anyathā pariṇamana hotā rahatā hai parantu āpake prabhāvase hamalogoṃkā to dundubhi nāmaka kāla hī cirakālase sthira hai | bhāvārthajyotiṣa-śāstrake anusāra sāṭha saṃvatsara hote haiṃ jo kramase parivartita hote rahate haiṃ, unameṃ hānilābha sabhī kucha hote haiṃ| parantu una saṃvatsaroṃmeṃ eka dundubhi nāmakā saṃvatsara bhī hotā hai jisameṃ prajākā samaya ānandase bītatā hai| prajāke loga rājā samudravijayase kaha rahe haiṃ ki yadyapi saṃvatsara parivartanaśīla haiṃ parantu hamāre lie āpake prabhāvase dundubhi nāmaka saṃvatsara hī cirasthāyī hokara āyā hai ||22|| he rājan ! isa prakāra sukhake rahate hue thoḍa़ā-sā duḥkha bhī hai parantu jisa

harivaṃśapurāṇe ityākarṇya nṛpaḥ prāha pauraprāgraharāniti | brūta vītabhayā duḥkhaṃ yūyaṃ mahyaṃ hitā yadi ||24|| ādhiādhirivālpo'pi hṛdaye kṛtasaṃnidhiḥ | prāṇakāraṇamapyannaṃ pratihanti na saṃśayaḥ ||25|| ityuktāstena te procuriti visrambhamāgatāḥ | duvijñaptimimā rājan nirbudhyasva prajāhitam ||26|| vasudevakumārasya nityaṃ niḥsarataḥ purāt | rūpadarśanavibhrāntā vismaranti vapuḥ striyaḥ ||27|| nirgame ca praveśe ca kumārasyānyadaṅganāḥ | na paśyanti na śṛṇvanti bhavanti vikalendriyāḥ ||28|| tiṣṭhantu tāvadanyāni svānuṣṭeyāni yoṣitām | stanaṃdhayastanādānaṃ rāgāndhānāṃ suvismṛtam ||29|| atirūpatamo dhīraḥ svabhāvasvacchamānasaḥ | sarvopadhāviśuddhāramā kumāraḥ śīlaśekharaḥ ||30|| nṛpa ! kasya na vijñātassamaste vasudhātale | tathāpi kiṃ vayaṃ kurmo cittoddhāntamamṛtpuram ||31|| yadatra yuktamādhātuṃ tattvameva nirūpaya | yathāsvantaṃ purasyeśa ! kumārasya ca jāyate ||32|| tanniśamya vaco rājā vicintya ciramāramani | tatheti pratipadyatān visasarja yayuśca te ||33|| paryaṭya ciramāgatya praṇataṃ bhrātaraṃ nṛpaḥ | āliṅgyāṅka tamāropya snehenāghrāya mastake ||34|| śronto'tyantaṃ kumāra ! tvaṃ ciraṃ śrāntvā vanāntaram | vivarṇa! kṣatpipāsāta ! kimityevaṃ cirāyitam||35||
vātātapaparimlānaḥ śiraḥśekharanīruciḥ | agaṇayya vapuḥkhedaṃ paryaṭasyaṭanapriyaḥ ||36|| prakāra apanā peṭa phāḍa़kara nahīṃ dikhāyā jā sakatā usī prakāra vaha thoḍa़ā-sā duḥkha bhī nahīṃ prakaṭa kiyā jā sakatā ||23||
__isa prakāra sunakara rājā samudravijayane nagarake vṛddhajanoṃse kahā ki yadi āpa loga hamārā hita cāhate haiṃ to nirbhaya hokara vaha duḥkha kahie||24|| kyoṃki hṛdayameṃ rahanevālī choṭī-sī mānasika vyathā bhī śārīrika vyathāke hī samāna, prāṇa-rakṣākā kāraṇa jo anna hai use bhī chuḍa़ā detī hai isameṃ saṃśaya nahīṃ hai| bhāvārtha-mānasika pīḍa़āke kāraṇa manuṣya khānā-pīnā bhī choḍa़ detā hai ||25|| isa prakāra samudravijayake kahanepara prajāke loga viśvasta ho kahane lage| unhoṃne kahā ki he rājan ! hamārī vijñapti, vijñapti nahīṃ kintu durvijñapti hai parantu prajāke hitake lie use avaśya sunie |||26|| vasudevakumāra pratidina nagarase bāhara nikalate haiṃ jisase nagarakī striyā~ unakā rūpa dekhakara pāgala-sī ho jātī haiṃ aura apane śarīrako sudha-budha bhūla jātī haiṃ ||27|| kumārake bāhara nikalane aura bhītara praveśa karaneke samaya striyā~ indriyoṃse rahita jaisī ho jātī haiṃ isalie ve na anya kisīko dekhatī haiṃ aura na anya kucha sunatī ho haiṃ ||28|| striyoṃke apane karane yogya dūsare kāma to dūra raheṃ parantu rāgāndha hokara ve choṭe-choṭe baccoṃke lie stana denādūdha pilānā bhī bhūla jātī haiṃ ||29|| he rājan ! yadyapi kumāra vasudeva, atyanta sundara, dhīravīra, svabhāvase svaccha hṛdayake dhāraka, sarvaprakārase viśuddha ātmāse yukta aura śīlake śiromaṇi haiṃ ||30|| yaha samastaṃ pṛthivītalapara kise nahīṃ vidita hai ? phira bhī hama kyā kareṃ ? nagaravāsiyoṃkā citta udbhrānta ho rahā hai ||31|| he svāmin ! hama logoṃne apanī manovyathā kahī aba yahā~ jo kucha karanā ucita ho tathā jisase nagara aura kumāra donoṃkā pariṇāma acchā ho vaha āpa hī kahie ||32|| rājā samadravijayane nagaravāsiyoṃkī bāta sunakara cirakāla taka apane-āpameṃ usakā vicāra kiyā, usake bāda sabako āśvāsana dekara vidā kiyā aura āśvāsana pākara nagaravāsī yathāsthāna cale gaye ||33|| uso samaya bhāī vasudevane cirakāla taka bhramaṇa karaneke bāda ākara rājā samudravijayako praṇāma kiyā| samudravijayane unakā āliṃgana kara godameṃ baiṭhāyā aura snehase mastaka sūṃghate hue kahā ki kumāra! tuma cirakāla taka vanake madhya meṃ bhramaṇa karanese atyanta thaka gaye ho| dekho, tumhārā varṇa phīkā paḍa़ gayā hai aura tuma bhūkha-pyāsase pīḍa़ita jāna paḍa़te ho| 1. śobhanapariṇāmaḥ | 2. bhrānto'tyantaṃ ma. | 3. parimlānaśiraḥ -ma. |

snānamojanavelāyā mā kṛtāstvamatikramam | adya prabhṛti śuddhāntavanānteṣvāramādhunā ||37|| iti rājānu bhaktamanuśiṣya śivāgṛham | saptakakṣāparikṣepi taṃ gṛhītvā kare'viśat ||38|| snātvā bhuktvā sa tenāmā kṛtarakṣāvidhiḥ svayam | tadalakṣitasaṃketo babhūva nṛpatiḥ sukhī ||39|| kumāro'pi śivādevyāḥ sa vanodyānabhūmiṣu | krīḍannāṭayasugītāyairvinodaiścāvasatsadā ||40|| ekadā tu śivādevyai samālammanamekayā| kubjayā nīyamānaṃ tāṃ khalīkṛtya jahāra saḥ ||41|| sā jagāda tato ruṣṭā kumāra! tava ceṣṭitaiḥ | īdṛśaireva saṃprāpto bandhanāgāramīdṛśam ||42|| sa tāṃ papraccha śaṅkāvān kubje ! kimiti jalpitam | nyavedayacca sā tasmai yathāvannṛpamantraṇam ||43|| tataḥ svaṃ vañcanaṃ jñātvā vimanāḥ sa nṛpaṃ prati | sadmanaśchadmanā dakṣo niragānnagarāttataḥ ||44|| gatvaikānucaro mantrasādhanavyājavānniśi | śmaśāne caikadeśasthaṃ taṃ kṛtvottarasādhakam ||4|| kiṃcidre niveśyaikaṃ mṛtakaṃ bhūṣaṇenijaiḥ | vibhūṣya citikāmadhye nikṣipya vadati sma saḥ ||46|| āryastātasamo rājā paurāśca piśunāściram | sukhaṃ jīvantu saṃtuṣṭāḥ praviṣṭo'haṃ hutāśanam ||47|| ityuktvoccaiḥ pradhāvyāsau pradāgnipraveśanam | antardhānaṃ gato dūraṃ bhujiṣyo'pi puraṃ tataḥ ||48|| vasudevasya vṛttānte tadabhṛtyena nivedite | saporāntaḥpurabhrātṛvṛṣṇivargastadā nṛpaḥ ||49||
itanī dera tumane kisa lie kī ? vāyu tathā ghāmase tuma murajhā gaye ho, tumhāre śirakā seharā bhī kāntihīna ho gayā hai, tuma ghūmaneke aise śaukīna ho ki śarīrake khedakī paravāha na kara ghūmate rahate ho ? aba ājase snāna tathā bhojanake samayakā ullaṃghana nahīṃ karanā tathā ājase antaḥpurake bhītara jo bagīcā hai usīmeṃ krīḍa़ā karanā ||34-37|| isa prakāra rājā samudravijaya bhaktise bhare hue choṭe bhāī vasudebako samajhākara tathā hātha pakaḍa़kara sāta kakṣāoṃse ghire hae śivādevīke mahalameṃ praviṣṭa hue ||38|| vahāṃ vasudevake sātha hī unhoṃne snāna kiyā, bhojana kiyā tathā 've vahīṃ rahe' isa bātakī svayaṃ aisī vyavasthā kara do ki jisakā vasudevako kucha bhī saṃketa mālūma nahīṃ haā| yaha saba kara rājā samadravijaya sukhī hae-niścinta ho gaye ||39|| aura kamāra vasudeva bhī śivādevīke bagīcoṃmeṃ nāṭya-saṃgīta ādi vinodoṃse krīḍa़ā karate hue sadā rahane lage ||40||
athānantara eka dina antaḥparakī eka kabjādāsī śivādevīke lie vilepana liye jā rahī tho so kumārane use taṃga kara chīna liyā| isase ruṣṭa hokara kubjāne kahā ki kumāra ! aisī hī ceṣṭāoṃse tuma isa prakāra bandhanāgārako prāpta ho--kaida kiye gaye ho ||41-42|| kubjākī bāta sunakara śaṃkāyukta ho vasudevane. usase pūchā ki kubje ! tūne yaha kyā kahā ?-tere kahanekā kyā tātparya hai ? taba usane rājākī jo salāha thī vaha jyoṃkī-tyoṃ kumārako batā dī ||43|| tadanantara 'hamāre prati dhokhā kiyā gayā' yaha jānakara kumāra rājāse vimukha ho gaye| ve catura to the hī isalie chalapūrvaka gharase tathā nagarase bāhara nikala gaye ||44|| ve mantrasiddhikā bahānā banā eka naukarako sātha lekara rātrike samaya śmaśānameṃ gaye| vahā~ naukarako eka sthānapara baiṭhākara tathā 'jaba maiṃ pukārū~ uttara denā' aisā saṃketakara kucha dūra akele gaye| vahā~ eka murdāko apane ābhūṣaṇoṃse alaṃkṛta kara tathā use eka citāpara rakhakara unhoṃne kahā ki pitāke samāna pūjya rājā aura cugalī karanevāle nagaravāsī santuṣṭa hokara cirakāla taka sukhase jīvita raheṃ; maiṃ agnimeṃ praviṣṭa ho rahā haiṃ| isa prakāra jorase kahakara tathā 'dauḍa़kara agnimeṃ praveśa kiyā hai' yaha dikhākara antarhita ho dūra cale gaye| isa ghaṭanāke bāda vaha naukara bhī nagarameṃ vāpasa ā gayā ||45-48|| naukara dvārā vasudevakā vṛttānta kahe jānepara rājā samudravijaya usī samaya nagaravāsī, antaḥpura, 1. nnādya- ma.| 2. śaṅkāsāt ma.| 3. vacanaṃ ma. | 4. anucaro'pi |

harivaṃśapurāṇe saṃprāpya prātarākrandamukharo vīkṣya bhasmani | kumārāmaraṇaṃ tatra ruditvā mṛta ityasau ||50|| pāttāpahato duḥkhī sa kṛtocitatakriyaḥ | nindan mandodyamaḥ svaṃ ca vañcito'hamiti sthitaḥ ||51|| vasudevastu niḥśaṅko gṛhītvā paścima diśam | dvijaveṣadharo dhīro yojanāni bahanyayāt ||52|| prāpad vijayakheṭākhyaṃ puraṃ kheṭapuropamam | kṣatriyānvayajenātra dṛṣṭo gandharvasūriṇā ||53|| sagrīva ityanagrāhī gāndharvāthijanasya saḥ | vīkṣyaivākārametasya vaśīkṛta ivāmavat ||54|| kanyānanyasamā tasya somā somasamānanā | anyā vijayasenākhyā rūpapāramite śabhe ||55|| gandharyādikalāpāraṃ prāptayoḥ sa tayoḥ pitā | gāndharva yo'nayorjetā sa bhattatyamimanyate ||56|| lakṣya yogena yatra yatra tayorjayaḥ | tatra tatra samāmadhye te jigāya sa yādavaḥ ||5|| sugīveṇa satoṣeṇa kanye dattaṃ tataḥ śabhe | pariṇīya mudā reme prāsādavarabhūmiṣu ||54|| sūnaṃ vijayasenāyānutpādyākrāsaṃjñakam | śauriḥ śauryasahāyo'yādavijñātavinirgataḥ ||59|| gacchanmārgavaśāt kvāpi praviveśa mahāṭavīm | apaśyacca saro ramyaṃ haṃsasārasavārijaiḥ ||6|| nāmnā ta sa jalāvartamavagāhya mahāsaraḥ | śītaṃ prapāya pānīyaṃ sasnau tatra cirantanam ||11||
jala gurajani?ṣa samavādayadunnataḥ | niśamya ravamuttasthau tatra supto mahāgajaḥ ||6|| bhāī tathā anya yaduvaṃśiyoṃke sātha śmaśāna gaye| usa samaya sabake mukhase ronekī dhvani nikala rahī thī| jaba prātaḥkāla rākhameṃ kumārake ābhūṣaṇa dekhe taba 'kumāra niścita hī mara gaye haiṃ'
yaha jānakara saba rone lage| rājā samudravijaya paścāttāpase pīḍa़ita ho bahuta duḥkhī hue| unhoṃne ___ maraṇottara kālako saba kriyāeṃ kīṃ, apane-āpakī bahuta nindā kī aura hama bhāīse vaṃcita hue haiṃ isa khedase unakā udyama kucha manda paḍa़ gayā ||49-51||
idhara dhora-vīra vasudeva niḥśaṃka ho paścima diśākī ora cala paḍa़e aura eka brāhmaṇakā veṣa rakhakara bahuta yojana dūra nikala gaye ||52|| calate-calate ve devoṃke nagarake samāna sundara vijayakheṭa nāmaka nagarameṃ pahuṃce| vahā~ kṣatriyavaṃśameṃ utpanna sugrīva nāmakā eka gandharvācārya rahatā thā| vaha gandharvācārya saṃgīta vidyāke icchaka manuṣyoṃkā baḍā upakārī thā tathā vasadevakā rūpa dekhakara unakā vaśībhūta jaisā ho gayā ||53-54|| usa gandharvācāryakī, rūpameṃ apanī śānī na rakhanevālā candramukhī somā aura vijayasenā nāmakī do uttama putriyā~ thīṃ| ye putriyāṃ saundaryako parama somāko prāpta huī-so jāna paḍa़to thīṃ ||55|| ye kanyāe~ gandharva ādi kalāoṃkī parama sīmāko prāpta thīṃ isalie unake pitā sugrovane abhimānavaśa aisā vicāra kara liyā thā ki jo gandharva-vidyāmeṃ ina donoṃko jītegā vahī inakā bhartā hogā ||56|| lakṣyalakṣaṇake yogase anyatra jina-jina viṣayoṃmeṃ una donoṃ kanyāoṃ kī jīta huī thī unhīṃ-unhīṃ viṣayoṃmeṃ sabhāke bīca vasudevane una kanyāoṃ ko parājita kara diyā ||57|| tadanantara sugrīvane santuṣṭa hokara apanī donoṃ kanyāe~ vasudevake lie de dī| vasudeva unheṃ vivāha kara mahalakī uttama bhūmiyoṃmeṃ ānandapūrvaka krīḍa़ā karane lage !|58|| śūravoratā hī jinakī sahāyaka thī aise vasudeva, vijayasenā nāmaka stro meṃ akrūra nāmaka putra utpanna kara ajñāta rūpase bāhara nikala gaye ||59|| mārgake anusāra bhramaṇa karate hue unhoṃne eka bahuta baḍa़ī aṭavīmeṃ praveśa kiyā aura vahā~ haṃsa, sārasa tathā kamaloṃse suśobhita eka sundara sarovara dekhā ||60|| jalāvarta nāmake usa mahāsarovara meṃ praveśa kara vasudevane ṭhaṇḍā pānī piyā tathā cirakāla taka snāna kiyā ||61|| tadanantara atiśaya unnata śarīrake dhā vahā~ jalako isa taraha bajāyā ki jisase mṛdaṃgake samāna śabda nikalatā thā| usa śabdako sunakara vahā~ soyā huā eka baḍa़ā hāthī uṭhakara khaḍa़ā ho gayā ||62|| māraneke lie ānevāle usa hāthīko - candratulyavadanā| 2. nāmnāntaḥ sa- ma. | 3. pītvā | 4. samabāhayadunnataḥ ma. |

āpatantaṃ sa taṃ hantu vañcayannavidakṣiṇaḥ | cikrīḍa dantidantāgre dolāpreṅkhanamācaran ||63|| vaśīkṛtya vaśī śītakaraśīkaraśobhitam | āruhyāsphālya hastena hastinaṃ niścalaṃ sthitam || 64 || vismitaḥ svayamevāsau saśiraḥkampamutkaraḥ | araṇyaruditaṃ jātamityacintayadekakaḥ ||65 || abhaviṣya dimakrīḍā yadi śauryapure sviyam | abhaviṣyattato loko mukharaḥ sādhukārataḥ ||66|| iti dhyāyantamevainaṃ jaturgajamastakāt | saumyarūpadharau dhīrau vidyādharakumārakau ||67 || nītvā taṃ kuñjarāvataṃ nagaraṃ vijayārddhajam | cakraturva hirudyāne sarvakāmikanāmani || 68 || aśokānokahasyādhaḥ śokakleśavivarjitam | vasudevaṃ sukhāsīnaṃ navā tāvidamūcatuḥ || 69 || svāminnaśa nivegasya vidyādharamaheśinaḥ | śāsanātvamihānīto jānīhi śvaśuraḥ sa te ||70|| armālī kumāro'haṃ vāyuvego'yamityamum | nivedya purameko'gādasthādeko'tra pālakaḥ || 71 || diṣṭyā vaṃ varddhase svāminnānīto dvipamardanaḥ | ghoraḥ śūro'bhirūpaśca vinīto navayauvanaḥ || 72 || naveti jñāpitastena sa pramodavaśo nṛpaḥ | aṅgaspṛṣṭaṃ dadajātaḥ paridhānāvaśeṣakaḥ ||73|| tataḥ samaṅgalaṃ tena nagaraṃ sa praveśitaḥ | alaṃkṛtavapuḥ pauranaranārībhirīkṣitaḥ ||74|| praśasta tithinakṣatramuhūrtta karaṇodaye | kanyāmaśanivegasya 'śyāmāṃ śyāmāmuvāha saḥ ||75 || reme kāmaṃ sa kāminyā kalāguṇavidagdhayā | tayā tadā tadugravid mukhapaṅkajaṣaṭpadaḥ ||76 ||
chalakara atiśaya catura vasudeva usake dāṃtoṃke agrabhāgapara jhūlā - sā jhūlate hue krīḍa़ā karane lage || 63|| tadanantara jo candramā ke samāna jala ke kaṇoṃse suśobhita thā, aise niścala khaḍa़e hue usa hāthīko vaśa kara jitendriya vasudeva hāthase usakā āsphālana karate hue usapara savāra ho gaye ||64|| usa samaya ekākī vasudeva svayaṃ āścaryaṃ se cakita ho tathā hātha ūparako uṭhā śira hilāte hue manameṃ isa prakāra vicāra karane lage ki merā yaha kārya araṇyarodana jaisā huā || 65 || yadi yaha hastikrīḍa़ā śauryapura meṃ huī hotī to loga dhanyavādase mukhara ho jāte athavā yaha saṃsāra dhanyavādakī dhvani gū~ja uṭhatā || 66 || vasudeva isa prakāra vicāra kara rahe the ki usī samaya saumyarūpake dhāraka do dhīra-vīra vidyādharakumāra hāthī ke mastaka se unheṃ hara le gaye || 67 || aura vijayādhaṃ parvatake kuṃjarāvataṃ nagara meṃ le jākara usake sarvakāmika nāmaka bāhya upavanameṃ choḍa़ diyā || 68 || vahā~ jaba vasudeva aśoka vṛkṣake nīce śoka aura kleśase rahita sukhase baiṭha gaye taba una donoṃ vidyādhara kumāroṃne namaskāra kara kahā ||69 || ki he svāmin! tuma aśanivega nāmaka vidyādhara rājākī ājñāse yahā~ lāye gaye ho use tuma apanā śvasura samajho ||70|| acimālī nāmakā kumāra aura yaha dūsarā vāyuvega hai | isa taraha vasudevase kahakara unameṃ se eka to nagarako ora calā gayā aura eka rakṣā karatā huā vahīṃ khaḍa़ā rahā ||71 || 'he svāmin! āpa bhāgyase baḍha़ rahe haiṃ | hāthīko mardana karanevālā, dhīra-vīra, śūravīra, sundara, vinīta aura navayauvanase suśobhita vaha kumāra yahā~ lāyā jā cukā hai' isa prakāra namaskāra kara jaba usane rājāse kahā to rājā ānandasevibhora ho gayā | usane mātra vastra śeṣa rakhakara śarīraparake saba ābhūṣaṇa use puraskārameṃ de diye ||72-73|| tadanantara jisakā śarīra alaṃkṛta thā aura nagarake nara-nārī jise baḍa़ī utsukatāse dekha rahe the aise vasudevako rājāne maṃgalācāra pūrvaka nagarameṃ praviṣṭa karāyā || 74 || vahā~ uttama tithi, nakṣatra, muhūrta aura karaṇakā udaya honepara vasudevane rājā aśanivegakī yauvanavatī śyāmā nāmaka kanyāko vivāhā || 75 || jo kalāoṃ aura guṇoṃmeṃ atyanta catura thī aisī usa kanyā ke sātha vasudeva icchānusāra krīḍa़ā karane lage | adhika kyā kaheṃ usa samaya vasudeva usake atiśaya

harivaṃśapurāṇe niṣādaśca 'niṣādāṃśo gāndhāraścarṣabhastathā | evamete hyupanyāsā nyāsaścaiva tu saptamaḥ ||224|| dhaivasyā api karttavyau ṣāḍavauḍavito tathā | tadvacca laṅghanīyau tu balavantau tathaiva ca ||225|| aṃśāstu ṣaḍa jakaiśikyā jñayau gāndhārapañcamau | upanyāsāśca vijñeyāḥ ṣaḍa japañcamamadhyamāḥ ||226|| gāndhāraśca bhavennyāso hīnasvayaṃ navātra tu | daurbalyaṃ cātra kartavyaṃ dhaivatasyarṣamasya ca ||227|| ṣaḍa jaśca madhyamaścaiva niṣādo dhaivatastathā | ṣaḍa jagodācyavāṃśāstu nyāsaścaivātra madhyamaḥ ||228|| upanyāsastathā caiva dhaivataḥ ṣaḍaja eva tu | parasparāṃśātigāmaśchandataśca vidhīyate ||22|| pañcamarṣabhahīnaṃ tu pañcasvayaṃ tu tatra vai | paḍa jaścāpyarṣabhaścaiva gāndhāraśca balī bhavet ||230|| ṣaḍajamadhyāstu sarveṣāmupanyāsāstathaiva ca | ṣaḍa jaśca saptamaścaiva nyāsau kāryoṃ prayotkṛbhiḥ ||231|| gāndhārasaptamopetaṃ pañcasvayaṃ ca tada bhavet | ṣāḍavaḥ saptamopetaḥ kāryaścaivātra yogataḥ ||232|| sarvasvarāṇāṃ saṃcāra iṣṭavastu vidhīyate | paḍa jagrānāśrayā yetāḥ vijña yāḥ sapta jātayaḥ ||233|| gāndhāryāḥ pañcadhaivāṃśā dhaivatarṣabharjitāḥ | paḍa jaśva pañcamaścaiva hyupanyāsāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ||234|| gāndhāro'tra bhavennyāso pāḍavarṣabhasaṃbhavaḥ | dhaivatarṣabhahīnaṃ ca tathā cauḍavitaṃ bhavet ||235|| lahanīyau ca to nityamārṣamāddhavataṃ vrajen | iti gāndhāravihitaḥ svaranyāsāṃśasaṃcaraḥ ||236|| lakṣaṇaṃ rakagāndhāryā evaṃ tatsamatāṃ gatam | balavāṃścaiva tatra syādravataḥ pañcamastathā ||23|| gāndhārapaḍa jayoścātra saṃcāro hyumayaṃ vinā | upanyāsaḥ samavyastu madhyamastu vidhīyate ||238||

viṃśatitamaḥ sargaḥ
athāpṛcchatpṛthuśrīkaḥ śreṇiko'tra gaṇeśvaram | kathaṃ viṣṇukumāreṇa vibho valirabadhyata ||1|| abhaṇīdgaṇamukhyaśca śṛṇu śreṇika ! vaiṣṇavīm | dṛṣṭiśuddhikarīṃ śrabyāṃ saskathā kathayāmi te ||2|| ujjayinyāmabhūdrājā śrīdharmā nāma viśrutaḥ | śrīmatī śrīmatī tasya mahādevī mahāguṇā ||3|| catvāro mantriṇaścāsya mantramāgavido baliḥ | bṛhaspatiśca namuciḥ prahlāda iti cāñcitaḥ ||4|| anyadā tapārasthaḥ sasaptaśatasaṃyataḥ | āgasyākampanastasthau bāhyodyāne mahāmuniḥ ||5|| vandanārtha nṛpo lokaṃ niryāntamiva sāgaram | prāsādasthastadālokya mantriṇo'cchadityasau ||6|| akālayātrayā lokaḥ ka yātīti tato baliḥ | rājanajñānino draṣṭuṃ śramaṇānityavedayat ||7|| tato jigamiṣū rājā niṣiddho'pi balād yayau | mantriṇo'pi sahāgasya dṛṣṭvā kiṃcidavīvadan ||8|| gurvādeśācca saṅgho'pi sthito maunamupāśritaḥ | yāntaḥ pratinivṛtyāmī saṃmukhaṃ vīkṣya yoginam ||9|| 'anūnudannṛpādhyakṣaṃ mithyāmārgavimohitāḥ | pramāṇamārgatastān sa jigāya śrutasāgaraḥ ||10|| sthitaṃ pratimayā rātrī jighāṃsūstāṃśca tadivā | devatāstambhitān dṛṣṭvā rājā deśādapākarot ||11|| tadā nāgapure cakrī mahāpadma itīritaḥ | aṣṭau ca kanyakāstasya tāśca vidyādharaihatāḥ ||12||
athānantara viśāla lakṣmīke dhāraka rājā śreṇikane gautama gaṇadharase pūchā ki he vibho ! viṣṇu kumāra munine baliko kyoṃ bāṃdhā thā ? ||1|| isake uttarameṃ gautama gaṇapatine kahā ki he śreṇika ! tū samyagdarśanako śuddha karanevālī viṣṇukumāra muniko manohāriṇī kathā suna, maiṃ tere lie kahatā hū~ ||2||
kisī samaya ujjayinī nagarameṃ śrīdharmā nāmakā prasiddha rājā rahatā thā| usakī śrīmatī nāmako paṭarānī thī| vaha śrīmatī vāstavameṃ śrīmatī-uttama śobhāse sampanna aura mahā guṇavatī thī ||3|| rājā śrīdharmāke bali, bṛhaspati, namuci aura prahlāda ye cāra mantrī the| ye sabhī mantrī mantra mārgake jānakāra the ||4|| kisī samaya śrutake pāragāmo tathā sāta sau muniyoṃse sahita mahāmuni akampana ākara ujjayinīke bāhya upavanameṃ virājamāna hue ||5|| una mahāmunikī vandanāke lie nagaravāsī loga sāgarakī taraha umaḍa़ paḍa़e| mahalapara khaḍa़e hue rājāne nagaravāsiyoṃko dekha mantriyoṃse pūchā ki ye loga asamayako yātrā dvārā kahā~ jā rahe haiṃ ? taba baline uttara diyā ki he rājan ! ye loga ajñānī digambara muniyoṃkī vandanāke lie jā rahe haiṃ ||6-7|| tadanantara rājā śrīdharmāne bhī vahā~ jānekī icchā prakaṭa kī| yadyapi mantriyoṃne use bahuta rokā tathāpi vaha jabardastī cala hī paḍa़ā| antameṃ vivaśa ho mantrī bhī rājāke sātha gaye aura muniyoṃke darśana kara kucha vivāda karane lage ||8-9|| usa samaya guruko ājñāse saba muni saṃgha mauna lekara baiṭhā thā isalie ye cāroṃ mantrī vivaśa hokara lauṭa āye| lauṭakara āte samaya unhoṃne sāmane eka muniko dekhakara rājāke samakṣa cheḍa़ā| saba mantrī mithyāmārgameṃ mohita to the hī isalie śrutasāgara nāmaka ukta munirājane unheṃ jīta liyā ||10|| usī dina rātrike samaya ukta munirāja pratimā yogase virājamāna the ki saba mantrī unheṃ māraneke lie gaye parantu devane unheṃ kolita kara diyā| yaha dekha rājāne unheṃ apane deśase nikāla diyā ||11||

harivaṃśapurāṇe ācāryākampanādīnāṃ sasaptaśatayoginām | vartate'vṛttapūrvo'yamupasargo'dya dāruṇaḥ ||26|| kṣullakaḥ puṣpadantastaṃ kva nāthetyatisaṃbhramaḥ | aprākṣodityatha prāha sa hāstinapure sphuṭam ||27|| kuto'pavarttate nātha sa ityukte jagau guruḥ | prāptavaikriyasāmarthyādviṣṇorjiṣṇoviṣyataḥ ||24|| tasmai sa kṣullako gatvā tamudantaṃ nyavedayat | vikriyālabdhisadbhāvaparīkṣāmakaronmuniḥ ||29|| bāhuḥ prasāritastena giribhittau vimidyatām | 'aruddhaprasaro dūraṃ sahasāpsu yathā tathā ||30|| jñāta labdhipariprāptirjinaśāsanavatsalaḥ | gatvā padmaṃ muniḥ prāha praṇataṃ praṇatapriyaḥ ||31|| padmarāja ! kimārabdhaṃ bhavatā rājyavartinā | na vṛttaṃ kauraveṣvatra kadācidapi yaddhavi ||32|| anāryajanasaṃvṛttamupasarga tapasvinām | nivartayennṛpastasya pravṛttistu kutastata: ||33|| nirvāpyate jvalannāgnirjalena sumahānapi | uttiṣṭhed yadyasau tasmāttasya śāntiḥ kuto'nyataḥ ||34|| nenvājñāphalamaiśvaryamājñādurvṛttaśāsanam | īśvaraḥ sthāṇurapyuktaḥ kriyāśūnyo yadīśvaraḥ ||35|| tannivarttaya durvṛttādvalimāśu paśūpamam | pradveṣaḥ ko'sya mitrārisamabhāveṣu sādhuṣu ||36|| sādhoḥ śītalaśīlasya tāpanaṃ na hi śāntaye | gāḍhatapto dahatyeva toyātmā vikṛtiṃ gataḥ ||37||
ve avadhijñānase vicāra kara tathā dayāse yukta ho kahane lage ki hā! āja akampanācārya ādi sāta sau muniyoṃpara abhūtapūrva dāruṇa upasarga ho rahā hai ||25-26|| usa samaya unake pāsa puṣpadanta nāmakā kṣullaka baiṭhā thā| guruke mukhase ukta dayādraṃ vacana suna usane baḍa़e sambhramake sātha pūchā ki he nātha ! vaha upasarga kahā~ ho rahā hai ? isake uttarameṃ gurune spaṣṭa kahā ki hastināpurameṃ||27|| kṣullakane punaḥ kahā ki he nātha ! yaha upasarga kisase dūra ho sakatā hai ? isake uttarameṃ gurune kahā ki jise vikriyā ṛddhikī sāmarthya prāpta hai tathā jo indrako bhī dhauṃsa dikhānemeṃ samartha hai aise viṣṇukumāra manise yaha upasarga dara ho sakatā hai||28|| kṣallaka puṣpadantane usī samaya jākara viṣṇakamāra munise yaha samācāra kahā aura unhoṃne 'vikriyā ṛddhi prāpta huī hai yā nahīṃ ?' isakī parīkṣā kī ||22|| unhoṃne parīkṣāke lie sāmane khaḍa़ī parvatakī dīvālake āge apanī bhujā phailāyī so vaha bhujā, parvatakī usa dīvālako bhedana kara binā kisī rukāvaṭake dūra taka isa taraha āge baḍha़tī gayo jisa taraha māno pānīmeṃ hī baḍha़ī jā rahī ho ||30||
tadanantara jinheṃ ṛddhiko prāptikā niścaya ho gayā thā, jo jinaśāsanake snehī the aura namra manuṣyoṃke lie atyanta priya the aise viṣṇukumāra muni usī samaya vinayāvanata rājā padmake pāsa jākara usase bole ki he padmarāja! rājya pāte hī tumane yaha kyā kārya prārambha kara rakhā ? aisā kārya to raghuvaṃśiyoṃmeṃ pṛthivīpara kabhī huā hī nahīṃ ||31-32|| yadi koī duṣṭajana tapasvījanoṃpara upasarga karatā hai to rājāko use dūra karanā cāhie| phira rājāse hī isa upasargakī pravṛtti kyoṃ ho rahī hai ? ||33|| he rājan ! jalato huī agni kitanī hī mahān kyoṃ na ho anta meṃ jalake dvārā śānta kara dī jātī hai phira yadi jalase hī agni uṭhane lage to anya kisa padārthase usakī śānti ho sakatī hai ? ||34|| niścayase aiśvarya, ājñārūpa phalase sahita hai arthāt aiśvaryakā phala ājñā hai aura ājñā durācāriyoṃkā damana karanā hai, yadi īśvara-rājā isa kriyāse śūnya hai-duṣṭoṃkā damana karaneme samartha nahīṃ hai to phira aise īśvarako sthāṇu-ṭhūṭha bhī kahā hai arthāt vaha nāmamātrakā īśvara hai ||35|| isalie paśutulya valiko isa duṣkāryase śīghra hī dūra karo| mitra aura śatruoṃpara samāna bhāva rakhanevāle muniyoṃpara isakā yaha dveṣa kyā hai ? ||36|| śītala svabhāvake dhāraka sādhuko santāpa pahu~cānā śāntike lie nahīṃ hai kyoṃki jisa prakāra adhika tapāyā huā pānī vikṛta hokara jalā hī detā hai usī prakāra adhika 1. aruddha: prasaraḥ ma. | 2. na tvājñā ma. | 3. uktakriyāśanyo ma.| 4. śītalaśītastha ma. |

ekaviṃśatitamaḥ sargaḥ
atha gāndharvasena tāṃ kathaṃcitkhecarānvayām | atirājavibhūtiṃ ca cārudattaṃ nirūpya saḥ ||1|| cārugoṣṭhīsukhāsvādaścārudattaṃ yadūttamaḥ | udāracarito'pṛcchadudāracaritapriyaḥ ||2|| 'pratīkṣya kathamīdṛśyaḥ sādṛśya parivarjitāḥ | devapauruṣasūcinyaḥ saṃpado bhavatārjitāḥ ||3|| vada vidyādharī ceyaṃ kutaḥ stutyā tavāspade | nyavasad vasumiḥ pūrṇa varṣakarṇāmṛtaṃ mama ||4|| iti pṛṣṭo'vadatso'smai prahṛṣṭamatirādarāt | sādhu pṛṣṭamidaṃ dhīra ! vacmi te śṛṇu vṛttakam ||5|| āsīdava veśyeśaścampāyāṃ sumahādhanaḥ | bhānudatta iti khyāta: subhadrā tasya bhāminī ||6|| samyagdarśanasaṃśuddhinānāṇuvratadhāriṇoḥ | kāle yāti sukhāmbhodhimagnayoyauvanasthayoḥ ||7|| cirāyati tayościttanayanāmatavarṣiṇi | sākṣādgṛhiphale śrīmadapatyamukhapaṅkaje ||8|| arhadāyatane pūjāṃ kurvāṇāvanyadā ca tau | cāraṇaśramaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā putrotpattimapṛcchatām ||9|| acireṇeva tenāpi yatinā kṛpayā tayoḥ | pradhānasutasaṃbhūtirādiṣṭā pṛṣṭamātrataḥ ||10|| utpannaścācireṇāhaṃ tayoḥ prītikaraḥ sutaḥ | cārudattābhidhānaśca kṛtaḥ kṛtamahotsavaḥ ||11|| kṛtāṇuvratadīkṣaśca grāhitaḥ sakalāḥ kalāḥ | bālacandraḥ parāṃ vṛddhiṃ bāndhavāmmonidheradhāt ||12||
athānantara jinheṃ uttamottama goṣṭhiyoṃke sukhakā svāda thā, jo svayaṃ udāra caritake dhāraka the aura udāracaritake dhāraka manuṣyoṃke lie atyanta priya the aise yaduvaṃśaśiromaṇi taraha vidyādharoṃke kūlameṃ utpanna gāndharvasenāko evaṃ rājāoṃkī vibhūtiko tiraskṛta karanevāle cārudattako dekhakara unase pūchane lage ki he pūjya ! jo apanī tulanā nahīṃ rakhatī tathā jo āpake bhāgya aura puruṣārtha donoṃko sūcita karanevālī haiṃ aisī ye sampadāeṃ āpane kisa taraha prāpta kī ? kahie ki yaha praśaṃsanīya vidyādharī, dhana-dhānyase paripūrṇa āpake bhavanameṃ nivāsa karatī huī mere kānoṃmeṃ amṛtakī varṣā kyoṃ kara rahī hai ? ||1-4|| vasudevake dvārā isa prakāra pūche jānepara cārudatta bahuta hī prasanna huā aura ādarake sātha kahane lagā ki he dhora! tumane yaha ṭhīka pūchā hai | acchā, dhyānase suno maiṃ tumhāre lie apanā vṛttānta kahatā hū~ ||5||
isī campāpurīmeṃ atiśaya dhanāḍhya bhānudatta nāmaka vaiśyaśiromaṇi rahatā thā| usakī strīkā nāma subhadrā thā ||6|| samyagdarśanako viśuddhatāke sātha nānā aṇuvratoṃko dhāraṇa karanevāle sukharūpī sāgarameṃ nimagna evaṃ pūrṇa yauvanase suśobhita una donoṃkā samaya sukhapūrvaka bīta rahā thā||7|| tadanantara kisī samaya jaba ki una donoṃke citta aura netroṃke lie amṛta barasānevālā evaṃ gṛhasthīkā sākṣāt phalasvarūpa, bhāgyaśālī putrakā mukha kamala vilamba kara rahā thā arthāt una donoṃke jaba putra utpanna honemeṃ vilamba dīkhā taba ve donoṃ mandirameṃ pūjā kara rahe the usī samaya cāraṇaṛddhidhārī munike darśana kara unhoṃne unase putrotpattikī bāta pūchī ||8-9|| pūchate ho una munirājane donoṃ dampatiyoṃpara dayā kara kahā ki tumhāre śīghra hī uttama putrakī utpatti hogī|||10|| aura kucha hī samaya bāda una donoṃ dampatiyoṃke ānandako baḍha़ānevālā maiṃ putra huā| merā cārudatta nāma rakhā gayā tathā mere janmakā baḍa़ā utsava manāyā gayā ||11|| a kī dīkṣāke sātha-sātha jise samasta kalāe~ grahaṇa karāyī gayī thīṃ aisā vaha bālakarūpī candramā parivārarūpī samudrako vṛddhi karane lagā | bhāvārtha-vaha bālaka jyoṃ-jyoṃ kalāoṃko grahaṇa karatā jātā thā tyoṃ-tyoṃ 1. pūjya !

varāhagomukhābhikhyaharisiṃhatamo'ntakāḥ | marubhūtiriti prītā vayasyā me'bhavaṃstadā ||13|| taiḥ saha krīḍayā yāto nimnagā ratnamālinīm | 'apādopahataṃ paśyan dampatyoḥ puline padam ||14|| jātavidyādharāśaṅkāḥ pragatyānupadaṃ ca tam | rataśayyāmapaśyāma śyāmale kadalīgṛhe ||15|| rativyatikaramlānapuṣpapallavatalpataḥ | alpamantaramanviṣya sumahāgahanaṃ vanam ||16|| dṛṣṭo vidyādharo vṛkṣe kolito lohakolakaiḥ | pāśrvakheṭakakhaḍa gāgravyagraraktanirīkṣaṇaḥ ||17|| tisraḥ kheṭakasaṃgūḍhā gṛhītvauṣadhivartikāḥ | cālanotkīlanonmūlabraṇarohāḥ kṛtā mayā ||18|| niḥkīlo nivraṇaścāsau gṛhītvā khaḍgakheṭako | niruttaraḥ khamutpatya dadhāvottarayā diśā ||19|| pralāpānupadaṃ gatvā hiyamāṇāṃ dviṣā priyām | vimocyādāya tāmetya māmavīcanmahādaraḥ ||20|| bhadra ! dattā yathā prāṇā mriyamāṇāya me tvayā | tathaiva dīyatāmājñā vada kiṃ vidadhāmi te ||21|| vaitāḍhayasti nṛpaḥ śreṇyā dakṣiṇasyāṃ hi dakṣiṇaḥ | mahendravikramo nāmnā nagare śivamandire ||22|| tasyāmitagatirnāmnā tanayo'hamatipriyaḥ | mitraṃ me dhūmasiṃhaśca gauramuṇḍaśca khecaraḥ ||23|| hīmantaṃ parvataṃ tābhyāmāgatena mayānyadā | yauvanaśriyamārūḍhā dṛṣṭā tāpasakanyakā ||24|| hiraṇyaromatanayā śirīṣasukumārikā | jahāra hṛdayaṃ hṛdyā nāmnā me sukumārikā ||25||
bandhujanoṃkā harṣarūpī sāgara vṛddhiṃgata hotā jātā thā ||12|| usa samaya varāha, gomukha, harisiṃha, tamo'ntaka aura marumūti ye pāṃca mere mitra the jo mujhe atiśaya priya the ||13|| eka bāra una mitroṃke sātha krīḍa़ā karatā huā maiṃ ratnamālinī nadī gayā| vahā~ maiṃne kinārepara kisī dampatīkā eka aisā sthāna dekhā jisapara pahu~caneke lie pairoṃke cihna nahīṃ uchale the ||14|| hama logoṃko vidyādhara dampatīkī āśaṃkā huī isalie kucha aura āge gaye| vahāṃ jākara hama logoṃne hare-bhare kadalī gṛhameṃ usa vidyādhara dampatīkī rati-śayyā dekhī ||15|| rati sambandhī kāryase jisake phūla aura pallava murajhā rahe the aisī usa ratiśayyāse kucha dūra āge calanepara eka baḍa़ā saghana vana dikhā ||16|| vahāṃ eka vṛkṣapara lohako kīloṃse kolita eka vidyādhara dikhāī diyā| usa vidyādharake lāla-lāla netra samīpameṃ paḍa़ī huī ḍhāla aura talavārake agrabhāgameṃ vyagra the arthāt vaha bāra-bāra unhīṃ kī ora dekha rahā thā ||17|| usake isa saṃketase maiṃne ḍhālake nīce chipī huī cālana, utkīlana aura unmūlavraṇaroha nāmaka tīna divya oṣadhiyāṃ uṭhā līṃ| aura cālana nāmaka oṣadhise maiṃne usa vidyādharako calāyā, utkīlana nāmaka oṣadhise use kīlarahita kiyā tathā unmūlanavraṇaroha nāmaka oṣadhise kīla nikālanekā ghāva bhara diyā ||18|| jyoṃ hī vaha vidyādhara kīlarahita evaṃ ghāvarahita huā tyoṃ ho ḍhāla aura talavāra lekara cupacāpa ākāśameṃ uḍa़ā aura uttara diśāko ora dauḍa़ā ||19|| jisa orase ronekā śabda ā rahā thā vaha usī ora dauḍa़tā gayā aura śatruke dvārā harī huī apanī priyāko chuḍa़ā lāyā| priyāko lākara vaha vahīṃ āyā aura baḍa़e ādarake sātha mujhase bolā ki he bhadra ! jisa prakāra āja mujha marate hueke lie āpane prāṇa diye haiṃ usī prakāra ājñā dījie | kahie maiṃ āpakā kyā pratyupakāra karūṃ ? ||20-21||
vijayādhaṃ parvatakī dakṣiṇa śreṇīmeṃ eka śivamandira nāmakā nagara hai| usameṃ mahendravikrama nāmakā sarala rājā hai| usī mahendravikrama rājākā maiṃ atiśaya pyārā amitagati nāmakā putra hū~| dhūmasiṃha aura gauramuṇḍa nāmake do vidyādhara mere mitra haiṃ ||22-23|| kisī samaya una donoṃ mitroṃke sātha maiṃ hrīmanta nāmaka parvatapara āyā| vahāṃ eka hiraṇyaroma nāmakā tāpasa rahatā thā| usako pūrṇa yauvanavatī evaṃ śirīṣake phūlake samāna sukumāra sukumārikā nāmakī sundara kanyā thī|

harivaṃśapurāṇe gāḍhākalpakaśalyāya pitrā me yācittā ca sā | saṃvṛttaścomayorāśa vivāhaḥ paramotsavaḥ ||26|| dhūmasiṃho'pi cāmaṣyāṃ sābhilāṣo'milakṣitaḥ | apramattatayā cāhaṃ viharāmi tayā sadā ||27|| ramamāṇo'dya tenāhaṃ kīlito mocitastvayā | hṛtāsau mocitā śatrormayeyaṃ sukumārikā ||28|| tadeṣa yojyatāmadya janaḥ karmaṇi vāñchite | vayojyeṣṭho'pi taṃ kurve prāṇadasyānuvarttanam ||29|| mavatoddhataśalyaṃ māṃ jīvantamiha janmani | kṛtapratyupakāraṃ te pratīhyaddhataśalyakam ||30|| iti priyaṃvado'vādi strīsakhaḥ khecarī mayā | kṛtaṃ kṛtaṃ hi me sarva tvayā sadbhāvadarśinā ||31|| śuddhaṃ darśayatā bhāvaṃ vada kiṃ na kṛtaṃ tvayā | tadevopakṛtaṃ puṃsāṃ yat sadbhāvadarśanam ||32|| puṇyavān nanu pūjyo'haṃ tattavānaghadarśanam | jātaṃ me sulabhaṃ loke sāmānyanaradurlabham ||33|| sarvasādhāraṇaṃ naṇāmavasthāntaravartanam | tvaṃ viṣaṇṇamanā mā bhūḥ kīlito'smīti vairiṇā ||34|| upakāramatistāta ! yadi māṃ prati te tataḥ | mayyapatyamatiḥ kāryā tvayā nityamitīrite ||35|| vāḍhamityabhidhāyāsau nāma gotraṃ ca me tataḥ | pṛṣṭvāmidhāya māpṛcchaya svosakhaḥ sa khamudyayau ||36|| praviṣṭāśca vayaṃ campāṃ vidyādharakathāratāḥ | dṛṣṭaśratānubhūtaṃ hi navaṃ tikaraṃ nṛṇām ||37|| "ūḍhā ca yauvanasthena nāmnā mitravatī mayā| sarvārthasya sumitrāyā mātulasya tanūbhavā ||38|| śāstravyasanino me'bhūnnātmastrīviṣaye'pi dhīḥ | śāstravyasanamanyeṣāṃ vyasanānāṃ hi bādhakam ||39||
vaha mere dekhane meṃ āyo aura dekhate hī sātha usane merā mana hara liyā ||24-25|| maiṃ vahā~se calā to āyā parantu usakī prāptiko utkaṇṭhārūpa śalya mere manameṃ bahuta gaharī laga gayī| antameṃ pitāne mere lie usa kanyākī yācanā kī aura śīghra hī donoṃkā baḍa़e utsavake sātha vivāha ho gayā ||26|| cūṃki mujhe dikhā ki merā mitra dhūmasiṃha bhī isa sukumārikāko pānekī abhilāṣā rakhatā hai isalie maiṃ sadā pramādarahita hokara isake sātha vihāra karatā hū~ ||27|| parantu āja maiṃ isake sātha ramaṇa kara rahā thā ki vaha dhūmasiṃha mujhe kīlita kara isa sukumārikāko hara le gayā| āpane mujhe chuḍa़āyā aura maiṃ ise śatruse chuḍa़ā lāyā hū~ |28|| isalie āja isa janako ( mujhe) icchita kāryameṃ lagāie | kyoṃki āpa mere prāṇadātā haiṃ isalie avasthāmeṃ jyeṣṭha honepara bhī maiṃ āpakī sevā karū~gā ||29|| yadyapi āpane merī śalya nikālakara mujhe jīvita kiyā hai tathāpi yathārthameṃ merī śalya tabhī nikalegī jaba maiṃ āpakā pratyupakāra kara la~gā ||30||
isa prakāra strīsahita madhura vacana bolanevāle usa vidyādharase maiṃne kahā ki jaba āpa mere prati isa taraha śubha bhāva dikhalā rahe haiṃ taba merā saba kāma ho cukā| kahie śuddha abhiprāyako dikhāte hue āpane merā kyā nahīṃ kiyā hai ? manuṣyoṃko jo śubha bhāvako dikhānā hai vahī to unakā upakāra hai ||31-32|| he niṣpāpa ! niścayase maiṃ āja puṇyavān aura pūjya huā hū~ kyoṃkisaṃsārameṃ anya sāmānya manuṣyoṃke lie dulaṃbha āpakā darśana mujhe sūlabha haā hai ||33|| manuṣyoṃkī avasthāoṃkā palaṭanā sarvasādhāraṇa bāta hai isalie maiṃ śatruke dvārā kīlita huā| yaha socakara āpa khinnacitta na hoṃ ||34|| he tāta ! yadi āpakī mere prati upakāra karanekī bhāvanā hī hai to āpa mujhe sadā apanā putra samajhie| isa prakāra mere kahanepara usane kahā ki bahuta ṭhīka hai| tadanantara vaha merā nāma aura gotra pūchakara strī sahita ākāśameṃ uḍa़ gayā ||35-36|| aura hama loga usī vidyādharakī kathā karate hue campā nagarīmeṃ praviṣṭa hue so ṭhoka hī hai kyoṃki dekhīsunī aura anubhavameṃ āyī nūtana vastu hī manuṣyoṃko sukhadāyaka hotī hai ||37||
taruṇa honepara maiṃne apane māmā sarvārthakī sumitrā srose utpatra mitravatī nāmaka kanyāke sātha vivāha kiyā ||38|| kyoṃki mujhe śāstrakā vyasana adhika thā isalie apanī vīke viṣayameṃ 1. vardhanaṃ ma.| 2. māṃ pṛcchaya ka., kha., ga., gha, | mā = mām + āpṛcchaya, iticchedaḥ | 3. rūḍhā sa.|

rudradattaḥ pitṛvyo me bahuvyasanasaktadhīḥ | saṃmānya yojito mātrā kāmuka vyavahāravit || 40 || āsītkaliṅgasenātra gaṇikā gaṇanāyikā | sutā vasantasenāsyā vasantaśrīriva śriyā || 41|| kanyāsī nṛtyagītādikalākauśalaśālinī | saurūpyasya parā koṭiyauṃvanasya navonnatiḥ || 42 || nṛtyārambhe'nyadā tasyā rudradattena saṃgataḥ | sasāhityajanākīrṇe sthito'haṃ nṛtyamaṇḍape || 43 || sūcanāṭakacyā jātimukulāñjalim | vyakirat pravikāsaṃ ca prāpteṣu mukuleṣu ca ||44|| suṣṭhukāre prayukte'syāḥ kaiścitsāhityavarttibhiḥ | mayā vikāsakālajñamālākārasya yojite || 45|| tasyā datte budhaistasminnaṅguṣṭhe'bhinaye kṛte | nāpitasya mayā datta e nakhamaṇḍalaśodhinaḥ || 46 || kukṣegarmakṣikāyāśca vyudāsāminaye kṛte | pūrvavat taiḥ kṛte prāptagopālasya mayā punaḥ || 47 || rasabhāvavivekasya vyañjikā sā ca saṃprati | suṣṭhukāramadātprītā svāṅgulisphoṭakāriṇī || 48 || tataḥ sarvasya lokasya paśyato mama saṃmukham | nanāṭa nāṭakaṃ hāri sānurāgavaśā ca sā || 49 || upasaṃhṛtanṛtyā ca nijaprāsādavarttinī | svamātre'kathayadbhāvamiti sākalpakāturā ||50|| daha janmani me mātaścārudattātparasya na | saṃkalpastena tenāraṃ māṃ yojayitumarhasi || 51 || mātā jñātvā sutācittaṃ cārudattasya yojane | dānamānādinābhyarcya rudradattamayojayat ||52|| tena cāhamupāyena pṛṣṭhataścāgrataḥ pathi | gajau prayojya tadveśyāveśma jātu praveśitaḥ ||53||
merī kucha bhī ruci nahīṃ thī so ṭhīka hī hai kyoṃki śāstrakā vyasana anya vyasanoṃkā bādhaka hai ||39|| merā eka rudradatta nāmakā kākā thā jo aneka vyasanoṃmeṃ āsakta thā tathā kāmījanoṃke samasta vyavahārako jānanevālā thā | merī mātāne use mere sātha lagā diyā ||40|| isī campā nagarī meṃ eka kaliṃgasenā nāmakī veśyā thī jo samasta veśyāoṃ kī śiromaṇi thī aura usakī vasantasenā nāmakī putrī thī jo śobhāmeṃ vasantakī lakṣmīke samāna jāna paḍa़tī thī || 41 || vaha vasantasenā nṛtya-gīta ādi kalāoṃ sambandhī kauśalase suśobhita thī, saundaryakī parama sīmā thī aura yauvanakī nūtana unnati thī || 42 || kisī eka dina vasantasenākā nṛtya prārambha honevālā thā | usake lie maiṃ bhī rudradattake sātha sāhityika janoṃse bhare hue nṛtya-maṇḍapameṃ baiṭhā thā ||43|| vaha sūcī nṛtya karanā cāhatī thī| usake lie usane suiyoṃke agrabhāgapara aṃjali bharakara jāti puṣpoṃ kī boṃḍa़iyā~ bikhera dīṃ aura gāyanake prabhāvase jaba saba boṃḍa़iyā~ khila gayīṃ to sabhā meṃ baiṭhe hue kitane hī loga usakī praśaṃsā karane lage| maiṃ jānatā thā ki puṣpoṃke khilanese kauna-sā rāga hotā hai, isalie maiṃne use mālākāra rāgakā saṃketa kara diyā | sūcī nṛtyake bāda usane aṃguṣṭha nṛtya kiyā to sabhāke vidvān usakī praśaṃsā karane lage | parantu maiṃne nakhamaṇḍalako śuddha karanevāle nāpita rāgakā saṃketa kara diyā | tadanantara usane go aura makṣikākī kukṣikā abhinaya kiyā to anya loga usakī praśaṃsā karane lage | parantu maiṃne gopāla rāgakā saṃketa kara diyā| isa prakāra rasa aura bhāva ke vivekako prakaṭa karanevālī usa vasantasenāne prasanna ho apanī aṃguliyāṃ caṭakāto huī merī bahuta praśaṃśā kī | tadanantara anurāgase bharī huī ukta veśyāne saba logoṃke dekhate-dekhate mere sāmane sundara nṛtya kiyā ||44-49 || nṛtya samāpta kara vaha apane ghara gayī aura tīvra utkaṇṭhā se ātura ho apanī mātā se kahane lagī ki he mātā ! isa janmameṃ merā cārudatta ke sivāya kisī dūsareke sātha samāgamakā saṃkalpa nahīṃ hai isalie mujhe śīghra hī cārudattake sātha milāneke yogya ho ||50-51 || mātāne putrokā abhiprāya jānakara cārudatta ke sātha milāne ke lie dāna-sammāna ādise santuṣṭa kara rudradattako niyukta kiyā arthāt isa kāryakā bhāra usane rudradatta ke lie sauṃpa diyā || 52 || kisī dina meṃ rudradattake sātha mārga meṃ jā rahā thā ki usane upāya kara mere āge 1. pravikāsātprākū ga. |

aura pīche do-do hāthiyoṃko laḍa़ā diyā aura surakṣā pāneke lie mujhe usa veśyā ke ghara praviṣṭa karā diyā || 53 | | kaliṃgasenā veśyāko isa bātakā pahalese hī saṃketa kara diyā gayā | isalie usane svāgata tathā āsana ādike dvārā hama donoṃkā satkāra kiyā || 54 || tadanantara kaliṃgasenā aura rudradattakā juā prārambha huā so kaliṃgasenāne juāmeṃ rudradattakā dupaṭṭā taka jīta liyā| taba maiṃ rudradattako haṭākara kaliṃgasenāke sātha juā khelaneke lie udyata huā || 55 || mujhe udyata dekha vasantasenāse bhī nahīṃ rahā gayā| isalie vaha caturā apanī mātāko alaga kara mere sātha juā khelane lagī ||56 || maiṃ juā khelanemeṃ cirakāla āsakta rahā| isī bīca mujhe jorakī pyāsa lagī to usane buddhiko mohita karanevāle yogase suvāsita ṭhaṇḍā pānī mujhe pilāyā || 57 || atiśaya viśvāsake kāraṇa jaba usapara merā anurāga baḍha़ gayā taba usakī mātāne mujhe usakā hātha pakaḍa़ā diyā || 18 || maiṃ usameṃ itanā āsakta huā ki usake ghara bāraha varṣaṃ taka rahā| isa bīcameṃ maiṃne apane mātā-pitā tathā priya strī mitravatīko bhī bhulā diyā| phira anya kāryoṃkī to kathā hī kyā thī ? ||59|| vṛddhajanoṃkī sevāse pahale jo mere guṇa vṛddhiko prāpta hue the ve taruṇīkī sevā utpanna hue doṣoṃse usa taraha ācchādita ho gaye jisa taraha ki durjanoṃse sajjana ācchādita ho jāte haiṃ ||60|| hamāre pitā solaha karoḍa़ dīnārake dhanī the| so jaba saba dhana krama-kramase kaliṃgasenāke ghara ā gayā aura anta meṃ mitravatīke ābhūṣaṇa bhī āne lage taba yaha dekha mantra karane meṃ nipuṇa kaliṃgasenā eka dina ekānta meṃ vasantasenāse bolī ki beṭī ! meṃ hitakī bāta kahatī hū~ so mere vacana kānameṃ dhara || 61-62 || jo manuṣya gurujanoṃke vacanāmṛtarūpa mantrakā sadā abhyāsa karatā hai anartharūpī graha sadā usase dūra rahate haiṃ, kabhī usake pāsa nahīṃ āte || 63 || tū hama logoṃ kī isa jaghanya vṛttiko jānatī hī hai ki dhanavān manuṣya hī hamārā priya hai| jisakā dhana khīṃca liyā hai aisā manuṣya īkhake chilake ke samāna choḍa़ne yogya hotā hai || 64 || āja cārudattakī bhāryā ne apane śarīrakā ābhūṣaṇa utārakara bhejā thā so use dekha maiṃne dayāvaśa vāpasa kara diyā hai ||65 || isalie aba sārahīna ( nirdhana ) cārudattakā sātha choḍa़ aura nayī īkhake samāna kisī dūsare sāravān (sadhana) manuṣyakā upabhoga kara || 66||

309 śaṅkaneva tataḥ karṇe tāḍitā sātipīḍitā | jagāda mātaraṃ mātaḥ kimidaṃ gaditaṃ tvayā ||7|| kaumāraṃ patimujjhitvā cārudattaṃ ciroṣitam | kubereṇāpi me kārya neśvareṇa pareṇa kim ||6|| prāṇairapi hi me 'nārthaścārudattaviyojakaiḥ | maivaṃ vocaḥ punarmātaryadi me jīvitaṃ priyam ||19|| pūritaṃ koṭiśo dyumnaiha te tadgṛhāgataiḥ | tathāpi tajihāsābhūdakṛtajñā hi yoṣitaḥ ||70|| kalāpāramitasyāmba rūpātiśayayoginaḥ | saddharmadarśino me'sya syātyāgastyāginaḥ kutaḥ ||7|| atyāsatāmiti jñātvā kṛtvā tadanuvartanam | cintayantī sthitopāyamāvayoḥ sā viyojane ||72|| āsane śayane snāne bhojane cāpi yuktayoḥ | yogenāyujya nau nidrāmahaṃ rātrau bahiḥ kṛtaḥ ||73|| nidrāpāye gṛhaṃ gatvā martṛniḥkrāntiduḥkhinīm | apaśyaṃ mātaraṃ duḥkhī bhāryā ca kṛtarodanām ||7|| tataḥ kṛtatadāśvāsaḥ priyālaṃkārahastakaḥ | uśīrāvarttamāyāto mātulena vaṇijyayā ||5|| krītvā tatra ca kāpasiṃ tāmraliptaṃ pragacchataḥ | devakālaniyogena so'pyadāhi davāgninā ||76|| muktvā mātulamaśvena pūrvāśāṃ gacchato mṛtaḥ | so'pi padbhyāṃ tato yātaḥ priyaṅga nagaraṃ śramī ||7|| surendradattanāmnāhaṃ pitṛmitreṇa vīkṣitaḥ| viśrāntaḥ katicittatra dināni sukhasaṃgataḥ ||8||
kaliṃgasenākī bāta sunakara vasantasenāko itanā tovra duḥkha huā māno usake kānameṃ kīlā hī ṭhoka diyā ho| usane mātāse kahā ki he mātaḥ ! tūne yaha kyā kahā ? ||67|| kumārakālase jise svīkāra kiyā tathā cirakāla taka jisake sātha vāsa kiyā usa cārudattako choḍa़kara mujhe kuberase bhī kyā prayojana hai ? phira dūsare dhanāḍhya manuṣyako to bāta hī kyā hai ? ||68|| adhika kyā kahū~ cārudattake sātha viyoga karānevāle ina prāṇoṃse bhī mujhe prayojana nahīṃ hai | he mātaḥ ! yadi merā jīvana priya hai to aba punaḥ aise vacana nahīṃ kaha ||69|| are ! usake gharase āye hue karoḍa़oṃ dīnāroṃse terā ghara bhara gayā phira bhī tujhe usake choḍa़nekī icchā huī so ṭhoka hī hai kyoṃki khiyāṃ akṛtajña hotī haiṃ ||70|| he mātaḥ! jo kalāoṃkā pāragāmī hai, atyanta rūpavān hai, samīcīna dharmako jānanevālā hai evaṃ atiśaya tyāgī-udāra hai, usa cārudattakā tyāga meṃ kaise kara sakatī hū~ ? 71|| isa prakāra vasantasenāko mujhameṃ atyanta āsakta jāna kaliṃgasenā usa samaya to kucha nahīṃ kaha sakī, usokī hāṃmeṃ hā~ milātī rahī paranta manameṃ hama donoṃko viyakta karanekā upāya socatī rahī ||72|| hama donoṃ āsanapara baiṭhate samaya, śayyāpara sote samaya, snāna karate samaya aura bhojana karate samaya sātha-sātha rahate the isalie use viyukta karanekā avasara nahīṃ milatā thā| eka dina usane kisī yoga ( tantra ) dvārā hama donoṃko nidrāmeṃ nimagna kara rātrike samaya mujhe gharase bāhara kara diyā ||73|| nidrā dūra honepara maiṃ ghara gayā| mere pitā munidīkṣā le cuke the isalie merī mātā aura strī bahuta duḥkhī thīṃ| ve vilakha-vilakhakara rone lagīṃ unheṃ dekha maiṃ bhī bahuta duḥkhī huā ||74|| tadanantara mātā aura strīko dhairya baṃdhākara tathā strīke ābhūṣaṇa hāthameṃ le vyāpārake nimitta maiṃ apane māmāke sātha uśīrāvarta deśa āyā ||75|| vahāṃ kapāsa kharīdakara becaneke lie maiṃ tāmralipta nagarako ora jā rahā thā ki bhāgya aura samayakī pratikūlatāke kāraṇa vaha kapāsa dāvānalase bocameṃ hī jala gayā ||76|| maiṃne. māmāko vahīṃ choḍa़ā aura ghoḍa़āpara savāra ho maiṃ pūrva diśāko ora calā parantu ghoḍa़ā bīcameṃ hī mara gayā isalie paidala calakara thakā-māṃdā priyaṃgunagara pahuṃcā ||77|| usa samaya priyaṃgunagarameṃ mere pitākā mitra surendradatta nāmakā seṭha rahatā thā| usane mujhe dekhakara baḍa़e sukhase rakhā aura kucha dina taka maiṃne vahā~ viśrāma kiyā ||78|| vahā~se maiṃ samudrayātrāke lie gayā so chaha bāra merā jahāja 1. nāthaścārudatto viyojakaḥ ma.| 2. anyāsaktā-ma. | 3. ni:krānta ma. | 4. kṛtarodanīm ma.| 5. priyāyā alaṃkārā haste yasyāsau|

harivaṃśapurāṇe samudrayātrayā yātaḥ ṣaṭ kṛtvo bhinnanausthitiḥ | aṣṭakoṭīśvaraśvāhamamavaṃ minnapātrakaḥ ||79|| āsādya phalakaṃ kṛcchāduttīrya makarālayam | prāpto rājapuraṃ tatra parivrājakamaikṣiṣi ||8|| tenāhaṃ śāntaveṣeṇa śrānto viśrāntimāhitaḥ| rasalobhena ca viśvāsya kāntāraṃ ca praveśitaḥ ||1|| mugdhaḥ sadagdhiko rajjvā parivājāvatāritaḥ | praviṣṭo'haṃ bilaṃ' mīma prerito rasatṛṣṇayā ||8|| rasāyā mūlamāsādya rajjvārūḍho dṛḍhāsanaḥ | ādadāno rasaṃ puṃsā niṣiddhastatra kenacit ||83|| mā spākṣīstvaṃ rasaṃ bhadra ! raudraṃ yadi jijīviṣuḥ | spṛśyeta cenna jīvantaṃ muñcati kṣayarogavat ||84|| tataścakitacitto'hamavocaṃ tamiti drutam | tvaṃ bhoḥ kaḥ kena vā kṣipta iheyukto jagāda saḥ ||85|| ujjayinyā vaṇigminnapātro'pātreṇa liṅginā | rasamādāya nikṣipto rasarākṣasavakṣasi ||86|| svagasthiśeṣabhūto'haṃ rasabhukto vyavasthitaḥ | mamāto nirgamo bhadra ! mṛtasyaiva na jīvataḥ ||87|| saṃpṛestena moḥ kastvamityavocamahaṃ punaḥ | cārudatto vaṇik kṣiptaḥ parivājā tavāriṇā ||48|| priyavādāti viśvasya vakavṛtterdurātmanaḥ | adho'dho'nucaro mugdhaḥ patatīti kimadbhutam ||8|| pūrayitvā rasaṃ tena rajjumāropya cālitam | ekāmākṛṣya kṛttvaikāṃ kṛtārthaḥ sa khalo gataḥ ||10|| patitasya taṭe tena puṃsā nirgamanāya me| upāyaḥ sādhunāvāci tataśceti kṛpāvatā ||11||
phaṭa gayā| antameṃ jisa kisī taraha maiṃ āṭha karoḍa़kā svāmī hokara lauṭa rahā thā ki phira bhī jahāja phaṭa gayā aura sārā dhana samudra meṃ ḍūba gayā ||79|| bhāgyavaśa eka takhtā pākara baḍa़e kaṣṭase maiṃne samudrako pāra kiyā| samudra pārakara maiṃ rājapura nagara āyā aura vahā~ eka saṃnyāsīko maiṃne dekhā ||80|| maiṃ thakā huā thā isalie śāntaveṣako dhāraṇa karanevāle usa saṃnyāsīne mujhe viśrāma karāyā| tadanantara rasakā lobha dekara evaṃ viśvāsa dilākara vaha mujhe eka saghana aṭavīmeṃ le gayā ||81|| maiṃ bholā-bhālā thā isalie usa saṃnyāsīne eka tūmaḍa़ī dekara mujhe rassīke sahāre nīce utārā jisase maiṃ rasako tṛṣṇāse eka bhayaṃkara kueṃmeṃ jā ghusā ||82|| pṛthivīke talameṃ pahuṃcakara rassīpara apanā dṛḍha़ āsana jamāye hue jaba maiṃ rasa bharane lagā taba vahā~ sthita kisī puruṣane mujhe rokā ||83|| usane kahā ki he bhadra! yadi tu jīvita rahanā cāhatā hai to isa bhayaṃkara rasakā sparśa mata kara| yadi kisī taraha isakā sparśa ho jātā hai to kṣayarogako taraha yaha jīvita nahīṃ choḍa़tā ||84|| tadanantara āścaryacakita ho maiṃne usase śīghra hī isa prakāra pūchā ki mahāśaya ! tuma kauna ho? aura kisane tumheṃ yahā~ ḍāla diyā hai ? mere yaha kahanepara vaha bolā ki maiṃ ujjayinīkā eka vaṇika hū~| merā jahāja phaṭa gayā thā isalie eka apātra sādhune rasa lekara majhe rasarūpī rākṣasake vakṣaḥsthalapara girā diyā hai ||85-86|| rasake upabhogase merī camaḍa़ī tathā haḍḍo hī śeṣa raha gayo hai| he bhadra ! merā to yahāṃse nikalanā tabhī hogā jaba maiṃ mara jāū~gā jīvita rahate merā nikalanā nahīṃ ho sakatā ||87|| usa manuṣyane majhase bhī pūchā ki tuma kauna ho? taba maiṃne kahā ki maiṃ cārudatta nāmakā vaṇik hū~ aura jo tumhārā śatru thā uso saṃnyāsāne mujhe yahā~ girāyā hai||88|| 'yaha priyavādī hai' isalie bagaleke samāna māyācārī duṣṭa manuṣyakā viśvāsa kara usake pīche-pīche calanevālā mūḍha़ manuṣya yadi nīce-nīce giratā hai to isameṃ āścarya ho kyā hai ? ekaviṃśatitamaḥ sargaḥ godhaikā rasapānāya sādho'trāvatariṣyati | susvā śīghraṃ hi tatpucchaṃ dhṛtvā nirgaccha niścayam ||12|| tadetyuktavate dharma tasmai samyakravapūrvakam | saprapañcamuvācāhaṃ sahapañcanamaskṛtim ||13|| paredhuśca rasaṃ pītvā gacchantyāḥ pucchamāśvaham | godhāyā dhṛtavān doāmākṛṣṭaśca bahistayā ||14|| taṭopāṭitagātro'haṃ bahirmukto'timūcchitaḥ | vibuddhaśca punarjanma jātamiti vyacintayam ||15|| śanairutthāya gacchantamanvadhāvad yamopamaḥ | mahiṣo vanamadhye māṃ praviṣṭo'haṃ guhāṃ tataḥ ||96|| prasupto'jagarastatra mayākrāntaḥ samutthitaḥ | amidhāntamatyugraṃ so'gṛhīnmahiṣaṃ mukhe ||17|| yāvaccoddhatayoryuddhaṃ vartate viṣamaṃ tayoḥ | tāvat tatpṛṣṭhamākramya nirgato'hamatidvatam ||10|| viniḥsṛtya mahāraṇyād pratyantagrāmamāpnuyām | kākatālīyatastatra rudradattaṃ dadarśa tam ||19|| kṣutpipāsātiharaṇaṃ kṛtvāsau me tato'bravīt | cārudatta! viṣādaṃ mā kārṣītvaṃ śṛṇu me vacaḥ ||10|| suvarṇadvīpamāviśya samupāyaṃ dhanaṃ mahat | pratyeṣyāvaḥ punaryana rakṣyate kulasaṃtatiḥ ||101|| ekavākyatayā tena yātau cairāvatī nadīm | uttīrya girikuṭaṃ ca giriṃ vetravanaṃ vanam ||102|| ṭaṅkaṇaṃ deśamāsādya krīvājau gatidakṣiṇau | gatau vāmapathenātiviṣameṇa śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ||103|| atilaṅghaya samāṃ prāha rudradatto'nvitāda| cārudatta ! paśūn hatvā kṛtvā mastrāpraveśanam ||104||
āsvahe tatra nau dvīpe bhāruṇḍāścaṇḍatuṇḍakāḥ | gṛhītvāmiṣalobhena pakṣiṇaḥ prakṣipanti hi ||105|| usane kahā ki he satpuruṣa ! rasa pīneke lie yahā~ eka goha āvegī so tuma sarakakara yadi śīghra hī usakī pūṃcha pakaḍa़ loge to niścaya hī bāhara nikala jāoge ||12|| vaha usa puruṣakā antima samaya thā isalie isa prakāra nikalanekā mārga batalānevāle usa puruṣake lie maiṃne samyagdarśanapūrvaka vistārake sātha dharmakā upadeśa diyā aura paṃca namaskāra mantra bhī sunāyā ||93|| dūsare dina rasa pīkara jaba goha jāne lagī taba maiṃne donoṃ hāthoṃse śīghra hī usakī pūṃcha pakaḍa़ lī aura vaha mujhe bāhara khīṃca lāyī ||94|| kināroṃkī ragaḍa़se merā śarīra chinna-bhinna ho gayā thā isalie usa gohane jaba mujhe bāhara choḍa़ā taba maiṃ atyanta mūcchita ho gayā| saceta honepara maiṃne vicāra kiyā ki merā punarjanma hī huā hai ||95|| dhīre-dhīre uṭhakara maiṃ āge calā to vanake bīcameṃ yamarājake samāna bhayaṃkara bhaiṃsāne merā pīchā kiyā| avasara dekha maiṃ eka guhāmeṃ ghusa gayā ||16|| usa guphāmeṃ eka ajagara so rahā thā| merā paira paḍa़nepara vaha jāga uṭhā aura sāmane dauḍa़te hue usa bhayaṃkara bhaiṃseko usane apane mukhase pakaḍa़ liyā ||17|| bhaiṃsā aura ajagara donoṃ hī atyanta uddhata the isalie jabataka una donoṃ meṃ yuddha huā tabataka maiṃ usakī pīṭhapara caḍha़kara baḍa़ī śīghratāse bāhara nikala āyā ||98|| usa mahāvanase nikalakara maiṃ samīpavartī eka gā~va meṃ pahu~cā to kākatālīyanyāyase ( acānaka ) maiṃne vahā~ apane kākā rudradattako dekhā ||99|| maiṃ kaī dinakā bhūkhā-pyāsā thā isalie rudradattane merī bhūkha-pyāsakī bādhā dūra kara mujhase kahā ki cārudatta ! kheda mata karo mere vacana suno ||100|| hama donoṃ suvarṇadvīpa calakara tathā bahuta bhārī dhana kamākara campāpurī vāpasa āveṃge jisase apane kulakī rakṣā hogī ||101||
tadanantara rudradattake sātha eka salāha ho jānepara donoṃ vahāṃ se cale aura airāvatī nadīko utarakara tathā girikūṭa nāmaka parvata aura vetravanako ullaṃghakara ṭaṃkaṇa deśameṃ jā pahuṃce| vahā~ mārga atyanta viṣama thā isalie calane meṃ catura do bakarā kharīdakara tathā unapara savāra ho dhīre-dhīre āge gaye ||102-103|| tadanantara samabhūmiko ullaṃghakara rudradattane baḍa़e ādara ke sātha mujhase kahā ki cārudatta ! aba āge māgaṃ nahīṃ hai isalie ina bakaroṃko mārakara tathā inakī bhastrā ( bhāthaḍa़ī) | banākara unameṃ hama donoṃ baiṭha jāveṃ| tīkṣṇa coṃcoṃvāle bhāruṇḍa pakṣī māṃsake lobhase hama donoṃko

uṭhākara suvarṇadvīpameṃ ḍāla deṃge ||104 - 105 || rudradatta baḍa़ī duṣṭa prakṛtikā thā isalie mere rokanepara bhī usane apanā bakarā māra ḍālā aura vinaya se cyuta ho mere bakarākā bhī anta kara diyā || 106 || merā bakarā jabataka mārā nahīṃ gayā tabataka maiṃne pahale usake māranekā pūrṇaṃ pratikāra kiyārudradattako māranese rokā parantu jaba mārā hī jāne lagā taba maiṃne use paṃcanamaskāra mantra grahaṇa karā diyā || 107|| rudradatta ne mṛta bakaroṃkī bhāthaḍa़iyā~ banāyīṃ aura ekake bhītara churī dekara mujhe baiṭhā diyā tathā dūsarī meṃ vaha svayaṃ hāthameṃ churī lekara baiṭha gayā || 108|| tadanantara bhāruṇḍa pakṣī painī coṃcoṃse dabākara donoṃ bhastrāoṃko ākāśameṃ le gaye | merī bhāthaḍa़ī eka kānā bhāruṇḍa pakṣī le gayā thā isalie usane dūsarī jagaha le jākara pṛthivīpara girā dī || 109 || | maiṃ vegase usa bhāthaḍa़īko cīrakara jaba bāhara nikalā to maiṃne ratnoṃkī kiraṇoṃse dedīpyamāna svargake samāna eka vistṛta dvīpa dekhā ||110|| usa dvīpakī sundara diśāoṃko dekhate hue maiṃne parvatake agrabhāgapara eka jinamandira dekhā jo havāse uḍa़tī huī patākāoṃse aisā jāna paḍa़tā thā māno nṛtya hī kara rahā ho || 111 || usī jinamandira ke samīpa maiṃne ātāpana yogase sthita eka cāraṇa ṛddhidhārī munirājako dekhā | una munirājako dekhakara mujhe aisā uttama sukha prāpta huā jaisā ki pahale kabhī prāpta nahīṃ huā thā || 112 ||

rājye saṃsthāpya māṃ prājye samyagdarśanabhāvitam | gurohiraṇyakumbhasya samīpe prāvajat pitā ||119|| bhāryā vijayasenā me nāmnānyāsīnmanoramā | khyātā gāndharvasenākhyā prathamāyāmabhūtsutā ||120|| itarasyāmabhūtputro jyeṣṭo siṃhayaśaḥśrutiḥ| vārāhagrīvanāmānyo vinayādiguṇākaraḥ ||121|| rājye to yauvarājye ca sthāpayitvā yathākramam | 'guroreva gurorante pravrajyāṃ śritavānaham ||12|| kambhakaṇṭakanāmāyaṃ ḍhepaḥ sāgaraveṣṭitaḥ | giriḥ karkoṭakaścātra cārudattāgataḥ katham ||123|| ityukte yatinādyantāṃ sukhaduḥkhavimiśritām | kathaṃkathamahaṃ tasmai kathāmakathayannijām ||124|| tadā vidyādharau dvau taṃ muni putrau namastalāt | avatīrya vavandāte vandanīyamaninditī ||25|| kumārī! cārudatto'yaṃ bhrātā yo vā mayoditaḥ | ityukte māṃ pariṣvajya sthitānuktvā bahupriyam ||126|| tāvacca dvau vimānāyādavatīrya surau purā| māṃ praṇamya muni paścānnavāsīnī mamāgrataḥ ||127|| akramasya tadā hetuṃ khecarau parcapṛcchatām | devāvṛṣimatikramya prāgnatau śrāvakaṃ kutaḥ || 128|| tridaśāvūcatuheṃ tuṃ jinadharmopadeśakaḥ | cārudatto guruḥ sākṣādāvayoriti budhyatām ||129|| tatkathaṃ kathamityukta chāga pūrvaḥ suro'maṇīt | śrayatāṃ me kathā tāvat kathyate khecarī! sphuṭam ||13|| vārāṇasyāṃ purāgārthavedavyākaraṇārthavit | brāhmaṇa: somaśarmāsītsomilā tasya māhanā ||131|| tayorduhitarau bhadrā sulasā ca suyauvane | vedavyākaraṇādīnāṃ śāstrāṇāṃ pārage pare ||132||
jise chaḍa़āyā thā ||118|| usa ghaṭanāne mere hṛdayameṃ samyagdarśanakā bhāva bhara diyā thā| kucha samaya bāda hamāre pitāne viśāla rājyapara mujhe baiṭhākara hiraṇyakumbha nāmaka guruke pāsa dīkṣā le lī ||119|| merī vijayasenā aura manoramā nāmakī do striyāṃ thīṃ unameṃ pahalī vijayasenāke gāndharvasenā nāmakī putrī huī aura dūsarī manoramāke siṃhayaśa nāmakā baḍa़ā aura vārāhagrīva nāmakā choṭā isa prakāra do putra hue| ye donoṃ hī putra vinaya ādi guṇoṃkī khāna the ||120-121|| eka dina maiṃne kramase baḍa़e putrako rājyapara aura choṭe putrako yuvarāja padapara ārūḍha़ kara apane pitārūpa guruke samīpa hī dīkṣā dhāraṇa kara lī ||122|| he cārudatta ! yaha samudrase ghirā huā kumbhakaṇṭaka nāmakā dvīpa hai aura yaha karkoṭaka nāmakā parvata hai yahā~ tuma kaise āye ? ||123|| munirāja ke aisā kahanepara maiṃne ādise lekara anta taka sukha-duḥkhase milī huī apanī samasta kathā jisa-kisī taraha unake lie kaha sunāyo ||124|| usī samaya munirājake donoṃ uttama vidyādhara putroṃne ākāśase nīce utarakara una vandanīya munirājako vandanā ko-unheṃ namaskāra kiyā ||125|| munirājane donoṃ putroṃko sambodhate hue kahā ki he kuṃmāro ! jisakā pahale maiṃne kathana kiyā thā yaha vahī tumhārā bhāī cārudatta hai| munirājake aisā kahanepara donoṃ vidyādhara merā āliṃgana kara priya vacana kahate hue samīpa ho baiṭha gaye ||126|| usī samaya do deva vimānake agrabhāgase utarakara pahale mujhe aura bādameṃ munirājako namaskāra kara mere āge baiṭha gaye ||127|| vidyādharoṃne usa samaya isa akramakā kāraṇa pūchā ki he devo! tuma donoṃne munirājako choḍa़kara śrāvakako pahale namaskāra kyoṃ kiyā? ||128|| devoṃne isakā kāraṇa kahā ki isa cārudattane hama donoṃko jinadharmakā upadeśa diyā hai isalie yaha hamārā sākṣāt guru hai yaha samajhie ||129|| yaha kaise ? isa prakāra kahanepara jo pahale bakarākā jīva thā vaha deva bolā ki he vidyādharo ! sunie, maiṃ apanī kathā spaṣṭa kahatā hū~ ||130||
kisī samaya banārasameṃ purāṇoṃke artha, veda tathā vyākaraṇake rahasyako jānanevālā eka somaśarmā nāmakā brāhmaṇa rahatā thā usakī brāhmaṇīkā nāma somilā thā ||131|| una donoṃke bhadrā aura sulasā nāmakī do yauvanavatī putriyā~ thīṃ| jo veda, vyākaraṇa ādi śāstroṃkī parama pāra1. pitureva | 2. saumillā ma. | 3. bhāminī ma.| brāhmaṇī (ga. ṭi.)|
