595 yudhiṣṭhiro'tra śalyena mīmo duśśāsanena tu | sahadevaḥ śakuninā hyulūko nakulena hi ||30|| duryodhanārjunau yoddhaṃ lagnau yuddha tatastayoḥ | babhūva bhūtavitrāsī śarasandhānadakṣayoḥ ||31|| nihatāḥ pāṇḍavaiḥ kecid dhṛtarāṣṭraśarīrajāḥ | raṇe duryodhanādyāstu kecijīvanmṛtāḥ kṛtāḥ ||32|| ākarṇākṛṣṭacāpaudhaiḥ karṇo'bhimukhamāgatān | yodhān bibheda saṃgrāme kṛṣṇapakṣānanekaśaḥ ||33|| dvandvayuddhe tadā jāte bahubhūtakṣayāvahe | senāpatyorabhadrauda kadanaṃ vividhāyudhaiḥ ||34|| hiraṇyanābhavīreṇa sa saptamiḥ śaraiḥ śataiḥ | navatyā saptaviṃśatyāviddho'nāvṛṣṭirāhave ||35|| prajaghāna śatenāsau sahasreṇa ca patriṇām | anāvṛṣṭirhiraṇyābhaṃ kuśalaḥ pratikarmaṇi ||3|| yādavasya dhvajaṃ tuṅgaṃ ciccheda rudhirātmajaḥ | so'pi cāsya bibhedāśu cāpaṃ chatraṃ ca sārathim ||37|| dhanuranyadupādāya śaravarṣa vavarṣa saḥ | parighaṃ tu yaduḥ kṣiptvā rathaṃ śatrorapātayat ||38|| khaḍgakheṭakahastaṃ taṃ āpatantamariya॑duḥ | khaḍgakheṭakahasto'gāthāduttīrya saṃmukhaḥ ||39|| prahāravañcanādānalāghavātiśayātmanoḥ | asiyuddhamamṛdghoraṃ senāpatyostatastayoḥ ||40|| vārṇayakhaḍgadhātena pradattena bhuje ripuḥ | chinnabāhudvayoraskaḥ papāta vasudhātale ||41|| hate senāpatau tantra caturaṅgabalaṃ dutam | vidrutaṃ śaraṇaṃ prāptaṃ jarāsandhaṃ mahāraṇe ||32|| tuṣṭo'nāvṛṣṭirapyāśu rathamāruhya sainikaiḥ | stūyamāno gato'bhyāśaṃ rāmakeśavayostataḥ ||43|| balakeśavavīrābhyāṃ vṛṣahastikapidhvajāḥ | cakravyūhasya bhettāraḥ pariṣvaktā mahaujasaḥ ||44||
samartha hai ? ||29|| yudhiṣṭhira śalyake sātha, bhīma duḥśāsanake sātha, sahadeva śakunike sātha aura ulūka nakulake sātha yuddha kara rahe the | ||30|| tadanantara duryodhana aura arjuna yuddha karaneke lie tatpara hue so bāṇoṃke caḍha़ānemeṃ catura una donoṃkā bhūtoṃko bhayabhīta karanevālā bhayaṃkara yuddha huā ||31|| pāṇḍavoṃne yuddha meṃ dhṛtarāṣṭra ke kitane hī putroṃko māra ḍālā aura duryodhana ādi kitane hī putroṃko jīvita rahate hue bhī mṛtakake samāna kara diyā ||32|| karṇane, yuddha meṃ āye hue kṛṣṇake pakṣake aneka yoddhāoṃko kāna taka khoṃce hae bāṇoṃke samahase naṣṭa kara ḍālā ||33|| usa samaya jaba donoṃ orase aneka prāṇiyoṃkā kṣaya karanevālā dvandva yuddha ho rahā thā taba donoṃ pakṣake senāpatiyoṃkā nānā prakārake śastroṃse bhayaṃkara yaddha hā ||34|| vīra hiraṇyanābhane yadadhameṃ yādava senāpati anāvaṣṭiko sāta-sau nabbe bāṇoṃ dvārā sattāīsa bāra ghāyala kiyā||35|| aura badalā lene meṃ kuśala hiraṇyanābhane bhī eka hajāra bāṇoṃ dvārā use sau bāra ghāyala kiyā ||36|| rudhirake putra hiraṇyanābhane anāvṛṣṭikī ūṃcī dhvajā cheda ḍālī aura anāvṛṣṭine śīghra hī usake dhanuṣa, chatra aura sārathiko bheda ḍālā ||37|| hiraṇyanābhane dūsarā dhanuṣa lekara bāṇoṃkī varṣā śurū kī aura anāvṛṣṭine parigha pheṃkakara śatrukā ratha girā diyā ||38|| aba hiraṇyanābha talavāra aura ḍhāla hāthameṃ le sāmane āyā to anāvṛṣṭi bhī talavāra aura ḍhāla hāthameṃ le rathase utarakara usake sāmane gayā ||39|| tadanantara prahārake bacāne aura prahārake deneko bahuta bhārī kuśalatāse yukta donoṃ senāpatiyoṃmeṃ bhayaṃkara khaḍga

anyedyurdyudyumaṇidyotadyotite bhuvanodare | saṃnadvau nirgatau yoddhuṃ balairmāgadha mādhavau || 1 || vidhāya pūrvavad byūhau baladvayamadhiṣṭhitam | nānārājanyavinyāsamanyonyaṃ hantumudyatam ||2|| rathastho māgadho yuddhe haṃsakaṃ nijamantriṇam | antikasthamiti prāha yādavānabhivīkṣya saḥ ||3|| pratyekaṃ nāma cihnādyairyadūnāṃ caśva halaka | kimanyairatra nihatairityukte saṃjagāviti ||4|| phenapuñjapratīkāśairhayaiḥ kāñcanadāmabhiḥ | ratho'rkarathavadṛśyaḥ kṛṣṇasya garuḍadhvajaḥ ||5|| śukavarṇasamairaśvairyukto'yaṃ svarṇaśṛṅkhalaiḥ | ariṣṭanemivīrasya vṛṣaketurmahārathaḥ || 6|| kṛṣṇadakṣiṇapāśrveśvariṣṭavarṇaisturaṅgamaiḥ | rathastāladhvajo rājan baladeyasya rājate ||7|| kṛṣṇa hayairyukto bhrājate'yaṃ mahārathaḥ | anīkādhipateratra kapiketūpalakṣitaḥ || 8 || nīla kesara bālā grairhayai hai mapariṣkṛtaiḥ | ratho yudhiṣṭirasyāyaṃ pāṇḍavasya virājate ||9|| śaśāṅkaviśadairaśvai mātariśvajavairvṛtaḥ | gajadhvajayuto māti savyasāciratho mahān ||10|| nīlotpalanibhairepa yukto yayubhirīkṣyate | ratho vṛkodarasyāpi maṇikāñcanabhūṣaṇaḥ || 11 || śoṇavarṇairhayairbhāti samudravijayasya hi | madhye yādavasainyānāṃ mahāsiṃhadhvajo rathaḥ ||12|| akrūrasya kumārasya ratho'sau kadalīdhvajaḥ | sabalairvājibhirbhāti rukmavidrumamāsvaraḥ ||13||
dūsare dina jaba saṃsārakā madhya bhāga sūryake prakāśase prakāśita ho gayā taba jarāsandha aura kṛṣṇa yuddha karaneke lie taiyāra ho apanī-apanī senāoṃke sātha bāhara nikale ||1|| tadanantara jo pahale ke samāna vyūhoṃ kī racanā kara sthita thīṃ aura jinameṃ aneka rājā loga yathāsthāna sthita the aisī donoṃ senāe~ paraspara eka dūsarekā ghāta karane ke lie udyata huīṃ ||2|| yuddha ke maidāna meṃ ākara rathapara baiṭhā jarāsandha, yādavoṃko dekhakara apane samīpavartī haṃsaka mantrīse bolā ki he haṃsaka ! yādavoṃ meṃ pratyekake nāma-cihna ādi to batā. jisase meṃ unhīṃko dekhūṃ anya logoṃke mārane se kyā lābha hai ? isa prakāra kahanepara haṃsaka bolā- ||3-4||
he svāmin! jisameṃ suvarṇamayī sāṃkaloṃse yukta phenake samāna sapheda ghoḍa़e jute hue haiṃ aura jisapara garuḍa़kī dhvajā phaharā rahī hai aisā yaha sūryake rathake samāna dedīpyamāna kṛṣṇakā ratha dikhāī de rahā hai ||5|| jo suvarṇamayī sā~kaloṃse yukta tote ke samāna hare raṃgake ghoḍa़oṃse yukta hai tathā jisapara belakī patākā phaharā rahī hai aisā yaha śūra-vīra ariṣṭanemikā ratha hai || 6 || he rājan ! jo kṛṣṇakī dāhinī ora rīṭhāke samāna varṇavāle ghoḍa़oṃse jutā huā hai tathā jisapara tālakī dhvajā phaharā rahī hai aisā yaha baladevakā ratha suśobhita ho rahā hai ||7|| idhara yaha kṛṣṇavarṇake ghoḍa़oṃse yukta evaṃ vānarako dhvajāse sahita jo baḍa़ā bhārī ratha dikhāī de rahā hai vaha senāpatikā ratha hai || 8|| udhara suvarṇamayī sāṃkaloṃse yukta, garadanake nīle-nīle bāloṃvāle ghoḍa़oṃse jutā huā yaha pāṇḍu rājāke putra yudhiṣṭhirakā ratha suśobhita ho rahā hai ||9|| jo candramāke samāna sapheda evaṃ vāyuke samāna vegaśālī ghoḍa़oṃse jutā huā hai tathā jisapara hāthīkī dhvajā phaharā rahī hai aisā yaha baḍa़ā bhārī arjunakā ratha hai ||10|| jo nīla kamalake samāna nīle-nīle ghoḍa़oṃse yukta hai tathā jisapara maṇimaya aura suvarṇamaya ābhūṣaṇa suśobhita haiṃ aisā yaha bhīmasenakā ratha hai || 11 || vaha yādavoṃkī senā ke bīca meṃ lāla raṃgake ghoḍa़oṃse jutā huā tathā baḍa़e-baḍa़e siṃhoṃkī dhvajāse yukta samudravijayakā ratha suśobhita ho rahā hai || 12|| vaha kumāra akrūrakā ratha suśobhita hai jo kadalīkī 1. mudyato ma | 2. aśvaḥ |

dhvajā sahita hai, balavān ghoḍa़oṃse yukta hai tathā suvarṇa aura mū~gāoṃse dedīpyamāna ho rahā hai ||13|| tītarake samāna maṭamaile ghoḍa़oṃse yukta ratha satyakakā hai aura kumudake samāna sapheda ghoḍa़oṃse jutā ratha mahānemikumārakā hai || 14|| jo suvarṇamaya viśāla daṇḍakī patākāse śobhita hai tathā totekī coṃcake samāna lāla-lāla ghoḍa़oṃse yukta hai aisā yaha bhojakā mahāratha hai || 15 || jo suvarṇamaya palāna se yukta jute hue ghoḍa़oṃse suśobhita hai aisā vaha hariṇakī dhvajāke dhāraka jaratkumārakā ratha suśobhita ho rahā hai || 16 || | vaha jo kāmbojake ghoḍa़ose yukta, sūryake rathake samāna dedīpyamāna sapheda raṃgakā ratha suśobhita ho rahā hai vaha rājā somake putra siṃhalakā ratha hai || 17|| jo suvarṇamaya ābhūṣaṇoṃ se citra-vicitra śarīrake dhāraka kucha-kucha lāla raṃgake ghoḍa़oṃse jutā huā hai tathā jisapara matsyakī dhvajā phaharā rahī hai aisā yaha marurājakā ratha suśobhita ho rahā hai ||18|| yaha jo kamalake samāna ābhāvāle ghoḍa़oṃse jutā, senāoṃke āge sthita hai vaha raṇavīra rājā padmarathakā ratha suśobhita hai || 19 || vaha jo suvarṇamayī jhūloṃse yukta kabūtarake samāna raṃgavāle tīna varṣake ghoḍa़oṃse jutā, evaṃ kamalakī dhvajāse sahita ratha suśobhita ho rahā hai vaha sāraṇakā hai ||20|| jo sapheda aura lāla raṃgake pāṃca varṣake ghoḍa़oṃse jutā hai aisā vaha nagnajit ke putra merudattakā ratha prakāśamāna hai ||21|| jo pāṃca varṇake ghoḍa़oṃse jutā hai, sūryake samāna dedīpyamāna hai aura jisapara kalaśakī dhvajā phaharā rahī hai aisā yaha kumāra vidūrathakā vegaśālī ratha suśobhita hai ||22|| isa prakāra balavān yādavoṃke ratha saba raṃgake ghoḍa़oṃse sahita haiṃ tathā ve saikaḍa़oṃ yā hajāroṃ kī saṃkhyā meṃ haiṃ, unakā varṇana nahīṃ kiyā jā sakatā ||23|| apane pakṣake śūra-vīra rājāoṃ tathā samasta rājakumāroṃke nānā cihnoṃse yukta rathoṃko āpa yathāyogya jānate hī haiṃ ||24|| nānā deśoṃse āye hue aneka kṣatriyoṃse yukta āpakā yaha vyūha atyanta śobhita ho rahā hai tathā śatru senā ke lie bhaya utpanna kara rahā hai ||25||
yaha sunakara jarāsandhane apane sārathise kahā ki he sārathi ! tū merā ratha śīghra hī yādavoṃ kī ora le cala ||26|| tadanantara sārathine ratha āge baḍha़āyā aura jarāsandha lagātāra

hai
jātā hai vaha satya hī kahā jātā hai raṃcamātra bhī anyathā nahīṃ hai || 72 || maiṃ garbha se hī īśvara thā aura baḍa़ese-baḍa़e logoṃ ke lie alaṃghanīya thā phira bhī garbhake prārambhase hī kleśa uṭhānevāle eka choṭe-se vyakti ke dvārā kyoṃ jītā jā rahā hū~ ? catuḥpañcāśaḥ sargaḥ
śreṇikena punaḥ pṛṣṭaśceṣṭitaṃ pāṇḍavodbhavam | saṃdehadhvāntaghātārko gautamaḥ sa jagī gaṇī ||1|| sthiteṣu hāstinapure pāṇḍaveṣu yathākramam | nijasvāmipariprāptyā tutuṣuḥ kuravo'dhikam ||2|| saurājye pāṇḍuputrāṇāṃ vartamāne sukhāvahe | sarve varṇāśramā rāṣṭra dhārtarāṣṭrān visasmaraḥ ||3|| akhaṇḍatagatiḥ prāptaḥ kadācitpāṇḍavāspadam | nāradaścaṇḍacitto'sī prakṛtyā kalahapriyaḥ ||4|| ādareṇa sa tairdṛṣṭaḥ praviśannissarannapi | vyagrayālaṃkṛtau tanvyā draupadyā tu na lakṣitaḥ ||5|| tato jajvāla kopena tailāsaṃgādivānalaḥ | sajanāvasarajño na prāṇī saṃmānaduḥkhitaḥ ||6|| sa taduḥkhavidhānāya kṛtecchaḥ kṛtaniścayaḥ | dhātakīkhaṇḍapūrvārdhamārataṃ prati khe yayau ||7|| aṅgedhvamarakāyāṃ puri śaṅkāvivarjitaḥ | strīlolaṃ padmanāmākhyaṃ sāmikhyaṃ dṛṣṭavānapam ||8|| tenāntaḥpuramātmīyamātmīyasyāsya darśitam | pṛṣṭaśca dṛṣṭamīdṛkṣaṃ strīrūpaṃ kvacidityasau ||9|| paryastaṃ manyamāno'yaṃ pāyase'bhimataṃ ghṛtam | draupadīrūpalāvaṇyaṃ lokātītamavarṇayat ||10|| taṃ draupadīmayaṃ 'grāhaṃ grāhayitvā sa nāradaḥ | dvīpakṣetrapurāvāsakathanaḥ kvāpi yātavān ||11|| ārādhayadasau tīvatapasā draupadīpsayā | suraṃ saṃgamakābhikhyaṃ pātālāntarvāsinam ||12|| ārādhitena devena padmanāmapurī niśi | sā suptava samānītā pārthasya vanitā priyā ||13||
athānantara rājā śreṇikane punaḥ pāṇḍavoṃko ceṣṭā pūchī so sandeharūpī andhakārako naṣṭa karane ke lie sūryake samāna gautama gaṇadhara isa prakāra kahane lage ||śā
jaba pāṇḍava hastināpurameṃ yathāyogya rītise rahane lage taba kuru deśakī prajā apane pūrvasvāmiyoṃko prāpta kara atyadhika santuṣṭa huī ||2|| pāṇḍavoṃke sukhadāyaka surājyake cālū honepara deśake sabhī varṇa aura sabhī āśrama dhṛtarāṣṭrake putra duryodhana ādiko sarvathā bhūla gaye ||3|| eka dina sarvatra be-roka-ṭoka gamana karanevāle, kruddha hṛdaya aura svabhāvase kalahapremī nārada, pāṇḍavoṃke ghara āye ||4|| pāṇḍavoṃne nāradako bahuta ādarase dekhā parantu jaba ve draupadīke ghara gaye taba vaha ābhūṣaṇa dhāraṇa karane meṃ vyagra thī isalie kaba nāradane praveśa kiyā aura kaba nikala gaye yaha vaha nahīṃ jāna sakī ||5|| nāradajī, draupadoke isa vyavahārase telake saṃgase agnike samāna, krodhase jalane lage so ṭhoka ho hai kyoṃki jo prāṇī sammānase dukhī hotā hai vaha sajjanoṃke bhī avasarako nahīṃ jānatā ||6|| unhoṃne draupadīko duḥkha denekā dṛḍha़ niścaya kara liyā aura usī niścayake anusāra ve pūrvadhātakīkhaṇḍake bharata kṣetrakī ora ākāśameṃ cala paḍa़e ||7|| ve niḥśaṃka hokara aṃga deśakī amarakaṃkāpurīmeṃ pahuṃce aura vahāṃ unhoṃne strīlampaṭa, padmanābha nāmaka śobhāsampanna rājāko dekhā ||8|| rājā padmanābhane nāradako ātmīya jāna, apanā antaḥpura dikhāyā aura pūchā ki aisā striyoṃkā rūpa āpane kahīṃ anyatra bhī dekhā hai ? ||9|| rājā padmanābhake praśnako khorameṃ paḍa़e ghoke samāna anukūla mānate hue nāradane draupadīke lokottara saundaryakā varṇana isa rītise kiyā ki usane use draupadīrūpī piśācake vaśībhūta kara diyā arthāt usake hṛdayameṃ draupadīke prati atyanta utkaṇṭhā utpanna kara do| tadanantara draupadīke dvaupakṣetra, nagara tathā bhavanakā patā batākara ve kahīṃ cale gaye ||10-11|| padmanābhane draupadīke prāpta karanekī icchāse tībra tapake dvārā pātālalokameṃ nivāsa karanevāle saṃgamaka nāmaka devako ārādhanā kī ||12|| tadanantara ārādhanā 1. saśobham 'abhikhyā nāmaśobhayoḥ' ityamaraḥ | 2. grāhyaṃ ma.|

bhagavān ne jo tatkāla gīlā vastra choḍa़ā thā use nicoḍa़ne ke lie unhoṃne kucha vilāsapūrṇa mudrā kaṭākṣa calāte hue kṛṣṇakī premapātra evaṃ anupama sundarī jāmbavatīko prerita kiyā || 58|| bhagavānkā abhiprāya samajha śīghratā se yukta tathā nānā prakārake vacana banāne meṃ paṇḍita jāmbavatī banāvaṭī krodhase vikārayukta kaṭākṣa calāne lagī, usakā oṣṭha kampita hone lagā evaṃ hāva-bhāvapūrvaka bhauṃheṃ calākara netrase bhagavān kī ora dekhakara kahane lagī ki ||59 || jinake śarīra aura mukuṭa maṇiyoṃkī prabhā karoḍa़oṃ sarpoṃke maṇiyoṃke kāntimaṇḍalase dūnī ho jātī hai, jo kaustubha maṇise dedīpyamāna haiṃ, jo mahānāgaśayyāpara ārūḍha़ ho jagat meṃ pracaṇḍa āvājase ākāśako vyāpta karanevālā apanā śaṃkha bajāte haiṃ, jo jalake samāna nīlī ābhāko dhāraṇa karanevāle haiṃ, jo atyanta kaṭhina śāṅganāmaka dhanuṣako pratyaṃcāse yukta karate haiṃ, jo samasta rājāoṃke svāmī haiṃ aura jinakī aneka śubha-sundara striyā~ haiṃ ve mere svāmī haiṃ kintu ve bhī kabhī mujhe aisī ājñā nahīṃ dete phira āpa koī vicitra hī puruṣa jāna paḍa़te haiṃ jo mere lie bhī gīlā vastra nicoḍa़nekā ādeśa de rahe haiṃ ||60-62 || jāmbavatīke ukta śabda sunakara kṛṣṇako kitanī hī striyoṃne use uttara diyā ki arī nirlajja ! isa taraha tīna lokake svāmī aura anantaguṇoṃke dhāraka bhagavān jinendrako tū kyoṃ nindā kara rahī hai ? ||63 || jāmbavatīke vacana suna bhagavān nemināthane ha~sate hue kahā ki tūne rājā kṛṣṇake jisa pauruṣakā varṇana kiyā hai saṃsāra meṃ vaha kitanā kaṭhina hai ? isa prakāra kahakara ve vegase nagarakī ora gaye aura śīghratā se rājamahala meṃ ghusa gaye || 64 || ve lahalahāte sarpoṃkī phaṇāoṃse suśobhita śrīkṛṣṇakī viśāla nāgaśayyāpara caḍha़ gaye | unhoṃne unake śāṅgaṃ dhanuṣako dūnā kara pratyaṃcāse yukta

narapatīn sakalān sakalatrakānakṛta sannihitān kṛtagauravaḥ ||72|| vihitatarasamayocitamajjanau paramarūpadharau ghṛtamaṇḍanau | puri yathāsvamagāramadhiṣṭhitau janamano'haratāṃ suvadhūvarau ||73||
kara diyā aura unake pāṃcajanya śaṃkhako jorase phū~ka diyā || 65 || śaṃkhake usa bhayaṃkara śabdase diśāoṃke mukha, samasta ākāśa, samudra, pṛthivī ādi sabhī cījeṃ vyāpta ho gayīṃ aura usase aisī jāna paḍa़ne lagīṃ māno śaṃkhake śabdase vyāpta honeke kāraṇa phaṭa hī gayī hoṃ || 66 || atyadhika madako dhāraṇa karanevāle hāthiyoṃne kṣubhita hokara jahā~-tahā~ apane bandhanake khambhe toḍa़ diye | ghoḍa़e bhī bandhana tuḍa़ākara hinahināte hue nagara meṃ idhara-udhara dauḍa़ne lage ||67|| mahaloṃke śikhara aura kināre ṭūṭa-ṭūṭakara girane lage | śrīkṛṣṇane apanī talavāra khīṃca lī | samasta sabhā kṣubhita ho uṭhī, aura nagaravāsī jana pralayakālake ānekī śaṃkāse atyanta ākulita hote hue bhayako prāpta ho gaye ||68|| jaba kṛṣṇako vidita huā ki yaha to hamāre hī śaṃkhakā śabda hai taba ve śīghra hī āyudhaśālā meṃ gaye aura nemikumārako dedīpyamāna nāgaśayyāpara anādarapūrvaka khaḍa़ā dekha anya rājāoṃ ke sātha āścarya karane lage || 69 || jyoṃ hī kṛṣṇako yaha spaṣṭa mālūma huā ki kumārane yaha kārya jāmbavatīke kaṭhora vacanoṃse kupita hokara kriyā hai tyoṃ hī bandhujanoṃke sātha unhoṃne atyadhika santoṣakā anubhava kiyā| usa samaya kumārakī vaha krodharūpa vikṛti bhī kṛṣṇake lie atyanta santoṣakā kāraṇa huī thī ||70||
apane svajanoṃke sātha kṛṣṇane yuvā nemikumārakā āliṃgana kara unakā atyadhika satkāra kiyā aura usake bāda ve apane ghara gaye | ghara jānepara jaba unheṃ vidita huā ki apanī strīke nimitta se unheṃ kāmoddīpana huā hai taba ve adhika harṣita hue ||71|| śrīkṛṣṇane nemināthake lie vidhipūrvaka bhojavaṃśiyoṃkī kumārī rājīmatīkī yācanā kī, usake pāṇigrahaṇa saṃskārake lie bandhujanoṃke pāsa khabara bhejī aura striyoṃsahita samasta rājāoṃ ko baḍa़e sammāna ke sātha bulākara apane nikaṭa kiyā || 72 || usa samayake yogya jinakā snapana kiyā gayā thā, jo parama rūpako dhāraṇa kara rahe the, jinhoṃne uttamottama ābhūṣaṇa dhāraṇa kiye the aura jo apane-apane nagarameṃ apane-apane ghara sthita the aise uttama vadhū aura vara manuṣyoṃkā mana haraṇa kara rahe the ||73||

ṛtṛriyāya sa dharmamayastato bhuvi dhanāgamakālamayādiva| nabhasi dīnamadarśi dhanāvalī marupathe pathikaistṛṣitairapi ||7|| prathamagarjitaśītapayaḥkaṇā jalamucāṃ 'śikhicātakasaukhyadāḥ| bhuvi babhūvuraśeṣaviyogināṃ dviguṇatāpajuṣāmatiduḥsahāḥ ||75|| davadivākaradagdhavanāvalīprathamanirgatavāṣpasusaurabhe| abhavatāmiva sauhṛdadarśane nabhasi varṣati meghakadambake ||7|| calataḍirasabalākabalāhake surapacāpadhare śaravarṣiṇī| kṣitirabhārasuragopaśataiścitā patitapānthamanobhirivāmitaḥ ||7|| kuṭajanīpakadambakadambakaiḥ kusumitaiḥ kakubhaiḥ kakubho'khilāḥ | navaśilīndhradalaiśca manoharāḥ savanarandhragirikṣitayo babhuḥ ||7|| ghanaghanāghanagarjitatarjitā mukharabāhuṭatāvalayāraveḥ| yuvatayaḥ priyakaṇṭhadṛḍhagrahairvidadhurugramayagrahanigraham ||7|| giriśilātapayogavimocitāstrividhayogadharā munayo vane| śiśiramārutavarṣasahakṣamāstarulatābhimukhāsvavatasthire||8|| pṛthurathaṃ caturaśvayutaṃ tadā dhvajapatākinamarkarathaprabham | samadhiruhya sanemiyuvānvito nṛpasutaiścalito vanabhūmikām ||8||
tadanantara aba pṛthivīpara varṣākāla ānevālā hai isa bhayase hī māno grīṣma ṛtu kahīṃ calī gayī| ākāśameṃ meghamālā chā gayī aura use marusthalake pathika pyāse honepara bhī baḍa़ī dīnatāse dekhane lage ||74|| meghoṃkī prathama garjanāke jo śabda aura śītala jalake chīṃṭe kramase mayūroṃ tathā cātakoṃko sukhadāyī the ve hī pṛthivīpara dūne santāpako prāpta samasta virahī manuṣyoṃke lie atyanta duḥsaha ho rahe the ||75|| sāvana ke mahīne meṃ jaba meghoke samūha barasane lage taba dāvānala aura sūryake kāraṇa dagdha vanapaṃktise jo sarvaprathama vāṣpa ( bhāpa ) aura soṃdī-soṃdī sugandhi nikalī vaha aisī jāna paḍa़ne lagī māno megharūpī mitrake dikhanese hī vanāvaloke vāṣpa-harṣāva aura sukhocchvāsakī sugandhi nikalane lagī ho ||76|| caṃcala bijalī aura balākāoṃse sahita, megha jaba indradhanuṣarūpī dhanuṣako dhāraṇa kara śara arthāt bāṇa (pakṣameṃ jala ) kī varṣā karane lage taba saikaḍa़oṃ indragopoṃse vyāpta pṛthivī aisī jāna paḍa़ne lagī māno jahāṃ-tahā~ pathika janoṃke gire hue anurāgī hṛdayoṃse hī vyāpta ho rahī ho ||77|| samasta diśāeṃ phūle hue kuṭaja, kadamba aura kohāke vṛkṣoṃse manohara dikhane lagī tathā vana, gataṃ aura parvatoṃse sahita samasta bhūmi śilīndhrake naye-naye daloṃse suśobhita ho uṭhī ||78|| meghoṃkī. ghanaghora garjanāse ḍarī huī yuvatiyāṃ, bhujāoṃkī khanakatī huī cūḍa़iyoṃke śabdase yukta patiyoṃke kaṇṭhake dṛḍhāliṃganase apane tīvra bhayarūpī piśācakā nigraha karane lagīṃ| bhāvārtha- meghagarjanāse bhayabhīta striyā~ patiyoṃke kaṇṭhakā dṛḍhāliṃgana karane lagīṃ ||79|| ātāpana, varṣā aura śiśirake bhedase tīna prakārake yogako dhāraṇa karanevāle muniyoṃkā usa samaya parvatakī śilāoṃpara honevālā ātāpana yoga chuṭa gayā thā isalie ve vanameṃ śīta, vāyu aura varṣāko bādhā sahana karate hue vṛkṣa aura latāoṃke noce sthita ho gaye| bhāvārtha - muditabhojasutāna garāṅganātṛṣitanetranipītavapurjalaḥ | vipularājapathena sa tairagāt sakṛpayeva manoharadarśanaḥ || 82 || jalanidhirmukharaḥ svataraṅga kailaṃ kitanartanadorbhirivākulaiḥ | atitarāṃ vibamau vibhusannidhī vidhṛtanartananartake vattadā || 83 || upavanaṃ samupetya vanaśriyaṃ sapadi yūni vilokayatīśvare | vitatākhavanadrumajātayo vicakaruḥ kusumāñjalimānatāḥ || 84 || sa khalu paśyati tatra tadā vane vividhajātibhṛtastṛṇamakṣiṇaḥ | bhavikampitamānasa gāvakān puruṣaruddhamṛgānativihvalān || 85 || laghu nirudhya rathaṃ sa hi sārathiṃ nijaninādajitāmbudanisvanaḥ | api vidannavadanmṛgajātayaḥ kimiha roghamimāḥ pratilambhitāḥ || 86 || akathayat praṇataḥ sa kṛtāñjaliḥ kṣitibhujāmiha māṃsabhujāṃ vibho | tava vivāhavidhau mṛgarodhanaṃ vividhamāṃsanimittamanuṣṭitam ||87|| iti niśamya niśāmya mṛgavajān pratra tibhūtadayāsthitamānasaḥ | nṛpasutānabhivīkṣya vibhurjagāvabhinibodhavitummaṇasāvadhiḥ || 88 || gṛha maraṇyamaraṇya tṛṇodakānyaśanapānamatīya nirāgasaḥ | mṛgakulasya tathāpi vadho nṛbhirjagati paśyata nirghṛṇatāṃ nṛṇām ||89 |
dedīpyamāna evaṃ cāra ghoḍa़oṃse jute rathapara savāra ho aneka rājakumāroṃke sātha vanabhūmikī ora cala diye || 81 || prasannatāse yukta rājīmatī tathā nagarakī striyoṃne apane pyāse netroṃse jinake śarīrarūpī jalakā pāna kiyā thā evaṃ jisakā darśana manako haraṇa kara rahā thā aise neminātha bhagavān, una rājakumāroṃ ke sātha viśāla rāja-māgaṃse darśakoṃpara dayā karate hue ke samāna dhīredhīre gamana kara rahe the || 82 || | usa samaya samudra, sundara nṛtyameṃ vyasta bhujāoṃke samāna apanī caṃcala taraṃgoṃse śabdāyamāna ho rahā thā aura bhagavān‌ke samīpa ānepara nānā prakārake nṛtyoṃ ko dhāraṇa karanevāle nartaka ke samāna atyadhika suśobhita ho rahā thā || 83 || upavana meṃ pahu~cakara yuvā nemakumāra śīghra hī vanakī lakṣmīko dekhane lage aura vanake nānā vṛkṣoṃkī paṃktiyā~ apanī śākhārūpa bhujāe~ phailākara namrībhūta ho unapara phūloṃkī aṃjaliyāṃ bikherane lagīṃ ||84 || usī samaya unhoṃne vanameṃ eka jagaha bhayase jinake mana aura śarīra kāṃpa rahe the, jo atyanta vihvala the, puruṣa jinheṃ roke hue the aura jo nānā jātiyoṃse yukta the aise tṛṇabhakṣī paśuoṃ ko dekhā ||85|| yadyapi bhagavān, avadhijñānase una paśuoṃko ekatrita karanekā kāraṇa jānate the tathāpi unhoṃne śīghra hī ratha rokakara apane śabdase meghadhvani ko jītate hue, sārathise pūchā ki ye nānā jāti ke paśu yahā~ kisalie roke gaye haiṃ ? || 86 || sārathine namrībhūta ho hātha joḍa़kara kahā ki he vibho ! āpake vivāhotsava meṃ jo māṃsabhojī rājā āye haiṃ unake lie nānā prakārakā māṃsa taiyāra karane ke lie yahā~ paśuoṃkā nirodha kiyā gayā hai || 87|| isa prakāra sārathike vacana sunakara jyoṃ hī bhagavānne mṛgoṃke samūhakī ora dekhā tyoṃ hī unakā hṛdaya prāṇidayāse sarābora ho gayā | ve avadhijñānī the hī isalie rājakumāroṃkī ora dekhakara isa prakāra kahane lage ki vana hī jinakā ghara hai, vanake tṛṇa aura pānī ho jinakā bhojana-pāna hai aura jo atyanta niraparādha haiṃ aise dīna mṛgoṃkā saṃsāra meṃ phira bhī manuṣya vadha karate haiṃ | aho ! manuṣyoṃ kī nirdayatā to
1. vidhuta nartakanartana ma., ṅa. | 2. sahasārathi ma. |

raṇamukheṣu raṇārjitakortayaḥ karituraṅgaratheṣvapi nirbhayān | abhimukhānamihantumadhiṣṭhitānamimukhāḥ praharanti na hītarān ||10|| śarabhasiṃhavanadvipayūthapān prakupitān parihṛsya vidūrataḥ || mṛgaśaśān pṛthukān praharatyamūn kathamivāna pumānna vilajate ||9|| caraṇakaṇṭakavedhabhayāgaṭā vidadhate paridhānamupānahām | mṛdumṛgān mṛgayāsu punaḥ svayaṃ niśitaśastraśataḥ praharanti hi ||92|| viṣayasaukhyaphalaprasavodayaḥ prathama eṣa mṛgaughavadho'dhamaḥ | anubhave punarasya rasaprade ṣaḍasukāyanipīḍanamadhyadhi ||13|| vipularājyapadasthitimicchatā sakalasattvavadho'bhimukhīkṛtaḥ | duritabandhaphalastu vadho dhruvaṃ kaṭuphalā sthitirasya parā' yataḥ ||14|| prakṛtideśarasānubhavasthiti pracitabandhacatuṣkavaśīkṛtaḥ | bhajati durgatiṣu kramato bhraman vividhaduḥkhamayaṃ bhavabhṛdgaṇaḥ ||55|| pratibhavaṃ mayaduḥkhakhanīyutairviṣayajaiḥ kusukhairatibhāvitaḥ | naramave'pyasumānatimohito na yatate bhavaduḥkhanivṛttaye ||16|| bhavasukhāni bahirviṣayodbhavānyatimahānsyapi santatimansyapi | bhavabhūto na bhavanti hi tuṣṭaye jalanidheriva sindhuśatānyapi ||17||
dekho ||88-89|| raṇake agrabhāgameṃ jinhoṃne kīrtikā saṃcaya kiyā hai aise śūravīra manuṣya hāthī, ghoḍa़e aura ratha ādipara savāra ho nirbhayatāke sātha māraneke lie sāmane khaḍa़e hae logoṃpara hī unake sāmane jākara prahāra karate haiṃ anya logoṃpara nahīṃ ||9.0|| jo puruṣa atyadhika krodhase yukta śarabha, siṃha tathā jaṃgalī hāthiyoṃ ādiko dūrase choḍa़ dete haiṃ aura mṛga tathā kharagośa ādi kṣudra prāṇiyoṃpara prahāra karate haiṃ unheṃ lajjā kyoṃ nahīṃ ātī? ||91|| ahā ! jo śūravīra pairameṃ kāṃṭā na cubha jāye isa bhayase svayaṃ to jūtā pahanate haiṃ aura śikārake samaya komala mṛgoṃko saikaḍa़oṃ prakārake tīkṣṇa śastroṃse mārate haiṃ yaha baḍa़e āścaryakī bāta hai ||92|| yaha nindya mṛga-ramūhakā vadha prathama to viṣayasukharūpī phalako detā hai parantu jaba isakā anubhāga apanā rasa dene lagatā hai taba uttarottara chaha kāyakā vighāta sahana karanā paḍa़tā hai| bhāvārtha--hiṃsaka prāṇī chaḍa़kāyake jīvoṃmeṃ utpanna hotā hai aura vahā~ nānā jīvoṃke dvārā mārā jātā hai ||93|| yaha manuṣya cāhatā to yaha hai ki mujhe viśāla rājyakī prāpti ho para karatā hai samasta prāṇiyoṃkā vadha so yaha viruddha bāta hai kyoṃki prāṇivadhakā phala to niścaya hī pāpabandha hai aura usake phalasvarūpa kaṭuka phalako hī prāpti hotī hai rājyādika madhura phalako nahīṃ ||94|| prakṛti, pradeśa, sthiti aura anubhāga rūpa cāra prakārake bandhake vaśībhūta huā yaha prāṇiyoṃkā samūha krama-kramase durgatiyoṃmeṃ paribhramaṇa karatā huā nānā prakārake duḥkha bhogatā rahatā hai ||95|| yaha prāṇī pratyeka bhavameṃ bhaya aura duḥkhako khānase yukta viṣaya-sambandhī khoṭe sukhoṃse prabhāvita rahā hai aura āja manuṣyabhavameṃ bhī itanā adhika mohita ho rahā hai ki saṃsāra-sambandhī duḥkhako dūra karaneke lie yatna hī nahīṃ karatā ||16||
jisa prakāra saikaḍa़oṃ nadiyāṃ samudrake santoṣake lie nahīṃ haiṃ usī prakāra bāhya viṣayoṃse utpanna, santatibaddha, bahuta bhārī saṃsārasukha bhī prāṇīke santoṣake lie nahīṃ haiṃ ||97||
1. varā ma.| 2. sthitiḥ pracita ma. | 3. viṣamajaḥ ma.| 4. santatitānyapi ma. |

harivaṃśapurāṇe khacaradevanṛpāmarajanmajaṃ nṛpajayantavimānabhavodbhavam | na hi sukhaṃ' bahu sāgarajīvinaḥ samanubhūtamabhūnmama tṛptaye ||9|| katipayāhamavaṃ vata kiṃ punaḥ sulabhamapyatimānuṣamapyalam | bhavati tṛptikaraṃ mama sāṃprataṃ sukhamasāramasāratayāyuṣaḥ ||99|| ata idaṃ kṣayi tāpakaraṃ sukhaṃ viṣayajaṃ pravihāya mahodyamaḥ | kṣayavimuktamatāpajamātmajaṃ śivamukhaṃ mahatā tapasārjaye ||10|| iti tadā manasā vacasā samaṃ suparicintayati dhruvamīśvare | śaśinibhāḥ khalu pañcamakalpajāstuṣitavayaruṇārka purassarāḥ ||10|| laghu sametya natā natamaulayaḥ kṛtakarāñjalayastridaśā jaguḥ | samaya eṣa vibho bharate'dhunā tvamiha vartaya tīrthamiti prabham ||102|| prativibuddhapathaḥ svayameva sa prativiyodhakadevagiro'sya tāḥ | anuvadantyapi tāḥ punaruktatāṃ phalati cāvasare punaruktatā ||103|| laghu vimucya mṛgān mṛgabāndhavo nṛpasataiḥ praviveśa puraṃ prabhaḥ | sapadi tatra nṛpāsanabhūṣaṇaṃ nunuvuretya pureva sureśvarāḥ ||104|| tamupaveśya tataḥ snapanāsane samupanītapayaḥpayasā suraiḥ | samamiṣicya vibhūṣya surocitasraganulepanavastra vibhūṣaṇaiḥ ||105|| suhariviṣṭaravartitamīśvaraṃ haribalānvitamapasurāsurāḥ |
babhuratīva tadā paritaḥ sthitā prathamamerumivorukulācalāḥ ||106|| aurakī bāta jāne do maiṃne svayaṃ sāgaroṃ paryanta vidyādharendra, devendra aura narendrake janmameṃ rājāoṃ tathā jayanta vimānameṃ samutpanna sukhakā upabhoga kiyā hai para vaha merī tṛptike lie nahīṃ huā ||98|| yadyapi mujhe lokottara sukha sulabha hai tathāpi vaha kucha hī dina ṭhaharanevālā hai, niḥsāra hai aura merī āyu bhī asāra hai ataḥ vaha mere lie tṛpti karanevālā kaise ho sakatā hai ? ||99|| isalie maiṃ isa vināśīka evaṃ santāpakārī viṣayajanya sukhako choḍa़kara mahān udyama karatā huā atyadhika tapase avināśī, asantāpase 'utpanna ātmottha mokṣa sukhakā upārjana karatā hū~ ||100|| bhagavān usa samaya mana-vacanase isa prakārakā vicāra kara hī rahe the ki usī samaya paṃcama svargameṃ utpanna, candramāke samāna śvetavarṇa tuṣita, vahni, aruṇa, āditya ādi laukāntika deva śīghra hī ā pahuṃce aura mastaka jhukākara tathā hātha joḍa़kara nivedana karane lage ki he prabho! isa samaya bharatakṣetra meṃ tīrtha pravartānekā samaya hai isalie tīrthapravṛtta kījie||101-102|| bhagavāna svayaṃ hī mārgako jānate the isalie lokāntika devoṃke ukta vacana yadyapi punarukta bātakā hī kathana karate the tathāpi avasarapara punaruktatā bhī phalībhūta hotī hai ||103|| mṛgoṃke hitaiṣo bhagavānne śīghra hī mṛgoṃko choḍa़ diyā aura rājakumāroṃke sātha svayaṃ nagarīmeṃ praveśa kiyā| nagarīmeṃ jākara ve rājyasiṃhāsanako alaṃkṛta karane lage aura indroṃne pahaleke samāna ākara unakī stuti kī ||104|| tadanantara indroṃne unheṃ snānapīṭhapara virājamāna kara devoṃke dvārā lāye hue kṣīrodakase unakā abhiṣeka kiyā aura devoṃke yogya mālā, vilepana, vastra evaṃ ābhūṣaṇoṃse vibhūṣita kiyā ||105|| uttama siṃhāsanake ūpara virājamāna bhagavānko gherakara
1. susaṃbhavasāgarajīvitaḥ ma.| 2. pañcamasvargotpannā laukāntikadevāḥ | 3. nanṛturetya ma., rurucuretya ka. | 4. hariyugā-ma., ḍa.|

saptapaścāśaḥ sargaḥ samavādi samāpādi śaraṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ kṣaṇāt | trijagatprāṇināṃ devaḥ pākaśāsanaśāsanāt ||1|| sarvo dvāravatīloko yadubhojakulāmbudhiḥ | āruroha niriṃ bhūtyā rāmakeśavapūrvakaḥ ||3|| avalokya jinendrasya śaraṇa samavākim | bahirantaḥparaṃ prāradvismayaṃ janasāgaraḥ ||3|| yādṛśī samavasthānabhūmistīrthakatāmiha | tādṛśī śrotṛlokasya samāsena nigadyate ||4|| bhūmeḥ svabhāvabhūtāyā divyārasnipramocchitiḥ | bhūmistāvatsamucchāyā kalpabhūmiruparyataḥ ||5|| svargaśriyaṃ śriyā jetrī caturasrā sukhapradā | saikānadvādaśādyātmayojanāṃ kāladeśataḥ ||6|| uccairgandhakuṭīdeśakarṇikā padmamūrtivat' | māti bhūmiraso bāhya bhūśrīpatraparamparā ||7|| indranīlamayī bhūmirbāhyādarśatalopamā | bhūyasāmapi bhūyastvaṃ viśatāṃ vidadhāti yā ||6|| dūrādindrādayo yasyāṃ mānayanti namasyayā | mānārhāstrijagannāthaṃ sābhūrmānāṅgaṇāmidhā ||9|| mahādikṣu catasro'syā gavyūtidvayavistṛtāḥ| vīthyastanmadhyagānīyurmānapīṭhānpuraḥ pramān ||10|| svotsedhatriguṇātmīyavistarāṇyuktivistaraiḥ | sauvarṇaratnamūrtīni mānyante nṛsurāsuraiḥ ||11|| nṛsurāmānavastambhānāsthāyārcanti yatra bhūḥ | sā tvāsthānāṅgaṇābhikhyā jvalallauhitaratnabhā ||12|| madhye vīthi catasro'tra tribhaṅgā haimapīṭhikāḥ | bhāntyurodvayasocchāyāḥ vṛttāḥ krośārdhavistṛtāḥ ||13||
athānantara devoṃne indrakī ājñāse kṣaṇa-bhara meṃ tīna jagatake jīvoṃke lie śaraṇabhata samavaśaraṇakī racanā kara dī ||1|| baladeva aura kṛṣṇako ādi le yādava aura bhojavaṃśake sāgarasvarūpa samasta dvārikā nivāsī baḍa़e vaibhavake sātha girināra parvatapara caḍha़e aura bhītara-bāhara jinendra bhagavānakā samavaśaraṇa dekhakara vaha janatākā apāra sāgara parama āścaryako prāpta huā ||2-3|| tīrthaṃkaroṃkī samavasaraṇa bhūmi jaisī hotī hai usakā yahā~ saṃkṣepase śrotāoṃke lie varṇana kiyā jātā hai ||4||
samavasaraṇako divya bhūmi svābhāvika bhūmise eka hātha ūṃcī rahatī hai aura usase eka hātha ūpara kalpabhūmi hotī hai ||5|| yaha bhūmi apanī śobhāse svargalakṣmīko jītanevālī. caukora, sukhadāyī aura deśakālake anusāra bāraha yojanase lekara eka yojana taka vistāravālī hotī hai| bhāvārtha-samavasaraṇa bhūmikā utkṛṣṭa vistāra bāraha yojana aura kamase-kama vistāra eka yojana pramāṇa hotā hai ||6|| yaha bhūmi kamalake ākārako hotī hai isameṃ gandhakuṭo to kaṇikāke samāna ū~cī uṭhī hotī hai aura bāhya bhūmi kamaladalake samāna vistṛta hai ||7|| yaha indranīlamaṇise nirmita hotī hai, isakā bāhya bhāga darpaṇatalake samāna nirmala hotā hai aura praveśa karanevāle bahutase jīvoṃko eka sātha sthāna denevālī rahatī hai |8|| jisameṃ mānake yogya indra ādi deva trilokīnātha-bhagavānkī dūrase hī pūjā karate haiṃ vaha mānāṃgaṇa nāmakī bhūmi hai ||9|| isa bhūmiko cāroṃ mahādiśāoṃmeṃ do-do kośa vistṛta cāra mahāvīthiyā~ haiṃ| ye vīthiyāṃ apane madhya meṃ sthita cāra mānastambhoṃke pīṭha dhāraṇa karatī haiṃ ||10|| ye pīṭha apanī ūṃcāīse tigune cauḍa़e evaṃ suvarṇa aura ratnamayī mūrtiyoṃke dhāraka hote haiṃ tathā manuṣya, sura, asura sabhī ākara inheṃ namaskāra karate haiṃ ||11|| jahāṃ sthita hokara manuṣya aura deva, mānastambhoṃkī pūjā karate haiṃ vaha āsthānāṃgaṇā nāmakī bhūmi dedīpyamāna lāla maṇiyoṃko kāntiko dhāraṇa karatī hai ||12|| vīthiyoṃke madhyameṃ
tīna kaṭanīdāra cāra suvarṇamayī pīṭhikāe~ haiṃ jo chātī barābara ūṃcī haiṃ aura ādhā kośa cauḍa़ī . 1. padmarūpavat ka. | 2. vādya bhū ma., bāhyābhū ka. | 3. puraḥ pramāḥ ka., kha., ga., ma. | 4. madhye vāpi ma. |

cāponapīṭhikāvyāsā yojanāmyadhikocchyāḥ | śumbhitā mānavastambhāścatvāraḥ pīṭhikāsvadhi ||11|| dviṣaḍyojanadṛśyāste pālikāsyāmbujasthitāḥ : vajrasphaṭikaveḍyaṃmūlamadhyāpravigrahāḥ ||15|| dvisahasrāśrayo nānāranaraśmivimiśritāḥ | caturdisūrdhvasiddhārcāḥ ratna bhūtorupālikāḥ ||16|| pālikāmukhapamasthatapanīyasphuradghaṭāḥ | ghaṭāsyābaddhaphalakāḥ śrīmāmāmiṣavaśriyaḥ ||17|| śrīcūlāratnamācakamāsyarviśatiyojanāḥ | sābhimānamanodevamānavastaṃbhanā vabhuḥ ||18|| tataḥ sarāṃsi catvāri śummadammojamāṃjyalam | haṃsasārasaṃcakrāhvārāvaramyakakupsvalam ||19|| ato vajramayo vapro vakṣodano ghanadyutiḥ | dviguṇībhūtavistāraḥ parīyāya samantataḥ ||20|| parītya parikhāto'sthājjalapramamaṇikṣita: | jānudanāmbugambhīrā kṛṣṇasāṭīva bhūstriyāḥ ||21|| hemāmbhojararajaḥpuñjapiñcarī māvitāmmasi | svacchāyāṃ diṅmukhānyasyāṃ sāṅgarāgāṇi cātyabhān ||22|| vallīvanamato'pyantaḥ parītya sthitamityamāt | kusumāmoditā śāntaṃ śakuntālikulākulam ||23|| prākāro'ntaḥ parīyāya kanaskanakamāsvaraḥ | vijayādibṛhadraupyacaturgopuramaṇḍitaḥ ||24|| tatra dauvārikā bhaumāḥ kaṭakādivibhūṣaṇāḥ | prabhāvotsāritāyogyā mudrodbhutapāṇayaḥ ||25||
haiṃ ||13|| una pīṭhikāoṃpara cāra mānastambha suśobhita haiṃ jo pīṭhikāoṃkī cauḍa़āīse eka dhanuṣa kama cauḍa़e haiṃ aura eka yojanase kucha adhika ūṃce haiṃ ||14|| ve mānastambha bāraha yojanakī dūrīse dikhāī dete haiṃ| pālikāke agrabhāgapara jo kamala haiṃ unhīṃpara sthita haiṃ, unakā mūlabhāga hīrākā, madhyabhāga sphaṭikakā aura agrabhāga vaiḍūryamaṇikā banā huā hai ||15|| hara eka mānastambha do-do hajāra koṇoṃse sahita haiṃ-do-do hajāra pahalake haiṃ, nānā ratnoṃkī kiraṇoṃse mile hue haiṃ, unakī cāroṃ diśāoṃmeṃ ūpara siddhoṃkī pratimāeṃ virājamāna haiṃ tathā unakī ratnamayī baḍa़ī-baḍa़ī pālikāe~ haiṃ ||16|| pālikāoṃke agrabhāgapara jo kamala haiṃ unapara suvarṇake dedīpyamāna ghaṭa haiṃ, una ghaṭoṃke agrabhāgase lagī huī sīḍha़iyāṃ haiṃ, tathā una sīḍha़iyoṃpara lakṣmīdevīke abhiṣekakī śobhā dikhalāyī gayī hai ||17|| ve mānastambha lakṣmīdevīke cūḍa़āratnake samāna apanī kāntike samūhase bīsa yojana takakā kṣetra prakāśamāna karate rahate haiṃ tathā jinakā mana ahaṃkārase yukta hai aise deva aura manuṣyoṃko vahīṃ roka denevāle haiṃ ||18|| una mānastambhoṃkī cāroṃ diśāe~ haṃsa, sārasa aura cakavoṃke śabdoṃse atyanta sundara haiṃ tathā unameṃ khile hue kamaloṃse yukta cāra sarovara haiṃ ||19||
sarovaroṃke āge eka vaja़maya koṭa hai jo chātī barābara ūṃcā hai, atyanta kāntise yukta hai, ūṃcāīse dūnā cauḍa़ā hai aura cāroṃ orase ghere hue haiṃ ||20|| isa koṭako cāroṃ orase gherakara eka parikhā sthita hai jisakī bhūmi jalake samāna kāntivāle maṇiyoṃse nirmita hai, usameṃ ghuṭanoṃ pramāṇa gaharā pānī bharā hai tathā vaha pṛthivīrūpī strīkī nīlī sāḍa़īke samāna jāna paḍa़tī hai ||21|| vaha parikhā atyanta svaccha hai tathā usakā jala svarṇamaya kamaloṃkī parāgake samūhase pīlā-pīlā ho rahā hai ataeva usameṃ pratibimbita diśārūpa striyoṃke mukha aṃgarāgase sahitake samāna jāna paḍa़te haiṃ ||22|| usake āge cāroṃ orase gherakara sthita latāoṃkā vana saśobhita hai jo phaloṃke dvārā diśāoṃke anta bhāgako sagandhita kara rahā hai tathā pakṣiyoṃ aura bhramaroṃke samūhase vyāpta hai ||23|| usake āge dedīpyamāna suvarṇake samāna camakīlā, evaṃ vijaya ādi cāṃdoke baḍa़e-baḍa़e cāra gopuroṃse suśobhita koṭa, cāroṃ orase ghere hue haiṃ ||24|| una gopuroṃpara vyantara jātike deva dvārapāla haiṃ jo kaṭaka ādi ābhūṣaṇoṃse suśobhita haiṃ, apane prabhāvase ayogya

harivaṃśapurāṇe maṇitoraṇapādveṣu gopurāṇāṃ sphuratviṣām | chatracāmarabhṛṅgārapūrvāṣṭaśatakānyamān ||26|| tagopurapuro mānti prekṣāśālāstribhūmikāḥ | dvirvīithyaṃtayonūsyadvātriṃśatsurakanyakāḥ ||27|| bhātyaśokavanaṃ prācyā saptavarṇavanaṃ svapāk | pratīcyāṃ campakavanamudīcyāmāmrasadvanam ||20|| sasiddhapratimo'śokaḥ saptaparṇaśca campakam | tathaivāmratarusteṣāṃ vanānāmadhipāḥ kramāt ||29|| trikoṇāḥ maṇḍalākārāścaturasnāśca vāpikāḥ | vaneṣu rasneta vyantāśuddhasphaṭikabhūmayaḥ ||30|| viśvāḥ satoraṇāḥ lakṣyāstīrthyāstūccairvarāṇḍakaiḥ | maṇḍitāgāhamāneṣvagādhā dvikrośavistṛtāḥ ||31|| nandā nandottarānandānandavatyaminandinī | nandaghoṣetyamūrvāpyaḥ ṣaḍaśokavanasthitāḥ ||12|| vijayābhijayā jaitrī vaijayantyaparājitāḥ | jayottareti ṣaḍvāpyaḥ saptaparṇavanāśritāḥ ||33|| kumudā nalinī padmā puṣkarā vikacopalā | kamalelyapi ṣaḍvāpyaścampakākhyavane matāḥ ||34|| prabhāsā māsvatī māsā supramā bhānumālinī| svayaṃprabheti ṣaḍvāpyaḥ sahakāravanoditāḥ ||35|| udayo vijayaḥ prītiḥ khyātiśceti kramoditaiḥ | phalaiḥ pūrvādayo vāpyaḥ pūjyante tatphalārthibhiḥ ||36|| tadvāpīpuṣpasaṃdohaṃ yathoktaṃ prāpya bhāktikāḥ | āstūpaṃ kramaśobhyarcya viśanti kramakovidāḥ ||37|| antareṇodayaṃ prīti cābhitastribhuvo'dhvasu | mānti nāṭakaśālāstā hāṭakojjvalamūrtayaḥ ||38|| adhyardhakrośavistārā dvātriṃśajyotiṣāṃ striyaḥ | tadbhuvo rasnanirmāṇāḥ svacchasphaṭikabhittayaḥ ||39||
vyaktiyoṃko dūra haṭāte rahate haiṃ tathā jinake hātha mudgaroṃse uddhata hote haiṃ ||25|| dedīpyamāna kāntise yukta una gopuroṃke maṇimaya toraṇoṃkī donoṃ ora chatra, camara tathā śṛṃgāra ādi deva-kanyāeṃ nṛtya karatī haiṃ ||27|| tadanantara pūrvadiśāmeṃ aśoka vana, dakṣiṇameṃ saptaparṇa vana, paścimameṃ campaka vana aura uttarameṃ āmravana suśobhita hai ||28|| ina cāroṃ vanoṃmeṃ aśoka pratimāeṃ virājamāna rahatī haiṃ ||29|| una vanoṃmeṃ tikonī, caukonī aura golākāra aneka vāpikāeṃ haiṃ| una vāpikāoṃke taṭa ratnanirmita haiṃ tathā unakī bhūmi śuddha sphaṭikase nirmita hai| ye sabhī nahīṃ rakhanā smṛtyanupasthāna hai ||180|| binā dekhī huī jamīnameṃ malotsarga karanā, binā dekhe kisī vastuko uṭhānā, binā dekhī huī bhūmimeṃ bistara ādi bichānā, cittakī ekāgratā nahīṃ rakhanā aura vratake prati ādara nahīṃ rakhanā ye pā~ca proṣadhopavāsa vratake aticāra haiṃ ||181|| sacittāhāra, sacitta sambandhāhāra, sacitta sanmiśrāhāra, abhiṣavāhāra aura duṣpakvāhāra ye pā~ca upabhogaparibhogaparimāṇa vratake aticāra haiṃ| sacitta-harī vanaspati ādikā āhāra karanā sacittāhāra hai| sacittase sambandha rakhanevāle āhāra-pānako grahaṇa karanā sacitta sambandhāhāra hai | sacittase milī huī acitta vastukā sevana karanā sacittasanmiśrāhāra hai| gariṣṭha padārthoṃ kā sevana karanā abhiṣavāhāra hai aura adhapake athavā adhika pake āhārakā grahaṇa karanā duṣpakvāhāra hai ||182|| sacitta-nikṣepa, sacittāvaraṇa, para-vyapadeśa, mātsarya aura kālātikramatā ye pā~ca atithisaṃvibhāga vratake aticāra haiṃ | hare patte ādipara rakhakara āhāra denā sacittanikṣepa hai| hare patte ādise ḍhakā huā āhāra denā sacittāvaraṇa hai| anya dātāke dvārā deya vastukā denā paravyapadeśa hai| anya dātāoṃke guṇako nahīṃ sahana karanā mātsarya hai aura samaya ullaṃghana kara denā kālātikrama hai ||183|| jīvitāśaṃsā, maraṇāśaṃsā, nidāna, sukhānubandha aura mitrānurāga ye pā~ca sallekhanāke aticāra haiṃ| kṣapakakā dīnacitta hokara adhika samaya taka jīvita rahanekī ākāṃkṣā rakhanā jīvitāśaṃsā hai| pīḍa़āse ghabaḍa़ākara jaldī maranekī icchā karanā maraṇāśaṃsā hai| āgāmī bhogoṃkī ākāṃkṣā karanā nidāna hai| pahale bhoge hue sukhakā smaraṇa rakhanā sukhānubandha hai aura mitroṃse prema rakhanā mitrānurāga hai ||184|| samyagjñānādi guṇoṃkī vṛddhi ādi sva-parake upakārakī icchāse yogya pātrake lie prāsuka dravyakā denā tyāga kahalātā hai, isakā dūsarā nāma atisagaṃ bhī hai ||185|| jisa prakāra bhūmi ādike bhedase dhānyakī utpatti ādimeṃ bheda hotā hai usī prakāra vidhi dravya dātā aura pātrakī viśeṣatāse dānake phalameṃ bheda hotā hai ||186|| dānake

anasūyāviṣādādirasūyādiparassvayam | dāyakasya viśeṣo'pi vicitrā hi manogatiḥ ||189|| mokṣakāraṇabhūtānāṃ dānānāṃ dhāraṇe satām | tāratamyaṃ mana:śuddha viśeṣaḥ pātragocaraḥ ||19|| puṇyāsavaḥ sukhānāṃ hi heturabhyudayāvahaḥ | hetuḥ saṃsāraduḥkhānāmapuṇyāsrava iṣyate ||191|| 'mithyādarśanamātmasthaṃ hiṃsādya viratistathā | pramādaśca kapāyaśca yogo bandhasya hetavaḥ ||192|| hanmithyādarśanaṃ dvedhā nisargānyopadeśataḥ | mithyākarmodayādādyaṃ tattvāśraddhānalakṣaṇam ||193|| paropadeśapūrva tu caturdhā matabhedataḥ | kriyāvādyakriyābādivinayājñānikatvataḥ ||194|| ekānta viparītatvavinayājñānasaṃśayaḥ | nimittaḥ pañcadhā cāpi mithyādarśanamiṣyate !!195|| dviṣoḍhā'viratijñeyā pramādo'nekadhā sthitaḥ | navami! kaṣāyaistu kaṣāyāḥ pañcaviṃśatiḥ ||196|| *catvāraḥ syurmanoyogā vāgyogāśca tathaiva te | kāyayogāstu pañcāpi matā yogāstrayodaśa ||197||
deya dravya meṃ bheda honese dānake phalameṃ bho bheda hotā hai ||188|| koī dātā to īrṣyā, viṣāda ādi durguṇoṃse rahita hotā hai aura koī dātā īṣyā ādi durguṇoṃse yukta hotā hai| yahī dātākī viśeṣatā hai| yathārthameṃ manako gati vicitra hotī hai ||189|| mokṣake kāraṇabhūta dānoṃke grahaṇa karanemeṃ satpuruṣoṃ ke manakī śaddhikā jo tāratamya-hīnādhikatā hai vaha pātrakī viśeṣatā hai||19|| puṇyāsrava aneka kalyāṇoṃko prāpti karānevālā honese sukhoṃkā kāraṇa kahā jātā hai aura pāpāsrava saṃsārake duḥkhoṃkā kāraṇa mānā jātā hai ||19|| isa prakāra āsrava tattvakā varṇana honeke bāda bhagavānkī divya dhvanimeṃ bandha tattvakā varṇana prārambha huā|
ātmapariṇāmoṃmeṃ sthita mithyādarśana, hiṃsā ādi avirati, pramāda, kaṣāya aura yoga ye bandhake kāraṇa haiṃ ||192|| inameṃ mithyādarśana, nisargaja ( agṛhīta ) aura anyopadeśaja (gahīta ) ke bhedase do prakārakā hai| mithyātvakake udayase jo tattvakā aśraddhāna hotā hai vaha nisargaja mithyādarśana hai ||193|| aura paropadeśapūrvaka honevāle atattva śraddhānako anyopadeśaja mithyādarśana kahate haiṃ| isake kriyāvādī, akriyāvādī, vainayika aura ajñānīke bhedase cāra bheda haiṃ ||194| inake sivāya ekānta, viparīta, vinaya, ajñāna aura saṃśaya ina nimittoṃkī apekṣā mithyādarśana pāṃca prakārakā bhī mānā jātā hai| vastu aneka dharmātmaka hai parantu use eka dharmarūpa ho śraddhāna karanā ekānta mithyādarśana hai, jaise vastu nitya hī hai athavā anitya hī hai| vastukā jaisā svarūpa hai usase viparīta śraddhāna karanā so viparīta mithyādarśana hai jaise hiṃsāmeṃ dharma mānanā, sagranthaveṣase mokṣa mānanā ādi| deva-adeva, aura tattva atattvakā viveka na rakhakara sabako ekasā mānanā tathā sabakī bhakti karanā vainayika mithyādarśana hai| hitāhitako parīkṣā-rahita ajñānamūlaka rūḍhivaśa śraddhāna karanā so ajñāna mithyādarśana hai aura samyagdarśana samyagjñāna tathā samyakcāritra mokṣakā mārga hai yā nahīṃ ? ahiṃsāmeṃ dharma hai yā hiṃsāmeṃ | isa prakāra sandeha rūpa śraddhāna karanā saṃśaya mithyādarśana hai ||195|| pā~ca sthāvara aura trasa ina chaha kāyake jīvoṃkī hiṃsākā tyāga nahīṃ karanā, tathā pāṃca indriya aura manako vaśa nahīṃ karanā yaha bāraha prakārakī avirati hai| pramāda aneka prakārakā hai aura nau nokaṣāyoṃko sātha milākara anantānubandho krodha, māna, māyā, lobha ādike bhedase kaṣāyake paccīsa bheda haiṃ ||196|| satyamanoyoga, asatyamanoyoga, ubhayamanoyoga aura anubhayamanoyogake bhedase manoyoga cāra prakārake haiṃ| satyavacanayoga, asatyavacanayoga, ubhayavacanayoga

aṣṭapañcāśaḥ sargaḥ samastavyastarūpāstu pañcaite bandhahetavaḥ | mithyādṛṣṭerhi pañcovaṃ catvārastriṣu paścimāḥ ||19|| virasyaviratimiśrāḥ pramādādyāstrayaḥ pare | saṃyatāsaṃyatasyoktāḥ karmabandhasya hetavaḥ ||199|| pramattasaṃyatasyāpi yogāntātraya eva te | tata ūvaṃ caturṇā tu kaṣāyāyogasaṃgatāḥ ||20|| śāntakṣīṇakaṣāyau tau sayogakevalī tathā | bandhakā yogatanmātrādayogo naiva bandhakaḥ ||20|| kaṣāyakaluṣo hyātmā karmaṇo yogyapudgalān | pratikṣaṇamupādatte sa bandho nekadhā mataḥ ||20|| prakṛtiśca sthitiścāpi sa bandho'nubhavastataḥ | pradeśabandhabhedena cāturvidhyaṃ prapadyate ||203|| prakṛtiḥ syātsvabhāvo'tra nimbādestiktatādivat | karmaṇāmiha sarveṣāṃ yathāsvaṃ niyatā sthitā | 204|| ajñānaṃ prakṛtijñayā jñānāvaraṇa karmaṇa: | dṛśyārthādarśanaṃ dṛśyā darśanāvaraṇasya sā ||205|| sadasallakṣaṇasyāpi vedanīyasya karmaṇaḥ | saṃvedanaṃ vidāṃ vedyaṃ prakṛtiḥ sukha-duḥkhayoḥ ||206|| dṛṣṭādarśanamohasya tattvāśraddhānameva sā | tathā cāritramohasya mahato'saṃyamaḥ sadā ||207|| prakṛtiḥ pratipannā tu bhavadhāraṇamāyuṣaḥ | devanārakanāmādikaraṇaṃ nāmakarmaṇaḥ ||20||

___kaṣāyase kaluṣita jīva pratyeka kṣaṇa karmake yogya pudgaloṃko grahaṇa karatā hai| vahī bandha kahalātā hai| yaha bandha aneka prakārakā mānā gayā hai ||202|| sāmānyarūpase bandha prakṛti, sthiti, anubhāga aura pradeśake bhedase cāra bhedoṃko prāpta hotā hai ||203|| prakṛtikā artha svabhāva hotā hai| jisa prakāra nīma ādikī prakṛti tiktatā ādi hai usī prakāra samasta karmoko apanī-apanī prakṛti niyatarūpase sthita hai ||204|| jaise jñānāvaraṇa karmakī prakṛti ajñāna arthāt padārthakā jñāna nahīṃ hone denā| darśanāvaraṇa karmakī prakṛti padārthoṃkā adarśana arthāt darśana nahīṃ hone denā hai ||205|| sātā, asātāvedanīya karmako prakṛti jñānī manuṣyoṃko kramase sukha aura duḥkhakā vedana karānā hai ||206|| darśanamohakī prakṛti tattvakā aśraddhāna karānā hai tathā atiśaya mahāna cāritramoha karmakī prakṛti sadā asaṃyama utpanna karanā hai ||207|| āyakarmako prakṛti bhavadhāraṇa karanā hai| nāmakarmako prakṛti jīvameṃ deva, nārakī ādi saṃjñāeṃ utpanna karanā hai ||208|| 1. sakaṣāyatvājjīvaḥ karmaṇo yogyān pudgalānādatte sa bandhaḥ ||2|| ta. sū. a. 8| 2. prakṛtisthityanubhavapradeśāstadvidhayaḥ ||3|| ta. sū. a.8|

___ jisa prakāra bakarī, gāya tathā bhaiṃsa ādike dūdha apane-apane svabhāvase hī mādhurya guṇase cyuta nahīṃ hote haiṃ usī prakāra kama bhī apanī-apanī prakṛtise cyuta nahīṃ hote haiṃ ||211|||
___jisa prakāra dūdhameṃ rasaviśeṣa, tīvra athavā manda ādi bhāvase rahatā hai usī prakāra karmarūpa pudgalameṃ bhī sāmarthya-viśeṣa tīvra athavā manda ādi bhāvase rahatā hai| yahī anubhavabandha mānā gayā hai ||212|| ātmāke karmarūpa pariṇata pudgala skandhoṃke samūhameṃ paramāṇuke pramāṇase kalpita paricchedoṃ-khaṇḍoṃkī jo saṃkhyā hai vaha pradeśabandha kahalātā hai ||213|| prakṛti aura pradeśabandha yogake nimittase hote haiṃ tathā sthiti aura anubhavabandha kaṣāyake nimittase māne gaye haiṃ ||214||

pañcadhā jñānāvaraṇaṃ navadhā darśanāvṛtiḥ | dvidhā tu vedanīyaṃ syānmoho'ṣṭāviṃśatisthitiḥ ||221|| āyuścaturvidhaṃ nāma dvicatvāriṃśadīritam | dvividhaṃ gotramudgītamantarāyastu pañcadhā ||222|| matiśrutāvadhijñānamanaḥparyayakevalaiḥ| āvṛtyairāvṛtīḥ pañca jhuttaraprakṛtīrviduḥ ||223|| dravyārthādeśataḥ 'śaktarmanāparyayakevalī| abhavyo'pyasti yattatsthaṃ jñānāvaraṇapañcakam ||224|| vyaktiyogyatvasadbhāvāpekṣā bhavyasya mavyatā | kaivalyavyaktya yogyatvādamavyasya rāmavyatā ||225|| cakṣuṣo'cakṣuṣo dṛṣṭeravadheḥ kevalasya ca | catvāryāvaraṇānyevaṃ nidrādyaiḥ pañcamiva ||226|| madakhedavinodārthaḥ svāpo nidrādhikasvataḥ | upayupari tadavṛttinidrānidrāmidhīyate ||227||
prakārakā mūla prakṛtibandha kahā gayā hai, aba isake āge uttara prakṛtiyoṃke bheda kahe jāte haiṃ ||220||
jñānāvaraṇa pā~ca prakārakā hai, darśanāvaraṇa nau prakārakā hai, vedanīya do prakārakā hai, mohanīya aṭṭhāīsa prakārakā hai, āyu cāra prakārakā hai, nāma bayālīsa prakārakā hai, gotra do prakārakā kahā gayā hai aura antarāya pā~ca prakārakā hai ||221-222|| matijñāna, śrutajñāna, avadhijñāna, manaḥparyayajñāna aura kevalajñāna ye pāṃca āvaraṇa karane yogya guṇa haiṃ| inheṃ āvaraṇa karanevāle matijñānāvaraṇa, śrutajñānāvaraṇa, avadhijñānāvaraṇa, manaḥparyayajñānāvaraṇa aura kevalajñānāvaraṇa ye pā~ca jñānāvaraṇa karmako uttara prakṛtiyā~ haiṃ ||223|| dravyāthikanayakī apekṣā śaktirūpase abhavya jīva bhī manaḥparyaya aura kevalajñānase yukta hai, ataḥ usake bhī jñānāvaraṇake pāṃcoṃ bheda sthita haiṃ ||224||
bhavya jīvakī bhavyatā ukta guṇoṃke prakaṭa honekī yogyatāke sadbhāvakī apekṣā rakhatī hai aura abhavya jīvakī abhavyatā kevalajñāna tathā manaḥparyayajñānake prakaṭa honekī yogyatā na honekī apekṣāse hai| bhāvārtha-kisīne praśna kiyā thā ki jaba bhavya aura abhavya donoṃke hī manaḥparyayajñāna aura kevalajñānakī śakti vidyamāna hai taba inameṃ bhavyatā aura abhavyatākā bheda kaise huā? isakā uttara granthakartāne diyā hai ki bhavya jīvake una śaktiyoṃkī prakaṭatā ho jātī hai aura abhadhya jīvake unakī prakaṭatā nahīṃ hotī ||225||
cakṣurdaśanāvaraṇa, acakṣudarśanāvaraṇa, avadhidarśanāvaraṇa aura kevaladarśanāvaraṇa ye cāra āvaraṇa tathā nidrā ādika pā~ca arthāt nidrā, nidrānidrā, pracalā, pracalāpracalā aura styānagṛddhi ye pāṃca nidrāeṃ saba milākara darśanāvaraṇa karmakī nau uttara prakṛtiyāṃ haiṃ| jo jīvake cakṣurdaśanacakṣuindriyase honevāle sāmānya avalokanako prakaṭa na hone de vaha cakṣurdarśanāvaraṇa hai | jo acakṣurdarśana-cakṣuko choḍa़kara anya indriyoṃ tathā manase honevāle sāmānya avalokanako prakaṭa na hone de vaha acakṣurdarśanāvaraṇa hai | jo avadhidarśana-avadhijñānake pahale prakaṭa honevāle sāmānya avalokanako na hone de yaha avadhidarśanāvaraṇa hai aura jo kevaladarśana-kevalajñānake sātha honevāle sāmānyāvalokanako na hone de vaha kevaladarśanāvaraṇa hai ||226|| mada tathā khedako dūra karaneke lie sonā nidrā kahalātī hai | ūpara-ūpara adhika rūpase nidrākā ānā nidrānidrā kahī jātī
1. śaktirmana: ma., kha., ṅa. | 2. abhavyāpyasti ka., ṅa| atra codyate-abhavyasya manaḥparyayajñānaśaktiḥ kevalajñānaśaktiśca syādvā na vā ? yadi syāt tasyābhavyatvābhāvaḥ | atha nāsti tatrāvaraṇadvayakalpanā vyarthati ? ucyate-ādeśavacanānna doṣaḥ | dravyārthādeśānmanaḥparyayakevalajñānaśaktisaṃbhavaḥ| paryāyārthādeśāttacchaktyabhāvaḥ| yadyevaṃ bhavyābhavyavikalpo nopapadyate; ubhayatra tacchaktisadbhāvāt | na śaktibhāvābhāvāpekṣayā bhavyābhavyavikalpa ityucyate | kutastahi ? vyaktisadbhāvāsadbhāvāpekṣayā | sa. si. a. 8 sūtra 6 |

harivaṃśapurāṇe
śramādipramavātmānaṃ pracalā pracalayatyalam | sā puna: punarāvṛttā pracalāpracalābhidhā ||228|| styānagṛddhiryayāstyāne svapne gṛdhyati dīpyate | āsmā yadudayādraudraṃ bahukarma karoti sā ||229|| śārīraṃ mānasaṃ saukhyaṃ duḥkhaṃ codayate yayoḥ | syātāṃ te vedanīye staḥ sātāsāte yathākamam ||23|| samyaktvaṃ cāpi mithyātvaṃ samyagmithyātvamityadaḥ | dṛśyaṃ darśanamohasya hyattaraṃ prakṛtitrikam ||23|| śubhātmapariṇāmena niruddhasvarase sthite | mithyātve śraddadhānasya samyaktvaprakṛtirbhavet ||232|| mithyātve tvardhasaṃśuddha kodrave madaśaktivat | śuddhāśuddhātmako bhāvaḥ samyagmithyātvamucyate ||233|| dvedhā cāritramohastu nokaṣāyakaṣāyataḥ | navadhā nokaṣāyo'tra kaṣāyāḥ ṣoḍaśoditaḥ ||234|| udayādyasya hāsāvirbhāvo hāsyaṃ tadutsukaḥ | yasyodayādatiḥ sā syādaratista dviparyayaḥ ||235|| śocanaṃ yadvipākātsa śoka udvega kṛdbhayam | svadoṣagopanaṃ yasya jugupsā sā jugupsitā ||23|| bhāvāṃstraiṇānyato yāti sa strīvedo'tigarhitaḥ | punnapuṃsakavedī staḥ pauṃsnānnāpuṃsakāt yataḥ ||237||
hai ||227|| thakāvaṭa ādise utpanna honevālī jo nidrā jīvako baiṭhe-baiṭhe hī atyadhika capala kara deve vaha pracalā hai| pracalā jaba bāra-bāra adhika rūpameṃ ātī hai taba pracalāpracalā kahalāne lagatī hai ||228|| jisake dvārā ātmā styāna arthāt sote samaya gṛddhatā karane lage-kisī karmameṃ saceṣṭa ho jāve aura jisake udayase yaha jīva atyadhika kaṭhina kāma kara le vaha styānagṛddhi hai| yaha pā~ca prakārako nidrā, darśanāvaraṇa karmake udayase ātī hai aura ina nidrāoṃke mādhyamase darśanāvaraṇa karma ātmāke darśanaguṇako ghātatā hai ||222|| vedanīya karmake do bheda haiṃ-sātāvedanīya aura asātāvedanīya| jinake udayase śārīrika aura mānasika sukha-duḥkha utpanna hote haiṃ ve yathākramase sātāvedanīya aura asātavedanīya kahalāte haiṃ ||230||
mohanīya karmake mūlameṃ do bheda haiṃ-1. darśanamohanīya, 2. cāritramohanīya| inameṃ se darśanamohanīyako samyaktva, mithyātva aura samyamithyātva ye tīna uttara prakṛtiyā~ haiṃ ||231|| ātmāke śubha pariṇāmoṃse jaba mithyātvaprakṛtikā svarasa-phala deneko śakti ruka jātī hai taba śraddhāna karanevāle jīvake samyaktva prakṛtikā udaya hotā hai| isa prakṛtike udayase ātmākā śraddhānaguṇa tirohita nahīṃ hotā kintu cala, mala, agāḍha़ doṣoṃse dūṣita ho jātā hai ||232|| mithyātva prakṛtike udayase śraddhāna guṇa vikṛta ho jātā hai aura atattva śraddhānarūpī pariṇati ho jātī hai| ardha śuddha kodoṃkī madaśaktike samāna mithyātva prakṛtike arddha śuddha honepara jīvakā jo śuddha aura aśuddha bhāva eka sātha prakaṭa hotā hai vaha samyamithyātva kahalātā hai| samyamithyātva prakṛtike udayase jīvake pariṇāma dahī aura guḍa़ke miśrita svādake samāna śraddhāna aura aśraddhāna rūpa hote haiṃ ||233||
nokaṣāya aura kaṣāyake bhedase cāritramohake do bheda haiṃ| inameṃ nokaṣāyake nau aura kaṣāyake solaha bheda kahe gaye haiṃ ||234|| hāsya, rati, arati, śoka, bhaya, jugupsā, strīveda, puruṣaveda aura napuṃsaka veda ye nau nokaṣāyake bheda haiṃ| inake lakṣaṇa isa prakāra haiṃ-jisake udayase utsuka hotā huā hāsya prakaṭa ho vaha hāsyakama hai| jisake udayase rati-prīti utpanna ho vaha rati karma hai| jisake udayase arati-aprīti utpanna ho vaha arati hai| jisake udayase śoka ho vaha śoka hai | jo udvega-bhaya utpanna karanevālā hai vaha bhaya hai| jisake udayase apane doṣa chipāne meṃ pravṛtti ho vaha jugupsā hai| jisake udayase yaha jīva strīke bhāvako arthāt puruṣase ramane kī icchāko prāpta hotā hai vaha strīveda hai| jisake udayase puruṣake bhāvako arthāt strīse ramanekī icchāko prāpta hotā hai vaha puruṣaveda hai| aura jisake udayase napuṃsakake bhāvako-arthāt strī-puruṣa donoṃse ramanekī icchāko prāpta hotā hai vaha napuṃsaka veda hai ||235-237||

kaṣāyāḥ krodhamānau ca māyālomau ca ghātakāḥ | samyaktvasya savṛttasya tatrānantānubandhinaḥ || 238 || yadīyodayato hyātmā pratyākhyātuṃ na śaknuyāt | hiṃsādīnyudayāṃste syurapratyākhyānasaṃjñakāḥ 4 23 || yadīyodayato jīvaḥ saṃyamaṃ na prapadyate | te krodhamānamāyāyāḥ pratyākhyāna viniḥśrutāḥ ||241 || yadīyodayato vṛttaṃ yathākhyātaṃ na jāyate | jvalantaḥ saṃyamenāmā khyātāḥ 'saṃjvalanāstu te || 245|| nārakaṃ narakodbhūtaṃ tairyagyonaṃ ca mānuṣam | daivaṃ cāyurbhavetteṣu caturvidhamitīritam || 242 || yadīyodayato janturbhavāntaramiyati sā | gatiścaturvidhā devanarakādivibhedataḥ || 243 || ātmano narakādiśvaṃ yannimittaṃ prajāyate | tatsyānnarakagatyādi gatināma caturvidham || 244|| gatikīkṛtārthā sā sāmyenābhyabhicāriṇā | jātistasyā nimittaṃ tu jātināmātra pañcadhā ||245|| ekendriyādikāṃ jātimudayādyasya jantavaḥ | prayāntyendriyādyetajjātināmābhidhīyate || 246 || śarīrapañcakasyāsya nivṛttiryasya codayāt | audārikaśarīrādi nāma pañcavidhaṃ tu tat || 245|| aṅgopāṅgavivekaḥ syāccharīrāṇāṃ yatastu tat | tridhāṅgopāṅganāmākhya maudārikapurassaram || 248 || cakṣurādīndriyasthānapramāṇe jātyapekṣayā | ye nirmāpayataste sto nāmnā nirmāṇanāmanī || 249 ||

nāraka, tairyagyona, mānuṣa aura devake bhedase āyu karma cāra prakārakā kahā gayā hai | āyu karmake udayase yaha jīva nārakādi paryāyoṃmeṃ utpanna hotā hai
|| 242 ||
jisake udayase jīva bhavāntarako prāpta hotā hai vaha gati nāma karma hai | deva tathā nārakādike bhedase gati nāma kamaṃ cāra prakārakā hai || 243|| jisake nimittase ātmāmeṃ narakādi paryāya prakaṭa hotī hai vaha cāra prakārakā narakādi nāma karma hai || 244 || una narakādi gatiyoṃ meṃ jo avirodhī samāna dharmase ātmāko eka rūpa karanevālī avasthā hai use jāti kahate haiṃ | usa jātikā jo nimitta hai vaha jāti nāma karma kahā jātā hai isake ekendriya jāti ādi pāṃca bheda haiṃ || 245|| jisake udayase jova ekendriyādi jātiko prāpta hote haiṃ vaha ekendriyādi jāti nāma karma kahalātā hai ||246||
jisake udayase audārika ādi pāṃca śarīroṃkī racanā hotī hai vaha audārika śarīrādi pā~ca prakārakā śarīra nāma kama hai || 247 || jisake udayase śarīroṃmeṃ aṃgopāṃgakā - viveka hotā hai vaha audārika śarīrāṃgopāṃgako ādi lekara tīna prakārakā aṃgopāṃga nāma karma hai || 248 || jo jātiko apekṣā cakṣu ādi indriyoṃke sthāna aura pramāṇakā nirmāṇa karate haiṃ ve

karmodayavaśopāttapudgalānyonyabandhanam | śarīreṣūdayāthasya mabebandhananāma tat ||250|| yasyodayāccharīrāṇāṃ nīrandhrānyonyasaṃhatiḥ | saṃghātanāma tannāmnā saṃghātānāmanasyayāt ||251|| śarīrākṛti nirvṛttiryato bhavati dehinām | saṃsthānanāma tat ṣoḍhā saṃsthānakaraṇārthataḥ ||252|| samādicaturasroto nyagrodhaparimaṇḍalam | svātisaṃsthānanāmāpi kubjavāmanahuṇḍakam ||253|| yato bhavati suśliṣṭamasthisaṃdhānabandhanam | tassaṃhanananāmāpi nāmnā ṣoḍhā vibhajyate ||254|| tadvajrarṣamanārācavajranārācakolakāḥ | sanārācārdhanāgacāḥ sāsaṃprāptaspāṭikāḥ ||255|| sparśanasyodayādyasya prādurbhāvena bhūyate | sparśanāma mavatyetatpravimaktamivāṣṭadhā ||256|| khyātaṃ karkaśanāmaikaṃ mṛdunāma tathāparam | gurunāma laghusnigdharūkṣaśītoṣṇanāma ca ||257||

ṣaṣṭitamaḥ sargaḥ
atha dharmakathāchede praṇipatya jineśvaram | kṛtāñjalirapṛcchat sā devakī vinayaṃ śritā ||1|| bhagavan mavane me'dya jātarūpamanoharam | muniyugmaṃ praviśya 'triruparyupari bhuktavān ||2|| bhagavan bhuktivelāyāmekasyāmekabhuktaye | bahukṛtvo gṛhaṃ vekaṃ yatayaḥ praviśanti kim ||3|| athātiśayarūpatvādhatiyugmatrayaṃ mayā | bhrāntyā nālakṣi me sneho dehajeṣviva teṣvabhūt ||4|| ityukte'kathayannāthastanayāste ṣaḍapyamī | yugmatrayatayā sūtā mavasyā kṛṣṇapūrvajāḥ ||5|| devena rakṣitāḥ kaṃsāt sudṛṣṭayalakayoḥ punaḥ | sutatvena ca vṛddhāste pure bhadilanāmani ||6|| dharma śrutvā samaṃ sarve mama śiṣyatvamāgatāḥ | kṛtvā karmakṣayaṃ siddhiṃ yāsyantyatraiva janmani ||7|| sneho'patyakṛto'mīṣu mavatyāḥ samabhūdataḥ | dharmacāriṣu sarveṣu snehaḥ kimuta sūnuṣu ||8|| praṇanāma tatastuṣṭā devakī dehajānmunīn | yādavāśca samastāste kṛṣṇādhāstuṣṭuvurnatāḥ ||9|| praṇamyātmamavān pṛṣṭo jinendraḥ satyamāmayā | yadulokāmarādhyakṣaṃ divyacakṣurjagāviti ||10|| prāgmadrilapure'trābhūnmarīcikapilāsutaḥ | kāvyakṛtpaṇḍitaṃmanyo vipro muṇḍaśalāyanaḥ ||11||
athānantara dharmakathā pūrṇa honepara vinayako dhāraṇa karanevālī devakīne hātha joḍa़kara bhagavānko namaskāra kiyā aura usake bāda yaha pūchā ki bhagavan ! āja suvarṇake samāna sundara do muniyoṃkā yugala mere bhavanameṃ tīna bāra āyā aura phira-phirase usane, tīna bāra āhāra liyā| he prabho! jaba maniyoṃke bhojanakī belā eka hai aura eka hī bāra ve bhojana karate haiṃ taba mani eka hī gharameṃ aneka bāra kyoṃ praveśa karate haiṃ ? ||1-3|| athavā yaha bhī ho sakatā hai ki vaha tīna muniyoṃkā yugala ho aura atyanta sadaśa rūpa honeke kāraṇa maiṃ bhrāntivaśa unheṃ dekha nahīṃ sakī hū~| parantu itanā avaśya hai ki merā una sabameṃ putroṃke samāna sneha utpanna huā thā ||4||
devakīke isa prakāra kahanepara bhagavānne kahā ki ye chahoṃ muni tere putra haiṃ aura kṛṣṇake pahale tīna yugalake rūpameṃ tūne inheṃ utpanna kiyā thā ||5|| devane kaṃsase inako rakṣā kī aura bhadrilapurameṃ sudṛṣṭi seṭha tathā alakā seṭhānīke yahāṃ putrarūpase inakā lālana-pālana huā ||6|| dharma śravaṇa kara ye sabake saba eka sātha merī śiṣyatāko prāpta ho gaye-muni ho gaye aura karmoṃkā kṣaya kara isī janmameṃ siddhiko prāpta hoṃge ||7|| terā ina sabameṃ jo sneha huā thā vaha apatyakṛta thāputra honese kiyā gayā thā so ṭhīka hī hai kyoṃki samasta dharmātmā janoṃmeṃ prema hotā hai phira jo putra hokara dharmātmā haiṃ unakā to kahanā hī kyā hai ? ||8|| tadanantara devakīne santuṣṭa hokara una putrarūpa muniyoṃko namaskāra kiyā tathā kṛṣṇa ādi samasta yādavoṃne namrībhūta hokara unakī stuti kī ||9||
tatpaścāt kṛṣṇakī paṭṭarānī satyabhāmāne bhagavānko praṇāma kara apane pūrvabhava pūche | uttarameṃ divya netra-kevalajñānake dhāraka bhagavān yādavoṃ aura devoṃke samakṣa isa prakāra usake pūrvabhava kahane lage ||10||
pahale bhadrilapura nagarameṃ maṇḍaśalāyana nāmakā eka brāhmaṇa rahatā thā jo marīci brāhmaṇa aura kapilā brāhmaṇīkā putra thā, kāvyako racanāmeṃ nipuṇa thā aura apane-āpako paṇḍita mānatā 1. vāratrayam | 2. gṛhetvekam ma. |

harivaṃśapurāṇe rukmiṇyāpi tataḥ pṛṣṭaḥ pūrvajanmāni sarvavit | avocaditi 'loke'sau praṇidhānapare sthite ||25|| atraiva bharatakṣetre viṣaye magadhābhidhe | brāhmaṇī somadevasya lakṣmīgrāme'grajanmanaḥ ||26|| āsīlakṣmīmatī nāmnā lakṣmīriva sulakṣaṇā | rūpābhimānato mūḍhā pūjyānna pratimanyate ||27|| dhṛtaprasādhanā vaktraṃ kadāciñcittahāriṇī | netrahāriṇi candrābhe paśyantī maṇidarpaṇe ||28|| samādhiguptanāmānaṃ tapasātikṛśīkṛtam | sādhaṃ mikṣāgataṃ dṛṣṭvā nininda vicikitsitā ||29|| munenindātipāpena saptāhābhyantare ca sā | klinnodumbarakuṣṭhena praviśyāgnimagānmṛtim ||30|| sahārtā sā kharī bhūtvā mṛtvā lavaṇabhārataḥ | śūkarī mānadoṣeṇa jātā rājagṛhe pure ||31|| varākī māritā mṛtvā goṣṭe'jāyata kukkurī | goṣṭhāgatena sā dagdhā paruṣeṇa davāgninā ||32|| tripadākhyasya maṇḍūkyāṃ maṇḍakagrāmavāsinaḥ | matsyabandhasya jātā sā duhitā pūtigandhikā ||33|| mātrā tyaktā svapāpena pitāmadyā pravardhitā | niṣkuṭe vaṭavṛkṣasya jālenācchādayanmunim ||34|| bodhitāvadhinetreṇa prabhāte karuṇāvatā | dharma samādhiguptena proktapūrvamavāgrahīt ||35|| puraṃ sopārakaṃ yātā tatrāryāḥ samupāsya sā | yayau rājagṛhaṃ tāmi: kurvāṇācāmlavardhanam ||36||

isī bharata kṣetrake magadha deśameṃ eka lakṣmī nāmakā grāma hai| usameṃ eka somadeva nāmakā brāhmaṇa rahatā thā| usakī lakṣmīmatī nāmakī brāhmaṇī thī jo ki lakṣmīke samāna uttama lakṣaṇoṃkī dhāraka thī aura apane rūpake abhimānase mūḍha़ hokara pūjya janoṃko bhī kucha nahīṃ samajhatī thī ||26-27|| cittako haraṇa karanevālī vaha lakṣmīmatī. eka dina ābhaṣaṇa dhāraṇa kara netroṃ priya tathā candramāke samāna ābhāvāle maṇimaya darpaṇameṃ apanā mukha dekha rahī thī usī samaya tapase atiśaya kṛśa samādhigupta nāmake muni bhikṣāke lie āye| unheṃ dekha glāniyukta ho usane unakī nindā ko ||28-29|| muninindāke bahuta bhārī pāpase vaha sāta dinake bhītara hī udumbara kuṣṭhase pīḍa़ita ho gayī aura itanī adhika pīḍa़ita huī ki vaha agnimeṃ praveśa kara mara gayo | 30 || ārtadhyānake sātha marakara vaha gadhī huī| usapara namaka lādā jātā thā| so usake bhārase marakara vaha māna kaṣāyake doṣase rājagṛha nagarameṃ śūkarī huī ||31|| usa becārīko bhī logoṃne māra diyā jisase marakara vaha goṣṭha-gāyoṃke rahaneke sthānameṃ kuttī huī| eka dina usa goṣṭhameṃ bhayaṃkara dāvāgni laga gayī jisase vaha kuttī usī dāvāgnimeṃ jala gayī ||32|| aura marakara maṇḍūkagrāmameṃ rahanevāle tripada nāmaka dhīvarakī maṇḍūkī nāmaka strīse pūtigandhikā nāmaka putrī huī ||33|| apane pāpake udayase mātāne use choḍa़ diyā arthāt usakī mātā mara gayī jisase dādone usakā pālana-poṣaṇa kiyā| eka dina isake gharake upavanameṃ vahī samādhigupta munirāja vihāra karate hue āye aura vaṭavṛkṣake nīce virājamāna ho gaye| rātrike samaya śītakī adhikatā dekha pūtigandhāne una munirājako jālase ḍhaka diyā || 34 || munirāja avadhijñānarūpī netrake dhāraka the isalie unheṃ usakī daśā dekha dayā ā gayī| unhoṃne use samajhāyā aura usake pūrva bhava sunāye jisase usane dharma dhāraṇa kara liyā || 35 || eka bāra vaha pūtigandhā sopāraka nagara gayī| vahā~ āryikāoṃkī upāsanā kara vaha unhīṃke sātha ācāmla nāmakā tapa karatī huī

atra śiddhaśilāṃ vandyāṃ vanditvā ca sthitā satī | kṛtvā nīḻaguhāyāṃ sā satī sallekhanāṃ mṛtā ||37|| acyutendramahādevī nāmnā gaganavallamā | vallabhāmavadutkṛṣṭastrīsthitistatra devyasau ||38|| tato'vatīrya bhīṣmasya śrīmatyāṃ vaṃ sutābhavaḥ | nagare kuṇḍinābhikhye rukmiṇī rukmiṇaḥ svasā ||39|| kṛtvā cātra bhave bhavye pravrajyāṃ vibudhottamaḥ | cyutvā tapaśca kṛtvātra nairgranthyaṃ mokṣyase dhruvam ||40|| bhīṣmā bhīṣmasaṃsārabhīrurākarṇya sā bhavān | jñātvāsannasvamokṣātiṃ praṇanāma prabhu mudā || 41|| jāmbavatyā jinaḥ pṛṣṭastasyāḥ prāha purābhavam | saṃsāramayabhītānāṃ sannidhau nikhilāṅginām ||42|| sutāsīt puṣkalāvatyā jambūdvīpasya devilāt | nagayāṃ vītaśokāyāṃ devamatyāṃ yaśasvinī || 43 || gṛhapatyātmajāyāsa "gṛhapasya śarīrajā | dattā sumitrasaṃjñāya mṛte tatra suduḥkhitā ||44|| jaina jinadevena jinadharmopadeśinā | śāmyamānā na samyaktvaṃ lebhe mohodayādasau ||45|| dānopavāsavidhinā laukikena mṛtā satī | nandane vyantarasyāsīt sā bhāryā merunandanā || 46|| triṃśadvarṣasahasrāṇi labdhāśītiyutāni tat | bhogaṃ bhuktvā ciraṃ kālaṃ saṃsāraṃ saṃsasāra sā ||47|| gistratakṣetre pure vijayapūrvake | bandhuṣeṇasya bhūpasya bandhumatyāḥ sutābhavat ||48|| nāmnā bandhuyaśāḥ kanyā śromatyā proṣadhavratam | kanyayā jinadevasya pratipadya mṛtābhavat || 49 || dhanadasya priyā patnī nāmataḥ sā svayaṃprabhā | cyutvātaḥ puṇḍarīkiṇyāṃ jambūdvīpe pṛthau puri || 50 ||
rājagṛha nagara calo gayo ||36|| vahā~ vandanā karane yogya jo siddhaśilā thī usakī vandanā kara vahīṃ nīlaguhā meṃ rahane lagī aura sallekhanā dhāraṇa kara mṛtyuko prāpta huī ||37|| marakara vaha solahaveṃ svargameṃ acyutendrakī gaganavallabhā nāmakī atiśaya priya mahādevī huī | solahaveṃ svarga meṃ striyoṃkī utkṛṣṭa sthiti pacapana palyakī hai so vaha usī utkṛṣṭa sthitikī dhāraka huī thī ||38|| vahā~ se caya kara tū kuṇḍinapura meṃ rājā bhīṣmakī śrīmatī rānīse rukmīkī bahana rukmiṇī nāmakī putrī huī hai ||39|| isa uttama paryāya meṃ tū dīkṣā dhāraṇa kara uttama deva hogī aura vahāṃse cyuta ho nirgrantha tapaścaraṇa kara niścita hī mokṣa prāpta karegī ||40|| apane pūrva bhava sunakara rukmiṇī bhayaṃkara saṃsāra se bhayabhīta gayī aura apane lie nikaṭa kālameṃ mokṣa prāpta hogā yaha jānakara baḍa़e harṣase usane bhagavān‌ko namaskāra kiyā ||41 ||
tadanantara kṛṣṇakī tīsarī paṭṭarānī jāmbavatīne śrī nemijinendra se apane pūrvabhava pūche so saṃsārase bhayabhīta samasta prāṇiyoṃke samakṣa ve usake pūrvaṃbhava isa prakāra kahane lage ||42|| jambūdvīpakī puṣkalāvatī deśameṃ eka vītaśokā nāmakī nagarī thī| usameṃ devila nāmakā eka gṛhastha rahatā thā | usakī devamatī nāmako strīse tu yaśasvinī nāmakī putrī huī thī ||43|| yaśasvinī, gṛhapati ( gahoī ) kī laḍa़kī thī aura gṛhapati ( gahoī ) ke putra sumitra ke lie dī gayī thī | parantu patike mara jānepara vaha bahuta duḥkhī huī || 44 || jinadharmakā upadeśa denevāle kisī jinadeva nāmaka jenane use upadeśa dekara śānta kiyā parantu mohake udayase vaha samyagdarśanako prāpta nahīṃ kara sakī || 45 || vaha pativratā laukika dāna tathā upavāsa karatī rahī aura unake prabhāvase marakara nandana vanameṃ vyantara devakī merunandanā nāmakī strī huī || 46 || tīsa hajāra assī varṣa taka vahā~ke bhoga bhogakara vaha cira kāla taka saṃsāra meṃ paribhramaṇa karatī rahī ||47|| tadanantara isī jambūdvīpake airāvata kṣetra meṃ vijayapura nagarake rājā bandhuṣeṇakī bandhumatī nāmaka strīse bandhuyaśā nāmakī kanyā huī | bandhuyaśāne kanyā avasthā meṃ hī śrīmatī nāmaka āryikāse jinadeva prarūpita proṣadhavrata dhāraṇa kiyā thā isalie vaha marakara kuberako svayaṃprabhā nāmakī strī huī| āyuke antameṃ vahā~se cyuta ho
1. siddhaśilā vandyā ma. | 2. dutkṛṣṭā ma., ka., ṅa. | 3. mokṣāptiḥ ma | 4. gṛhapateḥ ṅa. |

harivaṃśapurāṇe vajramuṣṭeḥ subhadāyāṃ sumatistanayāmavat | sundaryāyikayā pāśrve karavā ratnāvalītapaḥ ||51|| sā trayodaśapalyāyubrahmendrāmāṅganāmavat | cyutāto dakṣiṇaśreṇyā vijayārdhasya bhārate ||52|| nagare jāmbavābhikhye jāmbavasya khageśinaḥ | jāmbavatyā priyāyāṃ tvaṃ jātā jāmbavatī sutā ||53|| tapastapasvinī kṛtvā bhūtvā kalpāmarottamaḥ | cyutvā nṛpātmajo bhūtvā tapasā siddhimeṣyati ||54|| setyukta tyatasaṃśītiḥ śīlālaṃkṛtiśālinī | praṇamya jinamāsīnā manvānā bhavanirgamam ||55|| jananāni jino pṛṣṭo vinayena susīmayā | sabhājanamanohlādajananadhvaninābravīt ||56|| dhātakīkhaṇḍapūrvārdhamerupūrva videhaje | 'viṣaye maṅgalāvatyāṃ nagare ratnasaṃcaye ||5|| bhūpatirviśvaseno'bhūdbhāryāsyānundharīritā | amātyaḥ śrāvako'syaiva viśrutaḥ sumatiśrutiḥ ||58|| padmasenena nihato'yodhyādhipatinā yudhi | viśvaseno'sya jāyāyai so'mātyo dharmamabravīt ||5|| mohādaprāptasamyaktvā vijayadvāravāsinaḥ | mṛtvā jvalitavegābhūd vyaṃtarī vijayasya sā ||6|| daśavarṣasahasrāṇi bhuktvā tatra sukhaṃ tataḥ | cyutā ciraṃ paribhramya mīmaṃ saṃsārasāgaram ||6|| jambūdvīpavidehe'taḥ sītāyā dakṣiṇe taṭe | ramye ramyābhidhe kṣetre śāligrāme mahādhane ||62||
jambūdvīpakī puṇḍarīkiṇī nāmaka viśālapurīmeṃ vajramuṣṭiko subhadrā strīse sumati nāmakī putrī huī| vahāṃ usane sundarī nāmaka āryikāse prerita ho unake samīpa ratnāvalī nāmakā tapa kiyā jisake prabhāvase marakara vaha teraha palyakī āyukī dhāraka brahmendrakī pradhāna indrāṇī huī| tadanantara vahā~se bhī cyuta hokara bharatakṣetra sambandhī vijayā parvatakī dakṣiṇa śreṇīmeṃ jāmbava nāmaka nagarake vidyādhara rājā jāmbavakī jāmbavatī nāmaka rānīse tū jāmbavato nāmakī putrī huī ||48-53|| isa bhavameṃ tū tapasvinī hokara tapa karegī aura svargakā uttama deva hokara vahā~se cyuta ho rājaputra hogī| tadanantara tapake dvārā mokṣako prāpta hogī ||54|| isa prakāra bhagavānke dvārā apane pūrvabhava 'kahe jānepara jisakā saba saṃśaya dūra ho gayā thā tathā jo śīlarūpī alaṃkārase suśobhita thī aisī jāmbavatī rānī jinendra devako praṇāma kara 'maiṃ saṃsārase pāra ho gayī' aisā mānatī huī sukhase āsīna huī ||55||
tadanantara suśīlā nāmaka cauthī paṭṭarānīne vinayapūrvaka jinendra bhagavānse apane bhavāntara pūche so bhagavān sabhāsadoṃke manako ānanda utpanna karanevālī divyadhvanise usake bhavāntara isa prakāra varṇana karane lage
dhātakīkhaṇḍa dvīpake pūrvārdhameṃ jo meru parvata hai usase pūrvakī orake videha kṣetrameṃ eka maṃgalāvato nāmakā deśa hai | usake ratnasaṃcaya nāmaka nagarameṃ kisī samaya viśvasena rājā rahatā thā usako strīkā nāma anundharī thā| isī rājākā eka sumati nāmakā prasiddha mantrī thā jo śrāvaka dharmakā pratipālaka thā ||56-58|| kadācit ayodhyāke rājā padmasenane rājā viśvasenako yuddha meṃ prāṇarahita kara diyā jisase usakī strī anundharī bahuta duḥkhī huī| sumati mantrīne use dhamakā upadeśa diyā parantu mohake kāraṇa vaha samyagdarśanako prāpta nahīṃ ho sakī aura āyake antameṃ marakara vijayadvārapara nivāsa karanevāle vijaya nāmaka vyantara devakī jvalanavegā nāmako vyantarī huī ||59-60|| daśa hajāra varṣa taka vahā~ke sukha bhogakara vaha vahāṃse cyuta huī aura cirakāla taka bhayaṃkara saṃsāra-sāgarameṃ paribhramaṇa karatī rahī ||61|| tadanantara jambūdvīpake videha kṣetrameṃ sītā nadīke dakṣiṇa taṭapara eka ramya nāmakā sundara kṣetra hai | usake mahādhanasampanna śāligrāma nāmaka nagarameṃ eka yakṣila nāmakā gṛhapati rahatā thā| usakī strīkā nāma devasenā thā|

sutābhūdevasenāyāṃ yakṣilasya gṛheśinaḥ | yakṣārādhanato labdhā yakṣadevī svanāmataḥ ||63|| sā yakṣagṛhapūjārthamanyadā pragatātra ca | dharmasenagurorante dharma śuśrāva gauravāt ||64|| āhāradānamasmai sā pātrāyātithaye'nyadā | datvā bhaktimatī kanyā puṇyabandhaṃ babandha ca ||65|| sakhīmiḥ krīḍitaṃ yātā kadācidvimalācalam | tatra cākālavarṣaṇa pīḍitā prāviśad guhām ||66|| tatra siṃhena saṃtrastā grastā tyaktāramavigrahā| babhūva hariva'sau dvipalyopamajīvitā ||67|| jyotirlokamato gatvā palpopamasamasthitiḥ| taccyutvā puṣkalāvatyāṃ jambūdvīpasya mārate ||6|| vītaśokābhidhānāyāmaśokasya mahīpateḥ| śrīmatyāmabhavat kanyā śrīkāntā nāmataḥ sutā ||69|| jinadattāyikopānte viniṣkramya kumārikā | ratnāvaliṃ tapaḥ kṛtvā māhendrādhipateḥ priyā ||7|| bhūtvaikādaśapalyāyurmuktvā svargasukhaṃ cyutā | sujyeṣṭāyāṃ surāṣṭreṣu rāṣṭravardhanabhūbhṛtaḥ ||7|| susīmā tanayābhastvaṃ nagare giripūrvake | devo mṛtvā tapaḥ śaktyā mokṣyase nṛbhave tataḥ ||72|| niśamyātmabhavānitthaṃ susīmā saumyamānasā | prakṛṣṭāsannaniṣṭheti niṣṭhitārtha nanāma sā ||73|| pṛṣṭo lakṣmaṇayā gatvā jinaḥ provāca tadbhavān | jināḥ sarvahitāḥ sarve yatpraśnottaravādinaḥ ||7|| dvīpe'smin kacchakāvasyāṃ sītāyā uttare taṭe | rājāriṣṭapure hyāsīdvāsavo vāsavopamaḥ ||75||
sumitrākhyā priyāsyāsau vandituṃ sāṅgano yayau | guruṃ sāgarasenākhyaṃ sahasrāmravanasthitam ||76|| jvalanavegākā jīva inhīṃ donoṃke eka putrī huā| vaha putrī cūṃki yakṣakī ārādhanāse prāpta huī thī isalie usakā yakṣadevī yahī nāma prasiddha ho gayā || 62-63|| kisī samaya vaha yakṣadevī, yakṣagṛhakī pūjāke lie gayī thī| vahā~ usane dharmasena guruke samīpa baḍa़e gauravase dharma upadeśa sunā ||64|| kisī dina usa bhaktimatī kanyāne ukta munike lie āhāra dāna diyā aura usake phalasvarūpa pūṇyabandha bāṃdhā ||65|| kisī samaya vaha yakṣadevī sakhiyoṃke sātha krīḍā karaneke lie vimala nāmaka parvatapara gayī thī vahā~ akāla varṣāse pīḍa़ita hokara vaha eka guphāmeṃ ghusa gayī ||66|| usa guphāmeṃ pahalese siṃha baiṭhā thā so usa siṃhane dekhate hī yakṣadevīko khā liyā| yakṣadevī apanā śarīra choḍa़ harivarṣa kṣetrameṃ do palyakī dhāraka āryā huī ||67|| vahāṃse cayakara vaha jyotiṣa lokameṃ eka palyakī āyuvālī devī huī| tadanantara vahā~se cyuta ho jambūdvīpa sambandhī bharatakṣetrake puṣkalāvatī deśameṃ vītaśokā nāmaka nagarīke rājā aśokakī śrīmatī nāmaka rānīse śrīkāntā nāmakī putrī huī ||68-69|| śrīkāntāne kumārī avasthāmeṃ hī jinadattā āryikāke pāsa dīkṣā lekara ratnāvalī nāmakā tapa kiyā aura usake phalasvarūpa vaha māhendrasvargake indrako gyāraha palyakī āyuvālī priya devī huī| svargake sukha bhogakara vahāṃse cyuta huī aura surāṣṭra deśake girinagarameṃ rāṣṭravardhana rājākī sujyeṣṭhā nāmaka rānīse tū susīmā nāmakī putrī huī hai| aba tū tapakī śaktise deva hogī aura tadanantara manuṣya paryāya prāpta kara mokṣa prāpta karegī ||70-72|| isa prakāra apane bhava śravaṇa kara tathā apanā saṃsāra atyanta nikaṭa jānakara susīmā bahuta prasanna huī aura usane kṛtakṛtya bhagavān nemijinendrako namaskāra kiyā ||73||
tadanantara lakṣmaṇā nāmaka pā~cavīṃ paṭṭarānīne namaskāra kara bhagavānse apane pūrvabhava pūche so bhagavān usake pūrvabhava kahane lage| cū~ki samasta tīrthaṃkara bhagavān praśnoṃkā uttara, nirūpaṇa karate haiṃ isalie ve sarvahitakārī kahalāte haiṃ ||74| unhoṃne kahā ki isī jambūdvīpakī sītā nadīke uttara taṭapara eka kacchakāvatī nāmakā deśa hai| usake ariṣṭapura nagarameṃ kisī samaya indrakī upamāko dhāraṇa karanevālā eka vāsava nāmakā rājā rahatā thā| usakī sumitrā nāmakī vallabhā thī| eka dina vaha apanī vallabhāke sātha, sahasrāmra vanameṃ sthita sāgarasena nāmaka

712
harivaṃśapurāṇe dharma śrutvā guro rājā rājye vinyasya dehajam | vasusenamadīkṣiṣṭa na patnī putramohataḥ ||7|| patiputraviyogograśokaduḥkhahatā mṛtā| 'pulindītvaṃ gatā dṛṣṭvā nandimadraṃ khacāraṇam ||7|| avadhijñāninaṃ śrutvā tasmārapūrvabhavaṃ hi sā | smṛtapūrvabhavāmṛtvā tridinānaśanavatā ||79|| nāradasyāmavaddevī nāmato meghamālinī| cyutvā ca bharatakṣetre roṣyādradakṣiṇe taṭe ||8|| sānundhayāṃ mahendrasya pure candanapūrvake | sutā kanakamālābhadvidyādharamanoharā ||8|| harivāhanavidyeśaṃ mahendranagareśvaram | vṛtvā svayaṃvare kanyā mānyā jātāsya vallamā ||42|| anyadā caityapūjārtha siddhakūṭamiyaṃ gatā | śrutvā ca cāraṇājātimāryā muktāvalī tapaḥ ||8|| kṛtvā sanatkumārendravallabhābhṛt surāṅganā | navapalyopamāyuṣkā saukhyaṃ bhuktvāta taścyutā ||84|| jātātra ślakṣṇaromṇastvaṃ kurumatyāṃ sutā bhave | tṛtīye muktirityukta lakṣmaṇā praṇatā prabhum ||45|| sa gāndhāryā kṛte praśne tadbhavānbhagavān jagau | nagayoṃ kośalevāsīdayodhyāyāṃ mahīpateḥ ||86|| mahiṣī rudradattasya vinayaśrī śrutākhyayā | śrīdharāya dadau dānaṃ pasyā siddhārthake vane ||7|| mṛtvottarakuruṣvāsīdānāpalyatrayasthitiḥ | palyāṣṭabhāgatulyāyuḥ sātaścandramasaḥ priyā ||8||
manirājakī vandanā karane ke lie gayā |75-76|| rājā vāsava, manirājase dharmaśravaṇa kara virakta ho gayā aura vasasena nāmaka putrako rājyabhāra sauṃpakara dīkṣita ho gayā parantu pūtrake moha hase rānī sumitrā dīkṣā nahīṃ le sakī ||77||
__ kadācit putrakā bhī viyoga ho gayā ataḥ pati aura putrake viyogajanya tīvra śokase utpanna duḥkhase pīḍa़ita hokara vaha mara gayo aura marakara bhīlinī paryāyako prāpta huī| eka dina usa bhīlinīne avadhijñānake dhāraka nandibhadra nāmaka cāraṇa ṛddhidhārī munirājake darśana kara unase apane pūrvabhava sune | pūrvabhavoṃko smaraṇa kara usane tīna dinakā anaśana kiyā
aura marakara nārada nāmaka devakī meghamālinī nāmakī strī huī| vahāṃse cyuta hokara bharata kṣetrake dakṣiṇa taṭapara candanapura nāmaka nagarameṃ rājā mahendrakī anundharī rānīse vidyādharoṃke manako haraṇa karanevālī kanakamālā nāmakī putrī huī ||78-81|| kanakamālā svayaṃvarameṃ mahendra nagarake rājā harivāhana vidyādharako varakara usakī mānanīya vallabhā ho gayī ||82|| kisī samaya kanakamālā jina-pratimāoṃkī pūjā karane ke lie siddhakūṭa gayī thī| vahāṃ cāraṇa ṛddhike dhāraka munirājase apane pūrvabhava śravaṇa kara vaha āryikā ho gayī aura muktāvalī nāmakā tapakara sanatkumāra svargake indrakī priyadevī huī| vahāṃ usakī nau palyakī āyu thī| sukha bhogakara vaha vahāṃse cyuta ho yahā~ rājā ślakṣṇaromakī kurumatī rānīse lakṣmaṇā nāmakī putrī huī hai| tīsare bhavameṃ terī mukti hogī| isa prakāra bhavāntara kahe jānepara lakṣmaṇā rānīne bhagavān nemijinendrako namaskāra kiyā ||83-85||
tadanantara kṛṣṇakī chaṭho paṭṭarānī gāndhārīke dvārā praśna kiye jānepara bhagavān usake pūrvabhava kahane lage| unhoṃne kahā ki kośala deśakī ayodhyā nagarīmeṃ kisī samaya rudradatta nāmakā rājā rahatā thā| usakī vinayaśrī nāmakī rānī thī| usane eka samaya siddhārthaka nāmaka vanameṃ apane patike sātha, śrīdhara nāmaka munirājake lie āhāra dāna diyā ||86-87|| dānake prabhāvase marane ke bāda vaha uttarakurumeṃ tīna palyako āyukī dhāraka āryā huī| usake bāda palyake āṭhaveṃ bhāga barābara āyukī dhāraka candramākī priyā huī ||88| tadanantara isī vijayārdhakī uttara śreṇīmeṃ
1. śavarīparyāyaṃ | 2. cāraṇamuni | 3. mṛtvā ninditānaśanavatā ma.| 4. kṛtvā ma. |

tataścātrottara śreṇyāṃ pure gaganavallabhe | vidyudvegasya kanyābhūdvidyunmatyāṃ mahādyutiḥ || 89 || vinayaśrīguṇaiḥ khyātā nityā lokapureśinaḥ | mahendravikramasyaiṣā yoṣidguṇasamanvitā || 90 || cāraṇaśramaṇābhyāṃ tu dharmaṃ śrutvā sa mandare | rājye niyojya niṣkrānto nandanaṃ harivāhanam ||91|| vinayaśrīstu kṛtvāsau sarvabhadramupoṣitam | pañcapalyasthitirjātā saudharmendrasya vallabhā || 92 || puryāṃ svaṃ puṣkalāvatyāṃ gāndhāreṣu divaścyutā | gāndhārīndragire rājño merumatyāmabhūtsutā ||93|| tṛtīyabhavasiddhistvamityukte sānamajjinam | gauryā vijñāpito natvā tadbhavānāha viśvavit ||94|| ibhyasyebhya pure'trābhūddha nadevasya kāminī | yaśasvinī sthitā hayeṃ cāraṇau vīkṣya sāmbare ||95|| sasmāra svabhavān sarvān dhātakīkhaṇḍamaṇḍale | pūrvasya mandarasyāsaṃ videheṣvapareṣvaham ||96|| ānanda śreṣṭhinaḥ patnī nandaśokapure'rhate | mitasāgaranāmne'tra dānaṃ datvā sabhartṛkā || 97 || pañcāścaryāṇyahaṃ prāpaṃ kṛtāni tridaśairmudā | pītvākāśodakaṃ bhartrā saviṣaṃ mṛtavatyamā ||98 || mūtvā devakuruṣvāsamaiśānendra priyā tataḥ | jātātrāhamiti jñātvā sā saṃvegaparā yatim ||99|| natvā subhadranāmānaṃ proṣadhavratamagrahīt | mṛtvā śakrasya devyāsītpañcapalyasamasthitiḥ || 100||
gaganavallabha nagara ke svāmī rājā vidyudvegakī vidyunmatī nāmaka rānīse mahākāntiko dhāraka vinayaśrī nāmako kanyā huī | yaha kanyā guṇoṃse atyanta prasiddha thī aura nityāloka nagarake svāmī rājā mahendravikramako guṇavatī strī huī| kadācit sumeru parvatapara cāraṇa ṛddhike dhāraka yugala muniyoṃ se dharmaṃ śravaṇa kara rājā mahendravikrama saṃsārase virakta ho gayā aura usane harivāhana nāmaka putrako rājya kārya meṃ niyukta kara dīkṣā dhāraṇa kara lī ||89-91 || vinayaśrīne bhī saṃsāra se virakta ho sarvabhadra nāmaka upavāsa kiyā aura usake prabhāvase vaha pā~ca palyakī sthitikī dhāraka saudharmendrakī devī huī ||92 || aba tū svagaṃse cyuta hokara gāndhāra deśakī puṣkalāvatī nagarīmeṃ rājā indragirikī merumatī nāmaka rānīse gāndhārī nāmakī putrī huī || 93 || tū tīsare bhava meṃ mokṣa prāpta karegī| isa prakāra apane bhavāntarake kahe jānepara gāndhārīne jinendra bhagavān‌ko namaskāra kiyā | tadanantara kṛṣṇakī sātavīṃ paṭṭarānī gaurīne namaskāra kara apane pūrvabhava pūche so samasta padārthoṃko jānanevāle bhagavān isa prakāra usake pūrvabhava kahane lage ||24||
isa bharata kṣetrake ibhyapura nagara meṃ kisī samaya dhanadeva nāmakā eka seṭha rahatā thā| usakī yaśasvinī nāmakī strī thī | eka dina yaśasvinī apane mahalako chatapara khaḍa़ī thī vahā~ usane ākāśameṃ jāte hue do cāraṇa ṛddhidhārī muni dekhe ||15|| unheṃ dekhate use apane samasta pūrvabhavoṃkā smaraṇa ho gayā | use mālūma ho gayā ki maiṃ dhātakīkhaṇḍa dvīpake pūrva merukī paścima diśāmeṃ vidyamāna videha kṣetrake antargata nandaśoka nāmaka nagara meṃ ānanda nāmaka seṭhakī patnī thī | vahā~ maiṃne apane pati ke sātha, mitasāgara nāmaka munirājake lie āhāra dāna diyā| jisake phalasvarūpa maiṃ harṣapūrvaṃ devoṃke dvārā kiye hue paṃcāścarya prāpta kiye the| kadācit hama donoṃne ākāśase paḍa़tā huā varṣākā pānī piyā| vaha pānī viṣa sahita thā isalie patike sātha merā maraṇa ho gayā || 96-98 |
713
marakara maiṃ devakurumeṃ āryā huī | usake bāda aiśānendrakī priyā huī aura usake bāda yahā~ yaśasvinī huī hū~ | isa prakāra jānakara saṃsārase bhayabhīta hotī huī yaśasvinīne subhadra nāmaka munirājako namaskāra kara unase proṣadhavata grahaṇa kiyā | tadanantara marakara pā~ca palyakī āyukī dhāraka prathama svarga ke indrakī indrāṇī huī | 99-100 ||
