harivaṃśapurāṇe
egevābhūdiha kauśāmbyāṃ sumitrāyāṃ subhadrataḥ | ibhyāddharmamatirnāmnā kanyā dharmamatiḥ sadā || 101 || jinamasyāyikāpāveṃ tapo jinaguṇābhidham | gṛhītvopoṣya jātāsi mahāśukrendra vallabhā || 102|| ekaviṃśatipalyāyuścyutvā candramatistriyām | gaurī tvaṃ vītaśokāyāṃ merucandrādabhūtsutā || 103 ||
siddhistribhiste syādityukte sā natā vibhum | praṇipatya tataḥ pṛṣṭaḥ padmāvatyā bhavān jagau || 104 || ujjayinyāmi haivāsīdaparājitabhūbhṛtaḥ | tanayā vinayaśrīḥ sā vijayāvanitāṅgajā ||105|| hastiśīrṣapurādhīśaṃ hariṣeṇamasau patim | prāptā patiyutā dānaṃ varadattāya saṃdadau || 106 || kālāgurukadhūpena bharnā garbhagṛhe mṛtā | bhūtvā haimavate bhuktvā sukhaṃ palyasamasthitiḥ || 107 || jātā candraprabhādevī tataścandrasya vallamā | palyopamāṣṭabhāgāyurataścyutvā tu bhārate || 108 || grāme'bhūcchālmalīkhaṇḍe magadheṣu gṛheśinoḥ | duhitā padmadevīti devilājayadevayoḥ || 109 || 'ācāryādvaradharmākhyādekadā vratamagrahīt | yāvajjīvaṃ na makṣyaṃ me phalamajñātamapyasau || 110 || 'pracaṇḍaḥ śālmalīkhaṇḍe grāme'vaskandadānataḥ | akāṇḍe caṇḍabāṇākhyo vyādhamukhyo'harajjanam || 111 || vandigehe gṛhītvā tāṃ padmadevīṃ svadāratām | ninīṣuḥ śīlavatyāsau pratyākhyāto'nayā nayāt || 112 || sa rājagṛhanāthena rājñā siṃharathena tu | haṭhena nihato'raṇye'śaraṇye janatābhramat ||113||
714
vahā~se cyuta ho kauśāmbī nagarī meṃ subhadra seṭhakī sumitrā nāmakī bīse sadā dharmameṃ buddhi lagānevālī dharmamati nāmakī kanyā huī || 101 || dharmamatine jinamati ārthika ke pāsa jinaguṇa nāmakā tapa lekara upavāsa kiye aura unake phalasvarūpa vaha mahāśuka svargake indrakī vallabhā huī ||102 || vahā~ usakī ikkīsa palyakī āyu thī | vahā~se cyuta hokara aba tū vītaśokā nagarīmeṃ rājā merucandrakī candramati khose gaurī nāmakī putrī huī hai || 103 || tīna bhavameṃ tujhe muktikī prāpti hogī| isa prakāra kahe jānepara gaurīne namrībhūta hokara bhagavān‌ko praṇāma kiyā | tadanantara kṛṣṇakī āṭhavīṃ paṭṭarānī padmāvatīne bhī apane pūrvabhava pūche jisake uttara meṃ bhagavān usake pūrvaṃbhava isa prakāra kahane lage || 104 ||
isī bharata kṣetrakī ujjayinī nagarī meṃ kisī samaya aparājita nāmakā rājā rahatā thā | usakī strī vijayā thī aura una donoṃke vinayaśrī nāmakī putrī thī || 105 || vinayaśrī hastināpurake rājā hariṣeṇa patiko prāpta huī thī arthāt usakā vivāha hastināpurake rājā hariṣeṇa ke sātha huā thā | eka dina usane patike sātha, varadatta munirāja ke lie āhāra dāna diyā || 106|| kadācit vaha apane pati ke sātha garbhagṛhameṃ śayana kara rahī thī ki kālāgurukī dhūpase usakā prāṇānta ho gayā | marakara vaha haimavata kṣetrameṃ eka palyako āyuvālī āryā huī | vahā~ke sukha bhogakara vaha candradevakī candraprabhā nāmakī devī huī| vahāṃ palyake āṭhaveṃ bhāga usakī āyu thī | vahā~se cyuta ho bharatakṣetrake magadha deśa sambandhī śālmalī khaṇḍa nāmaka grāma meṃ devilā aura jayadeva nāmaka dampatīke padmadevī nāmakī putrī huī || 107 - 109 || eka samaya usane varadharmaṃ nāmaka ācāryase yaha vrata liyā ki maiṃ jīvana paryanta ajñāta phalakā bhakṣaṇa nahīṃ karū~gī ||110 || kisī eka dina asamaya meṃ caṇḍabāṇa nāmaka śaktiśālī bhīla śālmalī khaṇḍa grāmapara ākramaṇa kara vahā~kī samasta prajāko hara le gayā || 111|| sātha hī padmadevīko bhī pakaḍa़kara apane kārāgāra meṃ le gayā| vaha use apanī strī banānā cāhatā thā parantu śīlavatī padmadevīne kisī nītise usakā nirākaraṇa kara diyā || 112 || usī samaya rājagṛhake rājā

prabhake dattaka, puṣpadantake vaidarbha, śītalanāthake anagāra, śreyāṃsanāthake kunthu, vāsupūjyake sudharma, vimalanāthake mandarāya, anantanāthake jaya, dharmanāthake ariṣṭasena, śāntināthake cakrāyudha, kunthunāthake svayambhū, aranāthake kunthu, mallināthake viśākha, munisuvratake malli, namināthake somaka, nemināthake varadatta, pāśvanāthake svayambhū aura mahāvīrake indrabhūti the| ye sabhī gaṇadhara sāta ṛddhiyoṃse yukta tathā samasta śāstroṃke pāragāmī the ||346-349||

syuścatvāri sahasrāṇi tathā saptaśatāni ca | pañcāśaca vṛṣasyāmī sarve pūrvadharā vibhoḥ || 358 || catuḥsaharu gaṇanāḥ śataṃ pañcāśaduttaram | śikṣakāḥ sāvadhijñānāḥ sahasrāṇi nava smṛtāḥ || 359 || viṃśatistu sahasrāṇi pūjyāḥ kevalinaḥ satām | sahasrāṇyeva tāvanti ṣaṭśatāni ca vaikriyāḥ || 360 || syurdvādaśasahasrāṇi matyā vipulayā yutāḥ | śatāni saptapañcāśattarasaṃkhyāvādino'pi ca || 361 || ajitasya sahasrāṇi trīṇi saptaśatāni ca | pañcāśaśca satāṃ sevyāḥ sabhyānāṃ pūrvadhāriṇaḥ || 362 || 'śikṣakāḥ pātaiḥ sārdhaṃ saharu ṇyekaviṃśatiḥ | catuḥśatyā sahasrāṇi nava sāvadhayo matāḥ || 363|| syu viṃśatisahasrāṇi kevalāptāstu vaikriyāḥ | jñeyāstāvatsahasrāṇi pañcāśaca catuḥśatī ||| 364 || dvādaśaiva sahasrāṇi pratyekaṃ ca catuḥśatī | matyā tripulayā yuktā vādino hitavādinaḥ || 365|| 'saṃbhavasya sahasre dve śataṃ pañcāśatā samam | pūjyāḥ pūrvabhṛto jñeyāḥ pūrvasadbhāvavādinaḥ || 366 || ekonatriṃśatā lakṣā sahasaikhiśatāni ca | saṃkhyā śikṣakasādhūnāṃ saṃkhyātāḥ praśrayāśritāḥ || 367|| ṣaṭ śatāni sahasrāṇi nava sāvadhayaḥ smṛtāḥ | tathā daśasahasrāṇi pañcabhiḥ kevalāśritāḥ || 368 || tathaivaikonaviṃśatyā sahasairaṣṭabhiḥ śataiḥ | pañcāśadvaikriyāḥ proktā vikriyāśaktidhāriṇaḥ || 369 ||

daśasahasrāṇi vipulāṃ matimāśritāḥ | śatādhikāni tāvanti sahasrāṇi ca vādinaḥ || 370|| śatāni pañca turyasya dve sahasre'tha pūrviṇaḥ | dvilakṣe śikṣakāstriṃśatsahasrāyaddhitaṃ śatam || 371|| śatānyaṣṭau sahasrāṇi navaivānadhivīkṣaṇāḥ | ṣoḍaśaiva sahasrāṇi munayaḥ kevalekṣaṇāḥ ||372 || ekānnaviṃśatijñeyā sahasrāṇi tu vaikriyāḥ | ekādaśasahastrāṇi pañcāśatṣaṭśatāni ca || 373 || vipulopagatā ye te boddhavyā bhavyadehinām | vādino'pi ca tāvanti sahasrāṇīṣṭavādinaḥ || 374 ||
hai || 357|| bhagavān ṛṣabhadeva ke samavasaraṇa meṃ cāra hajāra sāta sau pacāsa pūrvadhārī, cāra hajāra eka sau pacāsa śikṣaka, no hajāra avadhijñānī, bīsa hajāra satpuruṣoṃke dvārā pūjanīya kevalī, bīsa hajāra chaha sau vikriyā ṛddhike dhāraka, bāraha hajāra sāta sau pacāsa vipulamatimana:paryayajñānī aura itane hī vādī the || 358-361 ||

harivaṃśapurāṇe sumate sahasre tu catuḥśatyapi pūrviṇaḥ | dve lakṣe śikṣakā dṛśyāścanuḥpañcāśadeva ca ||375|| sahasrāṇyabhiyuktāni pañcāśañca śatatrayam | ekādaśasahasrāṇi vimalāvadhayastathā ||376|| trayodaśasahasrāṇi kevalajñānadṛṣyaḥ | aṣṭādaśasahasrāṇi tatuḥśasyapi vaikriyāḥ ||377|| dṛśyā daśasahasrāṇi vipulāptāścatuḥśatī| tāvanto vādinastebhyaḥ sarve pañcāśatādhikāḥ ||378|| padmābhasya sahasra dve śatāni trīṇi pūrviṇaḥ | lakṣe dve śikṣakāḥ ṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi navāpi ca ||319|| jñeyā daśasahasrāṇi munayo'vadhilocanāḥ| dvādaśāṣṭaśatairyuktāḥ sahasrāṇyāptakevalāḥ ||380|| ṣoḍaśaiva sahasrāṇi triśatī vaikriyā nava | vādino vipulāptāḥ ṣaṭa śarayāmā daśa tāni vai ||381|| dve sahasra supārśvasya triṃśatā pūrviṇaścatuḥ | catvāriṃśatsahasrāṇi lakṣe navaśataiḥ saha ||382|| śikṣakā viṃśatiṃ prāptāḥ sahasrāṇi navāvadhim | ekādaśa sahasrāṇi triśatī kevalānvitāḥ ||383|| śataṃ pañcāśatā pañca sahasrāṇi daśāpi ca | vaikriyāvipulādyāḥ ṣaṭśatī navasahasrakaiḥ ||384|| vādino'ṣṭasahasrāṇi tataścandraprabhasya tu | pūrviṇo dve sahasre tu śaikṣā lakṣe catuḥśatī ||3.5|| saṃghāvaṣṭasahasrāṇi pṛthak savipulāvadhī | daśakevalinastāni vaikriyāstu catuḥśatī ||386|| jñeyāḥ saptaḥ sahasrāṇi ṣaṭ śatāni ca vādinaḥ | suvidheḥ pūrviṇaḥ pañca daśaśatyupavarṇitā ||38|| lakṣakā pañcapañcāśasahasrāṇi śatāni ca | pañca śikṣakasādhūnāmavadhijñānino'ṣṭa tu ||388|| sahasrāṇi catuḥśatyā pañcaśasyā tu sapta vai | sahasrāṇyāptakaivalyāḥ syustrayodaśa nai kriyāḥ ||389|| ṣaṭ sahasrāṇi vipulāṃ pañcaśatyā gatiṃ śritāḥ | vādinaḥ ṣaṭśataiḥ sapta sahasrāṇi viniścitāḥ ||390||
sumatināthake samavasaraṇameṃ do hajāra cāra sau pūrvadhārī, do lākha cauvana hajāra tīna so pacāsa śikṣaka, gyāraha hajāra nirmala avadhijñānī, teraha hajāra kevalajñānī, aṭhāraha hajāra cāra so vikriyā ṛddhike dhāraka, utane hī vipulamatimanaḥparyayajñānake dhāraka aura unase pacāsa adhika arthāt daśa hajāra cāra sau pacāsa vādī the ||375-378||
padmaprabhake samavasaraṇameṃ do hajāra tīna sau pūrvadhārī, do lākha unahattara hajāra śikṣaka, dasa hajāra avadhijñānī, bāraha hajāra āṭha sau kevalajñānī, solaha hajāra tīna sau vikriyā ṛddhike dhāraka, nau hajāra vādī aura dasa hajāra chaha sau vipulamatimanaḥparyayajñānī the ||379-381||
supāśvanāthake samavasaraṇameṃ do hajāra tīsa pūrvadhārī, do lākha cavālisa hajāra nau sau bīsa śikṣaka, nau hajāra avadhijñānī, gyāraha hajāra tīna sau kevalī, pandraha hajāra eka so pacāsa vikriyā ṛddhike dhāraka, nau hajāra chaha sau vipulamatimanaḥparyayajñānī aura āṭha hajāra vādī the|

suvidhināthake samavasaraṇameṃ pāṃca hajāra pūrvadhārī, eka lākha pacapana hajāra pā~ca sau śikṣaka, āṭha hajāra cāra sau avadhijñānī, sāta hajāra pāṃca sau kevalajñānī, teraha hajāra vikriyā ṛddhike dhāraka, chaha hajāra pāṃca sau vipulamatimanaḥparyayajñānī aura sāta hajāra chaha sau vādī the ||382-390||

śītalasya catuḥśatyā sahasraṃ pūrvavedina: | dviśasyaikānaṣaṣṭistu sahastrāṇi suśikṣakāḥ ||39|| dviśatyā sāvadhiḥ saṃghaḥ sahastrāṇi hi sapta saḥ| saptakevalinastāmi dvādaśatāni vaikriyāḥ ||39|| pañcaśatyā sahasrāṇi saptaite vipuleśvarāḥ | saptaśatyā sahasrāṇi paśca sadvādavādinaḥ ||39|| trayodaśa śatāni syuḥ pūrviṇaḥ śreyaso'ṣṭabhiḥ | catvāriṃśatsahasvāṇi dviśatī baukṣyasādhavaḥ ||39|| sāvadhiḥ ṣaṭa sahastrāṇi gaṇaḥ kevalināmapi | pañcaśatyā sahastrāṇi tathaikādana vaikriyāḥ ||395|| tato'nye ṣaṭ sahasrāṇi pañca tāni tataḥ pare | śatāni dvādaśaiva syurvāsupūjyasya pūrviṇaḥ ||396|| dviśasyā śikṣakāstriṃśatsahasrāṇi navāpi ca | catuḥśatyā sahasrāṇi paśca sāvadhayo matāḥ ||39|| sarvajñāḥ ṣaṭ sahasrāṇi vaikriyāḥ daśa ṣaṭ pare | vādinastu sahastrāṇi catvāri dviśatī tathā ||398|| śatānyekādaśa jñeyā vimalasya tu pūrviṇaḥ | aṣṭātriṃśatsahasrāṇi pañcaśatyā tu śakṣakāḥ ||399|| aṣṭaśasyā sahasrāṇi catvāryavadhilocanāḥ | pañcaśatyā sahasrāṇi pañca kevalino mava ||10|| vaikriyāśca sahasrāṇi tato'nye kevalipramāḥ | vādinastrisahasrī ca ṣaṭśatī ca viniścitāḥ ||40|| pūrviṇo'nantanāthasya sahasragaṇanāḥ smṛtāḥ | pañcaśasyā sahasrāṇi triṃśannava ca śikṣakāḥ ||40|| syāñcatvāri sahasrāṇi triśatyā sāvadhirgaṇaḥ | anye pañcāṣṭapañcatrisahasrānyantake śate ||403|| śatāni nava dharmasya pūrviṇaḥ śikṣakāḥ punaḥ | catvāriṃśatsahasrāṇi tathā saptasatāni ca ||40|| ṣaṭ śatāni sahasrāṇi trīṇi sāvadhayaḥ smṛtāḥ | pañcaśatyā sahasrāṇi catvāri sakalekṣaṇāḥ ||405|| santaḥ saptasahasrāṇi vaikriyā vipulānvitāḥ | pañcaśatyā tu catvāri dvisahasraṣṭaśatyataḥ||406||
śītalanāthake samavasaraṇameṃ eka hajāra cāra sau pūrvavedī, unasaṭha hajāra do sau śikṣaka, sāta hajāra do sau avadhijñānī, sāta hajāra kevalajñānī, bāraha hajāra vikriyā ṛddhike dhāraka, sāta hajāra pāṃca sau vipulamatijñānake svāmī aura pāṃca hajāra sāta sau uttama vādī the ||391-393||
śreyāṃsanāthake samavasaraṇameṃ teraha sau pūrvadhārī, aḍa़tālīsa hajāra do sau śikṣaka, chaha hajāra avadhijñānī, chaha hajāra pāṃca sau kevalajñānī, gyāraha hajāra vikriyā ṛddhike dhāraka, chaha hajāra vipulamatimanaḥparyayajñānī aura pāṃca hajāra vādī the|
vāsupūjyake samavasaraṇameṃ bāraha sau pūrvadhārī, unatālīsa hajāra do sau śikṣaka, pāṃca hajāra cāra sau avadhijñānī, chaha hajāra kevalajñānī, dasa hajāra vikriyā ṛddhike dhāraka, chaha hajāra vipulamatimanaḥparyayajñānī aura cāra hajāra do so vādī the ||394-398||
vimalanāthake gyāraha sau pūrvadhāro, aḍa़tīsa hajāra pā~ca sau śikṣaka, cāra hajāra āṭha sau avadhijñāno, pāṃca hajāra pāṃca sau kevalī, nau hajāra vikriyā ṛddhike dhāraka, nau hajāra vipulamatimanaḥparyayajñānī aura tīna hajāra chaha sau vādī niścita the ||399-401||
anantanāthake samavasaraṇameṃ eka hajāra pūrvadhārī, unatālīsa hajāra pāṃca sau śikṣaka, cāra hajāra tīna sau avadhijñānī, pāṃca hajāra kevalajñānī, āṭha hajāra vikriyā ṛddhike dhāraka aura tīna hajāra do sau vādī the ||402-403||
dharmanāthake samavasaraṇameṃ nau sau pūrvadhārī, cālīsa hajāra sāta so śikṣaka, tīna hajāra chaha so avadhijñānī, cāra hajāra pāṃca sau kevalajñānī, sāta hajāra vikriyā ṛddhike dhāraka, cāra hajāra pāṃca sau vipulamati manaḥparyayajñānī aura do hajāra āṭha sau vādī the ||404-406||

trayo'śītiśca navatiḥ pañcamiḥ sāṣṭasaptatiḥ| dvābhyāṃ ca saptatiḥ ṣaṣṭiścatvāriṃśaca saṃyutāḥ ||483|| ṣaṭasu kāleṣu palyāṣṭamāge śeṣe tṛtīyake | bhūtiḥ kulakarāṇāṃ ca tato'pi vṛṣamasya tu ||484|| janma krameṇa śeṣāṇāṃ jinānāṃ cakravartinām | halināṃ vāsudevānāṃ turya kāle viniścitam ||45|| vyabdāṣṭamāsamāsārdhaśeṣayoriha kālayoḥ | tṛtīyataryayoḥ siddhiḥ prasiddhā vṛṣavīrayoḥ ||486|| vīranirvāṇakāle ca pālako'trābhiṣicyate | loke'vantisuto rājā prajānāṃ pratipālakaḥ ||487|| ṣaṣṭivarṣāṇi sadrājyaṃ tato viṣayabhūbhūjām | śataṃ ca pañcapañcāśadvarṣāṇi tadudīritam ||488|| catvāriṃśatpūrūḍhānāṃ bhūmaṇḍalamakhaṇḍitam | triṃśattu puṣpamitrāṇāṃ ṣaṣṭirvasvagnimitrayoḥ ||489|| śataṃ rāsabharājānāṃ naravāhanamapyataḥ | catvāriṃśattato dvābhyāṃ catvāriṃśacchatadvayam ||49|| bhadravāṇasya tadājya guptānāṃ ca śatadvayam | ekaviṃśaśca varṣāṇi kālavinirudāhṛtam ||19|| dvicatvāriṃśadevātaḥ kalkirājasya rājatā | tato'jitaṃjayo rājā syādindrapurasaṃsthitaḥ ||492|| kaumārya maṇḍaleśatve vijaye rājyasaṃyame | cakrayādīnāṃ yathāyogyamitaḥ kālo nirūpyate ||493||
kramase bānabe varṣa, caubīsa varṣa, sattara varṣa, assī varṣa, sau varṣa, terāsī varṣa, paṃcānabe varṣa, aṭhahattara varṣa, bahattara varṣa, sāṭha varṣa aura cālīsa varṣa hai ||482-483|| chaha kāloṃmeṃ-se jaba tṛtīya kālameṃ palyakā āṭhavāṃ bhāga bākī rahā thā taba kramase caudaha kulakaroṃ aura unake bāda vṛṣabhadevakā janma huā thā| śeṣa tīrthaṃkaroṃ, cakravatiyoṃ, balabhadroṃ aura nārāyaṇoṃkā janma cauthe kāla meṃ niścita hai ||484-485|| jaba tīsare kālameṃ tīna varṣa sāḍha़e āṭha māha bākī rahe the taba bhagavān ṛṣabhadevakā mokṣa huā thā aura jaba cauthe kālameṃ tīna varṣa sāḍha़e āṭha māha śeṣa rahe the taba mahāvīrakā mokṣa hogā ||486||
jisa samaya bhagavān mahāvīrakā nirvāṇa hogā usa samaya yahā~ avantiputra pālaka nāmake rājākā rājyābhiṣeka hogā| vaha rājā prajākā acchī taraha pālana karegā aura usakā rājya sāṭha varṣa taka rahegā| usake bāda tad-tad deśoṃke rājāoṃkā eka sau pacapana varṣa taka rājya hogā ||487-488|| phira cālīsa varṣa taka puruḍha rājāoṃkā akhaṇḍa bhūmaṇḍala hogā| tadanantara tīsa varṣa taka puṣpamitrakā, sāṭha varṣa taka vasu aura agnimitrakā, sau varṣa taka rāsabha rājāoṃkā, phira cālīsa varṣa taka naravāhanakā, phira do sau bayālīsa varṣa taka kalki rājākā rājya hogā| usake bāda ajitaṃjaya nāmakā rājā hogā jisakī rājadhānī indrapura nagara hogī ||482-492|| aba inake āge cakravartī ādikī, kūmāra avasthā, maṇḍaleśvara daśā, digvijaya, rājya aura saṃyamameṃ jo kāla vyatīta huā hai usakā yathāyogya nirūpaṇa kiyā jātā hai ||423||

vihṛtya ciramīśānaḥ punarāgatya pūrvavat | girau raivatake tasthau samavasthānamaṇḍanaḥ ||13|| tatra sthitaṃ jinendra saṃ devendrāḥ sāndratejasaḥ | prāpya natvā natiṃ kṛtvā nijasthāneṣu susthitāḥ || 14 || vasudevo balaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sāntaḥpurasuhṛjjanaḥ | dvārikāprajayā yuktaḥ pradyumnādisutānvitaḥ ||15|| vibhūtyā parayāgatya śaiveryamabhivandyate | āsīnāḥ samavasthāne dharmaṃ śuśrūṣurīśvarāt ||16|| tatra dharmakathānte'sau jinaṃ navyā halāyudhaḥ | papraccha vastucittasthaṃ karakuḍmalitālikaḥ ||17|| nātha vaiśravaṇeneyaṃ nirmitā dvārikāpurī | kiyatānehasānto'syāḥ kṛtakā hi vinaśvarāḥ ||18|| nimajjet svata eveyaṃ kimu kālāntare'mbudhau | nimittāntarasānidhye kenacidvā' vināśyate ||19|| svāntakāle nimittard ko vā kṛṣṇasya yāsyati | jātānāṃ hi samastānāṃ jīvānāṃ niyatā mṛtiḥ || 20|| saṃyamapratipattirvā kālena kiyatā prabho | kṛṣṇasnehamahāpāśabaddhacittasya me mavet ||21|| iti pṛṣṭo jino'gādī dṛṣṭāśeṣaparāparaḥ | yāthātathyaṃ yathāpraśnaṃ yatpraśnottaravādyau ||22|| purīyaṃ dvādaśe varṣe rāma mathena hetunā | dvaipāyarnakumāreṇa muninā vakṣyate ruṣā || 23 ||

755
antaḥpura kī rāniyoṃ, mitrajana, dvārikākī prajā tathā pradyumna ādi putroṃse sahita vasudeva, baladeva tathā kṛṣṇa bhī baḍa़ī vibhūtike sātha āye aura bhagavān nemināthako namaskāra kara samavasaraṇa meṃ yathāsthāna baiṭha bhagavān se dharmaṃ śravaṇa karane lage || 15 - 16 || tadanantara dharnakathāke bāda jinendra bhagavānko namaskāra kara baladevane hātha joḍa़ lalāṭase lagā, apane hṛdaya meṃ sthita bāta pūchī || 17 ||| unhoṃne pūchā ki he bhagavan ! yaha dvārikāpurī kuberake dvārā racī gayī hai so isakā anta kitane samaya meṃ hogā| kyoṃki kṛtrima vastue~ avaśya hī naśvara hotī haiṃ || 18 || yaha dvārikāpurī kālāntara meṃ kyā apane āpa hī samudrameṃ ḍūba jāvegī ? athavā nimittāntarake sanadhāna meṃ kisī anya nimittase vināśako prāpta hogī ? kṛṣṇake apane antakāla meṃ nimittapaneko kauna prāpta hogā ? kyoṃki utpanna hue samasta jīvoṃkā maraṇa niścita hai | he prabho ! merā citta kṛṣṇake sneharūpī mahāpāśase ba~dhā huā hai ataḥ mujhe saṃyamako prāpti kitane samaya bāda hogī ? ||19-21 || isa prakāra baladevake pūchanepara samasta parāpara padārthoṃko dekhanevāle nemi jinendra, praśnake anusāra yathārthaṃ bāta kahane lage, so ṭhīka hī hai kyoṃki bhagavān praśnoṃkā uttara nirūpaṇa karanevāle hī the ||22||
unhoṃne kahā ki he rāma ! yaha purī bārahaveṃ varṣa meṃ madirā ke nimittase dvaipāyana munike dvārā krodhavaśa bhasma hogī ||23|| antima samaya meṃ śrīkṛṣṇa kauśāmbīke vanameṃ śayana kareṃge aura jarakumāra unake vināśameṃ kāraṇapaneko prāpta hogā ||24|| antaraṃga kāraṇake rahate hue pariṇativaśa

jānanto vastusadbhāvamato'bhyudayanāśayoḥ | harṣa bhuvi viṣādaṃ ca na gacchanti manasvinaḥ || 26 || bhavato'pi tapaḥprāptistannimittāttadā bhavet | bhavapaddhatimītasya brahmalokopapādinaḥ ||27|| dvaipāyanakumāro'sau rohiṇyāḥ sodaro yatiḥ | tadākarṇya vaco jainaṃ nirvedī tapasi sthitaḥ || 28 || avadheḥ pūraṇāyātaḥ pūrva deśamupetya saḥ | tapaścaritumārabdhaḥ kaṣāyatanuśoṣaṇam || 29 || duḥkhī jaratkumāraśca duḥkhitān bhrātṛbāndhavān | parisyajya gataḥ kāpi sa hariryatra nekṣyate || 30 || jaratkumāre pragate vanamekākini sthite | hariḥ snehākulo mene śūnyamātmānamātmani ||31|| cacāra mṛgasāmānyaṃ vijano vijanaṃ vanam | hariprāṇapriyaḥ prāṇān priyān hātumanāḥ kvacit || 32 || aispi janamānasya yādavā viviśuḥ purīm | āgāmiduḥkhasaṃbhāracintā saṃtaptamānasāḥ ||33|| ghoṣaṇāṃ kārayāṃcakre cakrī puri balānvitaḥ | madyāṅgāni ca mayāni visṛjyantāmiti drutam ||34|| piṣṭakiṇvādimacāṅgaistato mayāni madyapaiḥ | kṣiptāni saśilā kuṇḍe' kādambagirigahvare ||35|| kadambavanakuṇḍeṣu 'muktā kādambarī tu yā | sāimapākaviśeṣasya hetutvenāvatiṣṭhate ||36|| tathānyā ghoṣaṇādāyi kṛṣṇena hitabuddhinā | dvārikāyāṃ mahāpuryāṃ strīṇāṃ puṃsāṃ ca śṛṇvatām ||37|| pitā me yadi vā mātā sutā cāntaḥpurāṅganā | tapasyantu mate jaine vārayāmi na tānaham ||38||

bāhya hetu jagat ke abhyudaya tathā kṣayameṃ kāraṇa hote haiṃ isalie vastuke svabhāvako jānanevāle uttama manuṣya abhyudaya tathā kṣayake samaya pṛthivīpara kabhī harṣaṃ aura viṣādako prāpta nahīṃ hote || 25-26||
saṃsāra ke mārga se bhayabhīta rahanevāle āpako bhī usī samaya kṛṣṇakī mṛtyukā nimitta pākara tapakī prāpti hogī tathā tapakara āpa brahmasvarga meṃ utpanna hoṃge ||27|| dvaipāyanakumāra rohiṇīkā bhāī - baladevakā māmā thā so usa samaya bhagavān ke vacana sunakara vaha saṃsārase virakta ho muni hokara tapa karane lagā ||28|| vaha bāraha varṣa kī avadhiko pūrṇa karaneke lie yahāṃse pūrva deśakī ora calā gayā aura vahāṃ kaṣāya tathā śarīrako sukhānevālā tapa karane lagā ||29|| 'mere nimittase kṛṣṇakī mṛtyu hogī' yaha jānakara jaratkumāra bhī bahuta duḥkhī huā aura duḥkhase yukta bhāībandhuoṃkī choḍa़kara vaha kahī aisī jagaha calā gayā jahā~ kṛṣṇa dikhāī bhī na deṃ || 30 || jaba jaratkumāra vanameṃ jākara akelā rahane lagā taba snehase ākula śrīkṛṣṇa ne apane-āpameṃ apaneāpako sūnā anubhava kiyā || 31 || jo kṛṣṇako prāṇoṃke samāna pyārā thā aisā jaratkumāra kahīṃ priya prāṇoṃko choḍa़ne kī icchāse akelā hī mṛgoṃke samāna nirjana vanameṃ bhramaṇa karane lagā ||32|| idhara āgāmī duḥkhake bhārako cintāse jinake mana santapta ho rahe the aise yādava loga bhagavānko namaskāra kara nagarīmeṃ praviṣṭa hue ||33|| baladevake sātha kṛṣṇane nagara meṃ yaha ghoṣaṇā karā dī ki madya banāne ke sādhana aura madya śīghra hī alaga kara diye jāyeṃ || 34 || ghoṣaṇā sunate hī madyapāya logoṃne piṣṭa, kiṇva ādi madirā banāne ke sādhanoṃ ke sātha-sātha samasta madirāko śilāoṃ ke bīca bane hue kuṇḍase yukta kādamba girikī guhā meṃ pheṃka diyā || 35 || kadamba vanake kuṇḍoṃ meṃ jo madirā choḍa़o gayī thī vaha aśmapāka viśeṣake kāraṇa una kuṇḍoṃ meṃ bharī rahī | bhāvārthaṃ - pattharako kuṇḍiyoṃmeṃ jisa prakāra koī tarala padārtha sthira rahā ātā hai usī prakāra kadamba vanake śilākuṇḍoṃ meṃ vaha maṃdirā sthira rahī āyī || 36 || hitakī icchā rakhanevāle kṛṣṇane samasta strī-puruṣoṃke sunate samaya dvārikāpurīseṃ dūsarī ghoṣaṇā yaha ṭī ki yadi mere pitā, mātā, putrī athavā antaḥpurakī strī ādi koī bhī jinendra bhagavān‌ke matameṃ dīkṣita ho tapa karanā cāheṃ to meṃ unheṃ manā nahīṃ karatā hū~- unheṃ tapa karanekī merī orase

tadanantara bahuta bhāro tapase yukta jo dvaipāyana muni the ve bhī bhrāntivaśa bārahaveṃ varṣako vyatīta huā mānate hue bārahaveṃ varṣameṃ vahāṃ ā pahuṃce| 'jinendra bhagavānaśā ādeśa pūrā ho cukā hai' yaha vicārakara jinako buddhi vimūḍha़ ho rahī thī tathā jo samyagdarśanase dubala the aise dvaipāyana muni bārahaveṃ varṣa meṃ vahīṃ ā pahu~ce ||46-47|| ve kisī samaya dvārikāke bāhara parvatake nikaṭa, mārgameṃ ātāpana yoga dhāraṇa kara pratimāyogase virājamāna the ||48|| usī samaya vanakrīḍa़āse thake evaṃ pyāsase pīḍa़ita śamba ādi kumāroṃne kādamba vanake kuṇḍoṃmeṃ sthita usa śarābako pī liyā ||49|| kadamba vanameṃ choḍa़ī evaṃ kadamba rūpase ḍabaroṃke rūpameṃ sthita usa madhura madirāko pīkara ve saba kumāra vikāra bhāvako prāpta

harivaṃśapurāṇe vāruṇī sā purāṇāpi paripākavaśādvaśān | taruṇānakarodgāḍhaṃ taruṇīvāruṇekṣaṇān ||51|| asaṃbaddhāni gāyanto nṛtyantaḥ skhalitakramāḥ| muktakeśāḥ kṛtottaṃsāḥ kaṇṭhālambivanamrajaḥ ||52|| āgacchantaḥ muraḥ sarve dṛṣṭvārkāmimukhaṃ munim | pratyabhijñāya cāvocan ghūrṇamānanirīkṣaṇāḥ ||53|| so'yaṃ dvaipāyano yogī dvāravatyāḥ kilāntakṛt | mavitāsmākamadyāne va prayāti varākakaḥ ||54|| ityuktvā taṃ kumārāste loṣṭumiḥ sarvato'śmabhiḥ | prajaghnunighṛṇāstāvadyāvatpatati bhūtale ||55|| krodhādhikyāttato dadhe duṣṭoṣṭho bhṛkuṭīkuṭīm | pralayāya yadanā saḥ prāyaḥ svatapaso'pi ca ||56|| praviṣṭāstu purī vyālā vyālā iva calācalāḥ | kumārāḥ kaściduktaṃ tu durvṛttaṃ laghu viṣṇave ||57|| balanārāyaṇau śrutvā dvaipāyanamupaśrutam | dvārikāyāḥ kṣayaṃ prāptaṃ manāte jinabhāṣitam ||58|| sabhramaṇa pariprāpto parityaktaparicchadī| muni kṣamayituṃ krodhājvalantamiva pāvakam ||59|| dṛṣṭaḥ saṃkliṣṭadhīstābhyāṃ bhrūbhaṅgaviṣamānanaḥ | dunirīkṣyekṣaṇaḥ kṣīṇaḥ kaṇṭhaprāṇo vibhīṣaṇaḥ ||60|| kṛtāñjalipuṭābhyāṃ sa praṇipatya mahādarāt | yācyate yācanā bandhyaṃ jānadyāmapi mohataḥ ||6|| rakṣyatāṃ rakṣyatā sādho ciraṃ suparirakṣitaḥ | kṣamāmūlastapobhāro dhakṣyate krodhavahninā ||62|| mokṣasādhanamapyeṣa tapo dūṣayati kṣaṇāt | caturvargaripuḥ krodhaḥ krodhaḥ svaparanāśakaḥ ||63||
ho gaye ||50|| yadyapi vaha madirā purānī thī tathāpi paripākake vaśase usane taruṇa strīke samāna, lāla-lāla netroṃko dhāraṇa karanevāle una taruṇa kumāroṃko atyadhika vaśībhūta kara liyā ||51|| phalasvarūpa ve saba kumāra asambaddha gāne lage, laḍa़khaḍa़āte pairoṃse nācane lage, unake keśa bikhara gaye, ābhūṣaṇa asta-vyasta ho gaye aura unhoṃne apane kaṇṭhoṃmeṃ jaṃgalī phūloṃkī mālāeṃ pahana līṃ ||52|| jaba ve saba nagarakī ora ā rahe the taba unhoṃne sūryake sammukha khaḍa़e hue dvaipāyana muniko pahacāna liyā| pahacānate hī unake netra ghūmane lage| unhoṃne āpasameṃ kahā ki yaha vahī dvaipāyana yogī hai.jo dvārikākā nāśa karanevālā hogā| āja yaha becārā hama logoṃke āge kahāṃ jāyegā ? ||53-54|| itanā kahakara una nirdaya kumāroṃne luḍḍoṃ aura pattharoṃse unheṃ tabataka mārā jabataka ki ve ghāyala hokara pṛthivīpara nahīṃ gira paḍa़e ||55|| tadanantara krodhakī adhikatāse muni apanā oṭha ḍaṃsane lage tathā yādavoṃ aura apane tapako naṣṭa karaneke lie unhoṃne bhrukuṭī caḍha़ā lī ||56|| madamāte hāthiyoṃke samāna atyanta cañcala kumāra jaba dvārikāpurīmeṃ praviṣṭa hue taba unameṃ se kinhīṃne yaha durghaṭanā śīghra hī kṛṣṇake lie jā sunāyī ||57|| baladeva tathā nārāyaṇane dvaipāyanase sambandha rakhanevālī isa ghaṭanāko sunakara samajha liyā ki jinendra bhagavānne jo dvārikākā kṣaya batalāyā thā vaha ā pahuṃcā hai-aba śīghra hī dvārikākā kṣaya honevālā hai ||58|| baladeva aura nārāyaṇa ghabaḍa़āhaṭavaśa saba prakārakā parikara choḍa़, krodhase agnike samāna jalate hue muniko śānta karaneke lie, unase kṣamā māṃganeke lie unake pāsa dauḍa़e gaye ||59|| jinakī buddhi atyanta saṃkleśamaya thī, bhrakūṭīke bhaṃgase jinakā mukha viṣama ho rahā thā, jinake netra duḥkhase
gya the. jinake prāṇa kaṇṭhagata ho rahe the aura jo atyanta bhayaṃkara the aise dvaipāyana muniko baladeva aura kṛṣṇane dekhā| unhoṃne hātha joḍa़kara baḍa़e ādarase muniko praṇāma kiyā aura 'hamārī yācanā vyartha hogī' yaha jānate hue bhī mohavaśa yācanā kī ||60-61|| unhoṃne kahā ki, 'he sādho ! āpane cirakālase jisako atyadhika rakṣā ko hai tathā kṣamā hī jisakī jaḍa़ hai aisā yaha tapakā bhāra krodharūpī agnise jala rahā hai so isakī rakṣā kī jāye, rakṣā kī jāye ||62|| yaha krodha mokṣake sādhanabhūta tapako kṣaṇa-bharameṃ dūṣita kara detā hai, yaha dharma, artha kāma aura mokṣa ina cāroṃ vargoṃkā śatru hai tathā nija aura parako naṣṭa karanevālā hai ||63||

puṇyodayātpurā prāptāvunnatiṃ yau janātigām | cakrādiranasaṃpannau balinau balakeśavau ||1|| puṇyakṣayāttu tāveva ratnabandhuvivarjitau | prāṇamātraparīvārau śokamāravaśīkṛtau ||2|| prasthitau dakṣiṇāmāśāṃ jīvitāśāvalambinau | kṣutpipāsāpariśrāntau yāta satkāṅkṣiṇau pathi ||3|| uddiśya pāṇḍavān yāntau mathurāṃ dakṣiṇāmumau | hastavapraṃ puraṃ prāptau tatrodyāne hariḥ sthitaḥ || 4 || gato'nnapāna mānetuṃ kṛtasaṃketako'grajaḥ | vastrasaṃvṛtasarvāṅgaḥ praviṣṭaśva tataḥ puram ||5|| acchadanto nṛpastatra dhārtarāṣṭro'vatiṣṭhate | pṛthivyāṃ prathito dhanvo yadurandhadurantadhīḥ || 6 || janairjanitasaṃghaṭṭeḥ rūpapāśavaśīkṛtaiḥ | praviśya tatpurīṃ vīro dṛśyamānaḥ savismayaiḥ ||7|| "kaṇṭakaṃ kuṇḍalaṃ cāpi datvā kasyacidāpaṇe | annapānamupādāya nirgacchan vīkṣya rakṣakaiḥ ||8|| vijñāya baladevo'yamiti rājñe niveditaḥ | tatastena vadhāyāsya preṣitaṃ sakalaṃ balam ||9 || saṃghabhūpuradvāre sainyasya balarodhinaḥ | balena saṃjñayāhūtaḥ kṛṣṇaśca drutamāgataḥ || 10 || "annapānaṃ susaṃsthāpya gajastambhaṃ balo'grahīt | kṛṣṇastu parighaṃ ghoraṃ kiṃcitkupitamānasaḥ ||11||
jo baladeva aura kṛṣṇa pahale puṇyodayase lokottara unnatiko prāpta the, cakra ādi ratnoṃse sahita the, balavān the, balabhadra evaṃ nārāyaṇa-padake dhāraka the ve hī aba puṇya kṣīṇa ho jāne se ratna tathā bandhujanoṃse rahita ho gaye, prāṇamātra hī unake sāthī raha gaye aura śokake vaśībhūta ho gaye || 1-2 ||
kevala jīvita rahanekī āśā rakhanevāle donoṃ bhāī dakṣiṇa diśā kī ora cale | vahā~ ve bhūkha-pyāsase vyākula ho mārgameṃ kisī uttama āśrayakī icchā karane lage ||3|| pāṇḍavoṃko lakṣya kara ve dakṣiṇa mathurākī ora jā rahe the ki mārga meṃ hastavapra nāmaka nagara meṃ pahu~ce | vahā~ kṛṣṇa to udyānameṃ ṭhahara gaye aura baladeva saṃketa kara tathā vastra se apanā samasta śarīra ḍha~kakara anna pānī lene ke lie nagara meṃ praviṣṭa hue || 4-5 || usa nagara meṃ acchadanta nāmakā rājā rahatā thā, dhṛtarāṣṭra ke vaṃśakā thā, jo pṛthivīmeṃ prasiddha dhanurdhārī aura yādavoṃke chidra ḍhū~ḍhanevālā thā || 6|| vīra baladevane jyoṃ hī usa nagara meṃ praveśa kiyā tyoṃ hī unake rūpa-pāśase vaśībhūta hue logoṃ ke jhuṇḍa ke jhuṇḍa āścaryase cakita ho unheṃ dekhane lage || 7 || baladevane bājārameṃ kisīke lie apanā kaḍa़ā aura kuṇḍala dekara usase annapāna - khāne-pīnekī sāmagrī kharīdo aura use lekara jaba ve nagara ke bāhara nikala rahe the taba rājāke paharedāroṃne dekhakara tathā 'yaha baladeva hai' isa prakāra pahacāna kara rājāke lie khabara kara dī | phira kyā thā, rājāne unake vadhake lie apanī samasta senā bheja dī ||8- 9||
nagarake dvārapara baladevako rokanevālī senākī baḍa़ī bhīḍa़ ikaṭṭhī ho gayī | baladevane saṃketa se kṛṣṇako bulāyā aura ve śīghra hī vahā~ ā gaye ||10|| baladevane anna-pānako kisī jagaha acchī taraha rakhakara hāthī bā~dhanekā eka khambhā liyā tathā kṛṣṇane kucha kruddhacitta ho bhayaṃkara argala uṭhāyā || 11 ||
1. prāptāmunnati ma. | 2. yatkāṅkṣiṇī ma., kha., ṅa. | 3. yātī kha., ṅa, ma. | 4. ' sa tatpuraṃ ' kha. | 5. kaṇṭhakaṃ ma. | 6. annaṃ pānaṃ ca susthāpya ma | annaṃ pānaṃ ca saṃsthāpya kha. |

harivaṃśapurāṇe
cataraṅgaṃ tata: sainyaṃ sanāyakamitastataḥ | hanyamānaṃ nanāśābhyāṃ vihvalībhūtamānasam ||12|| samādāyānnapānaṃ to nirgatya nagarānataḥ | vanaṃ vijayamāgatya saro ramyamapaśyatām ||13|| snāsvā sarasi tau tatra jinaṃ navā manaḥsthitam | citramabhyavahṛtyānaṃ payaḥ pītvātiśītalam ||14|| viśramya ca kṣaṇaṃ vīrau prayāntau dakṣiṇāṃ diśam | kauśāmbyākhyaṃ vanaṃ bhīmaṃ praviṣṭau paradurgamam ||15|| khagarāvakharārāvamukharīkṛtadigmukham | tṛṣṇārtamṛgayūthānāṃ gamyaṃ pronmṛgatṛṣṇakam ||16|| grīṣmogratāpaparuṣavahanmārutadussaham | dāvadagdhalatājālagulmapādapakhaṇḍakam ||17|| asaṃbhāvyāmbhasi bhrāmyatśvāpadaśvāsaśabdake | vane vanecarodbhinnakumbhikumbhāstamauktike ||18|| ārohati viyanmadhyaṃ sutīne tīverociṣi | jagī janārdano jyeṣṭhaṃ guṇajyeṣṭhamiti śramī ||19|| pipāsākulito'tyarthamārya śuṣkauṣṭhatālukaḥ | śaknomi padamapyekaṃ na ca yātumataḥ param ||20|| tatpāyaya payaḥ śītamārya tṛṣṇāpahāri mām | sadarśanamivānādau saṃsāre sāravarjite ||21|| ityukta snehasaṃcārasamāīkṛtamānasaḥ | sa jagāda balaḥ kṛṣṇamuṣṇaniśvāsamocinam ||22|| tāta śītalamānīya pānīyaṃ pāyayāmyaham | tvaṃ jinasmaraṇāmmobhistāvattaṣṇāṃ vimardaya ||2|| nirasyati payastṛṣṇāṃ stokā velāmidaṃ punaḥ | jinasmaraṇapānīyaṃ pītaṃ tāṃ mūlato'syati ||24||
tadanantara ina donoṃke dvārā māra paḍanepara vaha caturaṃga senā apane senāpatike sātha vihvalacitta ho idhara-udhara bhāga gayī||12||
tadanantara anna-pāna lekara donoṃ bhāī nagarase nikala vijaya nāmaka vanameṃ āye| vahā~ unhoṃne eka sundara sarovara dekhā ||13|| sarovarameṃ snāna kara hṛdayameṃ sthita jinendra bhagavānko namaskāra kara nānā prakārakā bhojana kiyā, atyanta śītala pāno piyā aura kṣaṇa-bhara viśrāma kiyā| viśrāmake bāda donoṃ vīra phira dakṣiṇa diśākī ora cale aura calate-calate dūsaroṃke lie atyanta durgama kauśāmbī nāmake bhayaṃkara vanameṃ praviṣṭa hue ||14-15|| usa vanakī samasta diśāe~ pakṣiyoṃ tathā śṛgāloṃke śabdoṃse śabdāyamāna thīṃ, pyāsase pīḍa़ita mṛgoṃke jhuṇḍa vahāṃ idhara-udhara phira rahe the, baḍa़ī ūṃco mṛgatṛṣṇā vahāṃ uṭha rahī thī, grīṣmake ugna santāpase kaṭhora bahatī huī vāyuse vaha vana atyanta asahya thā, tathā dāvānalase vahā~ko latāoṃke samūha, jhāḍa़iyāṃ aura vṛkṣoṃke samūha jala gaye the ||16-17||
jahāṃ pānīke milanekī koī sambhāvanā nahīṃ thī, jahā~ dauḍa़te hue jaṃgalī jānavaroṃkī śvāsakā śabda ho rahā thā, tathā jahāṃ vanecaroṃke dvārā vidīrṇa kiye hue hāthiyoṃke gaṇḍasthaloṃse bikharakara motī idhara-udhara paḍa़e the, aise vanameṃ pahu~cakara jaba atyanta tīkṣṇa sūrya ākāśake madhyameṃ ārūḍha़ ho rahā thā taba thake hue kṛṣṇane guṇoṃse śreṣṭha baḍa़e bhāībaladevase kahā ki 'he ārya ! maiṃ pyāsase bahuta vyākula hū~, mere oṭha aura tālu sūkha gaye haiṃ, aba isake āge maiṃ eka ḍaga bhī calaneke lie samartha nahīṃ hū~||18-20|| isalie he ārya ! anādi evaṃ sārahīna saṃsārameṃ samyagdarśanake samāna tṛṣṇāko dūra karanevālā śītala jala mujhe pilāie '||21||
isa prakāra kahanepara snehake saṃcārase jinakā mana ārdra ho rahā thā aise baladevane garama-garama śvāsa choḍa़nevāle kṛṣṇase kahā ki 'he bhāī! maiṃ śītala pānī lākara abhī tumheṃ pilātā hū~ tuma tabataka jinendra bhagavānke smaraṇarūpī jalase pyāsako dūra karo || 22-23 || yaha pānī to thoḍa़e samaya takake lie hī pyāsako dūra karatā hai para jinendra bhagavānkā smaraṇarūpī
1. prayāto ma. | 2. sūyeṃ| 3. mānasaṃ ma.| 4. kṛṣṇaṃ doghaniḥśvāsa ga.| 5. tataḥ ma.|

dviṣaṣṭitamaḥ sargaḥ
chāyāyāmasya vṛkṣasya śīvakāyāmihāsyatām | bhānayāmi jalaṃ te'haṃ śītalaṃ śītalāśayāt ||25|| agrajaḥ pratipācavamanujaṃ manasā vahan | jagāma jalamānetuṃ nijaṃ śramamacintayan ||26|| kṛṣṇo'pi ca yathoddiṣṭā tarucchāyāṃ dhanāṃ śritaḥ | kṣitau mṛdumṛdi ślakṣṇavāsasā saṃvṛtāṅgakaḥ ||27|| vāme jānuni vinyasya dakṣiṇaṃ caraṇa kṣaṇam | śramavyapohanāyāsāvaśeta gahane hariḥ ||28|| taṃ pradeśaṃ taidaivāsau jarāsūnuryadṛcchayā | ekākī paryaṭanprāpto mṛgayāvyasanapriyaḥ ||29|| yo harisnehasaṃmāro hariprāṇarirakṣayā | dvārikāyā vinirgasya prāviśanmṛgavadvanam ||30|| sa tatra vidhinānīya tadānīṃ viniyojitaḥ | adrākṣīdūrato'spaṣṭaṃ kiṃcidane dhanurdharaḥ ||31|| maruñcalitavasāntajanitabhrāntirantike | prasuptamṛgakarṇo'yaṃ calatīti vicintya saḥ ||32|| gulmagūḍhavapurgāḍhamākarṇākṛṣṭakārmukaḥ | vivyādha vyādhīstīkṣṇaśareṇa caraṇaṃ hare ||33|| "viddhapādatalaḥ śaurirutthāya sahasākhilāḥ | diśo nirīkṣya so'dṛṣṭā paramuccairjagāviti ||34|| vipādatalo'haṃ bho kenākāraṇavairiṇā | kathyatāṃ kulamāsmīyaṃ nāma ca sphuṭamatra me ||35|| ajñātakulanāmānaṃ naraṃ nāvadhiṣaṃ raṇe | kadācidapi yo'haṃ hī kiṃ mamedamupāgatam ||36|| tad bravītu bhavān ko mo yo'jñātakulanāmakaḥ | ajñātavairasaṃbandho vane jāto mamāntakaḥ ||30||
pānī pīte hī ke sātha usa tṛṣṇāko jaḍa़-mūlase naṣṭa kara detā hai ||24|| tuma yahā~ isa vṛkṣakī śītala chāyāmeṃ baiṭho, maiṃ tumhāre lie sarovarase śītala pānī lātā hū~||25||
___ isa prakāra choṭe bhāī kṛṣṇase kahakara use apane hṛdayameṃ dhāraṇa karate hue baladeva apane śramakā vicāra na kara pānī leneke lie gaye ||26|| idhara kṛṣṇa bhī batāyī huī vṛkṣako saghana chāyāmeṃ jā pahu~ce aura komala vakhase śarīrako ḍhaṃkakara mṛdu mṛttikāse yukta pṛthivīpara paḍa़ rahe | usī saghana vanameṃ ve thakāvaṭa dūra karaneke lie bāyeṃ ghuṭanepara dāhinā pāṃva rakhakara kṣaṇa-bharake lie so gaye ||27-28||
śikāra-vyasanakā premī jaratkumāra akelā usa vanameṃ ghūma rahā thā, so apanī icchāse usī samaya usa sthānapara ā pahu~cā ||29bhāgyakī bāta dekho ki kṛṣṇake snehabharā jo jaratkumāra unake prāṇoṃkī rakṣākī icchāse dvārikāse nikalakara magakī taraha vanameṃ praviṣṭa ho gayā thā vahī usa samaya vidhātāke dvārā lākara usa sthānapara upasthita kara diyā gayā| dhanurdhārī jaratkumārane dūrase āge dekhā to use kucha aspaṣṭa-sā dikhāyī diyā ||30-31|| usa samaya kṛṣṇake vastrakā chora vāyuse hila rahā thā isalie jaratkumārako yaha bhrānti ho gayī ki yaha pāsa hī meṃ soye hue mṛgakā kāna hila rahā hai| phira kyā thā jhāḍa़ose jisakā śarīra chipā huā thā aura śikārīke samāna jisakī krūra buddhi ho gayī thī aise jaratkumārane baḍa़ī majabūtīse kāna taka dhanuṣa khīṃcakara tīkṣṇa bāṇase kṛṣṇakā paira vedha diyā ||32-33|| padatalake viddha hote hī śrīkṛṣṇa sahasā uṭha baiṭhe aura saba diśāoṃ meṃ dekhaneke bāda bhī jaba koī dūsarā manuṣya nahīṃ dikhā taba unhoṃne jorase isa prakāra kahā ki kisa akāraṇa vairīne merā padatala vedhā hai| vaha yahāṃ mere lie apanā kula tathā nāma sāpha-sāpha batalāye ||34-35|| jisa mujhane yuddha meṃ kabhī bhī ajñāta-kula aura ajñāta nāmavāle manuṣyakā vadha nahīṃ kiyā āja usa mere lie yaha kyā vipatti ā paḍa़ī ? ||36|| isalie kaho ki ajñātakula nāmavāle āpa kauna haiṃ ? tathā jisake vairakā patā nahīṃ aisā kauna isa vanameṃ merā ghātaka huā hai ? ||37||
1. saṃbhūtānakaḥ kha., ka. | 2. śramavyapohanāya + aso + aśeta | 3. tadevāsī ma.| 4. viddhatālapadaḥ ma. | 5. yajjñāta ma., ka , ṅa.|

ityukta so'bravīdasti harivaṃśodbhavo nṛpaḥ | vasudeva iti khyātaḥ pitā yo halicakriṇoḥ ||38|| sūnurjaratkumāro'smi tasyāhamativallabhaḥ | ekavīro bhramāmyatra vane bhīrudurāsade ||39|| so'haṃ nemijinādeśamīrurvanacarairvane | dvādaśābdapramāṇaṃ ca vasāmyatra priyānujaḥ ||10|| iyantaṃ vasatā kālamaraṇye vacanaṃ mayā | āryalokasya kasyāpi na śrutaṃ ko bhavāniha ||41|| iti śrutvā haritviā bhrātaraṃ snehakātaraḥ | ehyahi bhrātaratreti saṃbhrameṇa tamāhvayat ||42|| so'pi jñātvānujaṃ prāpto hākāramukharānanaḥ | kṣitikṣiptadhanurbāṇo nipasyāsthācca pādayoḥ ||43|| utthāpya taṃ hariḥ prāha kaṇṭhalagnaṃ mahāśucam | mātiśokaṃ kṛthā jyeṣṭha durlakyā bhavitavyatā ||44|| pramādasya nirāsāya nirastasukhasaṃpadā | ciraṃ puruṣaśārdūla sevitā vanavāsitā ||45|| karoti sajano yatnaṃ duryaśaḥpāpamīrukaḥ | deve tu kuṭile tasya sa yatnaḥ kiṃ kariṣyati ||46|| tatastena hariḥ pṛṣṭo vanāgamanakāraṇam | ādito'kathayavṛttaṃ dvārikādāhadāruṇam ||47|| śrutvā gotrakṣayaṃ so'pi pralāpamukharo'vadat | hā bhrātaḥ kṛtamātithyaṃ mayā te ciradarśanāt ||48|| kiṃ karomi va gacchāmi va labhe cittanirvṛtim | duḥkhaṃ ca duryaśo loke hantrā te hā mayārjitam ||49|| ityādi pralapanuktaḥ kṛṣṇenāsau sucetasā | pralāpaṃ tyaja rājendra kṛtsnaṃ svakṛtabhuga jagat ||50||
śrīkṛṣṇake isa prakāra kahanepara jaratkumārane kahā ki harivaṃśameṃ utpanna hue eka vasudeva nāmake rājā haiṃ jo baladeva aura kṛṣṇake pitā haiṃ| maiṃ jaratkumāra nāmakā unhīṃkā atiśaya pyārā putra hū~| jahāṃ kāyara manuṣya praveśa nahīṃ kara sakate aise isa vanameṃ maiṃ akelā hī vīra ghūmatā rahatā hū~| nemijinendrane ājñā kī thī ki jaratkumārake dvārā kṛṣṇakā maraṇa hogā so maiṃ unakī isa ājñāse ḍarakara bāraha varṣase isa vanameṃ raha rahā hū~| mujhe apanā choṭā bhāī kṛṣṇa bahuta hī pyārā thā, isalie itane samayase yahā~ raha rahā hū~, isa bīcameṃ maiṃne kisī āryakā nāma bhī nahīṃ sunā| phira āpa yahā~ kauna haiṃ ? ||38-41||
jaratkumārake yaha vacana suna kṛṣṇane jāna liyā ki yaha hamārā bhāī hai taba snehase kātara ho unhoṃne 'he bhāī! yahā~ āo, yahā~ āo' isa prakāra saṃbhramapūrvaka use bulāyā ||42|| jaratkumārane bhī jāna liyā ki yaha hamārā choṭā bhāī hai taba 'hāya hāya' śabdase mukhako śabdāyamāna karatā huā vaha vahāṃ āyā aura dhanuṣa-bāṇako pṛthivīpara pheṃka śrīkṛṣṇake caraṇoṃmeṃ ā girā ||43|
kṛṣṇane use uṭhāyā to vaha kaṇṭhameṃ lagakara mahāśoka karane lagā | kṛṣṇane kahā ki he baḍa़e bhāī ! atyadhika śoka mata karo, honahāra alaṃghanīya hotī hai ||44|| he śreṣṭha puruṣa ! āpane pramādakā nirākaraṇa karaneke lie samasta sukhasampadāoṃko choḍa़ cirakāla taka vanameṃ nivāsa karanā svīkṛta kiyā| apayaśa aura pāpase ḍaranevālā sajjana puruṣa buddhipūrvaka prayatna karatā hai parantu daivake kuṭila honepara usakā vaha yatna kyā kara sakatā hai ? ||45-46||
tadanantara jaratkumārane kṛṣṇase vanameṃ ānekā kāraṇa pūchā to unhoṃne prārambhase lekara dvārikādāha takakā saba dāruṇa samācāra kaha sunāyā ||47|| gotrakā kṣaya sunakara jaratkumāra pralāpase mukhara hotā huā bolā ki hā bhāī ! cirakālake bāda āpa dikhe aura maiṃne āpakā yaha atithi-satkāra kiyā ! ||48|| maiṃ kyā karū ? kahā~ jāū~ ? cittakī śānti kahā~ prāpta karūṃ? hā kṛṣṇa ! tujhe mārakara maiṃne lokameṃ duḥkha tathā apayaśa donoṃ prāpta kiye ||49|| ityādi rūpase vilāpa karate hue jaratkumārase uttama hṛdayake dhāraka kṛṣṇane kahā ki he rājendra ! pralāpako
1. gotrakṣathaḥ ma.|

hai ! ||23|| 'bhojarājakā kula tathā samasta yādavoṃkā kṣaya ho jānese maiṃ bandhurahita ho gayā hū~' yaha socakara kyā tū mohako prāpta ho rahā hai ? para aisā karanā ucita nahīṃ| he dṛḍha़pratijña ! yadi tū aura maiṃ jīvita hū~ to samajha ki hamāre samasta bandhuoṃkā samūha jīvita hai ||24|| anekoṃ pūrva janmameṃ tathā isa janmameṃ bhī nirantara merī ora tū sthira nayana hokara dekhatā rahā phira bhī tujhe tṛpti nahīṃ huī phira āja tū tṛpta kaise ho gayā ? ||25|| hāya ! mohavaśa tujhe akelā choḍa़ pānīke lie gaye hue maiṃne lokake sārabhūta nararūpī ratnoṃkā ābhūṣaṇa apahṛta karā liyā| anyathā mere pāsa rahate ise haranevālā kauna thā ? ||26|| are bhāī ! tū to kaṃsake krodha aura madarūpī parvatako naṣṭa karaneke lie vajrasvarūpa thā| bhūmigocarī aura vidyādhararūpī soko naṣṭa karane ke lie garuḍasvarūpa thā aura jarāsandhake yaśarūpī sāgarako pīnevālā thā para kheda hai ki tu isa goṣpadameṃ ḍūba gayā ||27||

uttara deneke bāda vaha eka sūkhe vṛkṣako sīṃcane lagā | baladevane phira pūchā- bhāī ! sūkhe vṛkṣako sīṃcanese kyā lābha hai ? isakā devane uttara diyā ki mṛta kṛṣṇako snānādi karānese kyā lābha hai ? isa prakāra usa devane baḍa़ī kaṭhināīse baladevako samajhāyā || 66 || pratibodhako prāpta hue baladeva kahane lage ki kṛṣṇa sacamuca hī prāṇarahita ho gayā hai | he bhadra mānuṣa ! tū jo kaha rahā hai vaha aisā hī hai, yahī satya hai, isameṃ raṃcamātra bhī anyathā bāta nahīṃ hai; he satpuruṣa ! he bhavya ! tūne ṭhīka hī kahā hai ||67 || isake uttara meṃ devane kahā ki yahā~ jo kucha huā hai vaha saba nemijinendra pahale hī

sāmparāyacāritra anivārya rūpase sabhīke hote haiṃ aura parihāraviśuddhi kinhīṃ-kinhīṃke hotā hai isalie jinake parihāraviśuddhi nahīṃ hogā unake cāra cāritroṃse aura jinake parihāraviśuddhi hogā unake pāṃca cāritroṃse siddhi hotī hai, yaha bhūtārthagrāhī nayako apekṣā hai| pratyutpannagrāhī nayakī apekṣā caudahaveṃ guṇasthānameṃ eka paramayathākhyāta cāritra hī hotā hai isalie eka cāritrase hī siddhi prāpta honekā kathana hai ||16|| pratyeka buddha aura bodhitabuddha-anuyogase vicāra karanepara pratyeka buddha jo ki apane-āpa ratnatrayako prāpta hote haiṃ aura bodhita buddha jo ki dūsaroṃke upadeśase ratnatraya prāpta karate haiṃ-donoṃko siddhi prāpta hotī hai-donoṃ hī mokṣa jāte haiṃ ||97|| jñāna anuyogase vicāra karanepara pratyutpannagrāhī nayakī apekṣā eka kevalajñānase hī siddhi hotī hai aura bhatārthagrāhī nayakī apekṣā do, tīna aura cāra jñānoṃse siddhi hotī hai| bhāvārtha-kinhīṃ jīvoṃkī kevalajñānake pūrva mati aura śrutameṃ do jñāna hote haiṃ| kinhīṃko mati, śruta, avadhi athavā mati, śruta, manaḥparyaya ye tīna jñāna hote haiṃ| aura kinhīṃko mati, śruta, avadhi, manaḥparyaya ye cāra jñāna hote haiṃ| avagāhanā anuyogase vicāra karanepara avagāhanāke utkṛṣṭa, jadhanya aura madhyamake bhedase tīna bheda hote haiṃ| inameṃ yukta jīvoṃko utkṛṣṭa avagāhanā kucha kama pāṃca-sau paccīsa dhanuṣa hai aura jaghanya avagāhanā kucha kama sāḍha़e tīna hātha hai| madhyama avagāhanāke yathāsambhava aneka vikalpa kahe gaye haiṃ| ina avagāhanāoṃmeṃ-se.jīva kisī eka avagāhanāse siddha hotā hai ||18-100|| antara anuyogako apekṣā vicāra karanepara antarakā artha śanyakālavirahakāla ho
honevāle jīvoṃmeṃ jaghanya antara eka samayakā aura utkṛṣṭa antara chaha māhakā hotā hai ||101|| saṃkhyā anuyogako apekṣā vicāra karanepara jaghanyarūpase eka samayameṃ eka hī jīva siddha hotā hai aura utkṛṣṭatāse eka sau āṭha jīva taka siddha hote haiṃ ||102|| alpabahutva anuyogakī apekṣā vicāra karanepara kṣetrādi bhedoṃse bhinna jīvoṃmeṃ jo paraspara saṃkhyākā bheda hai vaha alpabahutva kahalātā hai| yaha alpabahutva pratyutpannagrāhī nayakī apekṣā siddhikṣetrameṃ nahīṃ hai kintu bhūtārthagrāhī nayako apekṣā usakā kucha vicāra kiyā jātā hai| kṣetrasiddha jīva janma aura saṃharaṇako apekṣā do prakārake māne gaye haiṃ| inameṃ saṃharaṇasiddha thoḍe haiṃ aura janmasiddha garvahitakārī sarvajña jinendra ke śāsanameṃ saṃharaṇa siddhoṃko apekṣā saṃkhyāta gaṇe batalāye gaye haiṃ ||103-105|| ūrbalokase siddha honevāle thoḍa़e haiṃ, unase saṃkhyātaguṇe adholokase siddha honevāle haiṃ aura unase saṃkhyātaguṇe tiryaglokase siddha honevāle haiṃ ||106|| 1. siddhi niviśeṣairekadvitricaturthakaiḥ ma. | 2. pañcaviṃśā ma., pañcaviṃśāva kha. | 3. yataḥ ma. |

harivaṃśapurāṇe stokāḥ samudasiddhāstu syuḥ saṃkhyeyaguṇāḥ punaḥ | dvīpasiddhā itīhetthamaviśeṣeṇa bhāṣitāḥ ||17|| 'lavaṇode'tra ye siddhāḥ sarvatokāstu te stutāḥ| kālodasiddhā boddhavyāstatsaṃkhyeyaguṇāḥ sadā ||108|| ye jambūdvīpasiddhāste syuḥ saṃkhyeya guṇāstathā | dhātakīkhaṇḍasiddhāśca puṣkaradvīpagāstathā ||109|| yathā kṣetravibhāgena proktālpabahutā tathā | sā kālādivibhāgena veditavyā yathāgamam ||110|| iti dṛgjñānacāritratapasāmatyupāsakāḥ | somadattādayo'ntye te pañca bhūtvāraṇācyute ||111|| devāḥ sāmānikā bhogaṃ dvāviṃśatyabdhijīvinaḥ | bhuñjānāstasthuratyantaśudarśanadarśanāḥ ||112|| nāgaśrīrapi mṛtvāpa phalaṃ dhūmaprabhāvanau | anubhūya mahāduḥkhaṃ sā saptadaśasāgaram ||113|| bhūtvā svayaṃpramadvīpe duṣṭo dṛṣṭiviṣoragaḥ | trisāgaropamāyuṣkāṃ mṛtvāgādvālukāpramām ||114|| satrānubhūya duḥkhaughāṃścirādudvartya pāpataḥ | sasthāvarakāyeṣu sānayatsāgaradvayam ||115|| tato mātaṅgakanyābhūccampāyāṃ sānyadā muneḥ | samādhiguptataḥ kṛtvā madhumāṃsādivarjanam ||116|| jīvitānte subandhoḥ syāccampāyāmeva vaiśyataḥ | dhanavatyāṃ sutā jātā nāmnā ca sukumārikā ||117|| pāpānubandhadoṣeṇa sudurgandhaśarīrikā | rūpavatyapi vidveṣyā jātā yuvajanasya sā ||118|| vaiśyasya dhanadevasyāśokadattāsamudbhavau | tanayo jinadevaśca jinadattaśca viśrutau ||119|| kanyāṃ tāmapi durgandhā vṛtāṃ bandhumiragrajaḥ | parityajya pravavāja suvrataḥ suvratāntike ||120||
samudrase siddha honevāle thoḍa़e haiṃ, inase saṃkhyātaguṇe dvīpase siddha honevāle haiṃ, yaha sāmānyakī apekṣā kathana hai, viśeṣakī apekṣā lavaṇasamudra meṃ jo siddha hote haiṃ, ve sabase thoḍa़e haiṃ, unase saṃkhyātaguṇaṃ kālodadhise siddha honevāle haiṃ ||107-108|| jo jambadvīpase siddha hote haiṃ ve saṃkhyeyaguṇe haiṃ, unase saṃkhyātaguṇe dhātakīkhaṇḍase honevāle siddha haiṃ aura unase saṃkhyātaguṇe puṣkaradvīpase honevāle siddha haiṃ ||109|| jisa prakāra kṣetravibhāgako apekṣā alpabahutvakā kathana kiyā hai usī prakāra āgamake anusāra kāla ādi vibhāgako apekṣā bhī jānanā cāhie ||110||
isa prakāra samyagdarśana, samyagjñāna aura samyakcāritrakī atyanta upāsanā karanevāle somadatta ādi pāṃcoṃ jīva anta samaya marakara āraṇa acyuta svargameṃ sāmānika jātike deva hue| vahā~ bāīsa sāgarakī unakī āyu thī| atyanta śuddha samyagdarśanako dhāraṇa karanevāle ve deva uttama bhoga bhogate hue vahā~ bāīsa sāgara taka sthita rahe ||111-112|| vipamiśrita bhojana denevālī nāgaśrī bhī marakara dhūmaprabhānāmaka pā~caveṃ narakake phalako prāpta huī| vaha sattaraha sāgara taka vahāṃke mahāduḥkha bhogakara nikalī aura svayaṃprabhadvīpameṃ dṛṣṭivipa nāmakā duṣṭa sarpa huī| tadanantara marakara tīna sāgarako āyuvālī bālukāprabhānāmaka tīsarī pṛthvīmeṃ pahu~cī ||113-114|| vahā~ pāpake phalasvarūpa cirakāla taka duḥkhoṃ kā samūha bhogakara nikalī aura sasthāvara paryāyameṃ do sāgara taka bhaṭakatī rahī ||115|| tadanantara campāpurīmeṃ eka caṇḍālakī kanyā huī| vahāṃ usane eka dina samādhigupta nāmaka munirājake pāsa madhu-māṃsādikā tyāga kiyā ||116|| jisase anta samaya usī campāpurīmeṃ subandhu vaiśyako dhanavatī strīse sukumārikā nāmakī putrī huī ||117|| pāpake pūrva saṃskārase usake śarīrase tīvra durgandha

795 kanīyān jinadattastā bandhuvākyoparodhataḥ | pariṇoyāpi tatyāja durgandhāmatidūrataḥ ||12|| ātmānamapi nindantī sopavāsānyadā ca sā| kṣāntāryāmāthikāyuktāṃ bhojayitvātimaktitaḥ ||122|| abhivandya tadāpṛcchadāryike kena hetunā | ime paramarūpiṇyau sthite tapasi duṣkare ||123|| seti pṛṣṭā jagau hetumāryayostapasastayoḥ | prabodhanāya tasyāśca karuṇāparinoditā ||124|| śrayatāṃ sukumāri dve sukumārakumārike | hetutā yena tāpasye tapasvinyau vyavasthite ||125|| saudharmādhipaterdevyāvime pūrvatra janmani | vimalā suprabhā ceti suprasiddha babhūvatuḥ ||12|| te nandīśvarayātrāyāṃ jinapūjārthamāgate | kathaṃcijātasaṃvege cittāntaramiti śrite ||127|| manuṣyamavasaṃprāptī kariṣyāvo mahattapaḥ | āvāṃ strītvanimittaṃ tu yena duḥkhaṃ na dṛśyate ||128|| iti saṃgīrya te devyo divaḥ pracyusya bhūpateḥ | śrīṣeṇasyeha sākete śrīkāntāyāṃ suyoṣiti ||129|| hariṣeṇā sutā jyeṣṭhā śrīṣeṇā ca kanīyasī | jāte jāte ca kānte te yauvanaśrīvibhūṣite ||130|| svayaṃvaravidhī smṛtvā pūrva janma ca saṃgaram | bandhulokaṃ parityajya kumāyauṃ tapasi sthite ||131|| iti śrutvāryikāvākyaṃ nirviṇṇā sukumārikā | tadante sā pravavrāja saṃsāramayavedinī ||132|| tapasvinībhiranyābhistapasyantī tapasvinī| kālaṃ nītavatī nītyā tapasā śoṣitānikā ||133||

ye donoṃ pūrva bhavameṃ saudharma svargake indrakī vimalā aura suprabhā nāmakī deviyā~ thīṃ ||126|| eka dina ye nandīśvara parvakī yātrāmeṃ jinapūjāke lie āyī thīṃ ki kisī kāraṇa saṃsārase virakta ho cittameṃ isa prakārakā vicāra karane lagī ki yadi hama manuṣyabhavako prāpta hoṃ to mahātapa kareṃgī| aisā mahātapa ki jisase phira yaha strī-paryāyasambandhī dukha dikhāī nahīṃ degā ||127-128|| isa prakāra pratijñā kara ve deviyā~ svargase cyuta huī aura yahā~ ayodhyā nagarīke rājā śrīṣeṇakī śrīkāntā nāmaka strīse hariṣeṇā nāmakī baḍa़ī aura śrīṣeṇā nāmakī choṭī putrī huī| samaya pākara ye donoṃ hī rūpavatī aura yauvanarūpī lakṣmīse suśobhita ho gayīṃ ||129-130|| ina donoṃ kumāriyoṃkā svayaṃvara ho rahā thā ki usī samaya inheṃ apane pūrva janma tathā kī huī pratijñākā smaraṇa ho āyā jisase ye bandhujanoṃko choḍa़ tatkāla tapa karane lagīṃ ||131||

isa prakāra ariṣṭanemi purāṇake saṃgrahase yukta, jinasenācārya racita harivaṃśapurāṇameṃ yudhiṣṭhira ādi pā~ca pāṇḍavoṃ kī dīkṣākā varṇana karanevālā cauṃsaṭhavā~ parva samāpta huā ||64 ||

jisa prakāra agnimeṃ ūdhrvajvalana aura uṣṇatā, pānīmeṃ śītalatā, vāyumeṃ vega, sūrya candra ādi tejasvī padārthoṃ meṃ saba orase prakāśamānatā, ākāśameṃ amūrtikapanā aura pṛthivīmeṃ kisī padārthako dhāraṇa karanekī kṣamatā svabhāvase hī hotī hai, usī prakāra kṛtakṛtya jinendra bhagavānkā dharmopadeśa bhī svabhāvase hotā thā kisīkī preraṇāse nahīṃ ||8-9|| tadanantara yoganirodha karanevāle bhagavān nemijinendra aghātiyā karmoṃkā anta kara aneka sau muniyoṃke sātha nirvāṇa dhāmako prāpta ho gaye ||10|| jinake āge-āge indra cala rahe the aise cāroṃ nikāyake devoṃne

mṛdūpapādaśayyāyāmudapādi balo'maraḥ | mahāmaṇirivodāraratnākaramahākṣitau ||35|| bhāṣāmanaḥśarīrākṣaprāṇāhāraprasiddhibhiḥ | ṣaḍmiḥ paryāptibhiḥ sadyaḥ paryāpto'bhūtsurottamaḥ ||36|| śayane savatomare vastrābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ | vibudhaḥ sukhanidrānte yathātra navayauvanaḥ ||17|| vilokamānamālokya śabdairamarayoṣitām | surāṇāmanuraktānāmapyasāvabhinanditaḥ ||38|| candrādityādhikodāraprabhāvalaya dehabhṛt | iti dadhyau dhṛtadhyānaḥpramadāpūrṇamānasaḥ ||39|| ko'yaṃ ramyatamo deśaḥ ko'yaṃ pramudito janaḥ | ko'haṃ kvādya mavo'yaṃ me dharmaḥ ko vārjito mayā ||40|| bodhitaḥ suramukhyaiḥ sa sabhavapratyayāvadhiḥ | viveda sahasā devaḥ paurvāparyamaśeṣataḥ ||4|| jñātapūrvabhavāśeṣabandhubandhuhitodyataḥ | prāptābhiṣekakalyāṇaḥ svīkṛtātmaparicchadaḥ ||42|| avadhijñāta kṛṣṇaśca gatvāsau bālukāpramām | dṛṣṭvānujaṃ nijaṃ devo duḥkhitaṃ duḥkhito'bhavat ||43|| mahāprabhāvasaṃpane deve tatra tathāsthite | śabdagandharasasparśāḥ śubhatāmaśumā yayuḥ ||44|| ethehi kṛṣṇa yo'haṃ te bhrātā jyeṣṭho halāyudhaḥ | brahmalokādhipo bhūtvā tvatsamīpamihāgataḥ ||45|| ityuktvā taṃ samutya svarlokaṃ netumudyate | deve tasya vyalīyanta gātrāṇi navanītavat ||46|| tataḥ kṛṣṇo jagī deva bhrātaḥ kiṃ vyarthaceṣṭitaiḥ | kinna jñātaṃ yathā sarve jīvāḥ svakṛtabhoginaḥ ||47|| yathena yādṛśaṃ karma saṃsāre samupārjitam | tattena tādṛśaṃ bhrātarniyamādanubhūyate ||4||
ki viśāla ratnākarakī mahābhūmimeṃ mahāmaṇi utpanna hotā hai || 35 || vaha uttama deva vahā~ śīghra hī āhāra, śarīra, indriya, śvāsocchvāsa, bhāṣā aura mana ina chaha paryāptiyoṃse pūrṇa ho gayā ||36|| navayauvatase yukta evaṃ vastrābharaṇase vibhūṣita vaha deva, sarvatobhadra nāmaka śayyāpara aisā uṭhakara baiṭha gayā jaisā māno sukhanidrā pūrṇa honepara hī uṭhā ho || 37|| jaba isa devane cāroṃ ora dekhā taba anurāgase yukta devāṃganāoṃ aura devoṃke śabdoṃne isakā abhinandana kiyā || 38 || candramā aura sūryase bhī adhika utkṛṣṭa prabhāvalayase yukta śarīrako dhāraṇa karanevālā vaha deva, harṣase pūrṇa hṛdaya hotā huā isa prakārakā dhyāna karane lagā ki yaha atyanta sundara deśa kauna hai ? ye harṣase bhare jana kauna haiṃ ? maiṃ kauna hū~ ? merā yahāṃ kahāṃ janma huā hai ? aura maiṃne kisa dharmakā saṃcaya kiyā hai ? ||39-40||

vaha kahane lagā ki he kṛṣṇa ! āo, āo, jo maiṃ tumhārā baḍa़ā bhāī baladeva thā vahī brahmalokakā adhipati hokara yahā~ tumhāre pāsa āyā hū~ ||45|| yaha kahakara vaha deva jyoṃhī kṛṣṇake jīvako uṭhākara svargalokameṃ le jāneke lie udyata huā tyoṃhī usakā śarīra makkhanake samāna galakara vilīna ho gayā ||46||

śaknuyuḥ sukhamāhartuṃ hatuṃ vā duḥkhamaṅginām | devā yadi tato ghnanti mṛtyuduḥkhaṃ nijaṃ na kim ||49|| bhrātaryāhi tataḥ svargaṃ bhuṅkṣva puṇyaphalaṃ nijam | āyuṣo'nte'hamapyemi mokṣahetuṃ manuṣyatām ||50|| āva tatra tapaḥ kṛtvā jinaśāsanasevayā | mokṣasaukhyamavāpsyāvaḥ kṛtvā karmaparikṣayam ||51|| "āvāṃ putrādisaṃyuktau mahāvibhavasaṃgatau | bhārate darśayānyeṣāṃ vismayavyāptacetasām ||52|| śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇirmadīyapratimāgṛhaiḥ | bhārataṃ vyāpaya kṣetraṃ matkīrtiparivṛddhaye || 53 || ityādi vacanaṃ tasya pratipadya sureśvaraḥ | samyaktve śuddhimākhyāpya bhārataṃ kṣetramāgataḥ ||54|| bhrātṛsnehavaśo devo yathoddiṣṭaṃ sa viṣṇunā | cakre divyavimānasth cakrilāṅgaladarśanam ||55|| vāsudevagṛhaiścakre nagarādiniveśitaiḥ | viṣṇumohamayaṃ lokaṃ snehārdikaṃ vā na ceṣṭayate ||56|| brahmalokaṃ samāsādya kṛtajainamahāmahaḥ | vindan surasukhaṃ so'sthārasurastrīnivahāvṛtaḥ ||50||

sragdharā
uccairdeśasthito'pi pratimayapatanaṃ yāti pātālamūlaṃ bhuṅkte naivopalabdhaṃ viṣayasukharasaṃ sārasaṃsārasāram | snehādhikyādadhītaṃ smarati na tanubhṛtsevate pratyanīkaṃ
802
dhik dhik svarmokṣasaukhya pratighamatighanasnehamohaṃ janānām ||58||
kiyā hai, bhāī ! niyamase use vaisā hī phala bhoganā paḍa़tā hai ||48 || deva, yadi dūsare prāṇiyoṃ ke lie sukha dene aura duḥkha haranemeṃ samartha haiṃ to phira apanā hī mṛtyurūpī duḥkha kyoṃ nahīṃ
naṣṭa kara lete haiṃ || 49 ||
isalie bhāī ! svargako jāo aura apane puṇyakā phala bhogo | maiṃ bhī āyuke anta meṃ mokṣakā kāraṇa jo manuṣyaparyāya hai use prāpta karūṃgā ||50|| hama donoṃ usa manuṣya paryāya meṃ tapa kareṃge aura jinaśāsanakī sevāse karmoṃkā kṣaya kara mokṣa prāpta kareṃge || 51 || hā~, eka kāma āpa avaśya kareṃ ki 'bharata kṣetrameṃ hama donoṃko loga putra ādise sahita tathā mahāvaibhavase yukta dekheṃ aura hama logoṃ ko dekhakara dūsaroṃke citta āścaryase vyāpta ho jāveṃ ||12|| merī kīrtikī vṛddhi ke lie āpa śaṃkha, cakra tathā gadā hātha meṃ liye merī pratimāoṃke mandiroṃse samasta bharata kṣetrako vyāpta kara deṃ' | baladevakā jīva devendra kṛṣṇake pūrvokta vacana svīkāra kara tathā use samyagdarśanameṃ śuddhatā rakhanekā upadeśa de bharata kṣetra āyā || 53-54 || bhāīke snehake vaśībhūta hue usa devane kṛṣṇakā kahā saba kāma kiyā| usane divya vimānameṃ sthita kṛṣṇa aura baladevakā sabako darśana karāyā || 55 || tathā nagara-grāma ādimeṃ banavāye hue kṛṣṇake mandiroṃse saṃsārako kṛṣṇaviṣayaka mohase tanmaya kara diyā so ṭhīka hī hai kyoṃki snehase kyā-kyā ceṣṭā nahīṃ hotī hai ? ||56||
tadanantara devane brahmasvargaṃ jākara jinendra bhagavānkī pūjā kī aura vahā~ vaha striyoṃ ke samūhase āvṛta ho devoṃke sukhakā upabhoga karatā huā rahane lagā ||57 || gautama svāmī kahate haiṃ ki dekho snehakī adhikatāse yaha jīva ucca sthāna meṃ sthita hotā huā bhī bhayapūrṇa pātālake mūlameṃ jātā hai, śreṣṭa saṃsārake sārabhūta prāpta hue viṣayasukhakā upabhoga nahīṃ karatā hai, pahale adhyayana kiye hue śāstrakā smaraṇa nahīṃ rakhatā hai aura viparīta kāma karane lagatā hai isalie svarga aura mokṣa

ṣaṭṣaṣṭitamaḥ sargaḥ
vaṃśasthavṛttam
pratāpavaśyā khilarājake nṛpe praśāsati kṣmātalamupraśāsane | jaratkumāre janitādarāḥ prajāḥ prakāmamāpuḥ pramadaṃ dharātale || 1 || kaliṅgarājasya nṛpasya dehajā jaratkumārasya vadhūrvadhūttamā | sukhena lebhe jagataḥ sukhāvahaṃ vasudhvajaṃ rājakuladhvajaṃ sutam || 2 || sa tatra yūni vyavasāyini kṣitiṃ jaratkumāro harivaṃśaśekhare | nidhāya yātastapase vanaṃ satāṃ kulavataṃ tīvrataponiṣevaṇam ||3|| suto'bhavaccandra iva prajāpriyo 'vasudhvajākhyātsuvasurvasūpamaḥ | sa mīmavarmāsya kaliṅgapālakastadanvaye'tīyuranekaśo nṛpāḥ || 4 || kapiṣṭanāmānvayabhūṣaṇastvabhūdajātaśatrustanaya stato'bhavat | sa śatruseno'sya jitāriraṅgajastadaṅgajo'yaṃ jitaśatrurīśvaraḥ || 5 || bhavānna kiṃ śreṇika vetti bhūpatiṃ nṛpendrasiddhārtha kanīyasī patim | imaṃ prasiddhaṃ jitaśatrumākhyayā pratāpavantaṃ jitaśatrumaṇḍalam || 6 || jinendravīrasya samudbhavotsave tadāgataḥ kuṇḍapuraṃ suhṛtparaḥ | supūjitaḥ kuṇḍapurasya bhūbhṛtā nṛpo'yamākhaṇḍalatulyavikramaḥ ||7|| yaśodayāyāṃ sutayā yaśodayā pavitrayā vīravivāhamaṅgalam | aneka kanyāparivārayāruhatsamīkṣituṃ tuṅgamanorathaṃ tadā || 8 ||
tadanantara pratāpake dvārā samasta rājāoṃko vaśa karanevālā, ugraśāsanakā dhāraka rājā jaratkumāra jaba pṛthivīkā śāsana karane lagā taba usake prati prajāne bahuta ādara kiyā aura pṛthivītalapara adhika haṣaṃ prāpta kiyā || 1 || kaliṃga rājākī putrī jaratkumārakī uttama paṭṭarānī thī, usase usane jagat‌ko sukha denevālā evaṃ rājakulakī dhvajāsvarūpa vasudhvaja nāmakā putra prāpta kiyā || 2 || vyavasāyī tathā harivaṃśake śiromaṇi usa yuvāpara pṛthivīkā bhāra rakha jaratkumāra tapake lie vanako calā gayā so ṭhīka hī hai kyoṃki tīvra tapakā sevana karanā satpuruṣoṃkā kulavrata hai || 3 || vasudhvajake candramāke samāna prajāko ānanda denevālā kuberatulya suvasu nāmakā putra huā | suvasuke kaliṃga deśakī rakṣā karanevālā bhīmavarmā nāmakā putra huā aura usake vaṃśameṃ aneka rājā hue ||4|| tadanantara usī vaṃśakā ābhūṣaṇa kapiṣṭa nāmakā rājā huā, usake ajātaśatru, ajātaśatruke śatrusena, śatrusenake jitāri aura jitārike yaha jitaśatru nāmakā putra huā hai || 5 || he rājan śreṇika ! kyā tuma isa jitaśatruko nahīṃ jānate ? jisake sātha bhagavān mahāvīra ke pitā rājā siddhārthaṃkī choṭī bahanakā vivāha huā hai, jo atyanta pratāpī aura śatruoṃke samūhako jītanevālā hai || 6 || jaba bhagavān mahāvīrakā janmotsava ho rahā thā taba yaha kuṇḍapura āyā thā aura kuṇḍapurake rājā siddhārthane indrake tulya parākramako dhāraṇa karanevāle isa parama mitrakā acchā satkāra kiyā thā || 7 || isakī yaśodayā rānīse utpanna yaśodā nāmakī pavitra putrī thī| aneka kanyāoṃse sahita usa
1. vasudhvajāccāsuvasu ma | 2. yantritaśatru - ma. |

ṣaṭṣaṣṭitamaḥ sargaḥ
"sthite'tha nāthe tapasi svayaṃbhuvi prajātakaivalyaviśālalocane | jagadvibhūtyai viharatyapi kṣitiṃ kṣitiṃ vihāya sthitavāṃstapasyayam ||9|| amuṣya e jātātha tapobalānmuneravāptakaivalyaphalā manuṣyatā | manuṣya bhāvo hi mahāphalaṃ bhave bhavedayaṃ prāptaphalastapaḥphalāt ||10|| itīriteyaṃ harivaṃśasatkathā samāsataḥ śreṇika lokaviśrutā | triṣaṣṭisaṃkhyāna purāṇapaddhatipradeśa saṃbandhavatī śriye'stu te || 11 || "sugautamātpuṇyapurāṇapaddhatiṃ sapārthivaiḥ śreṇikapārthivastadā | dṛṣṭirākarṇya sakarṇatāṃ gato gataḥ puraṃ prītamatiḥ kṛtānatiḥ ||12|| caturṇikāyāmarakhecarādayo jinaṃ parītya praṇipatya maktitaḥ | yathāyathaṃ jagmurajanmakāṅkṣiṇaḥ prasiddhasaddharmakathānurāgiṇaḥ ||13|| vihṛtya pūjyo'pi mahīṃ mahīyasāṃ mahāmunirmocitakarmabandhanaḥ | iyāya mokṣaṃ jitaśatrukevalo nirantasaukhyapratibaddha makṣayam ||14|| jinendravīro'pi vibodhya saṃtataṃ samantato bhavyasamūhasaṃtatim | prapatha pāvānagarī garīyasīṃ manoharodyānavane tadīyake || 15 || caturtha kāle'rdhacaturtha māsa kairvihīnatā viśvaturabdaśeṣake | sa kārtike svātiṣu kṛṣṇabhūtasuprabhātasandhyāsamaye svabhāvataḥ || 16 ||
3
yaśodākā bhagavān mahāvīra ke sātha vivāha - maṃgala dekhanekī yaha utkaṭa abhilāṣā rakhatā thā | parantu svayambhū bhagavān mahāvīra tapake lie cale gaye aura kevalajñānarūpī viśāla netra prāpta kara jagatkā kalyāṇa karaneke lie pṛthivīpara vihāra karane lage, taba yaha svayaṃ bhī pṛthivīko choḍa़ tapameṃ līna ho gayā || 8- 9|| āja muni jitaśatruko tapake phalasvarūpa kevalajñāna utpanna huā hai aura usase unakā manuṣyaparyāya sārthaka huā hai so ṭhīka hī hai, kyoṃki saṃsārameṃ manuṣyaparyāya mahāphalasvarūpa tabhī hotā hai jaba vaha tapake phalasvarūpa isa kevalajñānarūpī phalako prāpta kara letā hai ||10||

gautama svāmī kahate haiṃ ki he śreṇika ! maiṃne yaha lokaprasiddha tathā tresaṭhaśalākā puruṣoṃ ke purāṇapaddhati se sambandha rakhanevālī harivaṃśakī kathā saṃkṣepase kahī hai so tujhe lakṣmokī prāpti ke lie ho ||11|| samyagdarśanase suśobhita rājā śreṇika aneka rājāoṃke sātha gautama gaṇadharase isa pavitra purāṇakā varṇana suna apane kānoṃko saphala mānane lagā tathā namaskārakara prasanna hotā huā apane nagarako calā gayā ||12|| mokṣakī icchā rakhanevāle evaṃ prasiddha samīcīna dharmakathā ke anurāgī cāroṃ nikāyake deva aura vidyādhara jinendra bhagavān‌ko pradakṣiṇā dekara tathā praṇāma kara apane-apane sthānoṃpara cale gaye || 13|| baḍa़e-baḍa़e puruṣoṃke dvārā pūjya mahāmuni jitaśatru kevalī bhī pṛthivīpara vihāra kara antameṃ karmabandhase rahita ho ananta sukhase yukta avināśī mokṣapadako prāpta hue || 14 || bhagavān mahāvīra bhī nirantara saba orake bhavyasamūhako saṃbodhakara pāvānagarī pahu~ce aura vahā~ ke 'manoharodyāna' nāmaka vanameṃ virājamāna ho gaye ||15|| jaba caturthakālameṃ tīna varṣaṃ sāḍha़e āṭha māsa bākī rahe taba svāti nakṣatra meṃ kārtika amāvāsyāke dina prātaḥ kālake samaya svabhāvase hī yoga nirodhakara ghātiyākarmarūpa īṃdhana ke samāna aghātiyākarmīko bhī

harivaṃśapurāṇe aghātikarmāṇi niruddhayogako vidhūya ghātīndhanavadvibandhanaḥ | vibandhanasthānamavāpa śaṃkaro nirantarāyorusukhānubandhanam ||17|| sa pañcakalyāṇamahāmaheśvaraḥ prasiddhanirvāṇamahe caturvidhaiḥ | śarīrapūjāvidhinā vidhānataḥ suraiḥ samabhyayaṃta siddhaśāsanaḥ ||18|| jvalatpradīpālikayā pravṛddhayā surāsuraiḥ dīpitayā pradīptayā | tadā sma pāvānagarī samantataḥ pradīpitākāśatalā prakāśate ||19|| tathaiva ca śreṇikapa prakṛtya kalyāṇamahaṃ sahaprajāḥ | prajagmurindrāśca surairyathāyathaṃ prayācamānā jinabodhisarthinaḥ ||20|| tatastu lokaḥ prativarṣamādarātprasiddhadīpālikayātra mārate | samudyataḥ pūjayituṃ jineśvaraṃ jinendranirvāṇavibhūtimaktimāk ||21|| trayaḥ kramākevalino jinātpare dviṣaṣṭivarṣāntarabhāvino'bhavan | tataḥ pare pañca samastapūrviṇastapodhanā varṣaśatāntare gatāḥ ||22|| dhyaśītike varṣaśate tu rūpayuk daśaiva gītā daśapūrviṇaḥ śate | dvaye ca viṃśe'ṅgabhṛto'pi pañca te śate ca sāṣṭādaśake caturmuniḥ ||23|| guruḥ subhadro jayabhadranāmakaḥ paro yaśobāhuranantarastataḥ |
mahāhalohāryaguruśca ye dadhuḥ prasiddhamācāramahāṅgamatra te ||24|| naṣṭa kara bandhanarahita ho saṃsārake prāṇiyoṃko sukha upajāte hue nirantarāya tathā viśāla sukhase sahita nibaṃndha-mokṣa sthānako prāpta hae ||16-17|| garbhādi pāṃcoṃ kalyāṇakoṃke mahāna adhipati, siddhaśāsana bhagavāna mahāvīrake nirvāṇa mahotsavake samaya cāroṃ nikāyake devoṃne vidhipūrvaka unake śarīrakī pūjā kī ||18|| usa samaya sura aura asuroṃke dvārā jalāyī huī bahuta bhārī dedīpyamāna dīpakoṃkī paṃktise pāvānagarīkā ākāśa saba orase jagamagā uṭhā ||19|| śreṇika ādi rājāoṃne bhī prajāke sātha milakara bhagavānke nirvāṇa kalyāṇakakī pūjā kī| tadanantara baḍa़ī utsukatāke sātha jinendra bhagavāna ke ratnatrayakī yācanā karate hue indra devoṃ ke sātha-sātha yathāsthāna cale gaye ||20|| usa samayase lekara bhagavānke nirvāṇakalyāṇakī bhaktise yukta saṃsārake prāṇī isa bharatakṣetrameṃ prativarṣa ādarapūrvaka prasiddha dīpamālikāke dvārā bhagavān mahāvīrakī pūjā karaneke lie udyata rahane lage | bhāvārtha-unhīṃko smṛtimeṃ dīpāvalīkā utsava manāne lage ||21||
__ bhagavān mahāvīrake nirvāṇake bāda bāsaṭha varṣameṃ kramase gautama, sudharma aura jambūsvāmī ye tīna kevalī hue | unake bāda sau varṣa meṃ samasta pūrvoko jānanevāle pāṃca śru takevalī hue ||22|| tadanantara eka sau terāsī varṣa meṃ gyāraha muni daśa pūrvake dhāraka hue| unake bāda do sau bīsa varṣa meṃ pāṃca muni gyāraha aṃgake dhārī hue| tadanantara eka sau aṭhāraha varṣameṃ subhadraguru, jayabhadra, yaśobāhu aura mahāpūjya lohāyaṃguru ye cāra muni prasiddha ācārāṃgake dhārī hue ||23-24||

ṣaṭṣaṣṭitamaḥ sargaḥ
mahātapobhṛdvineyaṃvaraḥ śrutāmṛṣiśrutiṃ guptapadādikāṃ dadhat | munīśvaro'nyaḥ śivaguptasaṃjñako guṇaiḥ svamarhadbalirapyadhātpadam ||25|| samandarāryo'pi ca mitravīravi gurū tathānyau baladevamitrakau | vivardhamānāya triratnasaṃyutaḥ śriyānvitaḥ siṃhabalaśca vīravit ||26|| sa padmaseno guṇapadmakhaṇḍabhṛd guṇāgraṇīrvyāghrapadādihastakaḥ | sa nāgahastī jivadaṇḍanāmabhṛtsanandiṣeṇaḥ prabhudīpa senakaḥ ||27|| tapodhanaḥ śrīdharasenanāmakaḥ sudharmaseno'pi ca siṃhasenakaḥ | sunandiṣeṇeśvarasena ko prabhū sunandiṣeṇā mayasenanāmakau || 28 || sa siddhaseno'maya bhīmasenako guru parau tau jinaśāntiṣeṇakau | akhaṇḍaṣeṭkhaṇḍamakhaṇḍitasthitiḥ samastasiddhāntamadhatta yo'rthataḥ ||29|| dadhāra karmaprakṛtiṃ śrutiṃ ca yo jitākṣavṛttirjayasenasadguruḥ | prasiddhavaiyyākaraṇaprabhāvavānaśeṣarāddhānta samudrapāragaḥ || 30 || tadīyaśiṣyo'mita sena sadguruḥ pavitrapunnāṭagaṇāgraṇīgaṇī | jinendra sacchāsanavatsalātmanā tapobhṛtā varṣaśatādhijāṃvinā ||31|| suśāstradānena vadānyatāmunā vadānyamukhyena bhuvi prakāśitā | 'yadagrajo dharmasahodaraḥ śamī samagradhīrdharma ivāttavigrahaḥ || 32 || tapomaya kīrtimaśeṣadikṣu yaḥ kṣipan babhau kīrtitakīrtiṣeṇakaḥ |
ke bāda mahātapasvī vinayaṃdhara, guptaśruti, guptaṛṣi, munīśvara śivagupta, arhadabali, mandarārya, mitravīravi, baladeva, mitraka, baḍha़te hue puṇyase sahita ratnatrayake dhāraka evaṃ jñānalakṣmī se yukta siṃhabala, vīravit, guṇarūpī kamaloṃke samūhako dhāraṇa karanevāle padmasena, guṇoṃse śreṣṭha vyāghrahasta, nāgahastī, jitadaṇḍa, nandiṣeṇa, svāmī dīpasena, tapodhana śrīdharasena, sudhamaṃsena, siṃhasena, sunandiṣeṇa, īśvarasena, sunandiṣeṇa, abhayasena, bhīmasena, jinasena aura śāntisena ācāryaṃ hue | tadanantara jo akhaṇḍa maryādāke dhāraka hokara paripūrṇa ṣaṭkhaṇḍoṃ ( 1 jīvasthāna, 2 kṣudrabandha, 3 bandhasvāmī, 4 vedanākhaṇḍa, 5 vagaṃṇākhaṇḍa ora 6 mahābandha ) se yukta samasta siddhāntako artharūpase dhāraṇa karate the arthāt ṣaṭkhaṇḍāgamake jñātā the, karmaprakṛtirūpa śrutike dhāraka the aura indriyoṃkī vṛttiko jītanevāle the aise jayasena nāmaka guru hue | unake śiṣya amitasena guru hue jo prasiddha vaiyākaraṇa, prabhāvaśālī aura samasta siddhāntarūpī sāgarake pāragāmī the| ye pavitra punnāṭa gaṇake agraṇī - agresara ācārya the| jinendra śāsanake snehī, paramatapasvī, sau varṣakī āyuke dhāraka evaṃ dātāoṃ meṃ mukhya ina amitasena ācāryaṃne śāstradānake dvārā pṛthivīmeṃ apanī vadānyatā - dānaśīlatā prakaṭa kī thī | inhīṃ amitasenake agraja dharmabandhu kīrtiṣeṇa nāmaka muni the jo bahuta hī śānta the, pūrṇa buddhimāna the, śarīradhārī dharmake samāna jāna paḍa़te the, aura jo apanī tapomayī kīrtiko samasta diśāoṃ meṃ prasārita kara rahe the | unakā prathama śiṣya maiṃ jinasena huā | mokṣake utkṛṣṭa sukhakā upabhoga karanevāle ariṣṭanemi jinendrakī bhakti se yukta mujha jinasena sūrine apane sāmarthyaṃke anusāra alpabuddhise isa harivaṃśapurāṇakī racanā kī
